## Publishers Note

This volume of Sarvarth Chintamani has been sadly over delayed due to the sudden demise of its renowned author Sh. J.N. Bhasin. In his absence the Publishers had to over come many difficulties, which, if he had been with us could have been sorted out without any effort two years ago. The manual proofs of over 'hundred, pages had to be discarded as they distorted the image, the learned author wanted to present. A search of the original text in sanskrit had to be made; with help of Shri S.S. Sareen, but for whom the present form and shape could have not been possible. He has not only edited the original manuscript but revised and set them in order so that a presentable shape to such a rare and ancient text could be provided with English rendering, a long felt need of our readers.

The publisher expresses his heart felt gratitude to Shri S.S. Sareen, Shri Girish Chand Sharma & Shri Vivek Seth to make the book what it is now before you.

# INTRODUCTORY NOTE

(1) “Sarvarth Chintamani” is one of the top astrological works. From the point of view of practical utility it offers very valuable comments on the subjects relating to each of the 12 houses of a birth chart. It has the unique distinction of following a procedure where by the main subject or objects pertaining to a house are first of all stated in the very beginning of the chapter relating to that house and then each of those subjects is dealt with in a suitable astrological way on the basis of the house concerned, its lord and its significator and the results—good and bad—declared.

(2) For example in the first shloka of chapter 3 dealing with the affairs of the 2nd house of the horoscope the author—Shri Venktesh Sharma has given family, dependents, mouth, speech, right eye, accumulated wealth, education, eating, servents & friend as the affairs covered by the 2nd house. He then deals with each of these affairs in detail. For example: He states that if a natural benefic Planet occupies the 2nd house, and the lord of the 2nd is also a natural benefic Planet and the significator—the Sun—is under good influence the man has broad eyes with good sight. Similar treatment is accorded to other affairs.

(3) On certain important points which required special mention we have inserted our notes bringing out the value of that specific point, with apt illustrations from actual life. It is hoped these notes and illustrations will go a long way in bringing out the true import of the shlokas.

(4) The aspects of Rahu and Ketu are conspicuous in this book by their absence. But we have added suitable notes to fill in the omission in this respect.

(5) It is our conviction that a birth chart having correct longitudes according to correct ayanamsa would give correct balance of dasa. Divination carried out on the basis of such a dasa with due regard to the aspects of the nodes and to the functioning of the planets as dispositors, would give correct results when applied to the house involved, the lord of that house & its significator.

(6) In regard to the use of correct ayanamsa we would recommend on the basis of our experience that the value of the Shri Lahiri's ayanamsa as applicable to a particular date should be reduced by 1 degree and 7 minutes and the longitude of Moon then arrived at should be used to ascertain the balance of dasa. In the alternative the longitude of Moon according to Shri Lahiri should be increased by 1 degree & 7 minutes & the balance of dasa arrived.

## SARVARTH CHINTAMANI
CHAPTER-1

श्रीमकेष्यीरेसतायिनलय श्रीमकेष्यो गुंक
नत्वा वेकतनायक कतवुदिन चातोहमायतसूपी : 11
ज्ञोटि : शास्तर महाखिद्यारामने वध्यायिन पोतालसक
ज्ञोटि : शास्तर विवेक पाक विवृपो सव्यायितसूपी 11 9 11

Shri Venket Sharma, the author, offers the following opening prayer (mangalacharanam):
"After bowing repeatedly to Lord Venketeshwar, who has his abode on the side of the mountain called "Sheshadri" and to the most respectable Guru of mine whose grace has made me Pandit Vyankat sharma. I offer the book "Sarvarth Chintamani" as a ship to cross the Great ocean of Astrology by the people learned in the art of astrological divination. (1)

नीलौखुद्यातिर देव सव्यायित मनोरयम 11
देवा : प्रगण्य ये सव्ये तै नमामित गाणननम 11 2 11

I bow to Shri Ganesh, who has the lustre like a blue Lotus and by worshipping whom all the gods easily get their desired object. (2)

वातिवमुतिरबा देवी या फरेतौडुद्यातिरता 11
गोहीरियवलकारा सव्य ठितौडु वातिवम देव 11 इ 11

May the Godess Sarasvati, who bestows on men the wealth of speech, who has her abode in the white Lotus and whose complexion is white like the Cow's milk, make my speech as her abode. (3)

मेयादिरशाय: सव्ये दिनेशायमुद्या प्रहार: 11
ये ब लोकोपोकतारे: पोतू मानिमह तै सव्य 11 8 11

May the signs Aries etc. the Planets Sun etc and others engaged in the welfare of mankind, always give me their protection. (4)

यज्जातके निगारित मुद्यि मानवाना तत्यारिनकेपी सव्यलकल कययातित तज्जा. 11
प्रश्नोपी चन्द्रसूपो मववित प्रश्नदेव: प्रश्नस्य चार जननस्य नं काशिचवितसूपो 11 9 11

---

Whatever principles have been enunciated in the Natal Astrology, are equally applicable to the "Horary" Astrology. There is no difference between the two (Horary relates to chart of the heaven prepared for the moment of query). (5)

मोझाच्चिवस्तरविषुक्रणप्रकेप मंबाकेशूतामरेखा : 11
मेयादिनानामरेखा : क्रमेग तन्द्रकानामरेखा ते मंबेग : 11 इ 11

The lords of the 12 signs Aries to Pisces are Mars, Venus, Mercury, Moon, Sun, Mercury, Venus, Mars, Jupiter, Saturn, Saturn and Jupiter respectively. The lord of a navamsa is the same as that of the sign as stated above. (6)

## TRANSLATOR'S NOTE

The idea underlying the lordship of the plantets over the signs is to state the fact that the various signs always act like the planets having lordship over them. For details regarding Navamsha. (See Shloka 11.)

The sign Pisces is symbolised by two fish with the tail of one on the mouth of the other, Sagittarius by a man with the lower portion as of a horse and with bow in the hand, Gemini by a pair of man and woman, holding mace and the musical instrument-veena, Virgo by a girl in a boat, holding a fire pot in one hand and grains in the other, Libra by a man with balance in the hand, Aquarius by a man carrying on his shoulder a water pot. The traits of the rest of the signs are as denoted by their names i.e. Aries by lamb, Taurus by an ox, Cancer by crab, the sea creature of that name, Scorpio by Scorpion. (8-9)

A decante (Drikaan) consists of one third part of a sign. The first decante i.e. from degrees 1 to 10 has the same planet as its lord as the lord of the sign whose 1st decante it is. The 2nd decante from degrees 11 to 20 is owned by the planet who is lord of the sign 5th to the sign under consideration. The 3rd decante from 21 to 30 degrees is owned by the planet lord of the sign 9th to that under consideration. In even signs the lord of the first hora i.e. the first 15 degrees is Moon & of the next is the Sun, while in the case of odd signs the hora of the first half of the sign belongs to the Sun & the second half to Moon. (10)

The first Navamsha sign in the cardinal signs 1, 4, 7, & 10 is the lord of the sign itself i.e. Mars, Moon, Venus & Saturn respectively.

---

The first Navamsha sign in the fixed signs 2,5.8 and 11 are the signs 9th from the sign i.e. 10,1,4 and 7 respectively. The first Navamsa sign in signs 3,6,9 & 12 are the signs fifth from the sign i.e. 7,10,1 & 4 respectively. (The rest follow in the order as stated in shloka-6.) (11)

## TRANSLATORS NOTE

Since the order of the Navamsha signs is the same as in the natural order Aries Taurus ete to Pisces there is a very simple way to find out the Navamsha sign. Suppose we desire to find out the 1st Navamsha sign in the sign Gemini. Multiply the number of signs past i.e.2 by9. The result gives the signs past i.e. 18 or Virgo (12 plus 6) hence the first sign in Gemini would be the sign next to Virgo i.e. Libra.

Example 2 Find out the sign representing the 4th Navamsha of Sagittarius. Here $ 8 \times9=7 2 $ plus 4 = 76 divided by 12 leaves 4 i.e. the answer & lord of 4 i.e. Moon is the lord of the 4th Navamsha of Sagittarius.

The 1st 1/12th part of a sign belongs to the sign itself & the other parts come in the order of the signs. As regards the 30th part, in the odd signs the lords of the first 5 degrees is Mars, of the 6th to 12th degrees Saturn, of the 13th to 20th degrees Jupiter, of the 21st to 25th degrees Mercury, of the 26th to 30th Venus. In the even signs the order is reverse i.e. the first 5 degrees belong to Venus, 6th to 10th to Mercury, 11th to 18th to Jupiter, 19th to 25th to Saturn & 26th to 30th to Mars.

In the odd signs the first 1/10th division belongs to the lord of the sign itself and in even signs the 1st 1/10th division belongs to the lord of the sign counted 9th from it. The order of signs is natural one. The lords of these divisions are the 10 dik pals (lords of directions). In the 1/16th division the lords of the divisions are the lords of the signs Aries to Pisces & then Aries to Cancer. In the sign Taurus the signs would be 5 to 12 & then 1 to 8 & so on (See the table). (14, 15)

In the 1/24th division the signs from Aries & other odd signs start with Leo. In the case of even signs these start with Cancer as shown in the table.

As regards the 1/27th division the 1st 27th division of the sign Aries belongs to Aries. 2nd 27th division to the next sign & so on, till the 27th which will in this order be governed by Gemini. Hence the 1st 27th division of Taurus will be governed by Cancer & so on. In the 1/40th division, the first division in all odd signs belongs to the sign Aries; while in all even signs, it belongs to Libra, as shown in the table. In the 1/45 division, the 1st division of every movable sign belongs to Aries; the 1st of every fixed sign, to Leo and the first of every common sign, to Sagittarius. The order of the signs owned remains the natural one. (6-14)

Planet with full strength such as by being in exaltation, in positive sign, but located in a malefic 1/60th division gets harmed (21)
A planet in its own sign, in kendra, in friendly sign, in positive sign, located in its own sign in the 7 vargas, in a bosom friends sign is called "uttam" (best). (22)

वागितु ये द्या प्रोत्ता : पूर्वचार्यमहासिम : 11 मविती वागितों पारिजताओं संख्यक : 11 22 11 उत्तल्यारिनिमहासिम प्रधा बलिवितिमथा : 11 मर्गावस्यास्त्रु पारिजताओं दिनशका : 11 28 11

The ancient Acharyas and Maharshis have mentioned ten fold division of the longitudes of planets etc. They have termed the number of vargas or division obtained as "Parijat" etc. Planets which are located in bad houses i.e. 6th, 8th & 12th, in their inimical sign or in their debilitation sign or are eclipsed by the Sun or are otherwise weak by being in 'Maranavastha' i.e. in the end of a sign, destroy the good results arising out of the good vargas or divisions got by them through their longitude. (23, 24)

उत्सम तु सिवोंकण चट्टफंर तु गौुरस्म। वापिककस्यों सिहासनिमहासिमथें 112911 कर्मिद्य पारिजतात फ़गणा पारावतात्रकस्म। सदम देवलोक स्याद्दम चामरे मवेत 112911 इरावत तु नवम फलल तेथा पूर्वकृष्णमथें 112911

If in the longitude of the planet etc there are two beneficial divisions, it is called "Paarijaat". If 3, it is called "Uttam", if 4 "Gopur", if 5 "Simhaasan", if 6 "Paaraavat" if 7 "Devlok", if 8 "Amār", if 9 "Airaavat", & if 10 it is called "Vaisheshik". The results of these are different (see next shloka). (25-27)

एरावते सावमोम : सवेश्यवर्षमहासिमथें 11 देवलोक महावनकस्यों राया सिहासनिमहासिमथें 112911 पारावते मध्यदिक : सवेश्यवर्षमहासिमथें 11 सिहासने सवेश्यवर्षमहासिमथें सवेश्यवर्षमहासिमथें 11 उत्सम सकला सवेश्यवर्षमहासिमथें सवेश्यवर्षमहासिमथें 112911 सवेश्यवर्षमहासिमथें सवेश्यवर्षमहासिमथें 112911

In the case of "Airaavat" division one becomes emperor, in "Devlok" one is highly charitable, in "Paaraavat" one is king knowing all sciences & arts, if in "Simhaasan". One is the object of praise every where, in "Gopur" one is wealthy & a man of allround knowledge. if in "Uttam" one has all kinds of wealth & if in "Pari-jat" one is fairly rich. If the planet has the division denoting his own sign the native is famous, intelligent, and leads a comfortable life. (28-31)

Planets located in odd signs are (symbolically) given the names,
"child" "boy" "youth" "old" & "dead" when occupying the degrees
1 to 6, 7 to 12, 13 to 18, 19 to 24 & 25 to 30 respectively in the
occupied sign. If they are located in even signs the names for the 5
states involved are given in the reverse order i.e. "Death", "Old",
"Youth", "Boy" & "Child" respectively. Planets in their ruling
periods give their results with a strength in keeping with the age
specified (36, 37).

The synonyms of the various sign in the Sanskrit language are:
Aries is called Meshaj, Vasta Pratham, kriy; Taurus is called
Vrishabha, Uksha, Go, Tavari, Shukra Bham (sign of Venus)
Gemini is called Mithun, Baudh, Nriyugma, Jitum, Triteeya, Cancer is called Karka, Chaandram, kuleer, chaturth, Leo is called Simha, Kanthirav, Leya, Virgo is called Kanya Pathon, Shashti, & Abala, Libra is called Jook, Vanik, Saptam, Tula, & Tauli, Scorpio is called Kaurpya, Ashtam, Vrishchik kauj, & Ali, Sagittarius is called Jaiva, Dhanu, Taukshik, chaap, Capricorn is called Aakekar Dasham, Ciiakra, & Makar, Aquarius is called Hridrog, Kumbha, Ghat, Pisces is called Rishph, Meena, Jhash, Antim, & Meena (38 & 41).

# SYNONYMNS FOR HOUSES

The first house is named as hora, tanu, (body) moorti, (complexion) udaya, (rising) shir, (head). The second is called vaag (speech), vitta (wealth), kutumba (family), eye. The 3rd is called sahotha (brother), dushchikya, gala (throat). The 4th is called shourya (bravery), karna (ears), sukha, water, bandhu (comforts, water & friend & relatives) rasatal (nadir) hibuk (chest) veshma (residence), patal (nadir) hrid (heart), vahan (conveyance) matri (mother). The 5th is called budhi (intellect), prabhav (influence), aatmaj (son), mantra (advisory capacity), vivek (discrimination), udar (belly). The 6th is called disease, kshat (injury), ari (enemies), vysanam (addiction), chor (theft), vighana (obstacles). The 7th is called chittoth, kaam, madan (sexual urge), wife, bhrtri (husband), dadih, (curd) soup. The 8th is called ksheer (milk) gudam (gur) montra kricha (urinary trouble), goohya (hidden) randhra (bad) marana anta (death) Aayou (age). The 9th is termed as dharma (duty), daya (compassion) paitrik (father) bhagya (luck), guru (preceptor) tapas (penance) laabh (gains) shubhaarjitaani (earned merit). The 10th is termed as aagya (orders) maan (honour) dashma (tenth) karma (actions) aspad (position) kham (sky). The 11th is termed as ayam & laabh (gains). The 12th is termed as vyaya (expenditure) antya (last sign) rishpha (bad) vinash (destruction) (42-46)

Planets located in the 6th, 8th or 12th house lose their influence. So also is the case with the houses whose lords occupy these three houses. The signs Aries, Taurus, Gemini, Cancer, Sagittarius and Capricorn are called "Prishtodaya" signs i.e. Rising with their hind part and are strong in charts with night birth. Signs Leo, Virgo, Libra, Scorpio, Aquarius & Pisces are strong in birth chart for day birth. These are called. "Sheershodaya" signs i.e. those which rise with their front part. But the sign Pisces rises in both ways i.e. with fore as well as hind part. (47-48)

By adding 13 degrees 20 minutes to the longitude of the Sun in
the birth chart we get the longitude of the space point called
"dhoom". By deducting from 12 signs the longitude of dhoom we
get the remainder as the longitude of the space point called "paat"
or vyatipat". By deducting 6 signs from this longitude we get the
longitude of the space point called "paridhi" or "parivesh". By
deducting parivesh from 12 signs we get remainder as "chaap" or
"dhanu" by adding 16 degrees and 40 minutes to Dhanu we get
Ketu. By adding 2 signs to Ketu we get again the longitude of the
Sun with which we started. (49)

The watery signs (second half of Capricorn, Aquarius and Pisces) are strong when located in the 4th house. The animal signs
(Aries, Taurus and Leo), the first half of Capricorn and 2nd half of Sagittarius) are strong when located in the 10th house. The human
signs(Gemini, Virgo & Libra and 1st half of Sagittarius) are strong in the 1st house and the insect signs(Cancer and Scorpio) are
strong when located in the 7th house. The signs, located in the 7th
house from where they get strength, are without strength. In the
intermediary position their strength is proportional. (51)

Sun is in its highest exaltation in the 10th degree of Aries, Moon
in the 3rd degree of Taurus, Mars in the 28th degree of Capricorn,
Mercury in 15th degree of Virgo, Jupiter in 5th degree of Cancer,
Venus in the 27th degree of Pisces, Saturn in the 20th degree of
Libra.

The mooltrikon or positive sign for the Sun is Leo; for Moon,
Taurus; for Mars, Aries; for Mercury, Virgo; for Jupiter, Sagit- tarius; for Venus. Libra and for Saturn Aquarius. Planets in their positive signs are very strong, only a little less than when in exaltation. (52,53)

## TRANSLATOR'S NOTE

A question may be raised as to why a particular Planet gets exalted in a particular sign & degree. So far as we are aware no author has answered this question. We, however, think that this can be explained on the basis of spirituality to which astrology owes allegiance being its main limb. The 10th degree of Aries falls in the asterism Ashvini whose lord is Ketu. Ketu has been declared by astrology as the "Moksha" karka i.e. the significator for salvation. The Sun is very well known as the "Atma" in the Vedas.

(सूत्रे : आत्मा जगतस्तरश्यप्रथम)

Thus Sun in the 10th degree of Aries means Atma in Moksha. obviously the highest state that the Atma can aspire to. Thus the exaltation of Sun in the 10th degree of Aries is perfectly in consonance with the spiritual principles. Now, why is Sun exalted in Aries & not in Leo or Sagittarius, for if availability of Ketu is the criterion, this asterism is equally available in Leo & Sagittarius. The answer to this part of the question is that Leo and Sagittarius belong to the "Satvik" Sun and Jupiter. The signs of these planets can hardly constitute a testing ground for the exalted Sun. It is only the sign of the sinful Mars which can offer a suitable testing ground for the purpose, for Atma in Moksha is untouched by sin.

(2) Moon is exalted in the 3rd degree of Taurus. This degree falls in the asterism "Kritika" belonging to the Sun. The Moon is mind.

(चन्द्रमा नसरसों अत्):

Mind immersed in the Atma represents the highest state of Samadhi. Nothing higher can be desired for the mind. Hence the exaltation in the asterism "Kritika". Now, why Taurus is preferred when the asterisms of Sun are available in the signs 5,6,9, & 10? The answer is that none of these four signs offer an emotional & luxurious testing gound as does the sign Taurus—the sign of the luxurious and amorous Venus. Hence the choice. Mars is exalted in the 28th degree of Capricorn in the asterism "Dhanishta" belonging to Mars himself. We know from astrology that Mars is a great martial planet. For a solidier to retain his mettle & bravery, even when surrounded by enemies in the enemy's camp, is his highest attainment. This is exactly what happens when Mars occupies Capricorn—the sign of its bitter enemy, Saturn. Hence the justification for exaltation in Capricorn. The asterism of Mars, no doubt, is also available in the signs 2,3,6,7 & 11; but Mercury, the boy & Venus, the neutral can hardly test the bravery of Mars through their signs. As regards Aquarius, Mars in Capricorn is more strong than in Aquarius. In Capricorn it is near the asterism of Mars while it is near that of Rahu in Aquarius.

(3) Mercury gets exalted in the 15th degree of Virgo. This degree falls in the asterism “Hasta” belonging to Moon. Now Mercury is a highly intellectual planet. Its intellect is a great asset. But too much of intellect can ruin man as we have seen in the development of the Atom Bomb. It is therefore highly desirable that intellect should be compassionate also. If it can be so nothing more can make intellect exalted. This is exactly what happens when Mercury in its own sign still retains compassion by being in the asterism of Moon. Here again the point is that the asterism of Moon is available in the signs 2 & 10. Why has Virgo been given preference over signs 2 & 10? The answer is that in none of these signs Mercury retains its intellectual eminence. It is only by retaining intellect with compassion that Mercury can be considered as exalted. Hence the justification.

(4) Jupiter gets exalted in the 5th degree of Cancer, belonging to the asterism “Pushya” whose lord is Saturn. Jupiter is the significator of wealth. Hence it has plenty of riches. It is also the most spiritual planet. Hence it is fed up with wealth. It believes in the maxim that man does not live by bread alone. Hence its aim is spiritual Samadhi, which is a state of “Shoonya” or absence of matter. This state is afforded easily by Saturn. Hence Jupiter gets exalted in the asterism Pushya. Here again emotions & desires are hinderances to Samadhi. Jupiter’s exaltation is tested in the emotional sign of Cancer. No other sign affords Samadhi and emotional ground. Hence Cancer is most appropriate.

(5) Venus gets exalted in 27th degree of Pisces which falls in the asterism Revaṁi belonging to Mercury. Venus, a most luxury loving and sensuous planet, is normally averse to the precepts of the shastras denoted by Jupiter. But when he gets the spiritual intellect of Mercury he gets changed spiritually & then Pisces constituting a testing ground for him no longer remains a problem for him. No other sign containing the asterism of Mercury is religious enough to offer a testing ground to Venus.

(6) Saturn is exalted in the 20th degree of Libra. The degree falls in the asterism “Swati” belonging to Rahu. Saturn, the yogi, is in his best element in the friendly congenial asterism of Rahu which also stands for void Thus Saturn is still poor in spirit & is not tempted by being in the luxurious, rich & sensuous sign Libra.

Human signs (3,6,7 & 1st half of 9) are strong in birth charts of day birth. Animal signs (1,2,5 1st half of Capricorn and 2nd half of Sagittarius) are strong during the night births. Insect signs (4 and 8) are strong in the morning and evening time. The 3rd, 6th, 10th and the 11th houses are commonly called "Chaya" or "Upchaya" houses. (54)

## TRANSLATOR'S NOTE

The term "Chaya" or "Upchaya" means houses that gather the traits of the planets located in them are said to be gained by the native. This is particularly true for planets in the 10th & 11th houses. For example, one gets many animals if Saturn (which denotes animals) is located in the 11th house. The author of Bhavarth Ratnakar holds (see shloka 1 under Libra lagna) that Jupiter for Libra nativities gives good wealth in his dasa even though Jupiter owns two bad houses of the horoscope. The reason is that the element of "financial gain" as upchaya house is common between these houses & Jupiter.

The Sun & the Moon are royal or high class government officials. Mars is connected with the military. Mercury is heir apparent. Jupiter and Venus are ministers. Saturn is treated as servant. These planets give career in the sphere to which they relate. (57)

## TRANSLATOR'S NOTE

How the Planets, Jupiter and Venus, perform the functions of ministers is illustrated by the Horoscope of Late Sanjay Gandhi. His Horoscope (birth 14th Dec 1946) is reproduced below.

would be observed that Venus, the minister, is lord of the house of Mantrana or ministership viz., the 5th from lagna. Similarly Jupiter, the other minister, is the lord of the 5th house from the Chandra Lagna. Both are located in the foremost kendra (10th) denoting karma. Hence the active interest that Shri Sanjay Gandhi showed in the affairs of the day to day working of the government as an advisor. Even though holding no portfolio, bears out the qualities of Jupiter & Venus as advisors to government.

## TRAITS OF PLANETS

The Sun has a square body. Its colour is dark red, the lustre of his eyes is yellow, has the body humour of bile., of average length in the bodily stature, has prowess, is satvik in nature, has very little hair (66) is intimately linked to causing movements, possesses a speech which gives meaning in very few words, gives very little, his intellect is divinely oriented;

Moon is of white body, of average size, well at speech, with round body, has the power of right thinking, is somewhat (67) weak in body, has pleasing speech, is satvik in temperament, possesses all the three humours i.e. bile, phlegm & wind.

Mars has eyes red with anger, has body whitish red in colour, possesses bile i.e. has heated nature, has haughty temperament, is thin of body, is prone to sin, has prowess, is given to sexual pleasures.

Mercury is of the colour of green grass, is highly learned, is ambitious, truthful in speech. (68) He is jocular, possesses all the three humours bile, phlegm & wind, gives status etc., with quickness, & is impotent. (69)

Jupiter is of satvik temperament, is endowed with all the good qualities of character, has yellow eyes, has no hair on the head.

Venus has beautiful eyes, is sexy in nature, gives comforts, strength, & beautiful complexion. (70)

Venus has black coloured hair on his body is ambitious in nature, is endowed with all the good qualities.

Saturn is cruel, with a thin long body, yellow eyes, & hard hair. (71) He has big sized teeth, is tamasic in nature (full of inertia) causes wind i.e. nervous troubles, is curt in speech, & is despicable. The results of the planets should be declared after due consideration of their strength whether it is the domain of natal astrology or of the horary astrology. (72)

## CASTES OF PLANETS

Jupiter and Venus are brahmins, the Sun and Mars are kshatriyas or of the warrior class. Moon & Mercury belong to the trading community, Saturn belongs to shuddra, Rahu and Ketu represent the lower most strata of one’s community. Mandi represents a foreign community other than the set of communities in which one is born. (73, 74)

## TRAITS OF PLANETS AND SIGNS

Sun is red coloured, Moon is white, Mercury green, Jupiter yellow. Venus of variegated colour, Saturn is blue. The devata of Sun is Agni, (fire) that of Moon is Jala (water), of Mercury Vishnu (protection), of Jupiter Indra (wealth), of Venus Indrani (sex)- the wife of Indra, of Saturn is Brahma (long life). The directions represented by the planets are East by Sun, South East by Venus, South by Mars, South West by Rahu, West by Saturn, North West by Moon, North by Mercury and North East by Jupiter. The signs Aries, Leo & Sagittarius represent the East, Taurus, Virgo, & Capricorn represent the South, Gemini, Libra & Aquarius represent the West & Cancer, Scoprio & Pisces represent the North. (75)

## PLACES & CLOTHES OF PLANETS

Sun (being satvik) is intimately linked to the Dev Sthaan i.e. the temple etc, Moon to watery resorts, Mars to fiery places, Mercury (being kumar i.e. boy) to play grounds, Jupiter (being the significator of wealth) to treasury etc, Venus (being sexy) to the bed room, Saturn to uneven places, Rahu to holes of serpents etc. (79)
If Saturn represents a cloth, it would be old; if Sun, it would be gross; if Jupiter, it would be neither old nor new; if Venus, it would be strong; if Moon, new; if Mercury, it would be wet, if Mars, it would be partially burnt, if Rahu, it would be old & of various colours like the cloth of a poor menicant; if Ketu, it would be with many holes. (81)

ताम दिनेशस्थासं निश्चारकरण्य मनीजिरस्थासं तु धरायुपुलासं 1
घुलितिवेबे देवश्यानोपुलासं रोप्य मुत्ता घुलोरायस्थासं कुवुनो : 114211

हपानिवत तद्दसने चि केतोमाहिरस्थासं तु वच्छेषहागाम 114211

## METALS ETC OF PLANETS

Sun represents Copper, Moon Gems, Mars Gold, Mercury represents ore of Pearls, Jupiter Silver, Venus Pearls, Saturn Iron, (82) Rahu represents Lead & Ketu represents Neelam. Amongst the clothes, yellow cloth is represented by Jupiter, Silken by Venus, variegated by Sun, white by Moon, Green by Mercury, dark red by Mars, blue by Saturn, old by Rahu, beautiful by Ketu. The strength of planets should be given due consideration in this context (85).

## SEASONS

Venus represents the Vasant season (March and April) Mars & Sun represent the Summer season (May & June) Moon stands for the Rainy season (July & August) Mercury for the Sharad season (September & October) Jupiter for Hemant (November & December) & Saturn for the Shishir season (January & February). (86)

## NATURE OF LOST THINGS, TASTE, TIME ETC

In horary astrology, in natal astrology or when the question of reconstructing a horoscope without the birth data is involved the data is ascertained from the nature of the planets who are the lords of the decantes involved. Among the tastes, the Sun represents the Pungent taste, Mars the bitter, Moon the saltish, Mercury the mixed one, Jupiter the sweet, Venus sour & Saturn astringent. In periods of time, the Sun represents a period of six months, Moon only a second, Mars a day. (89) Mercury a period of two months, Jupiter a month, Venus a fortnight & Saturn a year. Rahu represents a period of 8 months & Ketu only 3 months.

धातुयहा रौहणनीनुमोमी मुलाष्टों श्राहकदिनायकस्तरंं 1
जीवमाहों जीवश्राहकस्तरों मेवादि द्वारादि यथाकस्तरंं 119011

Rahu, Saturn, Moon and Mars are planets representing Dhatu i.e. metals. Sun and Venus represent planets. Jupiter and Mercury are jeevas i.e. Animals including man. The signs and the asterisms Ashvini, Bharni & Kritika are metals, plants & Animals respectively. Similar is the case in order for the rest of the asterisms i.e. Rohini, Mrigshar & Ardra are metals, plants & Animals & so on. (90)

The Sun and Mars have "upwards" sight. Venus and Mercury look slantingly. Moon and Jupiter look straight. Saturn and Rahu look downwards. (91)

## ASPECTS

Saturn fully aspects i.e. influences the house, sign or planet placed 3rd and 10th from it. Mars similarly aspects the house etc. placed 4th and 8th from it. Jupiter similarly throws its influence on the house etc 5th and 9th from it. All the planets aspect the 7th house etc from the place of their location. The planets aspect the 3rd & 10th place from their places with quarter aspect, the place etc 5th & 9th from them with half aspect & the house etc 4th & 8th from them with three quarters aspect. The house numbers should be counted by taking the aspecting planet as in first house. (92)

## TRANSLATOR'S NOTE

Most of the astrological texts do not prescribe any aspects for Rahu and Ketu. They omit it at their own peril. Maharshi Parashar—the father of Indian astrology—has very clearly laid down that Rahu and Ketu have aspects mostly similar to Jupiter i.e. on the house etc 5th, 7th & 9th from them.

In this connection please see the following shloka (number 26 in chapter 51) of Brihat Parashar Hora Shastra Bombay edition of Shaka 1837.

सूत्रमदन नवाने पुरु सूत्रित तपस्य सूत्राला व्याख्य गौरे चार्ड सूत्रित व्याख्य
सहज रिकू विपष्टनाद सूत्रित सूत्रीन्दा : निजमण्णनुपत्तों लोचनान्य : प्रदिष्ट:

i.e. Rahu has full aspect on the house etc located 5th, 7th, 9th and 12th from it. It has half the aspect (influence) on the houses 2nd and 10th from it. It aspects with a quarter strength the house etc 3rd and 6th from it and is blind towards the house it occupies.

Since the shadowy planets Rahu and Ketu easily take upon themselves the influence of other planets etc. we have deduced a corollary from the above rule that in throwing their own malefic influence on the house these shadowy planets may be aspecting, they will also throw on the aspected houses the malefic influence of the malefic planet or planets that may be influencing these nodes, by association or aspect. For example, if Ketu & Mars are located in the 6th house in any horoscope or if Ketu is located in the 6th house & Mars in the 3rd, 11th or 12th house, then Ketu in throwing its 5th, 7th & 9th aspect will convey to the 10th, 12th & the 2nd houses and will afflict the said houses with the malefic influence of Mars as well. This corollary has great impact on the "Kuja Dosha" for even though when for example Mars & Ketu are located together in the 6th house, Mars does not constitute technically "Kuja Dosha" in accordance with shloka relating to this dosha viz.

लागने क्षेत्रे च पाताले जामिस चाएदे कुजा :

etc. But in actual effect it would shorten the life of the partner very much because the influence of both Mars & Ketu (killers) would be felt by the 2nd house which being the longevity (8th) house of the partner is bound to suffer through the influence of Mars & Ketu (who also acts like Mars).

## FRIENDSHIP ETC

The Sun considers Jupiter, Mars and Moon as its friends. It is neutral towards Mercury. It is inimical to Saturn and Venus. Moon considers the Sun and Mercury as its friends. It treats the rest i.e. Saturn, Venus, Jupiter and Mars as a neutral. Mars treats Sun, Moon & Jupiter as its friends. It is inimically disposed towards Mercury. It is neutral to Saturn and Venus. Mercury treats the Sun and Venus as its friends. It is neutral towards Jupiter, Mars and Saturn, but it is inimical to Moon (94) Jupiter treats Sun, Mars and Moon as friends, but Venus and Mercury as enemies. Jupiter is neutral to Saturn. Venus treats Saturn and Mercury as its friends. It is inimical towards the Sun and the Moon & is neutral towards Jupiter and Mars (95). Saturn treats Venus and Mercury as its friends. Jupiter as neutral. While it treats the Sun, Mars and Moon as its enemies. Rahu treats Venus, Jupiter and Saturn as its friends. So also is the case with Ketu. (96)

Planets located in the 2nd, 3rd or 4th house from another planet or in the 12th, 11th or 10th from it become temporary friends of the latter. In other places they become natural enemies. In case the two are both natural & temporary friends they become Adhimitra i.e. bosom friends. If both are inimical naturally & temporarily they become bitter enemies. If friends in one way and enemy in another they are neutral to each other. (97, 98)

## SIX FOLD STRENGTH
## Positional strength

Planets located in their sign of exaltation, in a friendly sign, in their own Navamsha sign, in the signs they own, in their own decante or in 1/12th part, or in their own 1/16th part are considered to possess "Positional" strength. (99)

## DIRECTIONAL STRENGTH

Jupiter and Mercury have full directional strength when located in the ascendant. Mars & Sun get this full strength when located in the 10th house. Saturn gets it when located in the 7th house. Moon and Venus get full directional strength when situated in the 4th house. Planets are in zero directional strength when located in the 7th house from that where they get full directional strength. In the intervening situations planets get proportional strength. (100)

## TEMPORAL STRENGTH

Sun etc. located in their own month hora, day or year are considered as strong in temporal strength. (101) i.e. Sun in the Bhadon month (August and September), Moon in its own hora division. Mars on Tuesday & Saturn in the year when it is in its own sign. Capricorn or Aquarius, are considered as strong. (101)

## TIME (KAAL) STRENGTH

Saturn, Moon and Mars get strengthened in a night birth. The Sun, Jupiter and Venus get strengthened in a day birth. Mercury is strong both in day and night births. Benefic planets get strengthened in the bright fortnight of the Moon while the malefics get strengthened in the dark fortnight. (102)

## ASPECT STRENGTH ETC.

The planets aspected by benefics and unaspected by malefics are strong so far as the question of aspect is concerned. The Sun is very strong in the Uttarain (six months from the Sun’s entry into Capricorn). Moon is strong when the Sun is in Dakshanayan (i.e. in six months from its entry into Cancer). (103) In natural strength Saturn, Mars, Mercury, Jupiter, Venus, Moon and Sun are stronger in order one over the other i.e. Saturn is the least strong & Sun the most. (104) Planets Mars, Mercury, Jupiter, Venus and Saturn are strong when in retrogression. A planet is victorious in war when it has in comparison more northern declination and has brilliant rays (i.e. are away from the Sun). (105)

The strength of the Ascendant (and its lord) consists mainly in their sixfold strength. In regard to the strength of the Ascendant the Author says that if the Ascendant is a human sign (see shloka 51 anti), the ascendant gets full strength. If the sign is watery or animal, the strength of the Ascendant is half. Incase there is insect sign in the Lagna the Lagna gets no strength on this account at all. Sixfold strength of the Ascendant is as under. (106, 107)

The maximum strength in the sixfold ways for the Sun is 6 and a half rupas. rupa being a unit of strength. That of Moon is 6 rupas, of Mars 5, of Mercury 7, of Jupiter 6, of Venus 5 and a half, (108) of Saturn 5. The actual strength is worked out proportionately. In positional strength it is two rupas 3 quarters, in directional
strength it is 1 rupa & 3 quarters. (109) In Cheshta strength it is a
rupa less by 1/6th of it. In temporal strength it is 2 rupas less by one
eighth of a rupa. Sun, Mercury and Jupiter get half a rupa strength
in the Ayan strength.

In the sixfold strength Sun gets the maximum strength of six
and a half units. Moon gets 6 units, Mars 5, Mercury 7, Jupiter 6,
Venus five and a half, and Saturn 5. In the positional strength the
maximum units are a quarter less three units. The maximum
directional strength is three quarters of a unit. (109) The Cheshta
(motional) strength is 5/6th of a unit. In temporal strength it is 2
units less 1/8th. In Ayan strength Sun, Mercury and Jupiter get
half a unit. (110)

becomes particularly harmful. This is the reason why the time
when both a sign & a Nakashtra are ending, such as the end of
signs Cancer, Scorpio & Pisces are considered dangerous to life

A planet having a longitude up to the longitude of the house in which placed is called "Aarohi" (i.e. mounting). If it has greater longitude than that it is called "Chyut" (i.e. fallen). A planet that occupies a junction point is without results particularly in its dasa periods, even if it occupies its sign of exaltation, a friendly sign & even if endowed with all the six types of strengths. The position of the Ascendant is (a) triangular to the "Pranpada" (b) is triangular to the sign occupied by "Maandi" (115) (e) is triangular to the Navamsha sign occupied by "Maandi" (d) is in the 7th to the Navamsha sign occupied by "Maandi" (e) is triangular to the sign occupied by the Moon or (f) in the sign 7th to the Navamsha sign occupied by Moon (116). The learned thus determine the Ascendant both in natal and horary astrology. Importance is given to the Ascendant or the sign occupied by Moon whichever is stronger.

लागने बलो माधिव्याचित्रने चर्दे बलो चर्दे व्यक्तिशाखित्रने म् 1
अजें तदेशो पुत्रस्थय भन्न लागने तिष्णस्तटिपरीत-गौर्थ 1122411

In case the Ascendant is stronger, the process of rectification of the Ascendant should be carried out from the Maandi. If Moon is stronger the process should be undertaken with Moon as the base. In case the Ascendant arrived at is of odd sign and odd Navamsha the birth is of a male, if these two belong to an even sign the birth is of a female. (118)

सूयलमर्शणारुदिनाचित्रया : सोस्पेंटुपुण्याकिन्देशुपुण्या : 1122011
पुत्रक्रमाध्यहतमर्शणारुदिनाचित्रया मन्दीत तत्याकुण्या प्रदेशा : 1122911

In the following sets of four planets the first is "Pachak" (literally digestor) Bodhak (lit: informative), Karka (significator or doer) & Bedhak (piercing). The sets are (1) Saturn, Mars, Jupiter & Venus, (2) Venus, Mars, Saturn & Sun, (3) Sun, Moon, Saturn & Mercury, (4) Moon, Jupiter, Venus & Mars, (5) Saturn, Mars, Moon & Sun, (6) Moon, Mercury; Sun & Saturn (7) Venus, Moon, Jupiter & Mars. (119-121)

गुरोस्बू पखालवकामरिष्ठा : शुक्कामरिष्ठा पखालवकामरिष्ठा : 1122311
बुतिलामान्यवालच्युनों दिनेशहसों : प्रवेशित तनजा : 1122811

The aforesaid Pachak, Bodhak etc. for different planets are as under:-

Sun Planets 6th, 7th, 9th & 11th from it.
Moon Planets 7th, 9th, 11th and 3rd from it.
Mars Planets 2nd, 6th, 11th & 12th from it.
Mercury Planets 2nd, 4th, 5th & 3rd from it.
Jupiter Planets 6th, 5th, 7th & 12th from it.
Venus Planets 2nd, 6th, 12th & 4th from it.
Saturn Planets 3rd, 11th, 6th & 7th from it.

(124)

सकारको वेरी कौडिनेशहसों शुक्कौडिनेशहसों गुरोस्बू 1122411

To the Sun its Pachak planet acts as its enemy. The rest are friendly to Sun. The planet 12th to Moon is her enemy. Bedhak of Mars acts as its enemy. Bedhak for Mercury is its enemy; for Jupiter the Pachak planet is enemy. For Venus the Bedhak planet is enemy. The Karka for Saturn is its enemy. The rest are its friends.

(126)

.सकारको वेरिस्मो न ततु वेरिस्मो अल्यामकलप्त्र विशोपाब 1
Choeraiinbukulishitipalashevretiivu:भण्ड़ स्वप्रद्व्यत्त च 1123211

If the Karaka planet is friendly to the planet for whom it is Karaka, it gives some times better prospects and some times loss of fortune, some times disease to wife, son, relatives of wife, fear from thieves, fire, and conflict with others. (130)

In case the Karak planet is enemy to the planet to whom it is Karaka, then it gives in its dasa extremely bad results in regard to theft, fire, trouble to relatives, suffering at the hands of the Government and loss of position of self. (131)

विशेषयानं धननाखानं च वेरिस्मोस्तलपत्रमन्यान्य : 1123211

If the Bedhak planet is friendly to the planet to whon it is Bedhak, it brings about Foreign travel & loss of Wealth. If it is inimical, the results are opposite. (132)

तर्कसरजयनपुत्रशिपनाखायो भारकराइदिवरोग 1
दिनमानचतीगुलिता नागहता गुलिकनाखिका : सयप्ता : 1123211
सुउत्रुलिकनाखिकामिस्तलपत्रमनाखिका सायनखायित 1
भागनवदनत्तयो राष्ट्रयाकलादिवरोगो गुलिक : 1123811

## GULIK

At a place where the measure of the day time is 30 ghatis i.e. 12 hours, the Gulik occupies the degree denoted by the Ishta (interval between the Sun rise & the coming moment of birth) of 26 ghatis on Sunday, 22 ghatis on Monday 18 ghatis on Tuesday 14 ghatis on Wednesday 10 ghatis on Thursday, 6 ghatis on Friday & 2 ghatis on Saturday. When the duration of the day is more or less than 12 hours the Ishta should be ascertained by the rule of 3 i.e. if on Sunday for 30 ghatis duration it is 26 ghatis, how much is it for the duration of the day involved. Having ascertained the Gulik Ishta concerned for the day involved, the Ascendant on that Ishta worked out in the normal manner gives the Gulik point. (133, 134)

30, the answer will be the Ishta at which Mandi is. (135)

## TRANSLATOR'S NOTE

The author has opined that the product of the duration of the day period concerned and 26 etc. should be divided by 30. This is obviously based on the assumption that the duration of the day would be 30 ghatis which is not the case in most cases. Hence the appropriate step is to divide the product by the duration of the day in ghatis instead of by 30 in every case.

पाकेशाहादुमाल्य भारू मवने युत्तीपहारेषरसत्तःयुमवतीह लामयने सोल्यामणे
बंधुमे।

भागेये वा देखामे सम्मिनितःयुमवतीह सत्तकामानित चेवरसत्तःयुमवत :

प्रोत्तो स्थानागी क्षम : 11923411

If the planet having its sub-period is located in 6th, 8th or 12th, it is inimical (to some extent) to the planet having the main ruling period. If located in the rest of the houses except 7th, it acts as a friend to the dasa lord. The sub-period lord in 7th to the main period lord gives adverse results. (136)

## TRANSLATOR'S NOTE

The fact that a planet is placed 6th, 8th or 12th from the planet having its main ruling period makes the sub-period lord adverse by one point. If it is enemy also of the main period lord it would be adverse by two points. If it is enemy to the lord of the Ascendant, it would be adverse by 3 point. If it is located 6th, 8th or 12th from the lagna it would be adverse by 4 points. If it is placed 6th, 8th & 12th from the lord of the lagna it would be adverse by 5 points.

Thus a planet that indicates good results in its sub-period by even 4 points by being in a friendly sign, by owning good houses, by being in association with a benefic & by being in its own sign may still give slightly bad results for such a planet is good only on 4 counts & bad on 5.

पाप्षहादिस्तितो युणरसतू भारू : स्यात्यानतोपि युमवतिश्रोमानाध्य : 1
स्यानानुहपणपणमेव विस्तरसतू मगं जात्या वदेतिमुन्यो जगत्या युणरसतू 11923411

The planet having its sub-period, if with a malefic, acts in an inimical manner. If the Sub-period lord is a good planet in himself and is also good from the point of view of the house it occupies from the Main-dasa lord, it gives very good results. Thus it is necessary to give the results after due consideration of the position held by the Sub-period lord from the Main-period lord. (137)

The Rishis and men of ripe wisdom have given various results arising out of the association of the various planets with the various houses. I am presenting the same for the pleasure of the learned readers. (1)

## GOOD RESULTS

If a natural benefic planet is lord of any house and is located in that house or aspects it and the houses aspected or associated are not under the influence of malefic planets by association or aspect. The house concerned gets boosted in regard to the traits related to it. Similarly natural malefic planets, lords of houses similarly situated do not give nice results. Planets in general are strong when they are not in debilitation. eclipsed by Sun or in inimical signs. (2)

बागनाइवायायिपुल्मसोगसित्ये पापुल्मसत्यमवायित्या : 1
सोमायसु नात्यपत्यपणसत्यमवायित्याना फक्लोमवाययाय : 11311

If there are natural malefic planets in the 6th, 8th or 12th from the Ascendant etc and the lords of these houses are natural benelics, these benelics do not give much good results. (3)

यद्वमावनायो रिपूर्षरित्ये तु:स्यानयो यद्वमावनिस्त्रतो वा 1
तद्वमावनायो कळयपति तद्वजा : पुल्मसित्ये तद्वमावनिस्त्रतो सोमाययो 11811

## TRIK HOUSES

The Traits of a house suffer, if its lord is located in the 6th, 8th or the 12th house. Similarly the lord of the 6th, 8th or the 12th house arms the prospects of the house in which it is located. If, however, is well aspected it gives good results. (4)

स्यादनम् 1

मुनिगगा दिननायलगनश्यस्युत्तो मधेस्य बलीयासतत : कमेशयदिनश्यस्युत्तो वुटि
अगुलतिदिव : 11911

## SOURCE OF INCOME

Source of income should be declared from the planet occupying
the 10th house from the Ascendant or from the Moon, whichever
is stronger. If the planet occupying is the Sun, the source is father,
if Moon it is mother, if Mars the enemy, if Mercury the source is
the relations, if Jupiter it is from brothers (elder), if Venus it is from
wife, if Saturn the source of income is from servants. The
livelihood is also determined from the nature of the planet who is
lord of the Navamsha sign occupied by the lord of the 10th
house.

मन्सोपेद्राहरस्वाविवंद्धानी बुलित जगू : सकल्शास्त पुरुण माने : 1
जानोपेद्राहरस्वाविवंद्धानी : डिटिपालपुरुण जैवत्वस्थों डिटिपिते दिनायकाशों 11811

If the said lord of the Navamsha is Sun, one earns from medicine, gold, water, conveyance trade, pearls, ruby, Ambassadorship, (8) tours, advisory capacity, oxides, law suits, through pleasure affording matters, preceptorship & under Governmental patronage. (9)

चलोदमवाना क्रमविक्रमेण कुवेष्ठ मुदाविवंद्धानीदमवाना।
रजजानास्तरस्वाविवंद्धानीदमवाना।

If the lord of the said Navamsha is Moon, one earns from products of water, agriculture, from earth products, law suits, through pleasure affording matters (cinema etc), through the patronage of the royal females, or from the sale of cloth. (10)

धातोविवदेन रगप्रहारत्वस्थानिदमवाना।
जैवत्वस्थों साहस्मानिदमवाना जैवत्वस्थों वदि चौरुण्या।

If the said Navamsha lord is Mars, one earns from metal work, military occupation, from the use of fire (as in boilers etc), from engaging himself in creating trouble, from acts of courage, or through theft. (11)

धिलपाइदकाशवानस्तर मगपिज्ञोतितिगणवानस्तरस्वाविवंद्धानी।
वराववेदकाशवानस्तर पुरोहितवानस्तरस्वाविवंद्धानी : 112211.

If the said Navamsha is onwed by Mercury, one earns through handicrafts, literature, from scriptural usage, from Astronomy & Astrology, from moral means, from the study of the Vedas, from doing Japa work for others, or by acting as a family priest. (12)

जैवविषके पुरुणरेदत्वनामुपायकाशवानस्तर।
पुरोहितवानस्तरस्वाविवंद्धानीदमवानस्तर पुरोहितवानस्तर : 112311

If the Navamsha in question belongs to Jupiter, the native earns his livelihood by teaching the worship of the gods and Brahmins, or from the recitation, teaching etc of Puranas, & Vedas or by preaching religion. (13)

सुकवमानिदमवानस्तरस्वाविवंद्धानी क्रमविज्ञोतितिगणवानस्तरस्वाविवंद्धानी : 1
पुरोहितवानस्तरस्वाविवंद्धानी स्रीगा प्रलोमेन पुरोहितवानस्तर : 112811

If the said Navamsha lord is Venus, one earns from gold, gems, elephants, horses, or from the sale of gur etc or from the trade in milk and curd or from the support of women. (14)

---

If the lord of the said Navamsha is Saturn, one earns by despicable means, from handicrafts etc, from wood works, from butchery etc, from carrying burden, from works connected with water, or by creating rift amongst parties. (15)

स्वरूपे स्वन्नवाशे कृष्टदिन या स्वीच्छणशारे यबा स्वरूपेकाणवाशे कृष्टदिन मुत्तारिकोणु या 1

तत्रुलकालवलानितासु खचरा भगोलमासेयि या सबे शुमबा मध्यति हि तबा शुमतदिशावलयि 119411

All planets when located in their own sign, in the Navamsha of their own sign, in a friendly sign, or in the degree of their exaltation, or in the decante of their own sign, or in the cardinal houses (1st, 4th, 7th & 10th) or in their positive signs (see shloka 53 of chap I) or when strong by virtue of their temporal strength or when located in the Navamsha belonging to the sign occupied by them, give nice results in their Main and Sub-ruling periods. (16)

तत्रुलमावलयपों या खचरेझो इसकागाने चापि नायोकृपुस : 1
मावलयपों या तत्रुलवाशिपों या तेपा मध्ये यो र्थह : शुमबा� : 119411
तत्रुलमावलयपों या यो या ठेटो शुमबन्धयपों यो : 1
तत्रुलयपों मुत्तारिकागाने नायो शुमबन्धयपों यो र्थह : 119411

One dealing with natal or horary Astrology, should declare the traits and characteristics of a house as lost when the planet having its Main or Sub-ruling period is (a) the lord of the 8th house from the house under consideration (b) when the planet having its Main & Sub-period is kharesh i.e. lord of the 22nd decante (see shloka 16 chapter 1) or (c) when the said planet is Saturn as the lord of the decante of the said house, or (d) is the lord of the sign occupied by Maandi or (e) is the lord of the Navamsha sign or the lord of the sign occupied by Maandi, or (f) is located in a bad house such as 6th, 8th or 12th or (g) it is Adhi Shatru i.e. bitter enemy of the lord of the house involved (see shloka 17 of chapter 1) or (h) when that lord is in a sign having no good point in the Ashtak Varga system, (17 & 18).

मद्दमिकुलस्थरेशपासपत्ननवाशिपत्नपों ये र्थह : 1
तेपु डूबलद्या मुत्तारिवा कस्तमें चरीत शुमबन्धयपों यो र्थह : 119411

The following planets when weak bring about death in their Main and Sub-ruling periods:—(a) the lord of the Navamsha sign occupied by Saturn (b) the lord of the Navamsha sign occupied by Maandi, (c) Rahu (d) the lord of the Navamsha sign occupied by "Khar" (see previous shloka) the lord of the 8th house from the Ascendant, & the lords of the Navamsha signs occupied by all these. This happens when Saturn in transit crosses the bad signs such as the one in 8th house etc. (19)

धनाचित्र : पापशों यदि स्वास्थ्यान्तरमों निर्देशनेष्ठरगाम 1
उत्तरदेशाया धनाच्च्चामूं : पापशीस्त्र तदस्तवने तदस्त 112011
धनाचित्र : पापशास्त्रतरविष्ट : स्वास्थ्यान्तरश्याया दितिपालकोणब 1
नानायन्याश्य निगवेन्याश्याया स्वास्थ्यान्तरश्याया दितिजन्याश्याया 112211

In case the lord of the second house (the House of Wealth) is having its Main ruling period and there is the Sub ruling period of any of the planets—Saturn, Mars, Rahu and Sun—then the Sub-period will give loss of wealth. So also is the case, if the second house contains a malefic planet (20) in the dasa of a malefic planet, lord of the 2nd house & in that of the lord of the sign occupied by the said malefic lord of the 2nd house, there is loss of wealth, brought about through the punishment orders of the Government. There is also at that time relinquishment of position and opposition from the near and dear ones. (21)

## TRANSLATOR'S NOTE

Shloka number 20 makes no mention of the influence of the malefic Sub-period lords on the Main-period lord. It is, therefore, clear that there is always the influence of the planet having its Sub-period on the planet having its Main period. This should be taken as a law and applied to all Sub-periods to get correct results.

(2) The words "तत्वीष " (Tad Isha) in the opening part of shloka number 21, go to show that the lord of the sign occupied by the lord of any house acts as the latter. This is on the basis of the theory of dispositorship.

During the Main ruling period of a benefic, placed in the second house and the Sub ruling period of a benefic lord of the second house, one gets wealth. Then there is also pleasure from speech and the sons. (23)

## TRANSLATOR'S NOTE

The rationale behind the results in both the cases lies in the principle that the Sub-period lord always influences the Main-period lord.

पाप्रस्ते विक्रममाबनाये पाप्रास्ते पाप्रस्तेचरणगाय 1
अतिदेशायामनलास्तरों उख़ड़ समायाति शुमरस्तरी 112811

## THIRD HOUSE

Even if the lord of the 3rd house denotes good, the native will suffer from fire, weapons or thieves if there is the Main ruling period of a malefic lord of the 3rd house conjoined to a malefic planet and the Sub-period too is of malefic planets. (24)

कतिपरकोपानलावोधमृपूरुह मनोजायमतीय कक्षम 1
सौत्रष्यपापदवायकाले शुमरस्तर तारुषमर नाडित 112911

During the main ruling period of a malefic lord of the 3rd house there is trouble from fire, thieves and Government. There is also inertia of mind; but, if it is aspected by a benefic planet, there is no such trouble. (25)

शुमरष्यमाबनायिपदवायकाले सौत्रष्यतरगायमपरकाले 1
नाडित धवेदतर सहभदवाया मयेदिरोथ : सहभदवाया नाडित 112911

During the Main ruling period of the lord of the 3rd house & the Sub-ruling period of malefic planets there is loss of brothers & also rift with them. (26)

## TRANSLATOR'S NOTE

Again note the fact that the results in the shloka arise from the malefic influence exerted on the Main ruling period lord by the planet having its Sub-period and this is irrespective of the location of the two in the horoscope.

बेस्टिपस्तरों शुमरष्यमाबनायिपदवायकाले 1
स्यान्स्तूलि केश्विनाशमीत नीच्चस्तानामपरकाले 112911

## FOURTH HOUSE

During the Main ruling period of the lord of the 4th house and the Sub-ruling period of malefics, there is relinquishment of residence & the loss of brothers. Similar results follow during this

---

Sub-periods of planets that are in debilitation, or are eclipsed by the Sun. (27)

## TRANSLATOR'S NOTE

The Sub-period of Sun, Saturn and Rahu or of their dispositors is particularly instrumental in bringing about change of residence as these are all factors of "Separation", influencing the house of residence. (4th)

बुद्धिमं कुसितत भेजन च पापरष्कारा हि सूत्रेशकारे 1
वर्णतेशायी प्रवेदनरगान शुल्फ़ष्क़णेन तथा मबेट 112511

## FIFTH HOUSE

During the Main period of the lord of the 5th house, and the Sub-ruling period of malefics, the native gets confusion of intellect and bad food. But, if the Sub-period lord is a benefic, it does not happen. (28)

## TRANSLATOR'S NOTE

It is stated that the native would suffer from taking of bad food. This is obviously the result of the affliction of the 5th house which represents the belly. Just as the 4th house from the House of Gains (11th) is the place, where income is deposited, on the same analogy the 4th house from the 2nd house of Food is the food lying in the stomach, which gets bad as a result of the malefic influence of the malefic planets having their Sub-period.

राजाजिन्नोरेषसन श्रेष्ठषष्क़णेषणाके तु शुल्फ़ष्क़णेषणाके 1
वर्णतेशायीमर्मिन्न कक्षमेषिन्न श्रेष्ठषष्क़णेषणाके : 112911

## SIXTH HOUSE

During the Main ruling period of the lord of the 6th house and the Sub-period of malefic planets the native suffers from the orders of the king, from thieves or from chronically bad habits as also from diseases like seminal troubles, colic pains, consumption, or bile. (29)

## TRANSLATOR'S NOTE

From a study of the shloka it would be seen that the bad results in regard to wealth and health have arisen as a result of the affliction of the 6th house. Thus it would be right to assume that the 6th house is primarily one of "health" & of disease only when afflicted.

वर्णतेशायीप्रवेदनरगान श्रेष्ठषष्क़णेषणाके डिस्या श्रेष्ठषष्क़णेषणाके मर्गः च नत्यः : 1
वर्णतेशायीन च पुरीप्रवेदनरगान श्रेष्ठषष्क़णेषणाके मर्गः नत्यः : 113011

---

## SEVENTH HOUSE

During the Dasa of the malefic lord of the 7th house, there is opposition from wife, or even her death. There is also foreign travel, trouble in the semen and rectum as also the wrath of the Government. (30)

रुस्तेशकाले करिनाय भोमसनेशरगामहारकाले 1
आत्युष्ठीवितसिनायन च धारणनेशरगामहारकाले 113211

## EIGHTH HOUSE

During the Main ruling period of the lord of the 8th house and the Sub-period of Rahu, Mars, or Saturn, there is the loss of Longevity, fame and wealth of self and the destruction of wife, relatives & brothers. (31)

स्थानन्तृतिबन्धुविरोखिता च विरेष्याने सहजेष्यरोखित : 1
भोमसनेशरगामहारकाले द्रष्टाविकारे रनेशरगामहारकाले 113211

## NINTH HOUSE

During the Main ruling period of the lord of the 9th house and the Sub-ruling period of Saturn, Mars, Rahu or the Sun the native suffers in his career, gets opposition from his brothers. travels to a foreign land & has rift with his brothers. If the lord of the 9th is a benefic, these results are modified in the Sub-period of the benefic. (32)

कारणपूर्षारिनेकुव:भुस्तेशकाले रुस्तेशकालेलवेष्यरोखित : 1
कमेशरणपूर्षारिनेकुव:भुस्तेशकालेलवेष्यरोखित : 113211

## TENTH HOUSE

During the Main ruling period of the lord of the 10th house and the Sub-period of malefics there is liklihood of getting imprisonment, sorrow, bad dreams, and great mental worry. During this period the native gets defame. (33)

द्रष्टाविकारे तबव लामपर्यय पुत्तरतरे द्रष्टाविकारे च : 1

## TWELFTH HOUSE

During the Main ruling period of the lord of the 12th house and the Sub-period of Saturn, Sun or Mars there is mental grief, consumption, loss of honour and wealth. During the Sub-period of Rahu there is trouble from serpent. (35)

तत्काललखुममवरकले ततिसरे यदि स्याललखुममवरकले स्यानलखुमतिति मरेगा विश्रोपाल 11341
स्याटी कार्ययति द्वाराषिमाने विच्छारमाने मूनीनिर्धाला : 1
आयततत : संकृष्टतायपाण्यंद्दता रहगा फक्लायकप्रिति : 113911

In case the Sub-period lord is a temporary friend of the planet having its Main period it gives half the bad results of what it would give when it is the enemy of the Main Dasa lord. During the period when the Main Dasa lord and the Sub-period lord are located 6th & 8th to each other there is relinquishment of office or even death. (36)

The learned people clarify in detail the results of the Main and the Sub-periods of planets. We have of necessity, narrated their results in a language of brevity. (37)

निष्कृष्टनालखुममवरकले राष्ट्रो यदि चारष्टखुममवरकले 1
आयतनालखुममवर्ण बा सिकोपे रष्ट्रो यदि जन्मलाने भबेच्छारमाने मरेगा 113411
आयतनालखुममवर्ण द्वाराषिमाने विच्छारमाने मरेगा 113911

When during its transit, the Sun comes to the 3rd sign from that of the 1st conception, or when it comes in transit to the 5th or 9th house from the Ascendant at the time of other conceptions, people are born. (38)

People well versed in the science of astrology are of the opinion that the Ascendant at the time of birth is the same as sign that constitutes the Ascendant at conception.

In cases where the Ascendant at the time of conception contains a benefic planet or is aspected by a benefic, the native born is long-lived, with power and allluence. (39)

धमशिपुरु निष्कृष्टनालखुममवरकले सोफ़े : पुण्तष्ठहस्थवा 1
पुण्तष्ठहस्थवा निष्कृष्टनालखुममवरकले पुण्तस्थ भालाजनने विच्छारमाने 118011

If from the Nishek Lagna the 5th, 2nd and the 9th houses are aspected by benefic planets or by male planets and if there is the Navamsha of a male planet in the Ascendant at the time of Nishek, birth of a male results. If contrary is the yoga a female is born. (40)

---

When at the time of Nishek Lagna, there is, in that lagna, Mercury or Saturn aspected by malefics, the birth will be only of a piece of flesh. But not so if that Ascendant is aspected by benefics. (41)

निषेकलागने श्रीधननेवों या रेखालस्थों या वरि ढापदूष : 1

बुतोपनायेन युतो निषेकलागने श्रीधननेवों या वरि ढापदूष : 118211

The location of the lord of the Ascendant and of the 3rd house in the Ascendant or in the 3rd house gives rise to the birth of twins. (42)

## TRANSLATOR'S NOTE

The situation together of the Self of the native represented by the lord of the Ascendant & of its coborn represented by the lord of the 3rd house is essentially what constitutes a twin birth. We consider that the yoga for twin birth becomes certain if Mars—the significator of brothers & Mercury — the factor of "Plurality" also take part in the yoga involving lagna. For example, if Mars is in Ascendant in the sign with Mercury, the yoga becomes certain, for all the factors are together in lagna.

Here is the horoscope of a twin. It would be seen that Moon in lagna is the dispositor of Saturn, the lord of the lagna. Hence any influence on lagna would also be on Moon & Saturn. The influence of Mercury is there.

Since Mercury is lord of the sign occupied by Mars the influence of Mercury on lagna & its lord (Moon as Saturn) means the influence of Mercury, lord of the 3rd house, and the significator of the 3rd house (Mars). An intimate link having been established between the lagna & the lord & significator of the third house, together with factor of plurality by Mercury. The twin birth is clear.

If the lord of the lagna is in the 10th house and Rahu in the lagna, the child's feet come out of the womb first. If the lord of the 8th house and Rahu are in the lagna the child is enveloped in serpent like umbilical cord. (43) If Rahu & Gulik are together in kendra or if the lord of the 1st & 8th houses are together and the decante in the Ascendant belongs to a malefic planet, the child is enveloped in the serpent like cord in the womb. (44) The same result follows if there is serpentine or egg decante in the Ascendant and the decante is with its lord without good aspect. (45) If Mars or Saturn is in any of the lagnas Aries, Taurus, Leo, the child in the womb is enveloped in the limb denoted by the sign of the lagna. (46)

lagna सपाइं बुल्पायपूर्णे राउच्चजाम्या सहितेच भार 1
पायपूर्णे रु विलगनेशे या आतो नरो नालिनेशेत्तागा : 118911
कृुरतें लागनेशे सराही लागने कुरे वासरनायपूर्णे 1
lagna ख्रोने मुमिष्टोने रुसे आतो नरो नालिनेशेत्तागा : 118511

If malefic occupies the Ascendant and many malefics aspect the lagna or if Rahu or Ketu is there, or if the lagna contains too many malefic planets, the native is enveloped with the cord. (47)

If malefic surround the Ascendant and Rahu is there or if Mars and Sun are aspected in it or Saturn is there aspected by Mars, the part indicated by the Navamsha is enveloped with the cord. (48)

परस्परेसरस्मायिते या देहौचुपो जन्म बुल्पत्तानिम् 1
lagna सपाइं या हिंडूकेषरे या ध्रव्याहितोने जन्म पथोसूप 118911

## ANIMAL BIRTH

If the lords of the first and the 4th houses are located in each others sign & if either the lord of the 1st or of the 4th is situated with

---

Rahu or Ketu, the yoga indicates birth of an animal. (49)

पाण भत्ताद्या विषलास्तु सोम्या नयूसको केंद्रातो तर्बनीयु
नयूसक्रमोबाध विषयोनिलागे सङ्कृतवण जन्म वबेति तख्या : 119011

If the malefic planets are strong and the benefics weak & the cunuch planets i.e. Saturn and Mercury are in the cardinal house, or when these two planets aspect an Ascendant indicating an animal, the yoga leads to the birth of animals.

पाण भत्ताद्या : श्रमुह परपना : सोम्या : श्रमोहनराशियुला : 1
नयूसक्रमोबाध जन्मनिलागे सङ्कृतवण जन्म वबेति थाड़सातराशियुला : 119211

When in a nativity the malefic planets are strong & occupy their own sign and the benefics are located in a sign other than their own & where the Ascendant contains an animal sign the wise authors take it as a yoga for animal birth. (51)

पाणी दुकाळो तु विषलास्तु बलासितोनेव प्रहेशा दुके 1
राष्ट्री चरे वा यादि तन्नवाहो विषयोनिलागे दुकाळो वा 119211

If in the Ascendant there is the decante of a bird (the 2nd decante of Gemini. 1st of Leo, 2nd of Libra and first of Aquarius are bird decanes) and the Ascendant is aspected by a strong planet & when the sign & the Navamsha in the Ascendant is of a movable sign, or of Mercury, the birth then is of a bird. (52)

दुकाळोबाधे गौजनने महिष्या : दुयलस्तुनेवाधे दुके : सुउस्त : 1
राष्ट्रीजान्या सठितोथे दुके मेवस्तु जातोनेवण्तलान्ये : 119311

If the yoga mentioned in the previous shloka is aspected by Venus, the birth is of a cow. If it is associated with or aspected by Saturn, the birth is of a buffalow. If by Rahu or Ketu, the birth is of a Ram. Similarly other animals are born when their respective signs are in the Ascendant. (53)

लागने दुयलस्तुनेवाधे लागनेष्ठे दुयलस्तुनेवाधे 1
जातस्तु सठितोथे दुयलस्तुनेवाधेनारोगोलस्तुनेवाधे दुयलस्तुनेवाधे 119811

If the lord of the 6th house is located in the Ascendant in the sign of Mercury and the lord of the Ascendant occupies the sign of Mercury the man along with his wife is impotent. In the said yoga. If Saturn and Mars take part then the male himself only will be impotent. (54)

## TRANSLATOR'S NOTE

Saturn & Mercury are impotent planets. Here is the horoscope of an impotent person.

Rahu, who always acts like Saturn—the impotent, is fully aspecting the 7th house and its lord. Mercury, another impotent planet, is also influencing the 7th house and its lord. Sun is with the 7th house and its lord as lord of the 12th house. Saturn too aspects the 7th house and its lord. Venus the semen is hemmed in between Saturn and Mercury, dispositor of Rahu etc. In view of heavy impotency influence on all factors of sex impotency resulted.

लगनेषढ़बुझासचिनोंगा युग्मों : फहतो महिदिमबुझासचिनोंगा युग्मों : 114911

The following are the 6 yogas that give birth to impotent persons.

(a). When Sun and Moon aspect each other.
(b). When Saturn and Mercury occupy dual signs.
(c). When Saturn occupying an odd sign aspects the Sun or when Saturn is in dual sign & aspects the Sun.
(d). When Moon is located in odd sign in the Ascendant and is aspected by Mars located in a dual sign.
(e). When Moon & Mercury are occupying an even and odd sign respectively & when the Moon & the Ascendant are aspected by Mars.
(f). When the lord of the lagna is with Mercury. (55-57)

---

If the lords of the 10th & 9th houses are located in one of the bad houses, 6th, 8th or 12th and the lord of the Ascendant is strong, the boy even if born in a high family is without the ceremonies such as 'seemant' (a sanskara i.e. ceremony performed during the pregnancy of a woman). (58)

In case there is a malefic planet or a malefic sign in the 11th house, the boy even if he be the first born is with a sanskara such as is performed during pregnancy.

## DELIVERY ROOM

If the lagna is Leo the delivery room has two doors. If Virgo is the lagna the birth takes place in a third class house. (59) The direction of the door is (i) in the direction of the lord of the Navamsha in the lagna (ii) in that of the lord of the 5th house (iii) in that of the strongest planet (iv) in the direction of the planet in the kendra (v) in that of the lord of the decante in the lagna. (60)

The caste etc should be determined from the planets in association with the lords of the houses (mentioned in the previous shloka). (63)

As against the opinion of some who consider that it should be considered from the planets in these houses. Jupiter, Mercury and Venus in these houses denote the women attending delivery as belonging to the Brahmin class. (64) In case these planets are occupying the Navamsha of a malefic planet the women will be widows. If Rahu or Ketu is located in a bad Navamsha there the woman would still be of the high class but widow.

In case of Saturn there the woman would be of black colour & a hunch back. (65) The number of the attending women should be determined from the number of planets involved. The number is many if many planets are located in one sign. (66)

## LAMP ETC

If the Ascendant is a movable sign, the lamp will be moving by being taken from place to place. If lagna is fixed the lamp is stable. If it is a common sign the lamp would be in the hand. The number of lamps at birth should be declared by the number of planets in the lagna. (67)

The condition of oil should be told from the Moon while the wick of the lamp should be told by the condition of the lagna. Thus opine some. (68)

## FIRST HOUSE

Good bodily health should be predicted when the lord of the Ascendant is situated in his sign of exaltation, or in the Navamsha of a friend, or in the Navamsha sign belonging to himself or when associated with or aspected by benefic planet (69). When the lord of the Ascendant is strong in a cardinal or trinal house, and is not under the aspect of any malefic planet then also good bodily health should be predicted.

(g) is with the lord of a kendra the native has best of affluence, fame, wealth, grains & prosperity. (72)

If the lord of the lagna is located with a malefic planet, it harms the health etc. The same is the result if it is in the 8th house. If well aspected it gives good health etc. (73) In case the lord of the lagna is located with the lord of any of houses 6th, 8th or 12th or if the lord of any one of these bad houses is in lagna one suffers bodily. If, however, the lord of the lagna is weak but located in a kendra or trine one does not so suffer. (74) The lord of the sign occupied by the lord of the lagna is located in any of the bad houses 6th, 8th or 12th gives a weak body. Whatever be the house 1st, 2nd, 3rd etc, if the lord of the sign occupied by the lord of any house is badly placed the house suffers in its traits. (75)

## TRANSLATOR'S NOTE

It would be seen from shloka number 75 that the dispositors of
the lords of the various houses act for the traits of the houses concerned. This is a very important rule and should never be lost
sight of.

If Saturn is similarly situated i.e. if Saturn is in the lagna under the influence, by association or aspect of malefic planets, the injury comes through nervous trouble, fire, weapons or a fall. The head of a native is big if the sign in the lagna is of 2 hours duration, not when it is half of it. (81)

## TRANSLATOR'S NOTE

The idea is that the signs whose rising time is 2 hours or more (maximum) when in the first house would make the first house i.e. the head big in size.

## GAIT

If the lagna is a fixed sign and is associated with planets of slow motion (eg Jupiter) the native remains in his own country in a wealthy and lucky condition. In case the lagna is under the influence of both movable and slow planets the native gets luck and fame through bad means by moving to different terrestries. (92)

If the lord of the lagna is strong & located in its sign of exaltation the native possesses a sobre & influential gait. If the lord of the lagna is weak the native is a fool; but not so, if associated with or aspected by benefic planets. (93)

पुण्यास्तूह या पुण्यास्तूहार्थकाख़म : 118411

If the sign in the lagna belongs to a benefic planet and the lagna is also aspected by a benefic the native gets comforts of life from early child hood. This is not so, if the lagna is associated with a malefic.

In case the Ascendant contains many malefic planets, one goes through troubles throughout life. (94)

If the lord of the Ascendant is vargottam or is in Navamsha of its exaltation sign, in a friendly decante or associated with benefic or is under the aspect of a benefic, one leads a comfortable life till death. (95)

## TRANSLATOR'S NOTE

A reading of the above shlokas indicates that the Ascendant not only relates to conditions at birth, it covers also life as a whole. That is why the excellence of lagna & its lord indicates comfortable conditions throughout life.

If the lord of the Ascendant is located with a benefic planet in his exaltation Navamsha, in the kendra or a trine, under the aspect of benefic planet, is with the lord of the 10th house, or is in his own sign, the native gets high luck, fame, wealth, grains and long life. (106)

लगनाखिते विल्लननाते रूपस्तेगाति रूपस्तेगाति : केदरित : रूपस्तेगाति विल्लननाते मुझो : 1
रूपस्ते विल्लन विचारतकारसिते रूपस्तेगाति सौच्छे विराषुरेलि विल्लननाते मुझो : 1180911

If the lord of the lagna is very strong, and is without the aspect of any malefic planet on it and is on the other hand in any of the cardinal houses under the aspect of benefic planets, the yoga is anti short life. Gives long life, virtues and wealth. (107)

केदरितकारसिते विल्लननाते रूपस्तेगाति विल्लननाते रूपस्तेगाति : रूपस्तेगाति विल्लननाते मुझो : 1
रूपस्ते विल्लननाते विचारतकारसिते रूपस्तेगाति सौच्छे विराषुरेलि विल्लननाते मुझो : 1180511

When a native has no malefic planet in the cardinal houses (1st, 4th, 7th & 10th) or in trines (5th & 9th) or in the 8th house, and the, lord of the Ascendant and Jupiter are in the cardinal houses, the native lives for a hundred year free from disease. (108)

तल्नेन्शवादितवी निष्ठेन्शवादितवी केन्द्रित्तों निष्ठेन्शवादितवी पाये : 1

तत्स्यांगरणमय बा यदि मध्यमायुल्टसाहितकत्वभाषतसाहितकत्वभाषत 1120911

If the lord of the 8th house is stronger than the lord of the Ascendant and malefic planets occupy the cardinal houses or the 8th and the 12th house, the native gets short or medium life. It is only after facing dangers with courage that he may get long life. (109)

If either the lord of the Ascendant or the lord of the Navamsha occupied by the lord of the Ascendant is located in the 2nd house, the native gets comforts of life (through profession etc) after the age of 20 years. (114)

लागनेशो प्रनराविषयसंस्करण तु केन्द्रकौजोन्निष्ठपूर्ति 1
तालमेशो बा नथा यूते प्रनराविषयसंस्करण तुल्कम् 1192911

If the lord of the Navamsha sign occupied by the lord of the Ascendant is located, in a cardinal or trinal house or in exaltation, or if the lord of the 11th house is similarly situated, the native gets comforts of life after the age of 30 years. (115)

लागनेशो पुमराविषयसंस्करण पुमराविषयसंस्करण 1
गोपुराविषयसंस्करण वाटि भोड़ाविषयसंस्करण तुल्कम् 1192911

In case the lord of the Ascendant is located in a benefic sign and is aspected by a benelie planet or is located in "Gopur" division (see shloka 25 etc chapter 1) he starts getting wealth from the age of 16 years. (116)

प्रहःवोधागया तु बलावलवोधागयी 1
तालमेशो पक्षे जोड़े प्रहःवोधागया 1192911

Thus Sh. Venkat Sharma describes the shrengh and weakness of planets and their aspects in the lagna. (117)

इसी प्रहःवोधागयांचे लागनेशो लागनेशो नाम इसीचे Sध्याय : 119211

This completes the second chapter on Lagnaphala of Sarvarth Chintamani.

## CHAPTER-3

अब धन्मावक्षण:

# Results of the 2nd house.

कोईवादमत्त्रस्यानुस्थं च चादरिदिगािदृश्यानुस्थं।
विवाहमत्त्रस्यानुस्थं नजसानिमस्यानुस्थं च प्रवेदभव 11211

## SECOND HOUSE

The following should be studied from the 2nd house:— Those who are dependent on the native, face, mouth, speech, the right eye, accumulated wealth, education, eating, servants & friends.
(1)

## TRANSLATOR'S NOTE

It is a point for note that the author has opined that education should be studied and determined from the 2nd house. We are also of the same opinion and do not consider it advisable to examine education from 4th or 5th house, as done by some other authors. The 4th house relates to desires & as such can give knowledge of our desired object which may not necessarily be connected with academic education. The 5th house relates to intelligence & fore sight rather than to education as such.

लागेस्करेण सहिते यादि वितनाये रूप:स्करेणSिस्करेणमत्त्रस्यानुस्थं।
नेसेस्करेण तनुगते यादि नेसेस्करेण : स्करेणश्करेण पुण्यস्करेण न तथा वंदित 11211

## EYE SIGHT

If the lord of the first house along with that of the 2nd house is located in any of the bad houses 6th, 8th or 12th, the man gets his bones broken. If the lord of the 2nd house along with Venus and Moon is located in the Ascendant the man becomes "Night blind". If, however, it is with a benefic or is in its sign of exaltation the night blindness does not take place. (2)

भावनच्छणानुस्थं : सहिते तनुगते जालयस्करेण मध्यति हर्षवादमत्त्रस्यानुस्थं।
रिफेक्ट चरायस्करेण नयनं हि चामें नाथें तबा प्रस्तीत रूपस्करेण तबनस्करेण 11211

If the lord of the 2nd house. Sun & Venus, and the lord of the lagna are together in the 6th, 8th or 12th house, the native is born blind. (3)

---

चर्दाकेसुनुलहरो विधाने शन्यारूपतेविविनाश्माहु : 1
शन्यारूपतेविविनाश्माहु : स्याळूपतेविविनाश्माहु वैव : सभित्रओदायाश्माहु 11811

If the Sun and Moon are in Leo Ascendant & are aspected by Mars and Saturn, loss of eye should be predicted. In case the yoga is one where the aspected planets, Sun and Moon, and the aspecting planets (Mars & Saturn) are both associated with natural benefic planet, the blindness does not take place. The native has only unrestful eyes. (4)

निम्नोलिताश्माहु शन्यारूपतेविविनाश्माहु 1
जुनानाश्माहु पापवूपतेविविनाश्माहु यमेन दूसे स बू रोगनेस : 11911

If there is a malefic planet in the 2nd house & the lord of the 2nd house is under the aspect of benefic planet, the native has his eyes as if closed. If the lord of the lagna is with many malefic planets & aspected by Saturn, the native has disease in his eyes. (5)

नेस दूसे दूसे दूसे वा सोम्यानिरेत कारक्षणचरेंगे।
जुनानाश्माहु पापवूपतेविविनाश्माहु विश्याल दूसे : स नरो विश्यारूपतेविविनाश्माहु 11511

If benefic planet occupies the 2nd house, or if the lord of the 2nd house is associated with benefits & if the significator of the eye i.e. the Sun is with the lord of the lagna or aspected by it the native has very good eye sight. (6)

शन्यारूपतेविविनाश्माहु दूसे दूसे दूसे वा सोम्यानिरेत कारक्षणचरेंगे।
नेस यबा पापवूपतेविविनाश्माहु यमेन दूसे सति डॉगनेस : 11911

In case the lord of the 2nd house is situated with Saturn and Mars or is with Gulik, there will be disease in the eye. Similarly, if there are many malefic planets aspected by Saturn, the eyes get diseased. (7)

नेसभररेश्याश्माहु सपरेश्याश्माहु दूसे दूसे दूसे वा शोम्यानिरेत कारक्षणचरेंगे।
नेसभरिः बासरनायके दूसे दूसे दूसे वा शोम्यानिरेत कारक्षणचरेंगे।

If the lord of the Navamsha sign occupied by the lord of the 2nd house is located with a malefic or is in the sign of a malefic planet there is disease in the eye. So also will be the case, if Sun is the lord of the 2nd house and is in association with and aspected by malefics. Similarly, if Sun is in the company of Gulik & is aspected by Mars. (8)

सहादर्यनोडमियारुगोठे ककलसिमियारी खामेलचेव
रक्षारुगोठे सति नेशानारे दूसे तु ताप्या नयनातरक्ष : 112011

The disease etc to the eyes of the brothers, son, enemy, wife, friend etc should also be determined in the same manner. If the lord of the 2nd house is located with the Sun and Mars or is aspected by them, the native has redness in the corners of his eyes. (10)

## TRANSLATOR'S NOTE

The right eye of the younger brother is denoted by the house 2nd to 3rd i.e. the 4th house. If the 4th house & its lord along with the Sun suffer at the hands of Saturn & Mars, the younger brother will have serious trouble in his right eye. Similarly, the 6th house, its lord & Sun highly afflicted, give serious trouble in the right eye of the son & so on.
