पारवताथागे ताडिमन धने चद्दस्मिनिते 112211

If the 2nd house contains a malefic planet, and the lord of the 2nd is associated with and aspected by malefic planets, the native earns his livelihood with much difficulty. (20)

In case the lord of the 2nd house is associated with natural benefics & the Moon in the 2nd house is in the Paravataamsha, the native supports 20 people in their livelihood. (21)

(25)

प्रुणलेवबन : श्रीमानकेंद्र सूचितपत्तो यबा 1
हर्वोच्छिनिरस्ववभाषे तन्नाये गौपुरोधाके 112511

When the lord of the 2nd house is in kendra (cardinal house) located in its exaltation sign, or in a friendly sign or in its own varga (see shloka 25 etc of chapter 1) or the lord of the 2nd house is in "Gopur" amsha (see shloka 25 etc of chapter 1) one has the most smiling face. (26)

पापुरोते सूचितपत्तो तन्नाये पापुरोते 1
नीचराखिगाते वापि सूचितपत्तो 112911
स्रोच्छुसस नब : पापी तत्वीसे गौपुरोधाके 1
पापुरोगौपुरोधाके गट : 112511

When the 2nd house contains malefic planets and the lord of that house too is located with malefic planets or is in its sign of debilitation & aspected by malefics the native has a very bad looking face. (27)

If the lord of the 2nd house is with Gulik and influenced by many malefic planets, the native is full of anger & sinful & falls in the hands of his enemies. (28)

वाकस्थयानेप सोम्युरोते रिकोजे केन्द्रितपत्तो सूचितपत्तो बा 1
फुम्मिदिते पुर्षहवोगौपुरोधाके बागमी मबेळुसतिमितपत्तो 112911

## SPEECH

If the lord of the house of speech i.e. the 2nd is located with a benefic planet & is situated in kendra or trine or is in its sign of exaltation, is well aspected & is in the company of a male planet, the native is a great speaker with logical speech. (29)

वाकस्थयानेप देवुरोखितपत्तो सूचित यबा नाखागतेस मुक : 1
पिरादिकानामितपत्तो रीतिद्रता सूचितपत्तो सूचितपत्तो 113011

If the lord of the 2nd house is located in the 8th house along with Jupiter, the native is dumb. In the same manner dumbness should be predicted to father and other relations if Jupiter along with the lord of 2nd house of the father etc is located in their respective 8th houses.

वाचालके : केन्द्रागते तत्वीसे पारावताये परमोच्छमाने 1
सिहासने देवुरोगौपुरोधाके यबा धोगलमें सोम्युरोधाके सूचित यबा 113211

---

वागीश्यस्थापे सोर्से स्वोंचने शुमस्मनिते 1
गौरुरोखागते वाछiः वाग्मीपूरोखागते मबेव 113211

If the lord of the 2nd house is located in kendra in the Paravatamsha (see shloka 25 etc of chapter 1) & in its highest degree of exaltation & if Jupiter or Venus is in "Simhasanamsha" (see shloka 25 etc of chapter 1) associated with Mercury in its own sign and Navamsha, the native is a great speaker. (31) If the lord of the Navamsha occupied by the lord of the 2nd house is a natural benefic planet and is in exaltation with a benefic planet or is in Gopuramsha, the native is efficient & great speaker. (32)

## MATHEMATICS

If Mars is in the 2nd house along with the Moon aspected by Mercury or with Mercury in kendra, the native understands mathematics. (36)

If Mercury is the lord of the 2nd house & is in its sign of exaltation, Jupiter is in the Ascendant, and Saturn in the 8th house, the yoga makes the native a mathematician. (37)

If Jupiter is in kendra or in trine, & Venus is in its sign of exaltation or if the lord of the 2nd house & Mercury are in their signs of exaltation, the native becomes a mathematician. (38)

If the lord of the 2nd house is Sun or Mars and is aspected by Jupiter and Venus, & Mercury is in "Paravatamsha" (see shloka 25 etc of chapter 1) the native knows the rationale of Astrology. (39)

## TRANSLATOR'S NOTE

The role of Mercury in making one an Astrologer lies in the fact that a strong Mercury would give mathematical ability. The capacity to understand & know the future is given by the excellence of the 5th house & its lord, for the 5th house relates to "future" as distinct from the 9th house which relates to the past (having crossed the horizon before birth). But to earn from Astrology it would be necessary that there should be an intimate link between the lagna representing the self of the native & the 5th house representing the future. A link of Jupiter—the planet that can foresee the future with the lagna & its lord would give intuitive powers to the native. In addition, if the lagna and its lord are in intimate relation with the 4th & the 12th houses and their lords, this would be an indication that the native earns from the 4th & the 9th houses i.e. from the personal affairs of the public (4th house) & their prospects in life (9th from 4th is the 12th house). This is after all what makes a good Astrologer.

गुत्त गुत्तों धनेशों चर्चित भोम निरीक्षितों |
मूलतिकों घुसे या तक्षास्तर चिवे वर : 118011 |
स्पूर्ण बल सन्युते गुत्तों तदमवनेशों |
दिनेशों मुल्यस्तरस्ते गुत्तिकों नरे भोम |

When the lord of the 2nd house is either Jupiter or Venus & is aspected by Sun & Mars & is located in the Mool trikon (positive) sign or in the sign of exaltation, the native is foremost among the knowers of the science of logic. (40)

If Jupiter as the lord of the 2nd house is in high strength and is under the aspect of Sun and Venus, the native becomes a gram-marian. (41)

चाम्मायणे बक्से स्वोल्से गौुरोश्यागत खनो 1
सिहासने गौुरोश्यागत वापि वेरवत्जो मबेनर : 118211

If the lord of the 2nd house is Mercury located in its sign of exaltation and Saturn occupies the "Gopuramsha" & Jupiter the "Simhasanamsha" (see shloka 25 etc of chapter 1) the native knows Vedanta Shastra. (42)

वेरवत्जोरिशील : स्यालेंद्रकोणे गौुरोश्यागत खनो 1
भूपेन गौुरोश्यागत खनो धरवत्जोरिशील : 118311

If Jupiter occupies a trinal or a cardinal house Mercury is aspee-ted by Jupiter & Saturn is in "Paravatamsha" division the native is efficient in Vedanta Shastra. (43).

उत्तमोषे भूपेन लरने केन्ने वा ततिष्ये भूपेन धरवत्जोरिशील : 118811

If Venus is situated in the Ascendant in the "Uttam" division, or if Venus is in the same division in any other kendra, Moon is in the division called "Devlok". one is expert in the knowledge of the Vedanta. (44)

पद्धशास्त्रवलम : केन्ने जीवे धानवर्णुजिते 1
सिहासने गौुरोश्यागत वापि धरवत्जोरिशील : 118911

If Jupiter is in a cardinal house, Venus is in the division called "Simhasan", and Mercury becomes the lord of Navamsha sign in the 2nd house and is then situated in Gopur division one is a great scholar. (45)

विप्रदेशे धनेशस्य राष्ट्रिश्यागत खनो 1
स्यापें केरडकोणे वा मोरसेवे विनिद्द्रवल : 118511

## GOES BACK ON HIS WORD

If the lord of the Navamsha sign occupied by the lord of the 2nd house is in the cardinal or trinal house with a malefic planet the native goes back on his word. So also is the ease when Mars is similarly situated as the lord of the Navamsha occupied by the lord of the 2nd house. (46)

परिधासकरों निर्णय माउसिततनवाश्य 1
बागमावस्थे बलादेहे तू ततिमनवेशिकाश्य 118911

## JOCULAR

When the lord of the Navamsha sign occupied by the Sun is situated in the 2nd house in strength and is in occupation of the "Vaisheshik" division, the native is highly jocular in disposition. (47)

गुरों बलादेहे धनराजियुते ततीष्चराजियुते गुरों बलादेहे धनराजियुते बागमावस्थे ततिमनवेशिकाश्य 118511

If a strong Jupiter is located in the 2nd house, and the lord of the Navamsha sign occupied by the lord of the 2nd house is located in a cardinal or trinal house, and is aspected by benefics, the native is fully aware of the results of actions and is engaged in the study of the religious literature. (48)

लागनेशरें धनराजियुते वागनें बा सौमस्तुते गुरों।
पारवरें ततीष्चरें धागनें निर्माणत किछणे गुरों 118911

If the lord of the Ascendant is in the 2nd house or is located in the Ascendant itself but is in its sign of exaltation and in association with a benefic planet & the lord of the lagna is in "Paravatamsha" (see shlokas 25 etc of chapter I) & Venus is in the 12th house, the native knows, Vedas & Vedanta. (49)

लागनेशरें धनराजियुते पतिश्चराजियुते धनराजियुते बलादेहे।
वेश्रिकाश्य गुरों धनराजियुते बलादेहे धनराजियुते : 119011

## WEALTH

If the lord of the Navamsha sign occupied inturn by the lord of the Navamsha occupied by the lord of the Ascendant is strong, in the division called "Vaisheshik" & is in association with or under the aspect of benefic planets, the native gets much income depending on the number of good yogas. (50)

वित्तशरें सहिते भवराजियुते कम्मिफिस्टनवमावस्थे गुरों।
वेश्रिकाश्य कम्मिफिस्टनवमावस्थे परमोदमानें गुरों धनराजियुते बलादेहे : 119211

If the lord of the house of gains (11th) is located with the lord of the 2nd house (wealth) and both are aspected by the planet who is the lord of the Navamsha occupied by the lord of the house of karma (10th) & the 11th house lord is located in its highest degree of exaltation in the division called "Vaisheshik" the native gets very highly rich. (51)

ध्यामिद्येन सहिते यनराजिनाये लगनेशरणसिपतनवाषपतीचेवेथ 1
दुस्ते चटूस्तवाते रुम्बुस्तवाते जातस्तु मृष्ठिनलामुस्तवाते भाले 114211

If the lord of the 2nd house is located with the lord of the 9th house and is aspected by the lord of the Navamsha sign occupied by the lord of the Ascendant and is also situated in a cardinal house under the aspect of benefics the native gets immensely rich. (52)

लगनेशेन लाम मवनेशेन रुम्बुस्तवाते स्वोच्छ रुम्बुस्तवाते विश्विताशें 1
रुगाशके यनपतितसनवाषपतीचेवेथSभ मृष्ठि धनलामुस्तवाते भाले 114311

If there are natural beneficial planets in the first, second and the seventh houses and are in their exaltation sign, friendly sign, or in the Navamsha or their sign of exaltation or are in the "Vaisheshik" division and are aspected by the lord of the Navamsha occupied by the lord of the 2nd house, the native gets much wealth in his childhood. (53)

लगनेशेन धनाशें धनलामुस्तवाते धनलामुस्तवाते 1
लगनेशेन वातिल धननशें रुम्बुस्तवाते मवनेशें 114811

If the lord of the Ascendant occupies the second house, the lord of the 2nd house goes to the 11th house & the lord of the 11th is in the Ascendant, the native becomes very rich with a big bank balance. (54)

## TRANSLATOR'S NOTE

From he above shloka it is clear that the link between the houses that denote wealth in one shape or another is conducive to much wealth. The 1st, 2nd, 5th, 9th & 11th houses are all houses of wealth or gains or luck i.e. wealth in some shape or other.

सव्वर्षधारतितही मदि धननशें : केदे सिपतितसनवाषपतीचेवेथ 1
बेशोषिकाशकुणте धनराजिनाये विस्तर सव्वर्षधारतितही मदि धननशें : 114411

If the lord of the Ascendant is stronger than all other planets and is located in a cardinal house with Jupiter, the lord of the 2nd house occupies the division called "Vaisheshik" (see shloka 25 etc. of chapter 1) the native earns by dint of his own efforts. (55)

लगनेशेन रुम्बुस्तवाते धनलामुस्तवाते धनलामुस्तवाते 1
केदे सिपतितसनवाषपतीचेवेथ सव्वर्षधारतितही धनलामुस्तवाते मदि धनलामुस्तवाते : 114511

If the lord of the sign occupied by the lord of the Navamsha occupied by the lord of the lagna, is strong and is a friend of the lord of the 2nd house, is located in kendra or a trine, or is in his own sign, the native earns wealth through many ways by dint of his own power. (56)

वित्तेषरो लामिशिलनपाया यूत्रिक्सकाने यदि केंद्रारो 1
पुण्यधिन : कालबलानिनपाया जात : स्ववरीयानमेंटि महस्त्र 114911

In case the lord of the 2nd house is situated with the lords of the 1st and the 11th houses in a cardinal or trinal house, and is aspected by benefics and has temporal strength, the native earns by dint of his own labour in the middle age. (57)

उत्तर धने यदि धनेश्रुतरारो वित्तेषरो सस्तोमेंटि 1
तबीचरो लामनागते कलादेश लामेश्रुतराइवमुवाहरित 114511

If the lord of the 1st house and a beneficial planet are located with the lord of the 2nd house and the lord of the sign so occupied goes to the Ascendant & is strong there the man is rich at the end of his life. The yoga is valid for the lord of the 11th house too i.e. if the lord of the 11th house & the lord of the 2nd house are together and the lord of the sign so occupied by the man is strong in the Ascendant, the man is rich at the end of his life. (58)

वित्तेषरो धनेश्रुतरारो बलानिनपाया पुण्यधिनिनपाया 1
तबीचरो लामनागते कलादेश लामेश्रुतराइवमुवाहरित 114911

If the lords of the 1st and the 2nd house are located together in the 3rd house in strength & are aspected by or are associated with male planets as well as by the lord of the 3rd house & are in "Vaisheshik" amsha (see shloka 25 etc of chapter 1) the native gets wealth from his brother. (59)

वित्तेषरो भाविशिलनपाया धनेश्रुतरारो तर वित्तेषरो कारक्रमनरेश 1
दृष्टे यदि या तनुयन जातो धनेश्रुतरारो यदि वित्तेषरो दृष्टे 115011

If the lord of the 3rd house is located in the 2nd house along with Jupiter & associated with or aspected by the lord of the lagna. & is in "Vaisheshik" amsha, the native gets wealth from his brother. (60)

परस्यरो वित्तेषरो भाविशिलनपाया निरीखितो केंद्रुतरारो 1
निरीखितो लामनुयनश्रुतरायमो जातो धनेश्रुतरारो धनेश्रुतरारो 115211

If the lord of the Ascendant & that of the 2nd house are located in kendras in good Navamsha and are mutually aspecting & if they are also aspected by the lords of the 1st & the 9th houses the native earns much by many ways. (61)

वित्तेषरो परस्यरो लामनागते यदि वित्तेषरो स्ववरीयानमेंति महस्त्र : 1
वित्तेषरो भाविशिलनपाया दृष्टे यदि वित्तेषरो ताड़ओमेंति वित्तेषरो 115211

---

When the lord of the 1st house aspects the lord of the 2nd house or if both are located in the same house, the native earns by dint of his own labour. If the lord of the 2nd & 1st house are together and are aspected by the lord & significator of the 3rd house (Mars) one earns through his brother. (62)

दृष्टे दुते वितपत्तों बलाओं सूत्रशर्षणेशायि धन जन्न्या : 1
बच्छों : सकाशायण वा कुवेशण धन प्रयात्यर वितपत्तों 115211

If a strong lord of the 2nd house is in association with or under the aspect of the lord of the 4th house in Vaisheshikamsha the native gets wealth from his mother, relatives or from agriculture. (63)

दृष्टे दुते वितपत्तों धनन्ये तत्र शित्रते कारक्षणरंगे 1
दृष्टे दुते वा तनुपन जातों श्रुभुपन याति वितपत्तों 115811

If the lord of the 2nd house is located in the same house in Vaisheshikamsha (see shloka 25 etc. of chapter 1) in association with the significator of brothers i.e. Mars and is also associated with or under the aspect of the lord of the Ascendant the man gets wealth from his brother. (64)

दृष्टे दुते वितपत्तों धनन्ये तत्र शित्रते बलाओं 1
दृष्टे दुते लागनपत्तों बलाओं वेशीखिकारे सूत्रशर्षणेशायि धन स्थाब 115211

In case the lord of the 2nd house is strong and is associated with or aspected by the lord and the significator of the 5th house (Jupiter) and the lord of the Ascendant is strong, in the "Vaisheshik" division, the native gets wealth from his son. (65)

वेशीखिकारे वदि लागनपत्तों जातों : स्वपुष्ठीनमेशण वितपत्तों 1
पठेशलत्रकारे सहायत्या सूत्रशर्षण वितपत्तों धनात्या 115211
धनों : सकाशायण धन प्रयात्यर वेशीखिकारे लागनपत्तों धनात्या 1
कल्यासत्रकारे सहायत्या वितपत्तों धन प्रयात्यर दिन जान : 115911

If the lord of the lagna is located in "Vaisheshik" amsha (see shloka 25 etc. of chapter 1) the native gets benefitted from the wealth earned by his son.

If the lord of the 2nd house is stronger than the 6th lord & Mars the significator of 6th and the lord of the lagna is strong in Vaisheshik amsha (see shloka 25 etc. of chapter 1) the native gets wealth from his enemies. Similarly if the said two planets are strongly influenced by the lord of the 7th house and its significator (Venus) one gets wealth from his wife. (66 & 67)

---

If the 9th house and the significator of father i.e. the Sun are involved in the said yoga one gets wealth from his father as also from his Guru & from religious ceremonies. In case the association or the aspect of the lord of the 10th house and the Sun is involved, the native gets money through charity of others and through his own fame. (68)

लामेंश्रतलकरकुलित्वोगादें बदलस्थ धने बहुलस्थ 115911

In this way the association and the aspect of the lord of the 11th house and its significator i.e. Jupiter leads to heavy income. (69)

## TRANSLATOR'S NOTE

The lord of the 11th house and its significator Jupiter are both factors denoting "Plenty". It is thus clear that their influence on any factor would make the characteristics of that factor very valuable. This yoga obtains with added vigour in the case of Jupiter for Aquarius nativities in as much as Jupiter in addition to being the lord and significator of the 11th house would also be the lord of the house of wealth. That is why we hold that in such a case Venus in Taurus in the 4th house aspected by a strong Jupiter would bestow on the native much landed property and many valuable vehicles. Here is the horoscope of Queen Wilhelmina of Netherland. See

the fact that Jupiter—the significator of wealth is here the lord of two houses of wealth viz. of the 2nd and the 11th. It is located in dignity in its own sign in the house of wealth and is also in retrogression. It is also aspecting Moon lagna and its lord. The strength of Jupiter—threefold representative of what made the Queen, the richest woman in the world. One need not therefore, despair of Aquarius lagna.

---

In case natural malefic planets are strongly situated in the 2nd house (in their own sign etc.) the man gets rich even if it be in association with or under the aspect of planets in debilitation, in inimical sign or eclipse. (70)

तस्तुशाविष्ठि विचन्नबंदे सपाई रिफेक्ट धन्नशे दिननाथसूटे |
नीलसिस्ते वा शुम्मुशिस्ते जातस्ते रिफेक्ट हरात दिनतीश : 119211
धन्नशे दिननाथसूटे रिफेक्ट लामनाथसे |
नुस्ते धन्नशे नीलसे या राजद्वाडनसेव : 119311
धन्नशे नाथराखिस्ते सपाई नीलराखिसे |
राजकारकसूटे राजद्वाडनसेव : 119811

If the lord of the 1st house is weak and is located in the 12th house with a malefic planet and the lord of the 2nd house is with the Sun or is in its sign of debilitation & under malefic aspect, the native loses his wealth at the hands of the government. (72)

If the lord of the 12th house is in the 2nd house, and the lord of the 11th house is in the 12th, the lord of the 2nd house is in 6th. 8th or 12th house or is in its sign of debilitation, the native loses wealth in consequence of punishment by government. (73)

If the lord of the 2nd house is located in the 8th house, in his sign of debilitation and in association with a malefic planet and the Sun, the native loses wealth in consequence of punishment by government. (74)

धन्नस्तुशे धन्नशे विचन्नबंदे सपाई रिफेक्ट धन्नशे दिननाथसूटे |
तस्तुशाविष्ठि नाथराखिस्ते सपाई राजद्वाडनसेव : 119211

If the lord of the 2nd is in the 12th & the lord of the 12th is in the 2nd & are aspected by the lord of the lagna, & if the lord of the lagna is with a malefic in the 8th house, the native loses wealth in consequence of punishment from the king (government). (75)

---

कमेशरে लामगते विधानन्यास्थ रुते यमकटकाझे 1
द्वत्तकरणोप्राचेठ बाइप रजीं प्रकौपदन्यास्थां : 119511

If the lord of the 10th house is located in the 11th house with the
lord of the lagna and is situated in yamkantar or danshtrakaral
amsha the native loses wealth by being punished by govt. (For
definitions of these terms see shloka 49 of chapter 1). (76)

धनायपो मृत्यदिकस्तुत्तो स्रुरोषागो हीनसलो सपापो 1
चोरारिमायायिपुरोषागो चोरारिमृत्यदिकस्तुत्तो 119511

If the lords of the 2nd and the 11th houses are located in cruel
divisions such as the Navamsha of a cruel planet, are' weak,
associated with malefics, and are associated with the lords of bad
houses e.g. 6th, 8th or 12th, the native suffers loss at the hands of
thieves, fire or the government. (77)

कमेशरे नाशगते सपापो स्रुरोषागो विधोषागो 1
धनायपो सहिते तदनीं भोक्कापवाददन्यास्थां : 119511

In case the lord of the 10th house is in the 8th with malefies, particularly in a cruel Navamsha or 6th division, & is in association
there with the lords of the 2nd & the 11th houses, then the native
loses wealth through defame by the people. (78)

वित्तशस्तुत्तन्यास्थान्यास्थां सपापो 1
सूत्रस्तुत्तन्यास्थां चोरारिमृत्यदिकस्तुत्तो 119511

Take the lord of the sign occupied by the lord of the 2nd house
and then take the lord of the Navamsha occupied by it. If this lord
is associated with a malefic planet in any of the houses 6th, 8th or
12th, and is under the influence of the lord of the Ascendant by
association or aspect, the native loses wealth through fire, theft or
governmental orders. (79)

धनायपो वित्तशस्तुत्तन्यास्थान्यास्थां नाशो सूत्रस्तुत्तन्यास्थां पापुरुक 1
स्रुरोषागो चोरारिमृत्यदिकस्तुत्तो चोरारिमृत्यदिकस्तुत्तो 115011

In case the lord of the Navamsha sign occupied by the lord of
the 2nd house is located in any of the houses 6th, 8th or 12th, and is
in association with a malefic or occupies the Navamsha of a cruel
planet, the native becomes poor. (80)

धनो स्रुरोषागो तदनीं पापुरुक 1
तदनीं लामगते सपापो चनहीनो मदनोर : 115011
स्रुरोषागो तदनीं धनोन निरीखितो बा 1
नीबाको हीनसलो : सपापो : केन्द्रितितचदिति निरीखन : स्याल 115011

---

If the 2nd house has malefic influence on it through association, and its lord is with malefic planets, similarly the lord of the 11th house is with malefics, the native is poor in wealth. (81)

If the lord of the Navamsha occupied by the lord of the 12th house, is with lord of the 2nd house or is aspected by it, and is in debilitation sign, eclipsed & otherwise weak & with malefics in kendra, the native is poor financially. (82)

If the lord of the Navamsha occupied by the lord of the sign occupied by the lord of the 2nd house is in kaldanda amsha (see 1/60th division) the native is poor financially. (83)

If the lord of the 2nd house is in a kendra or a trine but is in its sign of debilitation, eclipsed by Sun & in malefic shashti amsha (1/60th division) the native has very little wealth. (84)

यतिक्रितिद्वान्याति लामेंश्चान्याति
गुरुगा मुरुगा दूसे गुरुण्णप्रसंस्थनेश्चोपी
If the lord of the Navamsha occupied by the lord of the 11th house is aspected by Jupiter and Venus but is in malefic shashti amsha one earns but not much (1/60th division). (85)

सभ्य धनी धनेश्रोन कर्मनाथ्युतो यदि 1
कर्मनाथ्युतिता लामनाथ्यत्युतो विषु: 115811

In case the lord of the 10th house is situated with the lord of the 2nd house or if the lord of the 11th house is situated with the lord of the Navamsha sign occupied by the lord of the 10th house one becomes rich suddenly. (89)

लामनेश्रोन धनेश्रोन लामनाथ्युतो 1
धनेश्रोन सौझ्य धनेश्रोन नामतो मबेच 119011

If the lord of the Ascendant occupied the 2nd house and the lord of the 11th house is in the 10th, and the lord of the Navamsha sign occupied by the lord of the 2nd house is a benefic planet, the man gets wealthy by his fame. (90)

सहहर्णिकर्मतो स्यालजलनेश्रोन यदि 1
धनेश्रोन सौझ्य धनेश्रोन नामतो मबेच 119211

If the lord of the Navamsha occupied by the lord of the lagna is aspected by the benefic lord of the Navamsha occupied by the lord of the 2nd house, or by Mercury & Jupiter, the man earns a thousand. (91)

लामनेश्रोन धनेश्रोन लामनाथ्युतो 1
लामनाथ्युतो सौझ्य धनेश्रोन नामतो मबेच 119211

If the lord of the lagna is in the 2nd house, and the lord of the 11th house is in the 10th, and is aspected by the lord of the 11th house or by Jupiter, the man earns a thousand. (92)

सहहर्णिकर्मतो स्यालजलनेश्रोन यदि 1
गौय़ूर्षागतो कर्मनाथ्युतो सदित बीडितो 119311

If the lord of the Navamsha occupied by the lord of the Ascendant is situated in the "Gopur" division and is aspected by the lord of the 10th house one earns a thousand. (93)

कर्मनेश्रोन धनेश्रोन स्यालजलनेश्रोन यदि 1
धूर्णगतो देवेश्रोर्षाहितो धूर्ण सहहर्णिकर्मतो 119811

If the lord of the Saptamsha (1/7th division) occupied by the lord of the Navamsha occupied by the lord of the 10th house is strong and aspected by Venus and Jupiter the man earns two thousand Nishkas (units of currency). (94)

सौझ्यप्रदर्शनेश्रोन धनेश्रोन बीडितो 1
तवीष्ठीपि तथा धूर्ण सहहर्णिकर्मतो 119911

If the planet talked about in the previous shloka is located in benefic Shashti amisha (1/60th division), if the 2nd & the 11th houses are strong & so also are the lords of these two houses, the native earns three thousand. (95)

वेशोपिकाश्यं वितनाये गुरुविद्यासकरे 1
तथा वितनाये मध्यशोपित बलव्यशोपित धनी 119511

In case the lord of the 2nd house, & Jupiter, Moon and Sun are in the "Vaisheshik" division and the lord of the 11th house is also strong in the same manner the native becomes rich. (96)

धनेशोपिकाश्यं वितनाये : 1
सक्रीतमबलोपित वितनाये सहाख्यनिकुल 119911

If the lord of the Navamsha occupied by the lord of the decante of the lord of the 2nd house is very strong the native gets 8 thousand Nishkas. (97)

लागेशोपिकाश्यं वितनाये : 1
वेशोपिकाश्यं वितनाये धनीमबलोपित धनी 119511

If the lord of the Saptamsha (1/7th division) occupied by the lord of the Ascendant is located in "Vaisheshik" division, the native gets income of 10 thousand Nishkas. (98)

चयये शुद्रे चयने जीवे सभाये वेशोपिकाश्यं : 1
लागेशोपिकाश्यं तथा शुद्रे तलूष्ठमबलोपित सभ : 119911

If Venus is located in the 12th house and Jupiter in the 2nd, & both are in their own Navamsha sign or are in "Vaisheshik" division, the lord of the Ascendant is also similarly situated, the man earns more than 10 thousand Nishkas. (99)

गुरोपि लागेशोपिकाश्यं चयने वेशोपिकाश्यं : 1
केन्द्रिकोपित चयने तलूष्ठमबलोपित सभ : 1190011

If Jupiter is conjoined to the lord of the Ascendant in the 2nd house, in "Vaisheshik" division or is located in the cardinal or trinal house, the native earns more than 10 thousand Nishkas. (100)

कमेशोपिकाश्यं नायसूष्ठमबलोपित : 1
एववतोष्ठमबलोपित चनलाह समस्यनुल : 1190211

If the lord of the Saptamsha (1/7th division) occupied by the lord of the decante occupied by the lord of the 10th house is-in "Aravat amsha" the man enjoys a lakh. (101)

लहड़णे चयने याटि चतूष्ठमबलोपित गुरोपिकाश्यं : 1
सिहासने यदेशोपित सति पारायतोष्ठमबलोपित 1190211

---

If all the four cardinal houses viz the, 1st, 4th, 7th & 10th contain natural benefics and the lord of the 2nd house is located in the "Simhasan" division, the man earns two lakhs. (102)

लोदर्शयिकारी स्वालखामहानन्तनायिः 1
बेश्विकारीशकारते मुद्राचित्रते भा 1180311

If any of lords of the 11th, 1st & 2nd houses is in "Vaisheshik" amsha (see shloka 25 etc. chapter 1) or in Mridu amsha, the native gets 3 lakhs. (103)

तत्पूर्णं वितल : स्वालखु धननगामपती यदि 1
वृद्धिकारीशकारते तो चेदिलनो माणपदस्त्रा 1180811

If the lords of the 2nd and the 11th houses are in the 4th house & are strong & the lord of the 9th house too is strong the native gets more than 3 lakhs. (104)

केदर्शिकारीशकारते वीरस्तस्त्रय भा मणनगामपती 1
बेश्विकारीशकारते धननगामपती समस्तस्त्रय 1180411

If the lord of the 9th house is strong in a kendra or a trinal house or is with the lord of the 11th house and in "Vaisheshik" amsha (see shloka 25 etc. in chapter 1), the native gets 1 lakh. (105)

लगनानगामपतीशकारते : परमोच्चशास्त्रय भा मणनगामपती 1
बेश्विकारीशकारते लामश्च तदा कोटीशस्त्रय मणनगामपती 1180511

If the lord of the Navamsha occupied by the lagna & the lord of the 9th house occupy their highest degree of exaltation and the lord of the 11th is in "Vaisheshik" amsha the native becomes crore pati (multimillionaire). (106)

सुपार्थे वितलनगामपतीशकारते : 1
सुपार्थे वेषनगामपत्रा मुद्राचित्रते समस्तस्त्रय 1180911

If Jupiter aspects the lord of the Navamsha occupied by the lord of the lagna & the planet thus aspected is in Mridu amsha (benelic Navamsha etc.), the native lends money on interest. (107)

वितलामपतीशकारते वीरस्तस्त्रयशकारते : 1
बेश्विकारीशकारते सुपार्थे मणनगामपती 1180511

If the lords of the Navamsha occupied by the lords of the decantes in which the lords of the 2nd and the 11th houses are located lie in kendra or trinal houses the native is a money lender. (108)

सुपार्थे धननगामपती धननगामपती पाठे पाठे लामनगामपती धननगामपती 1
कमेश्रीशकारते लामनगामपत्रा धननगामपती धननगामपती 1180911

If there is a malefic planet in the 2nd house and the lord of the lagna is in the 12th house one gets involved in debts. This will be more so if the planet in the 12th house influences the lords of the 10th and the 11th houses. (109)

दिनेशकरूपत्रवुल्लु धनेशों नीचराखिग : 1
फापानिस्तर धनेश तर्षे सुपानिस्तर मबेनर : 1122011

If the lord of the 2nd house is in its sign of debilitation and eclipsed by the Sun & if there are malefic planets in the 2nd and the 8th house, the native is badly caught in debt. (110)

धनेशों नीचराखिगे कृष्णपत्रवुल्लु धनेशों नीचराखिगे : 1
तौमेंशों तत्या धनेशों सुपानिस्तर मबेनर : 1122211

If the lord of the 2nd house is in its sign of debilitation & occupies malefic Shashti amsha and the lord of the 11th house is also in malefic Shashti amsha, the man is caught in debt. (111)

भामेशिक्षतमाहोंशनाये धूलेशों सुपानिस्तर मबेनर : 1122211

If the lord of the Navamsha sign occupied by the lord of the 11th house is located in 6th, 8th or 12th house with a malefic planet & is in a malefic Shashti amsha (1/60th division), the native is involved in debt. (112)

वाकस्थानपे फ़टगाते सराहों राहुस्थानपे सफ़टगाते धूलेशों सुपानिस्तर मबेनर : 1122211

## TEETH TROUBLE

If the lord of the 2nd house is with Saturn and other malefic planets, the native has brain trouble. The trouble is in consequence of the anger of the authorities if the malefic with Saturn is the Sun and it is from heat if Mars is with Saturn. (115)

तब्दिहरेशायि युतेडुवूणे संगमकेतावरिमाचुवूने।

राह़िहरेशायि संगमकेतावरिमाचुवूने या मुल्की तब्दा ताउमब : स रोग : 1192511

If the lord of the 2nd house is in the 6th house along with Mercury Rahu or Ketu or the two planets are in association there with the lord of the sign occupied by Rahu, the native will have disease in the upper portion of the organ of speech in the sub period of Rahu (and the main period of the lord of the second house). (116)

राजारिनायि तन्नमाववूने साच्छाशिष्टों युमिपते : प्रकौपपात।

उन्यातन नेसमुखीत तज्जा नीच्चशिष्टों यापुवते तज्जव : 1192911

If the lords of the 10th and the 6th houses are in occupation of the Navamsha of their sign of debilitation, are located in lagna, with malefic planet and with Venus and the lord of the 2nd house, the native loses his eyes under the orders of the king (government). (117)

राजारिनायि सित्तमाववूने युमिपते विलागनेशुवूने तज्जव :

śaچ्छाशिष्टों नाथगतों तज्जव युमिपने युमिपने नयनमाबद : 1192511

If the lords of the Navamsha occupied by the lords of the 10th & the 6th houses are located in the 6th, 8th or 12th house, along with the lord of the lagna & if the lord of the 2nd house and Venus are located in the 8th house without the aspect of benefic planets there is much trouble in the eyes. (118)

तब्दिहरेशायि कारकाम्य पिस्तादिकानों फकलमवामुव : 1192911

All types of results to father etc. should be declared from the house of the relation concerned and from the significator of that relation. (119)

कण्ठिस्त पिस्तादिकानमाध्याय : सोरे समोदने धनये पिस्तादने।

रोगाचिस्त पिस्तादिकानमाध्याय नाथगतों मवदुवते मवदुवते 1192911

If the lord of the 2nd house is in the lagna along with Saturn and Mars, this yoga leads to the ear being cut. Another yoga is constituted for the same result if the lord of the 6th house is in the lagna along with the lord of the 2nd house and Gulik is in the 8th house with Mars. (120)

---

## TRANSLATOR'S NOTE

Although the condition of ears is seen from the 3rd house & its lord, yet the 2nd house and its lord are also relevant in as much the loss of a limb is also seen from the house 12th to the house representing the limb. This point is clear from the fact that Vaikalya or loss of a limb in general is considered from the 12th house which is 12th to the first house standing for the body as a whole. In this connection attention is invited to shloka number relating to 12th house in chapter 8 i.e. to the word "Vaikalyam" used therein.

पिर्यादिकना फकलेवमुह तत्स्थाननायश्चरकारेकेष् : 1
मुत्तीश्बरे हन्ड्रनिशाकराम्या केंद्रे मुत्ते राजलमर्श पासम् 1192911

## UTENSILS

Thus should the results be declared by considering the house and the significator of the relation concerned. If the lord of the 2nd house is located in kendra with Venus and Moon the native has silver utensils in his house. (121)

सवर्द्रुपुणामर्ननायश्चरुपूणे केंद्रिते सवर्द्रुपुणे हि पासम् 1
तत्स्थानिशाकराम्या केंद्रे मुत्ते राजलमर्श पासम् 1192911

If Mercury alongwith Jupiter is in kendra the native has golden utensils. If the lord of the 2nd house is in kendra or trine & in Vaisheshik amsha (see shloka 25 etc. of chapter 1) then also the native has golden utensils. (122)

मुत्तेषे का परमोन्नमायश्चरुपूणे हिते तत्स्थानिशाकराम्या हि ताडुषे नव 1
सवर्द्रुपुणामर्ननायश्चरुपूणे हिते ताडुषे नव 1192911

Similarly if the lord of the 2nd house is in Mridu amsha (benelie Navamsha etc.) or in the Navamsha of the sign of its exaltation the native has golden utensil. (123)

बीवितिते मुत्तीपतितस्तरुपूणे मुत्तेषे हिते पास सवर्द्रुपुणे 1192911

If the lord of the 2nd house is strong and occupies its own Navamsha, the man uses golden utensils. (124)

मुत्तेषे मुत्तीपते विष्ठापत्यावतावे वललुषे मुत्ते 1
केंद्रिते मिस्रुपुणे हिते स्याच्छस्तरी पास बलुषे मुत्ते 1192911

If the lord of the 2nd house is in a Mridu amsha particularly in Paravat etc. amshas is strong in kendra and aspected by a benefic friend, the native uses many utensils at the time of eating. (125)

विचित्रपारे प्रबंधनेत नज़ा शुत्रीषरे केंद्रगते बलाओहै।
शुत्रीषरा मरेंचेडूलो बलाओहासतेहै यूत्रेस शुत्रीषरेहै 1122411

If the lord of the 2nd house is strong in kendra and in Vaisheshik amsha & is associated with strong Venus, Jupiter, or Mercury the native has a variety of utensils used at the time of eating. (126)

Davagni or Kal amsha (see table for Shashti amshas) the man is a ferocious eater. The same is the result if the lord of the 2nd house is in the Navamsha of its sign of debilitation and aspected by malefics. But if benefices are associated with or aspect the lord of the 2nd house the fault of too much eating does not arise. (131)

मुतितिस्याने शूम्मुतैं तत्वीष्य शूम्मस्यैं

शूम्मस्यैं सन्दृष्टे शूम्मस्यैं नरे मबेस 11923211

When there is a benefic planet in the 2nd house, the lord of the 2nd is associated with and aspected by a benefic planet, the native enjoys food in comfort. (132)

मुतितिस्याने शूम्मुतैं : प्रिमानस्याने बलस्यैं

विश्वस्यानेताथके बापि शूम्मुक्कनिरीधित 11923211

If the lord of the 2nd house is in strength, or in Vaisheshik amsha & aspected by Jupiter and Venus, the native is rich and enjoys food in comfort. (133)

मुत्तैं च्योच्य तिकौंगे बा तत्वीष्य खलाईनितैं

कारकेयि विश्वस्याने शूम्मुतैं शूम्माशनी 11923811

If there is a planet located in the 2nd house in its exalted sign or in its Mool trikon (positive) sign & the lord of the 2nd house is in strength & well aspected, the significator of eating (Moon) is located in Vaisheshik amsha, the native enjoys food in comfort. (134)

कारकेयिताथनी शूम्मुतैं नेड़श्यानितैं

If the lord of the 2nd house is aspected by the lord of the 1st house, the native takes food at appropriate times. If it is aspected by malefic planet or is located in debilitation Navamsha etc, the native is not mindful in this respect. (135)

## BLOOD

If Mars occupies 1st, 12th, 6th or the 7th house and is with Mandi and aspected by Sun; and Mars is eclipsed, in inimical sign, in its sign of debilitation, the man suffers from troubles of the blood.

## TRANSLATOR'S NOTE

Mars like Moon Represents blood. The heavy affliction of Mars & Moon lead to pollution etc. of blood. For example, if Mars lord of the lagna containing Moon or Moon lord of the lagna containing Mars is afflicted by disease factors such as Saturn and Rahu.

99 the man gets his blood polluted. If in addition Mercury representing skin is also afflicted by Saturn or Rahu, the man falls prey to leprosy. Here is the example of a person who developed leprosy. Here Moon is lord of lagna occupied by Mars suffring in 8th in the sign of Saturn & under aspect of Mars. Mars in lagna suffers from both Saturn & Rahu while Mercury is afflicted by Rahu & Saturn. Venus in Lagna is no relief as it is dispositor of Saturn.

## TRANSLATOR'S NOTE
We give below the horoscope of a person who tried to commit suicide by taking "sleeping pills" birth date is 28-11-1953. The first point that is relevant to the context is the fact that Moon—the significator of "Eating" is herself in this case the lord of the house of eating i.e. the 2nd house. It is obvious that the nature of influence falling on the 2nd house & on Moon—the lord & significator of eating would denote the nature of eating. The 2nd house is fully aspected by Rahu—a planet that stands for poison. It is also aspected by Saturn, another planet representing poison. Similarly, Moon has on it the surrounding influence of Rahu and Saturn on one side of it and of Mars & Rahu on the other. Mars too being a poisonous planet, both the 2nd house, its lord & significator are under the influence of poisonous planets. Hence the relevance of poison. It has a case of eating poison as Moon as the lord and significator of eating is involved & not a case of being bitten by some poisonous reptile etc.

तथे : सौत्रेश्यप्रयुत्राणवृद्धिया तथा मबेव 1
एत्यों रोशमानादा पापयोंगाडिनादन्य 112911

Or the number is denoted by the sign and Navamsha of the planet associated with the lord of the 3rd house and Mars. The stronger of these located in better amsha gives the number, or the number should be determined from the Rashmis (see note below) of these two planets. The number lost should be determined by the number of malefic influences & the location in bad amshas such as Kal. (29)

सौत्रेश्यप्रयुत्राणवृद्धिया पापयोंगाडिनादन्य 112911

When there are different types of yogas the result should be declared from the stronger of two i.e. Mars & the lord of the 3rd house. (30)

## TRANSLATOR'S NOTE

Rashmi is the proportional strength of a planet due to its distance from the point where it is in highest debilitation. Suppose we desire to ascertain the number of Rashmis possessed by the Sun when its longitude is 11-14-10. Taking out 6-10 from it, the remainder 5-4-10 is the distance of Sun from its highest degree of debilitation. Multiplying 5-4-10 by 7 we get 35-29-10 which divided by 6 gives us 5-29-52 i.e. about 6 Rashmis (for further details see shloka 1 of chapter IV of 'Maan Sagari Paddhiti'.

---

ग्रोयाचित्र सुगाउने बलादें केन्द्रिकोणे यादे सौम्युड़े 1
मूलारिकोणे सवुगाउने वेशीकोणे पुर्णभ : स ध्रुत : 113211

If the lord of the 3rd is exalted, strong, in Kendra or trine, aspeted by benefics or in own Mool Trikon, own or friendly sign and in
"Vaisheshik" Amsha, the native is patient, brave and learned.
(31)

ग्रोयाचित्र मवेदिकोणाचित्र सौम्युड़े सौम्युड़े पुर्णभ : 113211
तथ्यव तत्कारकोणे सौम्युड़े मवेदने तु ध्रुत : 113211

## BRAVERY

One is brave if the lord of the 3rd house occupies the Navamsha
of a benefic planet & is with a benefic planet. Similarly the
significator of the 3rd house if in the sign of benefic planet gives
bravery. (32)

ग्रोयाचित्र विक्रमराचित्र सौम्युड़े पुर्णभ : 113211
तथ्यव तत्कारकोणे सौम्युड़े मवेदने तु ध्रुत : 113211

Determine the Navamsha occupied by the lord of the 3rd house.
Then determine the Navamsha occupied by this Navamsha sign.
The lord of the latter Navamsha if situated in the good vargas such
as its own sign makes the native brave., expert in battle &
quarrels. (33)

विक्रमराचित्र सवुगाउने नाखच्चे पापसुड़े 1
चरमे चरणाचित्र सौम्युड़े पुर्णभ : 113811

If the lord of the 3rd house is located in its sign of exaltation, in
the 8th house, with malefic planets, in movable sign & in the
Navamsha of a movable sign, the man is courageous only before
the actual battle. (34)

पापसुड़े मवेदने विक्रमे पापसुड़े 1
तथ्यव तत्कारकोणे सौम्युड़े पुर्णभ : 113911

If there is the sign of a malefic planet in the 3rd house & there is
also a malefic planet there, if the lord of the 3rd is also in the sign of
a malefic planet, the native is courageous only before the actual
battle. (35)

कруरपस्तच्चे वापि तथ्यव तत्कारकोणे पापसुड़े 1
पापसुड़े बा तथ्यव तत्कारकोणे मवेदने : 113911

If the lord of the 3rd house is in its sign of debilitation, or in
malefic Shashti Amsha (1/60th division), is with malefics and
aspected by malefics, the native is inefficient in battle. (36)

---

If the lord of the 3rd house is in its sign of exaltation but in 8th house, & the significator (Mars) is weak & occupies a malefic Shashti Amsha (1/60th division). the native is defeated in battle. (37)

Hitler though vanquished at the end of World War II had conquered almost the whole of Europe. Let us see 3rd house in his horoscope given below. Moon is farthest away from the Sun;

hence it is a strong benefic. Jupiter also away from Sun & in dignity in 3rd house is also a strong benefic. Ketu with two strong benefics must tow their lines. In view of the highly beneficial planets in the 3rd house he had victory after victory. But Saturn-the planet of separation located in the house of ruling powers exerted itself in advance stage (appropriate to Saturn) & brought about his separation from ruling powers. In any case 3rd house is undoubtedly extra strong with benefics.

सिहासनों यदि विक्रमशेष पारावते गौरमाणुलुते 1
मूद्रशेष के बा पुल्फुलियों चिन्तोलसे गौरमाणुलुते : स्याल 11इड11

If the lord of the 3rd house is located in Simhasan, Paravat, Gopur, or Mridu Amsha & is in association of & under aspect of benefic planet, the native is happy to engage himself in battle. (38)
गौरमाणुलुते समर्प्तिजीं वीर्षषरे सोम्यालुते स्युलुते 1
वेष्टिकानों बलपुल्फुलुते मूद्रशेषों बा विपरीतमन्यव 11इड11

If the lord of the 3rd house is located with a benefic, or, in exaltation, or in Vaisheshik Amsha is in strength, is in Mridu Amsha, the native is a willing soldier adept in the art of battle. If, however, it is in company of malefic, weak, etc. opposite is the result. (39)

---

If the lord of the 3rd house is located with Sun, the man is brave,
if with Moon he has mental patience, if with Mars he is dark
coloured, fool & full of wrath, if with Mercury he has Satvik
intellect. (40)

जीवानिस्तंत धरतया समेत : सवानिश्चर्याविष्कार : स्थान 1
कामाटूरस्त्रयाविष्कार स्थाननमुल कोपाळ्लोड़ प्रविधि : 118211

If it is with Jupiter he is brave, and efficient in understanding the
Shastras, if with Venus is given to sex and gets enraged as a result
of his sexual disposition. (41)

जैवानिस्तंत धरतया समेत : सवानिश्चर्याविष्कार : स्थान 1
बहिदुः हुण्ठातःडुः समेत : केवलिस्तंत माइवुने नभेश 118211

If the lord of the 3rd house is with Saturn, he is fool, if with Rahu,
he is brave only outwardly. If it is with Ketu or Mandi the results
are the same as shown for the association of Rahu. (42)

लान गुरो विक्रमनाश्रुः सुण्ठयवना प्रविधि भातिस्तंत 1
मवा मय बा अखराश्रीलागने जलामाबे सुण्ठयवना स्थान 118211

## SOURCES OF DANGER

If Jupiter is in the Ascendant, with the lord of the 3rd house,
there comes danger from animals. If the lord of the 3rd house is in
a watery sign in the lagna the danger comes from cows. There is
trouble from water also. (43)

जीवानिस्तंत हुण्ठमेतराश्रीलागने हुण्ठयवना प्रविधि भातिस्तंत 1
सवानिश्चर्याविष्कार सुण्ठयवना प्रविधि गलरोगमर्स 118811

If the lord of the 3rd house is with Rahu in lagna & also with the
lord of the sign occupied by Rahu, the native may be bitten by a
serpent. If the lord of the 3rd house is with Mercury, there is disease in the throat. (44)

नीचे सुण्ठयवना सुण्ठयवना प्रविधि भातिस्तंत 11
विक्रमयवना सुण्ठयवना प्रविधि गलरोगमर्स 118811

If there is a planet in the 3rd house in its sign of debilitation, or it
is in an inimical sign in that house, and eclipsed, & aspected by
malefics, there is danger from poison either by its use or by its consumption. If the above yogas are not there, there is no danger from poison. (45)

## FOOD

If Moon or Venus is in the 3rd house in strength, & is aspected by benefics. & associated with benefics, is in the varga of its exaltation sign, own sign or friendly sign, the native takes food in valuable utensils & has food in comfort. (46)

पामे तुतीये गाळरोगमर्श वदेशि मौथादियूते विष्कृतपालः
भोमानिस्तर प्रतुतुरीश्मामों तुतीयराशूते वदेशि कग्रितमर्श 118911

## EARS

The native suffers from throat troubles if there is a malefic planet particularly Mandi in the 3rd house. If Mars is there in Yama Amsha (see shloka 49 of chapter 1) the native suffers from ear disease. (47)

सोल्यशनों माइडियूते तुतीये गाळरोगमर्श सोल्यशूता विष्कृतपालः
तुतीयनाखिदियूते तुतीये कग्रितमर्श रोगं कग्रितमर्श तज्जा : 118911

If Saturn located in the 3rd house is with Mandi & has no beneficial influence over it the native has nervous trouble in the ear. The trouble is also there in the following case. Find out the sign in which the lord of the third house is located. See then if the sign and the Navamsha sign in which the lord of that sign is located are in kendra. (48)

पामानिस्तर पामनिरीश्माते या वदेशि कग्रितमर्श रोगं कग्रितमर्श तज्जा : 118911

If the third house has malefic planet in it and is also aspected by a malefic planet the man suffers from disease of the ear. If the lord of the 3rd house is in malefic Shashti Amsha (1/60th division) even then there is trouble in the ear. (49)

सोल्यशनों तुतीये या सोल्यशनूते तुतीये कग्रितमर्श वदेशि कग्रितमर्श तज्जा : 119011

If there is a beneficial planet in the 3rd house & it is aspected by a benefic & the lord of the 3rd house is situated with benefics, the cars have ornaments in them. (50)

शुक्रं तुतीये यादि मौतिके तुत् जेबेसSुक्रं तचार्समर्श वदेशि।
भानोस्तु संबंधयूते तुतीये सर्दतमर्शनीलमर्श हि मौतिके 119211

If Venus is in the 3rd house, pearls constitute the ear ornament, if Jupiter is there the ornament is of the best type. If Sun is there the ornament is of valuable gem, if it is Mandi it is of fast blue colour. (51)

Find out the lord of the Navamsha occupied by the lord of the 4th house. Then see in which sign it is located. The lord of this Navamsha sign if in kendra indicates the acquisition of a house. (57)

भाग्यें कैदर्शावस्त्र गुणें स्वोच्चिमिस्ट्रें 1
गुणेरीशिगत घौते स्वोच्चिमिस्ट्रें 119211

If the lord of the 9th house is in kendra the lord of 4th house is in a friendly sign, & there is a planet in exaltation in the 4th house, the native gets a beautiful house. (58)

तृतीये सोम्सस्वुतें गुणें स्वोच्चिमिस्ट्रें 1
तत्वीये वलासपूर्णे हम्यरीकारमडितम 119211

If the third house has a benefic planet in it, the lord of the 4th house is strong, & the lord of the 3rd house is full of strength, the native gets multi-storey building. (59)

सिहासनाथ्यें वापि गुणें गुणुरोष्ठें 1
मुद्रादिनुतें वापि तर्बगुणे सोम्यादिनुतें 116011

If the lord of the 4th house is located in "Simhasan" Amsha, or in "Gopur" Amsha or Mridu Amsha, the native possesses a house built with lime etc. (60)

धरावतथाखें गोहनाथ्यें गुणिनुणोष्ठें 1
गुणुरोष्ठें वापि देविके हम्यरीकारमडितम 116211

If the lord of the 4th house is in "Paravat" Amsha. Jupiter is aspected by Moon, or Jupiter is located in "Gopur" etc. Amsha the native has a house as if of angles. (61)

विविस्तरोष्ठाखें गुणमाडिथें 1
कम्मिफिपें सहिते नाथे केन्द्रकुलना 116211

If the lord of the 4th house together with the lord of the 10th house and Saturn are in kendra, the native has a house of many storeys & built of good material. (62)

## TRANSLATOR'S NOTE

The 10th house denotes "Zenith". Hence its link in the yoga gives height at many storeys.

गुणमाडिथें नाथे वापि स्वात्मयपूर्णें तर्बगुणमाडिथें 1
गुणमाडिथें नाथे वापि स्वात्मयपूर्णें गुणमाडिथें : 116211

If the lord of the 4th house is located in the 8th house & is aspeced by malefics, the house is destroyed. So also when the lord of the

---

Navamsha occupied by the lord of the 4th house is in the 8th house. (63)

बन्सुल्यानिष्ठते सोम्य सोम्यप्रदर्शिते 1
तत्कारक्षलाधें वा बन्सुल्यानी मध्यनर : 115811

## RELATIVES

If there is a benefic planet in the 4th house aspected by a benefic planet, & the significator i.e. Mercury is strong, the native gets respect from his relatives. (64)

बन्सुल्यानिष्ठते जीवे तत्विः पुण्यसुल्ये 1
रुल्यप्रदर्शितसमापूर्ण बन्सुल्यसुल्ये मध्यनर : 115911

If Jupiter occupies the 4th house, & the lord of the 4thhouseis with a benefic planet & is aspected by Jupiter the man has highly placed relatives. (65)

बन्सुल्यक्ति तन्नाये केन्द्र केंगोच सुल्ये 1
बेशीपिकांशसुल्ये पाउडुआगविन्न 115411

If the lord of the 4th house is in kendra or trine, & in "Vaisheshik" Amsha & not under the influence of any malefic either by association or by aspect, the native helps his relatives. (66)

बन्सुल्यानुपकारी स्थानसंस्थे रुल्यसंस्थामजा : 1
तेपा गुणे भा तेपुणे मुस्त्रादिसमित्र 115911

If Jupiter, Venus and Mercury are located in the 4th house in "Mridu" etc. Amsha and these benefic planets aspect their own signs the native is very helpful to his relatives. (67)

बन्सुल्यमस्त्रतपुण्यसंस्थे पाउडुआगविन्न 1
कुण्यप्रदर्शिते बाऐप नीचारितुआगविन्न भा 115411

If the lord of the 4th house is with malefic planets & located in malefic Shashti Amsha (1/60th division) or in its sign of debilitation or inimical sign, the man is forsaken by his relatives. (68)

## TRANSLATOR'S NOTE

In problems where the question of separation, forsaking, leaving etc. is involved, the malefic planets most intimately concerned are the separative planets Sun, Saturn and Rahu. We may exclude others from this work. Hence in the above shloka the term "malefic planets" should be taken to mean Sun, Saturn & Rahu and of course their dispositors.

---

बन्डुपापसमायूते बन्दो नाय तर्वेव हि 1
तत्कारके तर्वेवार बन्दौना कुलिसते वदेव 115911

If more than 2 malefic planets are located in the 4th house, the lord of the 4th house is also under the malefic influence of more than 2 malefics & so is the case with the significator of relatives i.e. Mercury, the native is not liked by his relatives. (69)

नायकारकेसमुतेनायूथाधनायक : 1
नीचराशिगातो मुटो बन्दौना मयकमुतो 119011

Work out the Navamsha sign of both the lord of the 4th house and of Mercury. Then see in which Navamsha the lord of the two Navamsha signs is located. If this sign is in such case the debilitation sign of the two planets the native would be cause of fear to his relatives. (70)

बन्दौनुमंगी कन्नस्थे तर्वेव पुल्म वर्षिते 1
गौरुराख्षके वारित पुल्म द्विभितर्षित 119811

If the lord of the 4th house is located in kendra, is aspected by benefies, is located in Amshas such as Gopur & Mridu, the native gets help from his relatives. (71)

धन्न ताजे सिकोणास्थे तन्नाये पुल्म वर्षिते 1
सोफ्रुहागामोहे बा बन्दौनुमंगीकारुव 119211

If the lord of the 4th house is located in the 2nd, 11th, 5th or 9th house and is aspected by benefic planets & is located in the Navamsha of benefic planets, the native helps his relatives. (72)

बन्दौनुमंगी मयेनिन्ते पापाकारुव वर्षिते 1
नीचराशिगातो बन्दौनुमंगीकारुव 119311

If the lord of the 4th house is afflicted by malefic planets and is in association with planets who are in their debilitation sign or are eclipsed and is without the association or aspect of benefic planets the native always hates his relatives. (73)

## HOUSES

If there is a movable sign in the 4th house, its lord is the significator i.e. Mars (built up property) the native has houses in many places. (75)

शिर्तरे गुहे शिर्तरुहं नायकारक्योरीय 1
धवत्स्थे पुष्ममनों या तबीजे शिर्तरुहं रखेब 119511

If there is a fixed sign in the 4th house & the lord of the 4th house and Mars are also situated in fixed signs, there is stability of the house. (76)

अध्यण्यप्रयुगेश्टेश्टेश्टेश्टे : पापस्थुता : 1
तावदूरोहालिणा : स्याक्षुमदूरा न वैषवा : 119511

The number of malefic planets that influence each of the lords of the 2nd, 12th & 4th houses denote the destruction of that number of houses. There is no destruction of houses if these are aspected by benefic planets. (77)

देर्शाखित पंचमस्थय गौुरोषादिस्तुत् 1
मूद्रषाखिते वाछi बृहुस्थयस्थयनित् : 112211

If the lord of the 4th house is located in the 5th house in Gopur etc. Amsha or Mridu Amsha the man possesses much property. (82)

धारणकारकस्तुत् भावनायेन सेयुत् 1
देर्शे तत्विष्ठे वाछi भावनायेन विनिद्धेवल 112311

If there are in the 4th house or with the lord of the 4th the lord of the 3rd house & the significator of the 3rd house i.e. Mars, the native gets property from his brother. (83)

देर्शेशोषुत्तनवाशनायेन केदिष्टे मिस्रिनरीडिते या 1
भोमालिस्ते भोमुष्ठा समेते भावनायेन देर्शेशोषुधारिति 112811

If the lord of the Navamsha sign occupied by the lord of the 4th house is located in kendra & is aspected by its friend & is with Mars or under the aspect of Mars, the native gets property from his brother. (84)

लागनेष्ठे देर्शेशोषुत्तनवाशनायेन वलागने बलिज़्त यारि देर्शेशोषुत्तनवाशनायेन या देर्शे सवकीयने वलोन यारि 112911

If the lord of the lagna is strong in the 4th house & the lord of the 4th house is strong in the lagna, & is under the influence of benefits by association or aspect the native gets house through his own efforts. (85)

कलस्कारके देर्शे तत्विष्ठे या कलस्कार 1
तत्विष्ठेसत्या मेष्या कलस्कारसेमाधितेवल 113511

If Venus is in the 4th house, & the lord of the 4th house is in the 7th house, & if there is friendship between the lords of the 4th and the 7th houses, the native gets property from or through his wife. (86)

पद्धप्रवर्तनवाशनायेन वलागने फ़ळस्तिते या पुलस्तानवाशनायेन 1
पद्धप्रवर्तनवाशनायेन वलागने श्रेष्ठ : सक्षासनस्त्यायापुलस्तानवाशनायेन 113911

If the lord of the 6th house is in the 4th house and is strong & the lord of the 4th is in the 6th house & if the lord of 4th is stronger than the lord of the 6th, the native gets land etc. from the enemy. (87)

पारावतायों सवगुणे वलागने देर्शेशोषुत्तनवाशनायेन चौपणय गठत या 1
आरोहमागो पुलस्तितुत्तनवाशनायेन देर्शेशोषुधारिति 114511

If the lord of the 4th house is strong in its own sign, in "Paravatamsha" or is in upchaya house (3rd. 6th. 10th or 11th).

---

near its sign of exaltation, & under the aspect of benefic planets.
the native has much landed property. (88)

धन्नश्लामेषस्मिनते वा देशे तत्वीशोप्यण कारके वा 1
बेर्थिकांशे पुम्रुडियुटे बहवव्यहपर गुणमाहुराय : 115911

If the 4th house, its lord & its significator i.e. Mars are located in "Vaisheshik" Amsha & are under the aspects of benefic planets and are in association with the lords of the 2nd and the 11th houses. the native has a very costly house. (89)

देशे देशे नीचगाते विमुखे पापातरे पापिनरीखिते वा 1
पापप्रदेशस्मिनते रिगौंडे देशादिनाय कक्षयति तज्जा : 119011

If the lord of the 4th house is located in its sign of debilitation, is eclipsed, is located in between malefies or is aspected by malefies, is in the sign of an inimical and malefic planet, the yoga indicates loss of property. (90)

पापातरेस्मिनते वाइमुखे पापातरे पापिनरीखिते वा 1
पापप्रदेशस्मिनते वा स्यातकृुरायके मुखिरिनायमाहुर : 119211

If Mars (the significator of property) is associated with a malefic planet or is aspected by such a planet or is located in the sign of a malefic & is in a malefic Navamsha, the yoga indicates loss of landed property. (91)

कृुराखितस्मिनते तत्वीशे देशे सपापे वाइमुखे वा 1
तुल-स्यातरेस्मिनते तत्वीशे देशादिनाय कक्षयति तज्जा : 119211

If the lord of the 4th house is located in malefic Shashti Amsha (1/60th division), or is in its sign of debilitation, or in the sign of a malefic planet, is in 6th, 8th or 12th house, is in an inimical sign, or in a very malefic Navamsha, the yoga indicates loss of property. (92)

If the lord of the 4th house is with a malefic planet in the 2nd house, in its sign of debilitation or inimical sign, the yoga indicates loss of the landed property. If however, the lord of the 4th house is located in its sign of exaltation but is with malefic planets the property has to be sold. (93)

If in the 4th house there are signs of strong Venus, Moon, Mercury or Jupiter & the sign is aspected by or associated with benefics the native has many enjoyments in life. (107)

## DROWNING

If the lord of the 4th house is in its sign of debilitation, or eclipsed, or is in inimical sign indicating water, & is weak, the native falls in water near the well. (109)

तगनेखूषते चीननबेत शुर्णखूषते नीवेकुपतलमें यदि बा सपतलमें 1
जलराशिस्तेआपि युरोहित शुर्णखूषते बवेन चीनन जलराशिस्तेआपि : 1120011

If the lord of the lagna is located in the 4th house, in weakness, in its sign of debilitation, or eclipsed or is with malefics & if the lord of the 4th house is associated with a watery planet & is weak the man gets drowned. (110)

सरित्यानाशिस्ते चीननबेत शुर्णखूषते सपतलमें यदि बा शुर्णखूषते सपतलमें 1120911
पततने कुपनयादे शुर्णखूषते नरोशिस्तेआपि : 1
सरित्यानाशिस्तेआपि यदि बा शुर्णखूषते नुक़ 1120911

If the lord of the 4th is located in the 4th house along with the lord of the lagna and is aspected by the lord of the 10th house, the man falls in well, river, tank etc. (111)

If the lord of the sign occupied by the lord of the 4th house is associated with or aspected by the lord of the 4th house, the native falls in well, river etc. (112)

## INJURY BY STONE

शिलापहारसत्य स्यारित्यानाशिस्ते शुर्णखूषते सपतलमें 1
śuर्णे युरोहित कम्मपेन सरित्यानाशिस्ते बा 1120911

---

If the fourth house contains Sun and Mars & is in association with or aspected by the lord of the 10th house or by the lord of the 4th house the native is injured by stone. (113)

सुरूष्ठे राहुमबाम्या सदिते कुज्वीडिते 1
सुरूष्ठेचित्रिने तु शिखालिम : पीडिते नर : 112981

If the lord of the 4th house is associated with Saturn and Rahu and aspected by Mars & is without any benefic aspect, the native is injured by stone. (114)

## SEXUAL PERVERSITY

If Moon or Venus is in kendra & is associated with or aspected by malefic planets, is in malefic Navamsha. & located in the 6 signs following its sign of exaltation, the native cohabits with his mother. (115)

पाणित्रते पाण्युते श्रेष्ठाके दिवाकरे बा यदि केन्द्रित्रागे 1
सुरूष्ठे सुरूष्ठे बा यदि पाण्युते जातो नर : स्थायित्र माळुगामी 1129811

If Moon is associated with and aspected by malefics. Sun is in kendra, a malefic planet is in the 4th house under aspect of a malefic, the native cohabits with his mother. (116)

पाणित्रने बा सुरूष्ठामाण्याते पाण्युते सौम्युण्णा दिहाने 1
वर्णःसदित्रवल्लमन्यतो दिहाने जातो नरो माळुगामी 1129811

If the lord of the 4th house is with malefics & aspected by malefics & has no beneficial aspect on it & if the lord of the lagna is weaker than the lord of the 7th house, the native cohabits with a woman that is like a mother to him. (117)

सहभरी संगममाहुर्यं राहुमबाम्याते सौम्युण्णा 1
पाणित्रते पाण्यसमन्यतो सौम्युण्णा दिहाने जातो नरो माळुगामी 1129811

If the lord of the 7th house is in the 4th house with malefics & aspected by malefics or is in malefic Shashti Amsha (1/60th division) the native cohabits with a woman to be treated like a mother. Some are of the opinion that he cohabits with his sister. (118)

सुरूष्ठे शनो पाण्यनिरीखिते बा पाण्यनिरत नाडुफापुत्रत : 1
पाण्यहागो मबने सुरूष्ठे तु सौम्युण्णा दिहाने नरोबल 1129811

---

If Saturn is in the 4th house with malefics and aspected by malefics, the native commits the sin as stated in shloka 118. It is also the case, if there are malefics in the 4th house located in malefic Shashti Amshas. (119)

फट्टेशमुन्निदनसूत्रसंगे सूत्रसंगे पायनरीहित्रे बा 1
चर्दराशसूत्रनवाधनाये तयारिष्ठ मात्रि वेणमाहू : 1122011

If Moon is in association with the lord of the 6th house and Mars is in the 4th house, and if the lord of the Navamsha occupied by Moon is also with malefics and aspected by malefics, there is defect in the chastity of the mother. (120)

सूत्रसंगे राहुले सपाने शनेशमुन्निदनसूत्रसंगे दिवकरेथा 1
मात्रायसस्तल सूत्रसरीशिनायेसूत्रसंगे दिवेष 1122211

If the lord of the 4th house is with Rahu, Saturn, Sun & malefic planet, and if the lord of the Navamsha occupied by the lord of the 4th house is similarly afflicted by malefic, the yoga leads the same result regarding the chastity of mother already stated in shloka 120. (121)

सूत्रसंगे लजनगत बलादेचे गुविनसूत्रसंगेसूत्रसंगे 1
बेखिफकांशे गुविनसूत्रसंगेसूत्रसंगे पतिरता नस्य मबेळसिरी 1122211

If the lord of the 4th house is in lagna in strength & aspected by Jupiter, Moon, Sun, Mercury or Venus, & is located in "Vaisheshik" Amsha with good aspect, the native has a chaste mother. (122)

नयारिषे शिलकरे सराहुले सपाने नयारिषे यदि नयारिषे 1
मबेळसिरी सपाने नयारिषे सपाने नयारिषे 1122211
च्यानिषे दरिष्ठाशिनस्तल गुविनसूत्रसंगे दिवेषसूत्रसंगे 1
यदरिषेशिनस्तल नयारिषे बलो ताड़खमर्श सन्यम 1122811

If the Moon is with Rahu or Ketu and the lord of the Navamsha occupied by it is afflicted by malefics the mother is sexually & illegitimately attached to some one else. If afflicted by Saturn the person involved belongs to the Shudra class, if by Mercury he belongs to the Vaishya (trader) class, if by Sun he belongs to Kshatriya (warrior) class, if by Venus and Jupiter he belongs to Brahmin class. If by Mars then also she is illegitimately attached (to a warrior). (123-124)

फट्टेशमुन्निदनसूत्रसंगे मात्रिषेशिनसूत्रसंगे जनकमर्शिनसूत्रसंगे करोडित 1
मात्रिषेशिनसूत्रसंगे सपाने यदि मात्रिषेशिनसूत्रसंगे जनकमर्शिनसूत्रसंगे करोडित 1122211

## BASTARD BIRTH

If the lord of the 4th house along with the lord of the 6th house is located in the 9th house the birth of the native is a bastard one. Same is the case if the lord of the 4th house along with the lord of the 6th is located in the 9th house. (125)

तलनेश्बामानेश्बामुस्तरपृष्ठ फण्डायिपे स्थापरजात एव 1
तलेश्बामानेश्बामुस्तरपृष्ठ तलेश्बामुस्तरपृष्ठ पापीदित : स्थापरजात एव 1182511

One is an illegitimate child if the lord of the Ascendant, the lord of 4th house and that of the 6th are located together. When the lords of the 4th & the 9th houses are associated with the lord of the Navamsha occupied by the lord of the 6th house, then also the native is the son of the paramour of his mother & not his father. (126)

## TRANSLATOR'S NOTE

The 6th house being one of enmity appropriately stands for "others", & aliens. Hence the link of the lord of the 6th house with factors denoting the parents (4th & 9th house) gives alien birth.

पापीतरे मार्गुस्तरपृष्ठ तलेश्बामुस्तरपृष्ठ तलकरके वा पुमरजिपे फण्डायिपे 1
तलनेश्बामानेश्बामुस्तरपृष्ठ पुमरजिपे जातस्तरवनें परजात एव 1182511

If the 4th house is located in between malefic planets & the lord of the 4th house and Moon are not under the influence of benefies & the lord of the 9th house is weaker than the lord of the lagna, the person has alien birth. (127)

न रीहचटरे तलेश्बामुस्तरपृष्ठ विलगने निशाकरों वा पुमरजिपे न रूस्त : 1
दिवचकरेगापि फण्ड रीहचटरे सपापसनें रिवचा तलेश्बामुस्तरपृष्ठ 1182511

If the Ascendant is not aspected by Jupiter, nor is Moon aspected by Jupiter or if Moon is associated with Sun & malefic planets, the birth is alien. (128)

## TRANSLATOR'S NOTE

From this shloka it appears that Jupiter is a factor that makes relations real as opposed to aliens or adopted. While this is true, it has been observed in actual experience that in cases Jupiter is very heavily afflicted & then influences the stated factors it ceases to be a factor either of realship or of being benefic.

पापी पुमर मार्गुस्तरपृष्ठ सपापसने लगनेश्बामुस्तरपृष्ठ लगनेश्बामुस्तरपृष्ठ जातस्तरवनें एव : स्थापरजात एव 1182511

If the 9th house is occupied by a malefic planet, & so is the 4th & the lord of the lagna is weak, with a malefic and situated in the 4th house in an inimical Navamsha, the man is born of others.
(129)

मात्रुस्थाने पूर्मुस्थाने कारके पूर्मुस्थाने 1
सदर्भावने बलादहें बा मात्रुस्थाने पूर्मुस्थाने 1123011

If there is a benefic planet in the 4th house, the significator of the
4th is Moon i.e. also with a benefic & the lord of the 4th house is
strong, the mother is longlived. (130)
चण्ड बलिजट यदि बा मुझो जा सौम्बिष्ठते शोम्बिष्ठते 1
चण्डस्थ मात्रुस्थाने पूर्मुस्थाने मात्रुस्थाने शोम्बिष्ठते 1123211

If Moon and Venus are strong & are aspected by benefics & are
located in the Navamsha of a benefic planet, in the kendra & there
is benefic planet in the 4th house, the mother of the native lives
long. (131)
मात्रुस्थानेपूर्मुस्थानेवधानायपूर्मुस्थाने केस्थुस्थाने बलादहें 1
तीसम्बद्धशाखायपूर्मुस्थाने केस्थुस्थाने मात्रुस्थाने शोम्बिष्ठते 1123211

See the lord of the Navamsha occupied by the lord of the 4th
house. Then see the lord of the Navamsha occupied by the planet
thus worked out. If the latter is strong in kendra from lagna & from
Moon, the mother of the native lives long. (132)
पागतरे पापुस्थाने शोम्बिष्ठते पापुस्थाने मात्रुस्थाने शिनाश : 1
पूर्मुस्थानेप्रवर्तित ## TRANSLATOR'S NOTE

Saturn in the 4th house means there are two factors of life of the mother i.e. the 4th house and the significator of longevity in one place. Hence adversely afflicted they would denote short life & well influenced long life to mother.

मालुस्यानिपिपण्याशर्षः यन्नकोझे 1
तदेशनाविकितपाणसांडुकाजे विनिद्धिगण 1123511

Find out the lord of the Navamsha occupied by the lord of the 4th house. Then see the lord of the Navamsha occupied by that lord. The longevity of the mother should be decided from the number of rays (See note under shloka 30) possessed by the latter lord. (136)

नाथकौर करारहीनो महसं भो बच्छानमबव 1
यावनंशतदेशो स्यानंशपावे तस मुलुव : 1123911

Find out the strongest from the 4th house, the lord of the 4th house and the significator of mother. The number of the Navamsha counted from Aries would determine the longevity of the mother. (137)

बक्स तु डिगुण पोटे सिगुण लबितहकों 1
चनुगुण पुणेटे कालमबव विनिद्धिगण 1123511

If the strongest planet is in retrogression the number of years etc. should be doubled. If it is in maximum retrogression, it should be tripled, if it is aspected by benefits it should be taken four times. Thus should the longevity be measured. (138)

हद्यय पापमबवते पापमबवते तर्षहद्यय 1
पापमबवते बा हद्यय हन्नापवते विनिद्धिगण 1123511

## MIND

If the 4th house is occupied by a malefic & its lord is aspected by a malefic planet or is located in between malefics the native will have deceitful mind. (139)

शनयाराहुसहवते हद्यय पुणेटे तर्षहद्यय 1
तर्षहद्यय तर्षमानवते हद्ययटे विनिद्धिगण 1128011

If Saturn, Mars and Rahu are located in the 4th house without the association & aspect of benefies & so also is the case with the lord of the 4th house, the native has a deceitful mind. (140)

पापमबवते सोखय पापमबवते पापमबवते 1
सपापमबवते सोखय पापमबवते पापमबवते 1128811

---

If the lord of the 10th house is a malefic planet located in the 4th house, associated with or aspected by malefies the man is deceitful. If the lord of the 4th house is located in the 4th house with a malefic, then also one is deceitful. (141)

भारतना दीजाबर्गेंगा सहिते हूदये यदा ।
कमते दीजाबर्गेंगा सु निकाशापत्तें तत्वस्थलें : 1128211

If the 4th house is occupied by the Sun & Moon, the man is deceitful at one moment and then without it the next. (142)

हूदये पुमरस्थलेंगें स्वोच्छमिस्थलेंगें ।
पुमरस्थलेंगें धर्में वा निकाशापत्तें विनिद्धश्रेष्ठं 1128311

If the 4th house is occupied by a benefic planet or by a planet in exaltation, or one in a friendly sign & the sign in the 4th belongs to a benefic, the man has a mind without deceit or hypocrisy. (143)

विश्लुप्रहः : शागते हूदये वलाफितें ।
नौपुरस्थलेंगें वाडि मुद्रश्रेष्ठं तथा 1128811

If the lord of the 4th house is strong, & located in "Gopur" etc. Amsha or Mridu etc. Amsha, the man is of clean mind & in peace. (144)

लगनेश्रेंगें हूदये वा पुमरस्थलेंगें तथा 1128411

If the lord of the Ascendant is located in the 4th house, with benefits and aspected by benefits, & located in "Paravat" etc. Amsha the man is without deceit. (145)

लगने पुमरें बानवस्थलेंगें पुमरें तथा तस्य विश्लुप्रहः ।
पाप सुद्रश्रेंगें तस्य विनिद्धश्रेष्ठं 1128511

If Jupiter and Venus are located in the Ascendant the native has a pure mind. If the lord of the 4th house is in the 4th along with a malefic the mind of the native is not pure (it is deceitful). (146)

राहो सुद्रश्रेंगें पापस्थलें समन्तें बानवस्थलेंगें तस्य शाति ।
उन्नतें तस्य वदेति पापस्थलें सुद्रश्रेंगें 1128911

If Rahu is located in the 4th house under the aspect of malefies & the 4th house is occupied by many malefic planets, the man appears innocent from appearance but is inside full of deceit. (147)

यदा लगनेश्रेंगें वा मिस्स्तुटों पापस्थलें पुमरस्थलें मावस्थलें विनिद्धश्रेष्ठं 1128511

---

If the lord of the 1st & the 4th houses are mutual friends & are associated with and aspected by benefics, the native is specially loved by the mother. (148)

लागनेश्वरेज संबुद्ध मात्रनाये चूटदेष 1
पृथ्यहातिन्तर दूस्ते मात्रनाये विनिद्धित्व 1128911

If the lord of the 4th house located in kendra is well aspected by the lord of the lagna & is in association with and under the aspect of benefics the native is loved by his mother. (149)

पृथ्यहातिन्तर मात्रहातिन्तर यदि 1
पागनिद्ने पायुणे तळखूटदेष विनिद्धित्व 1129011

If the lords of the 4th and the 11th houses are enemies of the lord of the lagna & are in association with and aspected by malefics there is enemity between the native and his mother. (150)

लागनेश्वरेज मात्रहातिन्तर यदि 1
नवेस लागनमायदा तळखूटदेष विनिद्धित्व 1129211

If the lord of the 4th house is located in the 8th house from the lord of the lagna, or in the 8th from lagna, there is enemity between the native and his mother. (151)

वाहनेश्वरेज बलायुते वाहनेश्वरेज पृथ्यहातिन्तर 1
पृथ्यहातिन्तर संबुद्ध वाहनेश्वरेज मध्यदेष 1129211

## CONVEYANCE

If the lord of the 4th house is strong and the 4th house is occupied by a beneffic planet & they are aspected by benefics the native possesses conveyance. (152)

सृक्षणभिक्रमार्थादिष्ठान पृथ्यहातिन्तर वा 1
सेवेस चूटदेष विनिद्धित्व वाहनेश्वरेज युतेषवालाम : 1129211

From Venus should be considered gold, clothes, ornaments & conveyance (Venus being significator of these articles). The strength of the 4th house or its weakness is also relevant to the acquisition or otherwise of these articles. If the lord of the 4th house is in the Ascendant with the lord of the Ascendant and Moon, the yoga indicates the acquisition of horse. (153)

पृथ्यहातिन्तर यदि वाहनेश्वरेज देहातिन्तर वा नवेसहातिन्तर 1
देहेसहातिन्तर युतेषवालाम 1129811

If Venus is in the lagna along with the lord of the 4th house the native gets conveyance driven by men. If Jupiter is in lagna with the lord of the 4th house the man gets all sorts of conveyances.
(154)

नस्दामरेज्यामरशुलुपृष्ठत तनो बा यदि वाहनेशो |
प्रोत्त सर्व वाहननाडूराया नीचारिमुलुपिकारिनंदे : 1129411

If the lord of the 4th house is in lagna alongwith Moon, Jupiter and Venus, the native gets 3 types of conveyance. (Horse, men, elephants) provided the planets involved are not located in their debilitation sign, or inimical sign & are not eclipsed. (155)

भागयेशोलनेशोलुपृष्ठनाया : कम्मित्रता नीचिवुपृष्ठनाया : |
कम्मित्रबरेगायी यूते विलगने सिहासन प्रारिवुपुलाहरिनंदे 1129411.

If the lords of the 9th, 1st & 4th houses are all located in the 10th house and the lord of the 10th house is in the lagna, the native gets ruling powers provided none of these planets is weak in sign of its debilitation or eclipsed. (156)

भागयेशोलनेशोलुपृष्ठनाया सृष्टक्रमायेशोलुपृष्ठनाया |
भागयायेशोलनेशोलुपृष्ठनाया वा वहनवेशोलनायायायनंदे 1129411

If the lord of the 4th house is in the 9th house, the 4th house is occupied by Jupiter and Venus & the lord of the 9th is in kendra or trine, the native owns valuable territory, ornaments, wealth & conveyances. (157)

भागयायेशोलनेशोलुपृष्ठनाया सृष्टत यूते वाहनेशोलनेशोलुपृष्ठनाया |
सव्वेशोलुपृष्ठनायायते यूते वा सिहासन प्रारिवुपुलाहरिनंदे 1129411

If the lord of the 4th house along with the lord of the 9th house is located in the lagna under the aspect of Jupiter & is strong or if it is in a trine in its own sign or its sign of exaltation, the native gets wealth, conveyance etc. from the king (government). (158)

भागयेशोलनेशोलुपृष्ठनाया यूते सृष्टक्रमायेशोलुपृष्ठनाया |
सव्वेशोलुपृष्ठनायायते यूते वा वहनवेशोलनायायायनंदे : स्याले 1129411

If the lord of the 4th house, is situated anywhere with the lord of the 9th house and aspects its own sign and is strong, located in Vaisheshik Amsha, the native will possess conveyance along with all other amenities of life. (159)

तुल्ले सिहासन यूते वाहनेशोलनेशोलुपृष्ठनाया |
तुल्लाइनी चण्छवाधाखिनी वा लामाइनिनेशोलनेशोलुपृष्ठनाया |
तुल्लाइनी चण्छवाधाखिनी वा लामाइनिनेशोलनेशोलनायायनंदे : स्याले 1129411

If the lord of the 4th house is aspected by the lord of the 9th house, but is in a bad house (6th, 8th or 12th) or is eclipsed, the native has a low type of conveyance or a conveyance that he does not possess for long. (160)

---

सोच्याशिष्ट शोमनंतरस्थेण भागेश्वरेजाति रूतेश बा स्वालु
सोनाच्युले समुद्रीत जातो वहुलेदेशामर्षानि वानस् 1125211

If the lord of the 4th house is located with a benefic & with the
lord of the 9th house, the man gets much army also much land,
ornaments & conveyances. (161)

भागेश्वरेजलामर्षानि विधाननाति रूतेश बा भागेश्वरेजलामर्षानि वानस् 1125211

रूतेश मामर्षानि तत्वनाति बा नस्स़क्षयानिद्रुत : प्रसिद्ध : 1125211

If the lord of the lagna is in the 4th or the 11th house or the lord
of the lagna is located in 11th to the lord of the 9th house & the lord
of the 4th house is in the 9th, the native becomes famous and
possesses innumerable conveyances. (162)

Similarly if there are benefic planets in kendras and malefic planets in the 3rd, 6th & 11th houses then also the ruling powers are gained. (167)

गोठें च्याराराखिस्ते पिनाचन्ने विदेशाग : 1

अर्थमध्यें गुठें बा स्वयं सत्यावर्णेदूरहम 1129211

If the lord of the 4th house is in the 12th house the native has another house (other than that of his father) in a foreign country. Or if the lord of the 4th is in 8th he himself makes a house in a foreign land. (168)

धनें लागनभावस्ते कक्षें च्यनमाडिस्ते 1

बाहनें स्वयं सत्यावर्णेदूरहम 1129211

If the lord of the 2nd house is in the lagna, the lord of the 10th is in the 2nd. a planet in exaltation occupies the 2nd house. the native possesses conveyance. (169)

लागनभावस्ते च्याराखिस्ते कक्षें च्यनमाडिस्ते 1

लागनभावस्ते बलाद्रें बा वाहनाखिस्ते च्यनमाडिस्ते 1129211

If there is mutual exchange between the lords of the 2nd and the 9th house & the lord of the 1st house is strong, the native owns conveyance. (170)

गोठूराखिस्ते बाहनें बलाद्रें बा वाहनाखिस्ते : 1129211

If the lord of the 4th house is strong and located in "Gopur" etc. Amsha & aspected by the lord of the 11th, 10th and the 9th house. the native gets conveyance. (171)

परमोजलाखिस्ते गुठें भावस्ते कक्षें च्यनमाडिस्ते 1

प्रहदवे गुठूरोटे बहुवानुजमाक 1129211

If the lord of the 9th house is in kendra in its sign of exaltation & two other planets are also in exaltation. the native possesses conveyance. (172)

धनाखिस्ते स्वयं सत्योजलाखिस्ते गुठें भावस्ते बलाद्रें बाहनाखिस्ते 1129211

If the lord of the 12th house is in its sign of exaltation and is located with the lord of the 2nd house & is aspected by the lord of the 9th house the man becomes the owner of conveyances. (173)

कक्षें च्याराखिस्ते लागनभावस्ते स्वयं सत्योजलाखिस्ते 1

---

मायनायें वा यूते बहुवादनेष्ठमाको 1129811

If the lord of the 10th house is located in the 4th house with the lord of the 11th house or with the lord of the 9th, the native possesses many lands & conveyances. (174)

उच्चवादणें कमीगरे लागनायें वीडिते 1
मायनायें वा यूते बहुवादणें वीडिते 1129911

If the lord of the 10th house is located in the 10th house and is aspected by the lord of the 1st or the 9th house the native owns conveyance. (175)

परिहारसनायेंकमीगरे कमीगरणराखिते 1
लागनेशरेगा सद्धभवणें बहुवादणेंष्ठमाको 1129911

If the lords of the 10th and the 4th houses are located in "Simhasan" Amsha (see shloka 25 etc. chapter 1) and are aspected by the lord of the 1st house, the native owns much land & many conveyances. (176)

बाहनायेंडटोयेंथुम मायनकमीगरे : 1
सिन्तता बाहनायेंडटोयेंथुम निष्ठनें थुम 1129911
स्वोच्छेंडटोयेंथुम तननायेंकेन्द्रकोणसिन्तते 1
बाहनेंडटोयेंथुम स्वोच्छेंडटोयेंथुम स्वोच्छेंडटोयेंथुम 1129911

If the 4th, 2nd and the 3rd houses are occupied respectively by the lords of the 9th, 10th & the 11th houses or a benelic planet is located in the 8th with the lord of the 2nd & 10th houses or the lord of the 4th house is exalted the lord of the 10th house is located in kendra or a trine & a planet in exaltation occupies the 4th house, the 12th house has no planets in it, the native owns 3 conveyances. (177-178)

परमोच्छाखाकें थुमेंकेन्द्रें गुणस्तरेंथुम 1
सममेंडटोयेंथुम योगें बाहनायेंडटोयेंथुम 1129911

If Venus is in its high exaltation sign & the lord of the 10th house is located in the 4th, the native is owner of conveyance fitted with instruments of music. (179)

श्राहवादणेंडटोयेंथुम सद्धभवणेंथुम 1
केन्द्रकोणसिन्ततेंथुम योगें केन्द्रकोणसिन्ततेंथुम 1129911

If the lord of the 9th house is located in the 4th house and the lord of the 10th house occupies kendra or trine house in his sign of exaltation, the native owns a conveyance with instruments of vocal & other music. (180)

---

श्रीनिना सर्वुते कम्पनाये केन्द्रे शूमायिते 1
लागनेशे शूमिद्ध याते फजाओडिबेउत्तर : 1182411

If the lord of the 10th house, in association with Saturn is located in a kendra along with a benefic planet & the lord of the lagna is located in the 4th house, the native owns a conveyance with musical instruments like panav. (181)

कम्पनायितेलंगेशे सर्वुते सोमिष्यहा : 1182411
शूमिद्ध याते लागनेशे याते शूमायितेलंगेशे 1182411

If benefits occupy their signs of exaltation in the 10th, 9th and the 1st house & the lord of the lagna aspects those houses, the native owns conveyance but at the end suffers also. (182)

कम्पनायितेलंगेशे शूमिष्यहा : 1182411
शूमिद्ध याते लागनेशे याते शूमायितेलंगेशे 1182411

If the lords of the 10th, 6th, 3rd, 4th, 9th, 1st, & 12th houses are with the lord of the 5th house, the man is highly rich and enjoys the conveyances of his country. (183)

शूमिद्ध शूमिष्यहे नाये केन्द्रेगोच्चस्थुते 1
भाणेशे परामेशेशे शूमिष्यानितेलंगेशे 1182411

If the 4th house is occupied by a benefic planet and the lord of the 4th house is located in kendra or trine in his sign of exaltation & the lord of the 9th house is in its highest degree of exaltation, the native gets comforts and conveyances. (184)

भाणेशे शूमिष्यानितेलंगेशे लागे सोमिष्यहे शूमिष्यहे 1182411
लागनेशे शूमिद्ध शूमिष्यानितेलंगेशे 1182411

If the lord of the 10th house is located in the 4th house, & the lord of the 4th house is in the 11th, & the Ascendant is aspected by a benefic, the native gains many conveyances. (185)

शूमिष्यानितेलंगेशे लागे सोमिष्यहे शूमिष्यहे 1182411
राजवोगे शूमिष्यहे कम्पनायितेलंगेशे शूमिष्यहे 1182411

If the lord of the 10th house is in the 4th & there is Rajyoga, the native will have instruments of music such as Mridang, Bheri, Simakha etc. (186)

CHAPTER-5
## Consideration of 5th & 6th Houses

सुतर्मणनातूतर्मणिर्गमिनी मन्तर्मोचनिर्गमिनान।
हवेयोदर्पणे विवक्षणिति च निर्धिक्षणिति नई.11

The wise should consider the following from the 5th house:—son, intelligence, ministers, mantra, eating, father, heart, belly, power of discrimination.

## TRANSLATOR'S NOTE

It should be noted that the problems of heart and belly have been alloted by the author to one and the same house i.e. the 5th. Thus the 4th house relates to lungs & the 5th mostly to heart & belly. The lordship of the Sun—the planet representing the heart over the 5th house-would also suggest that heart's condition should be considered from the 5th sign & the 5th house.

नाये : कखासालंज़मिनाना पृष्ठिदिन्ता कययेलस्ट्रोवे : 1
शुद्ध तन्या सोमसुतालमिनाना पिरुस्त्रोवेलस्ट्रोवे : 11211

## SONS

The problems relating to the son should be considered from the lords of the 7th, 5th & 9th houses & (the significator of the son) Jupiter. Intelligence from the 5th house (its lord) & Mercury, and the affairs relating to father from the 5th and 9th house and the Sun. (2)

## TRANSLATOR'S NOTE

In regard to the house for the father, it would be observed that the 9th house has been taken as relating to him and not the 10th as some would take. The 5th house is relevant to consideration of affairs relating to the father only on the principle of "Bhavat Bhavam" i.e. 5th being 9th to 9th (the house of father).

पिरुस्त्रोवे याति सुद्धे समानो पृष्ठे श्रथाके मर्था च माळू : 1
शुद्धे शुद्धे श्रथनुस्त्रोवे पृष्ठे बवालेवे तबा तबीहो : 11211

If the Sun is in the 4th house, the native gets wealth from father. If Moon is then in the 5th mother dies soon (Moon being very weak). If a benefic planet occupies the 5th house & is under aspect of benefic planet & the lord of 5th a benefic, is under aspect of benefics, the native definitely gets a son. (3)

---

pūrṣṣ्याने तदीकों वा pūrṣों वा pūrṣ्यानिकों |
pūrṣ्यन सर्हितें वा पūrṣ्य pūrṣ्यानिकों सर्हितें : 11811

Undoubtedly one gains a son if the 5th house, lord of the 5th house and Jupiter are with benefies and under the aspect of benefies. (4)
