## FAMILY

A yoga for the discontinuance of the family tree will be constituted if Moon is located in the 10th. Venus in 7th and malefics in the 4th house and the lord of the lagna is located with Mercury. (23)

## TRANSLATOR'S NOTE

Moon located in the 6th house from any house shortens the longevity of the relation represented by the house from which it is 6th. (vide shloka 19 chapter 30 Saravali). Hence in the case under consideration it being 6th from the house of progeny (5th) would destroy progeny. The malefics (many) located in the 4th house would have the effect of not only afflicting the Moon located in the 10th but weakening the longevity of progeny still further. The malefic square aspect of many malefics on Venus in the 7th house would also weaken the prospects of progeny.

पायप्रहा रिफ्सुतातमश्या वेषणविस्तरणकरोस्थीहन : 1
निष्काररे लगनाते संजीवे तत्सपदमे मृखिस्तूते धनो या 112811

If malefic planets are located in the 12th, 5th or the 8th house, the yoga indicates the discontinuance of the family tree & the man becomes bereft of wealth. If the Moon is in the lagna with Jupiter & Mars or Saturn is located in the 7th house the results follow. (24)

## TRANSLATOR'S NOTE

The location of malefics in the 12th house would deny progeny as these would afflict the house of longevity (8th) of the progeny. The same results would follow by the affliction of the house of progeny (5th). The location of malefics in the 8th house would destroy the house of "family".

पायप्रहा बेषणविस्तरण सनेइ वेषणविस्तरणकरोस्थीहन : 1
लगनाते बेषणविस्तरणमरायिस्थुते : पायप्रहा बेषणविस्तरणकरोस्थीहन : 112811

If all malefic planets are located in the 4th house, the yoga indicates the discontinuance of the family tree. Similarly, if the malefic planets occupy the 1st, 12th, 5th, 8th houses, then also the result is the same. (25)

## TRANSLATOR'S NOTE

Why the location of all malefic planets in the 4th house destroys progeny is the question. The answer lies in the principle that the heavy affliction of the 12th house leads to the destruction of the
house from whom it is 12th. In this connection please refer to
shloka 1, chapter 8 under 12th house.

शुल्केतर रेमिचिलनीरिते वस्तृष्ट विचंद्धकर : सूत्रजस् 1
धारिचिते सोमसुते सभुके पाणे सूत्रे वेषयुरो सूत्रजस् 112411

If malefics are situated in the 8th, 1st, or the 12th house and
Moon is in the 5th, the yoga leads to the extinction of the family
tree. Same is the result if Mercury is in the 7th house with Venus,
the 4th house is occupied by malefics and Jupiter is in the 5th.
(26)

रेखे शुल्काकारस्थिते तु पाणेवस्थिते विचंद्धकरोस्थि आत : 1
पाणे विचालने सूत्रे शुल्काके लगनेवस्थरे पवमराशियुरो 112411
बत्तेवस्थिते यदि पूर्णनाये वस्तृष्टविचंद्धकरोस्थि आत : 1
दीजे शुल्काके ततुमायवस्थरे मुहानिरस्थि मध्ययुरो 112411

If many malefics occupy the 8th house from Moon, the yoga

house is in the 5th house, (27) and the lord of the 5th house is
devoid of strength. The same result follows, if weak Moon is in the
1st house and Jupiter is in the sign of Saturn with Saturn. (28)

सिक्केगों : पाणस्थिते सववे : प्राणवे पूर्णस्थिते सूत्रजस्थिते नाथे : 1
चन्द्रालने पवमराशियुरो लागने सूत्रे यदि पाणस्थिते 112411

If all the planets are in the 5th or the 9th house, there is early

śhul्केतर : पवमराशियुरो सववे पूर्णस्थिते पूर्णस्थिते हि तेन 1
JAATO यदि स्यातिचिलनिस्थुललने रन्से खनों पवमरो रवो बा 112411
pūrādīslalamे मुन्यों वददित कालातरे शुमन्युरोगाबल 1
लागने खनों वददितों तु रन्से वददि कुछे पूर्णस्थिते नहीं 112411

If malefics occupy the 5th house, the yoga denies a son. If Mars

## MEMORY

If there is no benefic planet in the 5th house, also this house contains Saturn, Mandi & Rahu, & the lord of the 5th house is aspected by malefic, the native often loses memory. (47)

## TRANSLATOR'S NOTE

Each of the planets—Saturn, mandi and Rahu—are known for not only their scantiness but also for their power of removal. Hence memory a trait of 5th house is both made scanty & removed under the yoga stated.

शुद्धिजाद्य स्यालकारे शुद्धिजाद्य |
तरीखे पापसूत्ते क्रूरणस्याद्य शुद्धिजाद्य |
Memory should be subject to forgetfulness if Mercury is associated with benefic planet but the lord of the 5th house is with malefics (Saturn, Rahu etc) & is associated with the Shashti amsha of such malefics. (48)

सोमें तु शुद्धिमावस्य शुद्धुकनिरीष्टे |
ताडूथे शुद्धिनाये या सवेयो शुद्धिनाये |
If a benefic planet is located in the 5th house, and is aspected by Jupiter and Venus & the lord of the 5th house is also similarly aspected the native imparts his learning & intellect to others. (49)

ज्ञाहाओहसमय : स्यालतीवैगोपुरशके 119011

If in the yoga stated in the previous shloka the lord of the 5th house is situated in Gopur etc. Amsha, the native is all the more efficient in the exercise of his power of intelligence. (50)

The number of sons should be determined from the number of rays possessed by the lord of the 5th house or by the number of the Navamshas in the 5th house or from the rays possessed by Jupiter. (57)

If the lords of the 5th and the lagna are mutual friends, there is friendship between the native and his son. If they are mutual enemies, enmity between the two should be declared. If the two planets are neutral there is neutrality between the two. (58)

If the lord of the 5th house is located in 6th, 8th or 12th house and is aspected by the lord of the lagna & also by Mars & Rahu, the son is always opposed to the father i.e. to the native. (61)

If the lord of the 3rd house occupies the 3rd house itself, the lord of the 5th is in the 4th house with a benefic planet in exaltation, the son feeds the father very well. (63)

---

## TRANSLATOR'S NOTE

The 3rd house in the horoscope of any body is the 11th house of his son i.e. the arms of his son. If the lord of the 3rd house is in the 3rd, it will influence the 9th house—the house of the father in a deliberate manner & in case it is a benefic planet it would act to the advantage of the father. Similarly, if the lord of the 5th house is in the 4th with strong benefits it will influence the 10th house i.e. the 2nd house or the mouth of the father, which means the son will feed the father.

अन्नवनपरे निल्ले पच्चमेंशो शुमागत |

## CHARITY

If the lord of the 5th house is located in the 9th house and is located with benefic planets & aspected also by such planets, the native is always engaged in feeding others. (64)

## TRANSLATOR'S NOTE

Charity of food articles is indicated by the fact that the 5th house is 9th from 9th & acts as 9th on the principle of "Bhavat bhavam". Another reason is the fact that the 5th house being second to the house of masses (4th) stands for the mouth of the public which is benefitted by good influence.

## BELLY

If a malefic planet occupies the 5th house & the lord of the 5th is located with malefics or in between malefics, disease in belly should be declared. (65)

तत्वीशो शुमागत दूतटीशो दूतटीशो |
शुमागत सद्भबः हद्रये दूतटीशो |

If the lord of the Navamsha occupied by the lord of the 5th house is located in a malefic Shashti Amsha (1/60th division) & is aspected by a malefic planet, the native suffers from pain in the belly. (66)

तत्वीशो नाशमाडिशो नाशमाडिशो |
नाशमाडिशो वा हद्रये दूतटीशो |

If the lord of the 5th house is located in the 8th house & is with the lord of the 8th, or is in its sign of debilitation, or in inimical sign, or is eclipsed, the disease in the belly is indicated. (67)

## 6th HOUSE

अरिमवनादिरीसोर्षतिन्त कौते शनाम्पुरदेशान 1
मयूराइणु पद्धान प्रहारशुरदेशान बदेल्यान : 11211

The following should be considered from the 6th house by examining the influence of signs & planets, enemies, thieves, injuries, obstacles, sorrow, naval region of the body (intestines, kidneys etc) venerial diseases. (1)

## TRANSLATOR'S NOTE

The author has not said much on the question of enemies to which the house number 6 is very intimately connected. In this connection it may be stated that exclusive influence of benefic planets on the 6th house and its lord indicates the absence of enemies.

The affliction by malefics of the 6th house and its lord leads to the creation of enemies, while the question who will win whether the native or his enemies has to be decided from the fact as to who is more strong. If the lagna & its lord are stronger than the 6th house and its lord the native wins & if otherwise is the case, the enemies win. The aspect of planets whether benefics or malefics has to be given more weight than the association of planets. The horoscope of Shri J.L. Nehru is an illustration in this context. His horoscope is as under. The fact that Jupiter in dignity is in

the house of enemies with Ketu aspected by Mars means he has mighty enemies. Their nature is denoted by the nature of the influence falling on the 6th house. The 6th house is aspected by Mars, lord of the 10th house (government) & of the sign occupied by the Sun (again government). Hence his lifelong struggle against the British Empire. But the enemy was ultimately defeated due to the fact that the lagna & its lord Moon are stronger than the 6th house and its lord Jupiter. Moon has much strength by virtue not only of being in its own sign in kendra, but also due to being away from the Sun while Jupiter though in its own sign is a smaller planet in natural strength than Moon. Then Moon has the malefic side influence on Saturn and Rahu whereas Jupiter has aspect (as distinct from association) of Mars & Rahu. Hence Nehru won against the British Empire.

फण्डेसरे रुबूते विलागने रन्सिमित्ते चा रखाब : धरीहे 1
कमिशित्ते ताळुथाच्चेनेरे स्थाननें पृष्ठुदित्ते चेहो 11211

## BOILS

If the lord of the 6th house is in lagna in the company of a malefic planet or if it is in the 8th house with a malefic, the yoga indicates boils or wounds in the body. If the lord of the 6th house is located in the 10th house with a malefic planet under the aspect of a malefic, it also gives the same trouble. (2)

Sun is head. Moon is face. Mars is neck. Mercury ears. Jupiter is nostrils. Venus is private parts. Saturn is hands. Sun is again sides. Moon is eyes. Mars feet. Mercury intestines. Jupiter belly. (4)

ticular limb represented by the sign, if these planets are aspected by a benefic planet. (6)

## TRANSLATOR'S NOTE

Moon represents blood in the body. Mercury stands for skin, the lord of the lagna stands for the body as a whole. Hence blood & skin all over the body would be polluted and diseased when these three planets are under the influence of Rahu.

If the two planets i.e. the lord of the lagna and the lord of the 6th house are associated with Mercury there will be mental trouble to the native, if the two are associated with Jupiter, there would be absense of disease, if the two are associated with Venus trouble comes from wife, if with Saturn it indicates chronic type of nervous troubles. (10)

If the lord of the 1st and the 6th houses are located with Rahu or Ketu trouble comes by snake bite, thieves, fire & from nervous disorders. (10)

---

If the lord of the 6th house is located in the Ascendant with Mercury and Rahu and these planets are without any beneficial aspect, the native himself takes measures for the removal of his private organ. If Mars also joins the removal is due to disease in that organ. (11)

## TRANSLATOR'S NOTE

The lord of the 6th denotes trouble. Rahu is a planet of separation or removal and Mercury with Rahu makes Rahu all the more effective instrument of removal. The role of lagna is that of deliberate self. The "Removal" influence falls on the 7th—the private organ.

चिन्तनस्थी सोम्पुर्षा विहित : समुद्रुपूर्षा यदि लिगारोगब :
काणेशवत : शुक्कुलों विहित : कलस्पदलमुद्रुपूर्षन (11211)

If the lord of the 7th house and Venus are both located in the 6th house, the yoga indicates that the wife of the native is sterile. (12)

## TRANSLATOR'S NOTE

The lord of the 7th and Venus combined denote fully the wife, for one is the lord of the house of wife and the other the significator thereof. Their location in the 6th house, the house of deficiency and want, denotes the deficiency & want of power of procreation. The yoga in our opinion will be more effective if the lord of the lagna is also afflicted by the lord of the 6th house or by Rahu and Saturn—planets of dearth & want, for the lord of the lagna would represent the private organ of wife.

If the lords of the 6th house and that of the Ascendant are located with Saturn in a kendra or a trine, the yoga indicates that the native would be imprisoned.

## TRANSLATOR'S NOTE

The lagna and its lord denote the body as a whole of the native. The lord of the 6th. Saturn and Rahu are 'planets of "Restriction". Hence when these planets are together the yoga constituted denotes restriction on the movement of the body. These restrictions would be all the more severe if these planets are located in kendra trine, for such a location of the planets causes their influence to be felt by the Ascendant (body again).

---

If Saturn is located in his sign of debilitation or in inimical sign or is eclipsed by the Sun & is associated with and aspected by malefic planets i.e. situated in a malefic Shashti amsha (1/60th division), the man meets a miserable death. (23)

## TRANSLATOR'S NOTE

Since the death and longevity are denoted by the lagna, 8th house and Saturn. Saturn too like the lagna and the 8th house denotes the mode of death through the nature of influence falling on it. This shloka thus studies the influence on Saturn—the significator of longevity.

रस्मेशरितनत्वों पाख्षणपीडिस्करके 1
तुकालों मरगों श्राहितद्वानमरगों भर्ति 112811

If the decante occupied by the lord of the 8th house in Pash or Sarpa (see shloka 12 of chapter 17), the native dies by disease or being hanged. (24)

मरमबांगुस्तुले रस्मेशरितनत्वों 1
तत्याविष्कृतुले बा हर्षुधानमरगों भर्ति 112911

If the lord of the decante in the 8th house is located with Saturn, Mandi, Rahu, and so also be Saturn, the native dies by being hanged. (25)

फट्रुगमबांगुस्तुले मोमें जा विकमबांगडिस्करके 1
मरमबांगुस्तुले श्राहितद्वानमरगों भर्ति 112911

If the lord of the 6th house and Mars are located with the lord of the 3rd house & are in association with Saturn, Rahu and Mandi, the native dies due to battle. (26)

तुल्नन मरगों श्राहितद्वानमरगों भर्ति 1
कुजन बोडिनें युल्ट मोमेंद्वानमरगों भर्ति 112911

If the lord of the decante occupied by Saturn is located with or is aspected by Mars or is located in the sign or Navamsha of Mars, the native dies in battle. (27)

रतिमोनें वर्णनोनें गारस्यानरोखितों 1
परस्यानरोखितों रतिमोनें भर्ति 112911

If Sun and Mars aspect each other & are located in each other's Navamsha, the native dies as a result of fight with another individual in a duel. (28)

अस्तमें बहनव : पाख्य मोमेंद्वानमरगों : 1
तुरुगमबांगुस्तुले : सथचस्तममरगों भर्ति 112911

---

If there are many malefic planets in the 8th house, occupying the Navamsha sign of Mars & are located in malefic Shashti Amsha (1/60th division) the man meets a sudden death. (29)

नोव्युलीरिहास्या : साम्या : सत्य परविज्ञा : 1

पाण्युलीरिहास्या : पाण्युलीरिहास्या मूटि संदेश 113011

If all the benefic planets are located in their sign of debilitation, or inimical sign or are eclipsed and are defeated in war (by Mars etc. having more northern declination) are located in the Navamshas of malefic planets & are in association with malefics, the man meets sudden death. (30)

नदे पठे कुछस्थून शालितपड़वारीरागमक 1
सारे चने रिविष्णुन पुल्लबस्परीरागमक 112511

If Moon is located in the 6th house with Mars the native suffers from mental aberration & jaundice etc. If Moon in the 6th is with Mars and Sun the native suffers from colic pains etc. (36)

पठे कुछस्थून पुल्लबस्परीरागमक 1
कुल्लबस्परीरागमक धर्यरोग वब्बति ह 112511

If Mars is in 6th with Mercury aspected by Venus & Moon & Mars is in the Navamsha of a malefic planet, the native suffers from consumption. (37)

शन्यारस्थिते पठे रिविष्णुन पुल्लबस्परीरागमक 1
लौनेश्बरे जीनस्बले देखे रोगे मब्बनरे : 112511

If the 6th house is occupied by Saturn and Mars & is aspected by Sun & Rahu & the lord of the lagna is weak, the native suffers from some long lasting disease. (38)

पठे शन्यों पुल्लबस्परीरागमक 1
पुल्लबस्परीरागमक धर्यरोग वब्बति ह 112511

If Saturn is located in the 6th house with Gulik & aspected by Sun. Rahu & Mars & is neither in association with nor aspected by any benefic planet the native suffers from cough, asthma, consumption etc. (39)

जलारस्थिते चने पठे तटमवनाSिक्ये 1
जलारस्थिते धर्यरोग पुल्लबस्परीरागमक मब्बनरे 118011

If Moon is located in a watery sign in the 6th house & the lord of the 6th house is also located in a watery sign aspected by Mercury. the native suffers from urinal troubles. (40)

If the lord of the Navamsha occupied by the lord of the 6th house is afflicted, the trouble should be indicated from the Sun etc. which may be the lord of the Navamsha involved through the element of heat etc. in the limb represented by it. (43)

प्रतुर्षणानिर्देश केन्द्र प्रतुर्षणनिर्देश 1
प्रतुर्ष बा प्रतुर्षानिर्देश प्रतुर्षणनिर्देश विनिद्धित्व 118811

## ENEMIES

If the lord of the 6th house is located in a kendra under the aspect of malefics or if there are many malefic planets in the 6th house, the man has trouble from enemies. (44)

लक्षनेंगे प्रतुर्षानिर्देश तत्वेंगे वांसमारित्व 1
मन्दिमारित्व वांसमारित्व विनिद्धित्व 118411

If the lord of the 6th house is located in the 6th house & the lord of the 6th house is in the 1st house & associated with Saturn, Mandi & Rahu, the yoga indicates trouble from enemies. (45)

प्रतुर्षणहेगे संयुज्ञे बलहीनेशSriनायके 1
प्रतुर्षतरेगे वाचि प्रतुर्षानिर्देश विनिद्धित्व 118411

If a weak lord of the 6th house is aspected by a malefic planet or if it is located in between malefic planets, the yoga indicates trouble form enemies. (46)

प्रतुर्षणहेगे सुख:समें नीमुखारिसुखे 1
लक्षनेंगे बलहीनेशुखे वांसमारित्व : 118911

If the lord of the 6th house is located in 6th, 8th or 12th house, in its sign of debilitation, in an inimical sign, or in an eclipsed condition and the lord of the lagna is strong, the enemy is destroyed. (47)

प्रतुर्षणहेगे सुखसमें नीमुखारिसुखे वचा 1
प्रतुर्षतरेगे प्रतुर्षसमें तेन मेंडी वचेदुखे : 118511

If the lord of the 6th house is aspected by a benefic, or is associated with a benefic and is located in the sign of a benefic planet, this constitutes a yoga for friendship with the enemy. (48)

## TRANSLATOR'S NOTE

If the 6th house and its lord are entirely under benefic influence, the yoga indicates the absence of enemies. In case there is some malefic influences but by far the most benefic ones the yoga indicates enemity & the friendship.

लागनेशांबलतीने तु श्रुद्धस्नानाचिको यवा 1
рушмानिस्तंत श्रुद्धस्नान मेरस्नानिस्तंत 118911

When the lord of the 6th house is weaker than the lord of the 1st house & is with benefits and aspected by benefics the yoga indicates friendship with the enemies. (49)

लागनेशांबलतीने भण्डेशन निरीखितेन 1
तो चा विलगनेशांबलतीने जातिपीडा विनिखितेन 114011

If the lord of the 1st house is located in the 8th house & is aspec- ted by the lord of the 6th house or when both of them are located in the 1st house, the yoga indicates trouble to maternal brothers and sisters. (50)

рушмानिस्तंत विलगनेशांबलतीने श्रुद्धस्नान निरीखितेन 1
рушмानिस्तंत विलगनेशांबलतीने जातिपीडा विनिखितेन 114211

If Jupiter and Venus are located in the first house together with the lord of the 6th house & are aspected by Saturn, Mars & Rahu the yoga indicates trouble to people of the native’s community. (51)

लगनेशांबलतीने श्रुद्धस्नान भण्डेशन चा श्रुद्ध 1
केन्द्रिकोणगा सोमें चातिपीडा : सह जोबनस्न 114211

If the lord of the first house is with benefics & there is in the 6th house Moon or other benefic planet & if a benefic occupies kendra or the trine, the native lives in cordiality with his community. (52)

जातियो बहव : सठित भण्डेशन देवपुष्टेन 1
рушмानिस्तंत श्रुद्धस्नान मृद्धाचिकोणगा 114311

If the lord of the 6th house is Jupiter who is with benefics and aspected by benefics & located in Mridu amsha etc, the native has many members of his community (sons & daughters of his mother). (53)

जातिष्यो विज्ञानियात्तेन पापस्नान चा श्रुद्ध 1
क्रुरोशनियमुदान श्रुद्धस्नान मृद्धाचिकोणगा 114811

If the lord of the 6th house is with malefics, in a malefic Navamsha, in its sign of debilitation or in an eclipsed state & without the aspect or association of benefics, the yoga denotes the destruction of the community (brothers & sisters of mother). (54)

---

पारवतातिद्मास्थे लागनें शुमरोडिते 1
जातीं चलाखोने वा तस्मानुलक्षेता रखेंब 119411

If the lord of the lagna is strong by location in "Paravat" amsha etc & is aspected by benefics and the lord of the 6th is weaker than the lord of the lagna, the native excels his uncles etc. (55)

भाण्यं पठतौष्टिस्थे पठतौष्टेन निर्यादिते 1
पठतौष्टे मन्दिमोमाम्यो यूते चोराहनपीडिते 119411

If the lord of the 9th house is located in the 6th house & is aspected by the lord of the 6th house & the lord of the 6th house is located with Saturn and Mars, the yoga indicates loss due to theft or fire. (56)

तत्वेंशे गोपुरेशारे दिवसेशेन धोखिते 1
तानेंशे चलास्थुपों चातीनामुलक्षेतर 119411

If the lord of the 6th house is located in "Gopur" etc amsha aspected by the Sun, & if the lord of the 1st house is full of strength, the native helps his community members (also brothers & sisters of mother). (57)

पठते सोमें शुमरोडिते तत्वेंशेंशेन शुमरोडिते 1

## DISHES

## TRANSLATOR'S NOTE

When the lords of the 2nd and the 7th are occupying their own signs in the 2nd and 7th houses respectively, the two houses would become strong. Since both of these houses stand for the longevity of wife, the first wife would be long living without necessitating a second marriage.

The number of planets located with the lords of the 2nd and the 7th houses give the number of wives. The number is also determined from the number of planets in association with the lord of the sign occupied by the lord of the 7th house. (14)

## TRANSLATOR'S NOTE

It is easy to see that the malefic affliction to the 7th & 2nd houses & their lords leads to the death of the first wife & hence to the 2nd marriage. The author states that the location of the lord of lagna in the 8th house also leads to the same result. This is apparently based on the principle of "Bhavat bhavam" under which the first house being 7th to 7th would be treated as 7th and as such its destruction of the first wife & consequently to the 2nd marriage. ## TRANSLATOR'S NOTE

Mercury in strength is not only a female planet in strength, but
also a factor of plurality in strength. Located in 10th from the lord of the lagna Mercury would make the traits of the lagna lord plural as it would throw its 3/4th aspect on it. Since the lagna is 7th to 7th, it represents 7th i.e. wife & hence wife would be made plural by the said yoga. Similarly Moon is also a female planet like Mercury in 10th (upchaya) Moon would also be in an upchaya house from the lord of the 7th & would denote gain of wives. For the relevance of upchaya houses to the problem of many wives see also shloka 30 & 31.

श्रवणपेंटो बुतीयस्तो गुरुगा च निरीखितो |
भायनायंन वा गुरुगा बुतीयस्तो मवेव |
If the lord of the 12th and the 2nd houses are located in the 3rd house and are aspected by Jupiter or by the lord of the 9th house, the native has many wives. (29)

## TRANSLATOR'S NOTE

The 12th house stands for दिवाह according to the dictum "मध्य श्रवणपेंटो". The 2nd also denotes marriage according to Maharshi Parashar vide shloka 9 chapter 22 bphs. Hence when the lords of these houses are located in the 3rd house—an upchaya (gain) house, the yoga would denote much gain of wives particularly when aspected by the best of benefics i.e. Jupiter & the priest for marriage & by another best of planets viz the lord of the 9th house. It would also be noted that the 3rd house is 2nd to 2nd and 4th to 12th i.e. very well placed from both. For this reason too the prospects of the 12th and the 2nd (marriage) would prosper.

## TRANSLATOR'S NOTE

One of the conditions for the loyalty of the wife laid down is
that the lord of the 7th house should be a friend of the lord of the
lagna. This is generally not so as the two planets involved in the
case of every Ascendant are mutually inimical. What is probably
meant is that the lord of the 7th house should be a temporary
friend of the lord of the lagna (see shloka 97 of chapter 1).

## TRANSLATOR'S NOTE

This is an important shloka of much use and demand in actual life. The lagna has two roles to play: one is that of "self" & the other as of the 7th house on the principle of "Bhavat Bhavam". The lord of the house of marriage connected with self i.e. the lagna obviously signifies easy acquisition of marriage. The placement of benefic planets near the two houses of marriage would also boost these houses & thereby bring about marriage at early date.

## TRANSLATOR'S NOTE

The idea behind the method stated in shloka 77 for finding out the lagna of the wife is to find out the predominating influence on the factors that represent wife. Since under the fundamental principle of astrology all problems have to be tackled by a consideration of the house concerned, its lord and the significator involved, we think we should determine the dominant planet & its sign that influence the 3 fundamental factors. We suggest our own horoscope as an illustration. We will tackle the problem of the sign of our younger & elder brother.

Sign in the 3rd house is Virgo. This 3rd house, its lord and Mars the significator of younger brothers have to be taken as the basic influenced factors. Virgo or the sign of Saturn may be the brothers sign, the lord of 3rd Mercury is influenced by Jupiter, Sun, Mars & Venus. It may give a sign belonging to any one of these. The significator Mars is influenced by Sun, Mercury, Jupiter and Venus. It may give the sign of any of these. Since Mercury is involved in all the three cases & is thus dominant, the younger brother should be born with Virgo as his Ascendant, which is actually the case. Similarly in the case of elder brother the sign in the 11th house, Moon & Saturn aspecting it, Leo in which the significator of elder brothers viz Jupiter is situated or Venus who is influencing Jupiter through the 9th aspect of Ketu aspected by Venus may give their sign. Since Venus has the predominent influence on the relevant factors, Taurus—the sign of Venus in the 11th house—wins. Hence Taurus is the lagna of the elder brother which is actually the case.

## CO-HABITATION

By the location of Sun etc in the 4th house, the same results regarding cohabitation with the type of women stated would follow. The nature of conveyance and the type of residence should be decided on the basis of the location of Sun etc in the 4th house (see next shloka). (83)
वने गुछे च कुछस्थल स्याड़गमिति स्याड़गमिति श्रुगो 114211

If Sun is in 4th, the residence is in a jungle, If Moon, it is in places of habitation. If Mars, it is a cottage; if Mercury, it is a pleasure resort, if Jupiter, it is temple, if Venus, it is a watery place; if Saturn, it is a place infested with lions; if it is Rahu or Ketu, it is a place infested with elephants. (84)

पार्थुले चवूकेन्द्र चवूयान्मेशन बदेव 1
पार्थुले सवेषु केसेषें विनिधिेषोब 112911

If all the four kendras (i.e. the 1st, 4th, 7th and the 10th houses) and their lords are afflicted by male planets, the native has sexual contact with quadrupeds. (85)

केन्द्र कोणे पार्थुले पथुलेशन बदेव 1
मन्ने पार्थुलेशन वाटि समाजे ताडुखे बदेव 112911

If kendras and trines (1, 4, 7, 10, 5 & 9) are occupied by malefic planets, or if Saturn is with Mandi and a malefic planet, the native cohabits like an animal. (86)
मन्ने सृष्टे सृष्टे मोमे पथुलेशन बदेव 1
राहो ककले मोमे वा सृष्टे ताडुखेशन बदेव 112911

The native engages himself in the sexual act like an animal, if Sun. Saturn and Mars occupy the 4th house. The same result should be there if Rahu is in the 7th house and Mars in 4th. (87)
मन्ने भुलुलेशन भोमे पथुलेशन बदेव 1
भुलुला सहिते वाटि मगलुलेशन मामलेब 112911

If the lord of the sign occupied by Saturn is aspected by Venus, or is in the sign of Mars or is with Venus, the native kisses the private part of the woman. (88)
एवे कथुलेशन मगलुलेशन मामलेब 112911

Similarly the said act of kissing should be predicted from the lord of the 2nd house (i.e. by Saturn lord of second influencing Venus). (89)
कमेशे मन्ने सृष्टे मोमे पथुलेशन बदेव 1
भुलुला सहिते वाटि मगलुलेशन मामलेब 112911

If he lord of the 10th house is aspected by Saturn or is located in the sign of Mars or is in association with Venus, the native engages himself in that act of kissing. (90)
तलेनेशे नीचराष्ट्रावे सित्ते ताडुखेशन मामलेब 1
एवे कथुलेशन मगलुलेशन मामलेब 112911

If the lord of the lagna is located in bad signs such as its sign of debilitation the act of the said kind will be performed by the native. The same result will follow by the debilitation etc of the
lord of the 2nd house. (91)

कुजे कुश्चतनी मदे राहवादे लोबनसतनी 1
काटिनोचकुजा भानो थोइ : स्थुलोचमसतनी 119211

If Mars is in the 7th house, the wife has small breasts, if Saturn
or Rahu is there she has long breasts, if Sun is there the breasts are
hard and pointing upwards. If the rest of the planets occupy the
7th house, she has, very good and big sized breasts. (92)

पापनेकेन सदिते विलड़गाँचा मदेवण 1
धरेषे पापनेकें वा शुमें वा ताड़खसतनी 119311

If the lord of the 7th house is with one malefic planet, the wife
has abnormal type of breasts, irrespective of the fact whether the
said lord is a malefic or a benefic. (93)

рушмездेन सदिते धरेषेSि तपापाचिके 1
समसतनी मदेवणतनी पापनेकेंSन्याचिके मदेवण 119811

The wife has normal sized breasts if the lord of the 7th house is
with two benefits. If with malefics the opposite is the result (she
has very small breasts). (94)

अतिश्रुलसतनी पत्नी स्थुलेषे धरनायके 1
जलोषे जलवणसे रुलगामिः निरीधिते 119411

If the lord of the 7th house is located with benefits, in a watery
house & in a watery sign, aspected by Jupiter, the wife has abnormally big sized breasts. (95)

रवें वा मुझिपूर्वे वा मन्दिमान्नचुलसतुर्त 1
धरायकें पापमानें भानायकें विनिरीधिते 119411

If Sun or Mars is the lord of the 7th house and is situated with
Saturn. Mandi or Rahu in the Navamsha of a malefic planet it is
an indication of the private part of the wife being long in size.
(96)

तवेंशो रुलखसतुर्त वा रुलमान्नचुलसतुर्त 1
समें मंगे धरेषेषे : पापपूर्वे तु धरेषेषेषे 119911

If the lord of the 7th house is Jupiter or Venus & is located in the
Navamsha sign of a benefic, the wife has a normal sized private
part, if in the Navamsha of a malefic it is long sized. (97)

ग्रानिशन्दर्ववा मदेय यवेकसिममदेयर्त 1

जलदिश्च्युरीचिता सभेव 1190011

If the lord of the 7th house occupies a watery sign & the significator i.e. Venus too is in a watery sign, the 7th house contains a watery sign aspected by Moon, strong in Paksha strength (i.e. at or near its maximum distance from the Sun), or if Moon occupies a watery sign in the 7th house & is aspected by Venus located in a watery sign or by Mercury located in a watery sign, the wife of the native will have plenty of raja i.e. liquid matter in her private part. (99-100)

परमोःचांश्चाके पुण्फ जलराष्ट्रश्चाकेशित बा |

## EATING

If Mercury as the lord of the 7th house is aspected by a strong Jupiter & also by the lord of the 2nd house, the native eats pulses, curd, & ghee. (105)

सौप्याख्यानाख्यमिनिते सृष्टियाज्ञामिनेव 1120411

If the lord of the 7th house is aspected by Jupiter & is located in a benefic Navamsha, aspected by Mercury located in a benefic Navamsha, the native enjoys pulses, curd, ghee etc. (106)

चारेशे मुल्यु़ु़ु़े बा पुणिचनिरीदिते 1

If Sun or Mars is lord of the 7th house & is aspected by a benefic planet or is placed in the 2nd house, the man sometimes enjoys curd and pulses etc. (108)

पापे सद्धमेंशे तरीखे पापेरु़ु़े बा सृष्टियाज्ञामिनेव 1

If a malefic planet occupies the 7th house & the lord of the 7th house is with malesics or in a malefic Shashti amsha, the native seldom enjoys ghee & pulses etc. (109)

## LONGEVITY

If the lord of the 8th house is located in the 12th with malefics the native gets short life. If the lord of the 8th is in the 6th under influence of malefics then also he is short lived. (2)

स्ववर्तनपुल्तेल्यात यदि रखनाये वीधापुल्तेल्यानो महानत : 1
मदेन वाचिन्य वीधापुल्तेल्यानो : स्ववर्तनपुल्तेल्यानो 11211

If the lord of the 8th house is located in its own sign in the 8th, the great thinkers declare it as a yoga for long life; so also is the result, if the lord of the 8th is located in the 7th in its own sign, in the sign of a friend or in its sign of exaltation. (3)

रन्सेशवरेगोगाज्ञ वीधापुल्तेल्यानो यदि वा चयराशिपुल्तेल्यानो 1
पण्ड़तवेश वा यदि लानेशवरेगोगाज्ञ वीधापुल्तेल्यानो 11811

If the lord of the 8th house and that of the 1st are together in the 6th or 12th house under aspect of benefic planets or if the lords of the 6th and the 12th houses are in the 1st house but under the aspect of benefics the native has long life. (4)

कमेशवरेगोगाज्ञ वीधापुल्तेल्यानो सुहतस्क्रियन यदि तेन 1
केन्द्र वीधतवेश कमेशवरेगोगाज्ञ रस्म नायस्तेश बायुल्ताहरिन 11911

Very good longevity is given by the lord of the 10th house too if it is located in a friendly sign or in its sing of exaltation. The location of the lords of the 10th, 1st & 8th houses in kendra confers long life. (5)

प्रोत्त प्रहेषवरेगोगाज्ञ समाजुल्तेल्यानो कमेश गतेशवरेगोगाज्ञ 1
सववर्तनपुल्तेल्यानो गतेशवरेगोगाज्ञ वीधापुल्तेल्यानो वंदति : 11211

If any three of the planets mentioned in shlok 5 anti together with Saturn are located in kendras, in their own signs or in their Mooltrikona (positive) signs, the native enjoys long life. (6)

केन्द्रानिते विलगनेसे यूत पुरक सम्मिश्रते |
ताम्या निरीधिते भावि विर्णमायु विनिधितेब |
11911

If the lord of lagna is in kendra with Jupiter and Venus, or is aspected by them there, the native is long lived. (7)

चुवरसे पुरमुवते लागनेसे यूत सम्मिश्रते |
ग्रोडजा यूतित सर्वोसे पुरमायु विनिधितेब |
11211

If the kendras contain benefic planets and the lord of the lagna is with a benefic & under aspect of Jupiter, the native enjoys full longevity. (8)

सिर्धायागता : पाया : पुरमा : केन्द्रानितेपुरमा |
लागनेसे बळ,सुवते पुरमायु विनिधितेब |
11211

If natural malefics occupy the 3rd, 6th and the 11th houses of the horoscope and natural benefics occupy kendras & the trines and the lord of the 1st house is strong, the native enjoys full longevity. (9)

फ़रस्तबरनमायु यूतमुवते सहितेब |
सिरधायु पायमुवते पुरमायु विनिधितेब |
112011

If natural benefic planets are located in the 6th, 7th and 8th houses & are associated with benefics, & there are natural malefics in the 3rd, 6th & 11th houses, the native enjoys full longevity. (10)

रमायिते विलगनेसे यूतघुवतेब |
लागनेसे केन्द्रानिते या देखमायु विनिधितेब |
112211

If the lord of the 8th house is in the 1st under aspect of Jupiter and Venus or is associated with them & the lord of the 1st house is in a kendra, the man has long life. (11)

उच्चायितेशिष्टिमिम: सेतेलोगे रन्स्थायितेशिष्ट |

112211

If there are in the horoscope three planets in exaltation, the lord of 8th is in the first & there are no malefics in the 8th house the native enjoys long life. (12)

रन्स्थायितेशिष्टिमिम: सेते : संवचनितेशिष्टोगे |

112211

पारावत्तदे मागस्था : पाया : सर्वे शुमाड़त्या |

Longevity is of three types: upto 32 years, it is called "short", from 32 to 69, it is middle and beyond 69 it is called "long" (19)

If the lord of the lagna is enemy of the Sun the longevity is short. (20)

If it is neutral the longevity is middle; if it is friend, the longevity is long, one lives till middle age if the lord of the lagna is weak, Jupiter is in kendra or trine & there are natural malefics in the 6th, 8th & 12th houses.

If a benefic occupies a kendra or trine & Saturn is strong in kendra or a trine, malefics are situated in 6th or 8th house, the yoga gives middle longevity. (23)

अल्पायुषोगाजताना वियत्ताको मूत्रिस्ब : 1
नख्नसे प्रल्लिहरिशा मूत्री दचाईद्धिःथवत : 112811
क्षणमेश्बद्धा कक्षा पुणायुषोगाजद्धके 1
भोगायुषोगिति निष्कलण जातस्बइं वदेद्धुवत : 112411

People born in a yoga that gives only short life; the main ruling period of the "Vipat" tara i.e. the planet lord of the 3rd asterism from that occupied by Moon at birth which ends life. In the case of people with middle longevity, death occurs in the main period of "Pratyari" tara i.e. lord of the asterism from that occupied by Moon. (24)

For people born in A yoga conferring long life the main period of "Vadha" tara i.e. lord of the asterism from that occupied by Moon at least ends life. Thus death should be predicted after determining the type of longevity short, middle or long. (25)

लायुषिलनाचिपती बलेन हिनो धरायुषोगोष्टनो 1
मूत्री मूत्रि तस्त्र वदेदित तज्जा : धरायुषेगा वा तनरस्थ वियत्ताको 112411

If both the lords of the 1st and the 8th houses are weak & are influenced by Mars & the lord of the 6th house, the native dies in battle field or by weapons. (26)

## TRANSLATOR'S NOTE

The mode of death has to be seen from the influences on the 1st & 8th houses and their lords. We would study for example the following birth chart of Sheikh Mujiburrehman who was shot dead by his enemies along with many other members of his family.

---

It would be noted that the 6th house is one of injury. Its lord is Mars who is also a planet of injury. Add to it the fact that Mars is lord of the sign occupied by Ketu & then you have an idea of how injurious Mars can prove. It can give death by injury if it influences the factors stated at the beginning of this note. Here if you know that according to Maharshi Parashar Rahu aspects i.e. influences the house located 9th from it you will see that the 8th house of the birth chart, showing manner of death is influenced by it. Since Rahu is a shadowy planet & conveys the influence of the planet associated with it, it throws on the 8th house the killing & injury influence of Mars thereby showing death by injury. The influence of Mars is felt on each side of the 1st house & the house containing Mercury, the lord of the 8th house. Thus the influence of Mars & Ketu is falling on all factors denoting mode of death. Since Mars is lord of the 10th & 3rd houses from the 4th, it brought about death by the deliberate action of some member of the public denoted by the 4th house.

## TRANSLATOR'S NOTE

The mode of death is indicated by the nature of influence falling on the 1st & 8th house or their lords. In the case under consideration the influencing planets are Mars & the lord of the 6th house, each of which is an injury planet. Hence death through injury by weapons represented by Mars.

रश्माननायो यदि वा रिस्त्रो राउड्रीन्वतो केवुयुतो सम्बंधो 1
तद्रमुत्तिकालोपण्य वापि पाके श्रष्ठेगा चौरेमण्या प्रयाति 1129411

If the lords of the 8th and the 1st house are located in the 6th house along with Rainu, Ketu & Saturn, then in the main ruling period of the lord of the 8th & the sub-period of the lord of 1st or vice versa death of the native takes place through thieves or weapons. (27)

मुटित लवकीशिकुलस्मुत्रे तो देखचारीवो रियुगास्थीवो 112511

If the lord of the 1st and 8th houses are located with the lord of
the 4th house, death of the native is caused by a conveyance. If the
two are with Jupiter death is through loss of appetite. Death also
takes place through loss of appetite if the lord of the 1st house &
Jupiter are located in the 6th house. (28)

लागेशबरे वाहननायपुत्रे वाहीशबरेआय युते लवकीशिकुलस्मुत्रे या मर्फे लवकीशिकुलस्मुत्रे 112911

If the lord of 1st, 4th houses and Jupiter are together, death takes
place through loss of appetite. If the lords of the 1st, 4th & the 2nd
houses are together then also death takes place through loss of
appetite. (29)

death takes place by consumption of poison. If the two i.e. the
lords of the 1st and 2nd house are with Rahu or Ketu & located in
6th, 8th or 12th house the man dies by being hanged. (31)

फ़टेशबरे माणुलस्मुत्रे सराहो केतो मुガाडमीत्वुलहारलिस 1

death of the native takes place through the horns of an animal. If
the lord of the 6th & Saturn are with Mars the fear of death is from

If the lords of the 4th house and the 9th house, together with the lord of the 1st house are all located in kene'ras or trinal houses, then during the sub or main period of the lord of the 4th house, death of father takes place soon followed by that of the mother. (34)

If Moon is located in the 8th house along with Rahu and Saturn & is weak in Paksha strength i.e. it is located within 72 degrees from the Sun, the native suffers from epilepsy. Moon in such a condition also gives trouble from the souls of the dead and from water. (35)

If the 9th or 10th house from the 1st is occupied by Mars, and aspected by malefics, the yoga indicates death of the brother of the mother. If such a Mars is with Saturn it indicates death of the son. If the said Mars is with Moon & malefic, the death of the mother takes place. (39)

पितुम्बिति सरनायकें न संश्लेषण : पापुम्बिता सरनेते 1
पापुम्बितेनायि यूतो विधाननिष्ठाकरों मूल्युम्बिति चाल : 118011

If Sun is with Mars in the 9th or 10th house, and is aspected by a malefic, there is early death of father. If both the lagna and Moon are afflicted by two malefics the native meets his death in early childhood. (40)

mother. If Sun is similarly situated, it indicates death of father. If Mars. Saturn and Venus are in the 7th, it indicates death of son. (44)

वृत्तियाप्रभासितर्थेचर्णें : पापप्रभासरन्याप्रभासेचर्णें : 1
शिष्टोप्रभासेचर्णें वा कुल्बासतमण्डें चूफ़र्थेचर्थेचर्णें : 118911

If malefics are in 3rd & 6th houses & benefics are in the 12th & if Moon is in 4th or 8th house with malefics, the native dies in infancy. (45)

लानेकचर्णें शायगासतु पापा : शिष्टोप्रभासेचर्णें खोमन्दुचमण्डें : 1
असते रवीं चन्द्रुते विलागें पापाप्रभासेचर्णें तत्वुतेचर्णें : 118911

If Moon and Sun are in the 1st house and malefic planets in the 12th house, and these are without the aspect of a benefic planet, the native dies in infancy. If Sun is in the 7th & Moon in the 1st house with a malefic, the yoga indicates early death of the son. (46)

दिनेचर्णें शायगासतु तत्वुतेचर्णें मबेस्टोप्रभासेचर्णें विलागें : 1
युते तत्वुतेचर्णें शिष्टोप्रभासेचर्णें मबेस्टोप्रभासेचर्णें विलागें 118911

If Sun and Moon are in the 12th house without the aspect of benefics the native becomes blind. If one of them is in the 6th and the other in 12th without benefic aspect the man is blind by one eye. (47)

दिनेचर्णें शायगासतु तत्वुतेचर्णें मबेस्टोप्रभासेचर्णें विलागें : 1
युते तत्वुतेचर्णें शिष्टोप्रभासेचर्णें मबेस्टोप्रभासेचर्णें विलागें 118911

If Sun and Moon are in the 12th and the lord of the 12th in the 1st house, the yoga indicates destruction of body. Similar is the result if Jupiter is located in 12th or 8th with malefics and under the aspect of malefics. (48)

लानेकचर्णें पुलिकें सूत्रश्रमायेंचर्णें नाशगासतु विलागें : 1
जातस्थ जन्मावसरें तत्वुतेचर्णें पिुलुशं मात्रुशिन्द्रं वद्धित : 118911

If the lord of the 1st house is strong, but the lords of the 4th and the 9th houses are weak and occupy the 8th house, there will be death of father and the mother at the time of the birth of the native. (49)

युते तत्वुतेचर्णें सचन्द्रें सतन्द्रें परस्थीुशं पिुलुशं वद्धित : 1
लानेकचर्णें जन्मावसरें तत्वुतेचर्णें पिुलुशं मात्रुशिन्द्रं वद्धित : 119011

If the lord of the 3rd house along with Moon is located in 6th, 8th or 12th house, the native drinks the milk of women other than his own i.e. his mother dies soon after his birth. If the lord of the 9th house and its significator i.e. Sun are located in 6th, 8th or 12th house, the father does not see a son. (50)

केन्द्रिकोणे याइतो विहंगो वदेतयो : पुरस्थल लभीच्चम 1
पितुनिशाया मर्जे वदेतयो भागेष्ठौयोकृतयो : धत्तयो : 119811

If the two planets i.e. the lord of the 9th house and Sun are located in a trine, the yoga indicates good comfort from the son. The location of the lord of 9th. Sun. & Saturn in the 6th house indicates the death of father during the night. (51)

फ़्रेटशर्घेगाई युतास्तरयेव चेरेगा बीनास्तर दिया मूति : स्यावल 1
युतास्तरयेव : चेरेनास्तरयेव मायुस्तरयेव : स्यावलेने तु ततिसन् 119211
नो चेरेनास्तरयेवतराशिकारे मायुस्तरयेव : स्यावलेने च ततिसन् 1
दियादियोगायणेन हि ततर अस्तराशिकारे या प्रवर्तित सन्न : 119311

If the planets—the lord of the 9th house the Sun & Saturn in 6th house—are located there with the lord of the 6th house then too death is in night time. If the yoga does not include Moon the death is during day time. The ayana—north or south in which mother dies—should be determined from the planets in the 4th house. (52)

If there are no planets in the 4th house death takes place in the time indicated by the sign occupied by the lord of the 4th house. If there are more than 2 planets in the 4th house the ayana at death of mother shold be determined by the strongest of them all. (53)

नायो चरेणे वा पितुनायनाये युतास्तरयेवतराशिकारे याच्छ : 1
खिर्रोमयस्तरे पितुनायनाये समीपतरयेवक : खिर्रोमयस्तरे स्यावल 119811

If the lord of the 9th house is located in a movable sign or in 8th house the father dies away from home. If it is in fixed or dual signs the father dies near home. (54)

केन्द्र चरेणे याइतो वा श्रह्याकेस्तरोगायणेन ततर 1
खिर्रोमयस्तरे याइतो वा केन्द्र तत्योगायणेन ततर वदेतयोगायणेन 119411

If the Sun & Moon are in kendras, in movable signs, the son will not have opportunity to light the pyre of the parents. If they are in kendra & in common sign, there will be delay in the lighting of the pyres. (55)

If the lord of the 9th house is strong and Moon, lord of lagna and the lord of the 4th house are without strength, the yoga indicates severe trouble to the mother. (56)

## DEFEAT

If the lord of the 8th house is located with malefics, is aspected by malefics, is located in between malefics or if the sign of a malefic is in the 8th house; the native often meets defeat in his undertakings. (59)

चरे रन्स' मुद्रदिते तदनतर चरेयिते 115011

If there is influence of benefic planets on the 8th house there is no defeat for the native. If the sign in the 8th house is a movable one, & the lord of the 8th is also in a movable sign the native dies away from his home. (60)

खनो वा चरेयिते चरेयिते तदा मवेव 1
खिरणे रन्स' तदनतर वि खिरणारोगी तदेयाके 115211

In case Saturn is located in movable sign & in a movable Navamsha the death takes away from home. If there is a fixed sign in the 8th house, the lord of the 8th house is also in a fixed sign, or a fixed Navamsha. Saturn too is in a Navamsha belonging to a fixed sign, the native dies in his own home. If the 8th & its lord are in common signs, the death is on the way. (62)

## THE 9TH HOUSE

---

From the 9th house of the horscope the following should be considered, Guru, prospects in life, father, grandsons, compassion, tapas, income, hips, mind, family members, charity yoga, boss, uncles. If the 9th house is associated with benelic planets, the relations etc mentioned get benefitted. Otherwise these suffer.

(1-2)

If Moon is located in the 9th house with a malefic planet and if Venus is there in afflicted condition, the native cohabits with the wife of his Guru. The same result follows if the lord of the 9th house is with Venus or Moon and is afflicted by a malefic planet. (3)

If the lord of the Navamsha occupied by the lord of the 9th house is with Moon or Venus & is afflicted by malefic, the native cohabits with the wife of his Guru or if the lord of the 9th house is in its sign of debilitation, its Navamsha occupied by it belongs to Venus & is located with Venus, the same result follows. (4)

दीजे निष्कारें तत्वव बा तत्वव भुगों तत्वव रुलवारगामी |

If Moon is weak in Paksha strength i.e. within 72 degrees from the Sun & is located in the Navamsha of Venus, the man cohabits with the wife of his Guru. Or if the lord of the 9th house is in its sign of debilitation & Venus occupies the Navamsha sign of the lord of the 9th the same result follows. (5)

धमिफ़रे सोम्युते तत्वव बा तत्वव |

If the lord of the 9th house is located with a benefic planet through its Navamsha, or if its lord is located in the Vaisheshik amsha & does not occupy a malefic Shashti amsha (1/60th division) the native is strongly entrenched in religion & morality.

भुगों बा रुलवारगामी बा स्वोच्छमित्रणसोम्युते |

If Jupiter or Venus occupies its own or a friendly Navamsha & the lord of the 9th house & a benefic planet in strength, the native becomes the head of a religious institution. (7)

If a benefic planet occupies the 9th house, but is located there in the Navamsha belonging to a malefic planet & is occupying a malefic Shashti amisha (1/60th division), the native resorts to religion through hypocrisy. (9)

If the Navamsha sign in the 9th, house, its lord and its significator belong to a benefic planet, is with a benefic planet and aspected by a benefic, the man is sincerely devoted to religion & morality. (10)

If the 9th house is occupied by a malefic planet, & if the lord of the 9th house is located with a malefic, is in between malefics or is located in malefic Shashti amsha, the native becomes sinful. (11)

---

If the lord of the 9th is located in the division called "Simhasan" & is aspected by the lord of the lagna, as also by the lord of the 10th house. the native performs great acts of charity. (46)

भार्योरो तु संपादे वान्नोरो तया मन्बल 1
राज्योरो वा पादे नेतरेयो तया मन्बल 118911
इतरेयो तु संपादे वान्नोरो कया मन्बल 1
भार्योरो नरे जातो वान्नल्यो तु संपादे कया 118911

If in addition to Bhagya yogas for good luck or Rajyogas for affluence and power there is Dan yoga or yoga for charity, the yoga for charity works in actual practice. In cases where there is no Bhagya yoga or Rajyoga how can the charity yoga work. It is only people who are lucky and affluent can help charity. (47-48)

जात : पुरोहितो चाण्य बहमवर्षमस्तुमवर्ष . 1
वान्नयोशो Sय जात : स्यान्द्रमवर्षकल्लनवर्ष 118911

If there is charity yoga but not one of affluence & power, the native becomes a priest, if born in a brahmin family or he may supervise charity, if of some other caste. (49)

चवूयो वान्नमासेयो कमेशो केन्द्रमासितो 1
धयेशो गुणस्तुमसेयो महादानकरो मन्बल 119011

If the lord of the 9th house is in the 4th house & the lord of the 10th is in kendra & the lord of the 12th house is aspected by Jupiter, the native performs great acts of charity. (50)

भार्योरोनायि संडुते स्वोद्रस्ये सोमन्बले 1
लामेशो केन्द्रमासेयो महादानकरो मन्बल 119211

If Mercury, located in its sign of exaltation, is aspected by the lord of the 9th house & the lord of the 11th house is located in a kendra, the native performs great acts of charity. (51)

लामेशो लामराखिशेयो कमेशो बलसंडुते 1
लामेशोनायि संडुते वान्नयोशीमसेयो 119211

If the lord of the Ascendant is in the 11th house, the lord of the 10th is strong, and aspected by the lord of the Ascendant, the native gets charity from others. (52)

चवूयो भार्योरोशेयो कमेशोपसंडुते 1
लामेशोनायि संडुते वान्नयोशिमसेयो संडुते : 119311

If the lord of the 5th house is located in the 9th house, & is associated with the lord of the 10th or the 9th house & is aspected by the lord of the 1st house, the native gets articles in charity. (53)

मार्वेशो कमनायेन दृष्टे केदर्शिकोणो ।
परमोच्चशोके वापि वान्सायित्रन संख्याः : 114811

If the lord of the 9th house is located in a kendra or a trinal house and is aspected by the lord of the 10th house, or is located in its highest degree of exaltation, the native gets articles in charity. (54)

गुत्तल्यानेशोस्तुत्तनायेशोणो यदा ।
गुत्तल्युकोणोटे वापि गुत्तल्युकोणो मबेव 114211

If the lord of the Navamsha occupied by the lord of the 9th house is aspected by Jupiter and/or Venus, the native is devoted to his Guru. (55) ·

गुत्तल्याने सौस्पूर्ते गुत्तल्याने सृष्टे ।
तत्रीहो मुद्धायसे गुत्तल्यानेशोणो मबेव 114611

If a natural benefic occupies the 9th house, & the 9th house has Sambandha or link (by mutual aspect etc) with Jupiter, the lord of the 9th is in Mridu amsha, the native is devoted to his Guru. (56)

CHAPTER—8
# ON THE TENTH HOUSE ETC.

व्यामात्मकत्रिमाजा कीति युखित प्रवासपूर्णत्रिन 1
मानं कम्माजीव आनुष्ठानं ब निदिश्चाधान 11211

Actions, ruling powers, fame, rain, living away, acts of public utility, honour, profession, knees & servants should be considered from the 10th house. (1)

कम्माजिव हीनवले सपाईव कम्माजिवकल्पमुखात्र तज्जा : 1
कम्मेशागीश्याशकुल्या वीयानित्ता वच्छकरा मयनित 11211
शुमरस्थडित्तस्ममित्तासे वीयानित्ता यज्जिश्याशमाज : 1
दृष्टा : शुमरकालस्मभाविश्युक्ता : पपेशिता : कम्मेशिनश्ममाज : 11211

## ACTIONS

If the lord of the 10th house is weak and under the influence of malefics, the yoga indicates frustrations in actions. When the lord of the 10th house, Jupiter and Mercury are strong the native is engaged in the service of others. (2)

These three planets, when strong and aspected by natural benefics, make the native particularly engage himself in acts of helping public causes. If, however, these are in 6th, 8th, or 12th house, badly aspected, there is absence of such acts. (3)

नाशित्तास्तर तदेशनाशित्तास्तरारिप्रिप्यास्तर नाश्मम 1
राजों च माने यदि या दिनेशे मागिरिशनाशित्तास्तर तज्जा : 11811

If the lord of the 10th house, or the lord of the Navamsha occupied by it or the lord of the sign occupied by it is located in the 8th house, the native gets devoid of acts of public utility if Rahu or Sun is in the 10th house. One has sacred baths in the Ganges. (4)

माने च माने यदि या सस्तोषे मोमाजित्ते या मयनित च मुटिक : 1
चलदेशे पुँफाश्याक्रीवे मानित्ते गोगाजलाशित्ते : 11211

If in the Pisces in the 10th house, there is Mars with benefics. one gets liberation or moksha. If Jupiter and a strong Moon are occupying a watery sign in the 10th house one bathes in the sacred waters of the Ganges. (5)

---

माने गुरों शूक्तवृत्ते च केने स्वोच्चिति ताड़यतोपुत : 1
माने धने शूक्तवृत्ते सजीवे केनेच्च्चों ताड़यतोपुत : 11811

If Jupiter occupies the 10th house, and Venus occupies its sign of exaltation in any kendra, one gets purified by a sacred bath in the Ganges. (6)

शूक्तवृत्ते या यदि या तत्वीषे शूक्तवृत्ते ताड़यतोपुत माक्षयाब 1
चने तत्वीषे जलाराहितोपुते सौम्यानिते ताड़यतोपुत माक्षयाब 11911

If Mercury is in the 12th house, and the lord of the 12th house is in his sign of exaltation, the native has meritorious results enabling him to have the said sacred baths. (7)

सन्नायसेंगुस्मरम् फूरोशेंके मायम् मबेस्थल फूरोशेंके 11811

If 4 planets are together in any place other than a kendra and if the lord of the sign occupied by these four planets is located in a kendra or a trinal house. Sanyas yoga is constituted. Sanyas yoga is also constituted if 4 planets are together in a kendra. (1)

If Saturn alone aspects the lord of the lagna & the lord of the lagna aspects Saturn & the lord of the lagna is weak Sanyas yoga is constituted. (2)

If Sun occupies the decante of Saturn and is aspected by Saturn. this yoga is constituted. Similarly Sanyas yoga is formed if Moon is located in the Navamsha of Saturn or if she is located in the Navamsha of Mars & is aspected by Saturn. (3)

If the lord of the house in which the Sanyas yoga is formed is with Rahu in a malefic Navamsha or is with Gulik, the Sanyas yoga is cancelled, if the planets afflicted are other than benefics.

## TRANSLATOR'S NOTE

The rationale behind the Sanyas yoga constituted by the location together of 4 planets in a kendra is not quite clear. From a perusal of the texts it is thought that according to the texts the location of planets in a kendra or trinal house influences the Ascendant. Based on this principle the location of 4 planets in any kendra would have the influence of the four planets on the lagna. Since the association of 4 planets is generally of a "Separative" character in view of the inclusion of one or more of the seperative planets, Sun, Saturn, Rahu, Mandi, etc. the influence of the 4 planets gathered together in a kendra will be one of separation on the lagna which will have the effect of separating one from the traits of the 1st house, viz wealth and the place of birth, there is some justification in the yoga in question.

(2) We, however, think that it would be better if we have a definition of the term "Sanyas" & consider the question from the astrological factors involved. Sanyas in our opinion is formed when the mind is in Vairagya and the native leaves his family, home and wealth & enjoyments of the bed. This will be there if Moon, the 4th house and its lord, representing the mind are under the influence of the significator of Sanyas-Saturn & Rahu who always acts as Saturn. This will suffice to give the requisite Vairagya. Then the influence of the "Separative" planets. Sun, Saturn and Rahu or their dispositors should be on the 2nd house and its lord (family) on the 4th house and its lord (Residence) & on the 12th house and its lord (pleasures of the bed).

(3) In actual life we can verify the correctness of the above statement. We will present some illustrative horoscopes. The birth chart of Shri Chaitanya is given below. See the intensity of

Vairagya given by the 10th aspect of Saturn on Moon—the significator of mind. See the full 8th aspect of Mars—the dispositor of Saturn on Moon. See the location of Saturn in the 4th house from Moon. See the aspect of Saturn on the lord of the 4th house from Moon. See the aspect of Saturn on the 4th house from lagna.

---

As regards separation see the influence of Saturn on the house of family (2nd) not forgeting that Saturn is the dispositor of another two separative planets, Sun & Rahu. The severe separative influence on residence (4th house) is clear through aspect of Saturn. The 12th house and its lord have the surrounding influence of Rahu & Saturn etc.

(4) In the case of Swami Shivananda, mark Saturn with Rahu in 4th from Moon aspecting Moon, the significator of mind & the lord of that 4th house. Saturn also aspects lord of 4th from lagna.

So far for Vairagya. As regards separation the residence is influenced by Saturn & Rahu through Moon, their dispositor, the lord of 4th is Venus by Saturn, the lords of the 12th & 2nd by the surrounding influence of Saturn and Rahu on one side & of Saturn & Ketu on the other.

(5) In the case of Swami Shuddhanand Bharti Saturn is dispositor of Rahu & as such his influence on Moon more than ordinary factor for giving Vairagya. The dispositor of Moon is influenced by the aspect of both Rahu and Saturn. The 4th from Moon is influenced by Sauru & its lord by Rahu. The 4th from lagna is hemmed in by influence of Rahu, Saturn and Sun.

208

---

Enough to give Vairagya of the highest order, Saturn, Sun & Ketu on 4th from Moon give separation from residence. 4th from lagna is in between the separative influence of Rahu & Saturn. Its lord is squared by Rahu which is aspected by Saturn.

We need not give further examples. The principle has been seen in actual practice to mark satisfactorily.

If the lord of the Navamsha occupied by the lord of the 12th house is a benefic planet, is located in a benefic Navamsha sign, is surrounded by benefics, one spends on legitimate items. (4)

## HELL AFTER DEATH

The lord of the decante occupied by the Sun or the Moon which ever of the two is stronger determines the nature of the next world. If it is Jupiter the native goes to heaven (Devlok), if it is Moon or Venus to Pitrilok or the abode of the manes, if it be Sun or Mars it is some animal birth, if it be Mercury or Saturn it is hell. (20 & 21)

---

If the said lord of the decante is in its sign of exaltation, the abode after death is of a high order; if it is in its sign of debilitation, it is a low type abode; if it is of a middling type, the next abode too is of that type. (22)

## DIETY WORSHIPED

If Venus is located in the 5th house with Moon or if the 5th is aspected by Moon and Venus, the native worships a female diety. (34)

---

If the 5th house is occupied by a male planet, the native worships a male diety. If the 5th house is influenced by Sun, the native is a worshipper of the Sun or Shankar. (35)

If the planets mentioned above are located in the Navamsha of their sign of exaltation, or of a friend, the diety is worshiped for the benefit of self. If it is otherwise, it is done to harm others. (39)

## TRANSLATOR'S NOTE

From a perusal of shloka 4 above it would be seen that a planet
occupying a friendly sign and in retrogression is almost equal to
an exalted planet if not better. Retrogression is thus always a sign
of strength.

The native becomes equal to a king, if Moon occupies the lagna; Jupiter, the 4th house; Venus, the 10th & if Saturn is in its sign of exaltation or its own sign. (9)

द्वारेकांडरो रिफकलानिवतस्थानोल्यंसे 1
श्रहणिष्ठाति वेळसीमा नुपवूलो मबेनर : 118011

The native becomes equal to a king, if benefic planets are located in 10th, 11th, 12th, 1st, 2nd & 3rd houses of the horoscope. (10)

केन्द्रिकोगा : सौख्या पापा : ध्रुलामसोबवा : 1
चागनाइयो बलवीटि नुपवूलो मबेनर : 118211

The man becomes equal to a king if in his horoscope, benefic planets are located in kendras and trinal houses and the malefics occupy the 3rd, 6th and the 11th and the lord of the lagna is strong. (11)

द्वुख्यते नुपवूले वापि चन्द्रजेन नुपवूले : 1
भिरस्ता धासने तत्स्य धररयेति नुपवूले 118211

If Jupiter is associated with or aspected by Mercury, even the kings obey the native. (12)

नीचिष्ठातो जन्नानिन यो र्षह : स्यास्तराशिनायो तुल्लचनाय : 1
स चेदिलनाय़ि केन्द्रवती राजमवेदाशिनाय़ि केन्द्रवती 118211

When a planet is located in the sign of its debilitation but the lord of the said sign of debilitation or of the sign of its exaltation is located in kendra from the lagna, the native rules over all kings. (13)

## TRANSLATOR'S NOTE

By the kendra position of the lord of the said debilitation sign, the planet in debilitation will get strengthened, for the planet in kendra will act as a dispositor. The rationale for cancellation of debilitation through the strength of the lord of the exaltation sign is not clear. May be the exaltation sign too acts as the planet by being aspected by the Neecha planet.

If the planet that is lord of the said sign of debilitation is in kendra from both the lagna and the Moon sign, it is obvious, it will be all the more strong & as such would give still better results.

(2) The results stated for the above shloka are so high that we are of the opinion that the house to be benefitted by the location of the debilitated planet should be one of the houses connected with ruling powers. Hence the term " संश्लेषन " should in our opinion be interpreted as in the lagna. In that event the strength of the lord of the lagna would make the lagna very strong & would lead to the acquisition of ruling powers.

निष্কारে केन्द्रगते विचलणने लखकर्षा सिकोणे याब रीवूड़े 1
शुकुणे दूस्ते लखपुणुणे जाते नेहे शुपपिनुणेवनायम : 119811

The luck of the native will be equal to that of a king, if Moon is in a kendra other than the lagna, or is in a trinal house & is aspected by Jupiter & is strong and aspected by Venus. (14)

## TRANSLATOR'S NOTE

From a study of the various shlokas of this chapter, it would be clear that the strength and excellence of the lagna or its lord is a great factor in the acquisition of ruling powers. Since Moon acts as lagna in astrology, the acquisition of ruling powers as a result of the strength of Moon too is quite appropriate. The horoscope of our prime minister, Shrimati Indira Gandhi is an example to the point. In her horoscope given below, the lord of lagna i.e. Moon aspects the lagna & is in turn aspected by a strong retrograde beneficial Jupiter. Similarly the lord of chandra lagna i.e. Saturn.

aspects its own sign Capricorn, which is also aspected by the strong Jupiter.

नौविशिष्टा जन्मानि वे प्रहेंदा : स्वोच्छाश्रीगा रावस्मानमाण्या : 1
त्रलबिशिष्टा वेदिति नौविशिष्टा रहा नन कुवेंदी तरेखब भागमण्य 112911

Planets which occupy the sign of their debilitation but the Navamsha of their sign of exaltation give fortune as that of a king. On the contrary, planets which occupy the sign of their exaltation but are located in the Navamsha of their sign of debilitation, do not give high results. (15)

रहा बलाख्या वाइड पूर्वधर्मके स्वोच्छिशिष्टा : पूर्वधर्मे नुप : स्थाब 1
तर्द्रभयय पाइशमाण्यपुर्तला मिस्रिशिष्टाचे पूर्वधर्मर भागमण्य 112611

If strong planets in their sign of exaltation are located in the 1st 6 houses of the horoscope they boost luck in the first half period of life. Similar planets if located in the houses 7 to 12 give lucky results in the 2nd half of life. If such planets are located in both halves, one gets luck both in the first and the 2nd half period of life. (16)

रहा विमज्ञे तु वय : प्रमाण चण्ड़स्रय तत्र वयदित सत्त : 1
व्यापाइके प्राप्तिमके भ चण्ड़स्रय : शोमनमर बहुः 112911

चण्ड़स्रय दितीये बहवस्म सोमस्रये सोमस्रये तु तुतीयस्रये 1
चण्ड़स्रये तु विमज्ञे दितीये बहवस्म सोमस्रये सोमस्रये तु तुतीयस्रये 112611

तुत्रभय मबेतनर विश्रावतस्रु राज्यालयद्वर्षमुवाहरित 1
एवे मबेठळमनवाहरिते : चण्ड़स्रये : शोमनकालमुवाहरित 112911

The total longevity years of the native should be divided into 3 equal parts. The 4 houses from 12th to 3rd stand for the 1st part of life, the next 4 houses i.e. 4th to 7th stand for the 2nd portion of life & the houses 8th to 11th stand for the last portion of life.

If the four houses 12th to 3rd are occupied by natural benefics, they give good results in the early life. In the case of benefics occupying the 2nd & 3rd part good resluts flow in those parts.

In the age division in which there are many malefics, located in their Navamsha of debilitation or are with eclipsed planets, much sorrow is experienced in that portion of the age, particularly there is disfavour from the government. (17 & 19)

---

लागने गुरों बूझे केन्द्र भावनायें वाहिते 1
लागने शाखे वाहित संदृष्टे नुपडुलें मध्येनर : 112011

If Jupiter occupies lagna & Mercury is in kendra aspected by the lord of the 1st and the 9th houses, the man is equal in status to that of a king. (20)

सपतमे जीवनस्थुते सिकोणे वा सपतमे सपतमे 1
लागनायें संदृष्टे नुपडुलें मध्येनर : 112811

If Jupiter is located in the 7th house or in a trinal house and is aspected by the lord of the lagna, the native is equal in status to that of a king. (21)

केन्द्र शन्नो सिकोणे वा स्वोच्छमुलारिकोणे 1
राज्यायें संदृष्टे नुपडुलें मध्येनर : 112811

If Saturn is in a kendra or a trinal house, in his sign of exaltation in his positive sign (11) & is aspected by the lord of the 10th house, the native gets favour from the king (i.e. the government). (22)

कमेशे रन्समावसे स्वोच्छमुलारिकोणे 1
पारवतोशे कमेशे वाहित राजराजे मध्येनर : 112811

If the 10th house lord is in the 8th, but in its Navamsha of exaltation or that of its friend or in the Paravat amsha, the man is king of kings. (23)

## TRANSLATOR'S NOTE

The 8th position of the lord of the 10th is bad, but due to the excellent strength derived by the 10th lord from exalted Navamsha etc, the planet on the whole works to the great advantage of the native. (23)

नीच गुरों विल्लनस्थुते रन्समावसे वाहित धर्मेनर 1
त्यायवियायस्थुते राजराजे मध्येनर : 112811

If Jupiter occupies its sign of debilitation in the lagna, & the lord of the 9th house is in the 8th, but it is in Navamsha of exaltation etc (see previous shloka) the man becomes king of kings. (24)

गुरुरे वण्ये शनो लामे रवो वा विषस्माचिप्रयोग 1
गुरुरे वण्ये विलानेशो राजराजो मबेनर : 112911

If Jupiter is in the 12th house, Saturn or Sun in 11th, the lord of the 3rd house is Jupiter. the lord of the lagna is also in the 12th house, the native is king of kings. (25)

पचमे जीवस्थयुत्त चन्द्र केन्द्र वुहस्माचिप्रयोग 1
विषस्माचिप्रयोग तदीके तू राजस्थयुत्त नुपतिमिप्रयोग 112911

It Moon is with Jupiter in the 5th house or lagna; and there is a fixed sign in the lagna with its lord posited in the ruling house, then also the native will be a king (26)

गुरुफेटके प्रहा : सभे वण्य तिरंतित जन्मनिन 1
मध्याचिप्रयोग चन्द्रे वा सभे वण्य नुपतिमिप्रयोग 112911

If a native has all the planets in houses 1 to 6, and the lord of the 9th house is in the 2nd with Moon. the native becomes a king. (27)

चन्द्राचिप्रतरणयुत्तरणयुत्त केन्द्राचिप्रकारगे 1
वुहालकेद्रगे वापि राजराजो मबेनर : 112911

If the lord of the Navamsha occupied by the lord of the sign occupied by Moon is located in kendra. 11th house or a trinal house or it is in kendra to Mercury, the man becomes king of kings. (28)

निष्कारकर : सभेमस्तु विते वा विषस्माचिप्रयोग 1

If Moon along with Mars is located in the 2nd or the 3rd house & Rahu is in the 5th, the native is king of kings. (29)

---

If the lord of the 10th house is with a malefic planet & there are all the planets in each of the 6 houses from 1st to 6th, the native becomes king of kings. (31)

भागेयें चरेराष्ट्रशकांनिर्णते फुमिपाळोस्क्रियाग : 113211
राज्योगादिवस्थाते तथा धासोस्क्रियाग न हिं 1
उत्तमोषाते चन्द्र गुरों नीचाष्ट्रशकांनिर्णते 113211
फुमिपाळोस्क्रियागे सुपे नुपुल्लोस्क्रियाग मबेनर : 113811

If lagna has a movable sign in it, the lord of the lagna too is in a movable sign & Navamsha. The lord of the 9th is also in movable sign, the native rules in another land. If Moon occupies the amsha called "uttam", Jupiter is not in the Navamsha of its sign of debilitation & the Sun is in benefic Shashti amsha, the native is equal in status to a king. (32-34)

स्रयों बा रे खगों वाछi चत्वारें नीचरुल्ला : 1

नीचरुल्लानायसुपे चेट : केन्द्रिकौपण : 1

माने राहों मबे मबे भाग्यनायसुपे चेट : केन्द्रिकौपण : 1
तलेनें नीचरुल्लानुपे चेट नुपसमें मबेनर 113211

If Rahu is in the 10th house & Saturn in the 11th is aspected by the lord of the 9th house, then lord of lagna may be located with a planet in its debilitation sign, the native is equal in status to that of a king. (37)

अर्थातों भागतों वाछi चेट स्वोच्छारें नीचरुल्लानुपे चेट नुपसमें मबेनर 113211

Planets in a king Rajyogas give best results if these are in good houses such as kendras & in good signs such as the sign of their exaltation or their positive sign & in the same type of Navamshas. (38)

# DESTRUCTION OF GOOD YOGAS

जीवे सकेतो यादि या सराहों चाँदालता पापिनिरीधिते चेब 1
नीच्छाशके नीच्छममिनिते या जीवे डिज़स्थेदिते ताडूष : स्याब 11211

If Jupiter is with Rahu or Ketu & is aspected by a malefic planet, it creates "Chandal" yoga i.e. a yoga denoting bad character of the native. Similarly, if Jupiter is located with a planet in its sign of debilitation and is located in the Navamsha of its sign of debilitation, the same result follows even if the man is a Brahmin. (1)

ख्रजाहिमन्दे : सतितेदरपुणे पुर्कोषिते या श्रीशिपुर्कोषिते 1
पुर्कोषिते वेडिरसमानमेटे विचा च सत्वममिनामेटे जात : 11211

Even when Jupiter is located with Rahu, Ketu or Saturn, but is aspected by Venus and Moon, the native even if he be a Shudra, is treated as a Brahmin, efficient in good knowledge. (2)

मेब श्रीशिपुर्कोषिते मिश्राशनी मुझिपुर्कोषिते दृष्टे 1
निन : श्रीशिपुर्कोषिते निश्राशकरस्य तृकोषे दिनेशिपुर्कोषितेगाब 11311

If Moon occupies Aries & is aspected by Saturn, the native has to beg for his food. If such a Moon is aspected by Mars the man is poor. If Saturn influences by association or aspect the lagna & the Moon, the native is very greedy. (3)

पुर्षमहागमवलोकनेन हिनादमवलोकर सम्मिनितादा 1
तत्काललोकरायितो धराजे केदे श्रीशिपुर्कोषिते या तिलागे 11811
पुर्षमहागमवलोकनेन धासस्थू मिश्राशनेद्रष्टे 11911

The bad yogas referred to in shloka 3 take place only if there is no influence of benefic planets by association or aspect. If the lord of the lagna be Mars located in a kendra and Saturn is in the lagna without the aspect of a benefic, the native becomes a servant living on charity. (5)

पापमहागमवलोकनेन चन्दे सप्तले मन्दिस्थू दृष्टे 1
प्रकाशस्थूपलीहुलमिनिते मज्जते नह : 11811

If Moon is located in the 7th house with Saturn & is in between malefics i.e. one malefic is in 6th and the other in 8th house the native suffers from diseases like asthama, consumption, spleen trouble, colic, etc. (6)

बेशो समन्दे ध्यामे सप्तले बेशुलमिनिते कलले 1
परस्पररेद्रसन्यश्युलमिनिते श्रीशिपुर्कोषिते तत्वुषोष्ठे स्याब 11911

If Saturn is located in Veshi i.e. 2nd to the Sun. Moon is in 10th,

---

Mars in 7th one gets his body impaired and if the Sun is in the Navamsha of Cancer & Moon in the Navamsha of Leo, the native gets his body emaciated. (7)

## TRANSLATOR'S NOTE

Saturn in 2nd to Sun will afflict the Sun i.e. the body & bring about trouble to body. Moon in 10th would have zero directional strength & would suffer a body again. Mars in the 7th aspects the lagna standing for body & therefore, injure it. Sun & Moon in mutual Navamsha would mean that Moon as a lagna would suffer at the hands of the Sun. All of these yogas are harmful to body.

दिनेशाबन्दों रिवराशियुत्तों चन्द्रशून्यों वा यदि गौरण स्याल 1
रन्सारीविताल्यापता प्रकेष्टा दिनेशाबन्दों स्याल 11511
कुव्यनित जात नवनेन भीन तदारुकोपादल्यापत्तम् 1
लगने गुरो मुमिष्टों कलबे तन्नादमाक तर नरो हि जात: 11911

The Sun & Moon in Leo or Cancer reduce the body much. If Sun, Moon, Mars and Saturn occupy respectively the 8th, 6th, 2nd & 12th house, the native loses eyes through the humour of the strongest of the afflicting planet. If Jupiter is in lagna. Mars in 7th, the native gets mental derangement. (9)

## TRANSLATOR'S NOTE

In the stipulated position Sun, & Moon as planets denoting the right and left eyes & the second and twelfth house representing the same would suffer very much bringing about the eye trouble.

If Saturn is in lagna & Mars in the 7th or in a trine the yoga gives mental derangement, also when Saturn is in the lagna and Sun in the 12th, Moon or Mars in a trine. Such a man may be defective in speech & naughty in nature. (10)

If Sun and Moon are in lagna or a trinal house, or if Saturn and Jupiter are in kendra, the native suffers from mental derangement if the birth has taken place on a Saturday or Tuesday. (11)

रन्स्यिता : पापखांच सर्वे निशाकरणों यदि केन्द्रुतों 1
योग गड़ाइसे समबेतवनीं आतोपणस्मारुत : शुतलः 112911

If all malefic planets are located in the 8th house, Moon and Venus are together in kendra, the yoga so formed goes under the name of "Gad" (disease). The native in this yoga suffers from epilepsy. (19)

समबेतवना : सौमफ्षांकृष्टा : केन्द्रिता भोगिपतों विलगने 1
चधालयोगा : स मबेतवनीं जातों निजावरुक्तमिनों 112011

If Mercury, Moon and Venus are in kendras and Rahu in the first house, the yoga formed is called "Chandal" yoga. The native of this yoga becomes devoid of character and morality. (20)

यात : परिमहासमबेतवना : स्यातुमेंने युत्ता यदि दूस्तहीना : 1
माने विलगता या यदि वितराशों पापसत्या देवुरों च खीने 112211

If malefic planets are located in the 10th or the 2nd house and are neither associated with nor aspected by benefic planets and if Jupiter is of low type i.e. in bad Navamsha, bad Shashti amsha, bad sign etc the man becomes devoid of good character. (21)

मानेवरुक्तमिनों विलगते समबेतवने जन्नोवरुक्तमिनों रिकीों कुलचना : 1
विन्नसुरुपाकलमिनों युत्ता यदि वीदितों या 112211

If the lord of the 9th house is located in the 12th house with a malefic planet and if the lord of the lagna is eclipsed by the Sun, the native loses his family. If the lords of the 1st and the 9th houses are neither in association with nor aspected by benefic planets the man loses sons, wealth and wife. (22)

सौमफ्षांकृष्टा या यदि सुत्तहीना जातों देवुरों विलगने 112211

If both malefics and benefics occupy kendras, the Moon is aspected by the lord of the lagna & is located in the Navamsha of Saturn, the man loses his family & becomes without a wife. (23)

गुणात्वरिमहासमबेतवनों युत्तने विलगने यदि या जहोसों 1
केन्द्र शनों लगनेवरुक्त श्यातुमेंने जीवे ध्येय मिशुक केव जातों 112811

If Saturn is in a kendra & Moon in lagna & Jupiter is in the 12th house, the native, separated from his home, devoid of sons and wife, is without virtues, is foolish and lives on charity. (24)

If the lord of the lagna is located in the 5th or 2nd house from Moon & only malefic planets are in the 8th house, the Moon is in the 10th house the native lives by despicable means. (25)

लेनाशिपनुत्रीरुप्यस्थस्य : पानीहि जातो जनिष्ठिमस्थस्य : 1
नीचारिमाथो यादि देवुळ्ये तदेशके यासरनाथुणे 112ई11

If the malefic planets occupy the 6th, 8th and 12th house from the lord of the lagna, the man has to leave his place of birth. If Jupiter is in the Navamsha of the sign of its debilitation, or in the inimical Navamsha, & Saturn is in the Navamsha of Jupiter, the result follows. (26)

जातोटि रुण्यो रुत्रारुप्यस्थस्य : कृष्णारुप्यस्थस्य जातोटि भागयोटि : 1
उच्चिशिते यासरनाथो यू नीचारिथुणे यादि राजुणर : 112ई11
प्रानोटि नीचारिथुणे स्यातोप्यस्थस्य या यादि निष्ठितायर : 112ई11

If the Sun is located in its sign of exaltation but is located in the Navamsha sign of its debilitation, the native suffers from sorrow, is devoid of son & wife & devoid of luck and lives on somehow with difficulty even if a prince. (27)

This yoga will be all the more certain if Sun gets the debilitation in question by his location in the lagna under aspect of malefics. (28)

रुलाया द्वध्ये भागो सितत : फक्कजोप्यस्थस्य : 1
संख्यराज्योगानो फलत नीचारिथुणायुणारुप्यस्थस्य : 112ई11

If the Sun is located in the 10th degree of Libra, the native loses the nice results of thousands of good yogas in his horoscope. (29)

## TRANSLATOR'S NOTE

Sun in the 10th degree of Libra is in his extreme debilitation.

मुगो : पुरुषोप्य नीचारिथुणे राजुणराज्योगानो फलत नीचारिथुणायुणारुप्यस्थस्य : 112ई11

Venus located in its sign of debilitation destroys Raj yoga. If at the time of birth there is the fall of a meteor or there is a "Aprkasha" planet, even then the Raj yoga is lost. (For Aprakashak planet see shloka 49 of chapter 1) (30)

नीचे मुगो मन्दनवश्यके या स्यातोप्यस्थस्य चन्दरवी कलसे 1
निरीशितो भागुत्रोतन चार जात : पर्याच्छुप्यस्थस्य 112ई11

If Venus is in its sign of debilitation (6) or it is situated in the Navamsha sign of Saturn, if Moon & Sun are located in the 7th house under aspect of Saturn, the native always serves others. (31)

---

दीजे श्रेषाके मृघुसे कलारे लागने धनो प्रशास्तिशितत : स्याब 1
लागने धनो कर्मगते श्रेषाके रूस्तंचिते वा यदि कर्मगते है 113211

If the Moon is "Ksheen", is located within 72 degrees from the Sun, Venus is in the 7th, and Saturn in lagna the native lives in tattered clothes and if Saturn in the lagna, Moon in tenth aspected by Venus the man gets imprisoned. (32)

चन्ने बस्ते वा यदि वा दिनेशे मने दिकोणे मदरन्समेके 1
मन्नविरिगोणे स मन्नविरिगोणे नीचारिश्रेष्ठालस्थेव 113211

If Moon is in the 12th house, or the Sun is there, Saturn is in a trinal house, the Sun is in 7th or 8th house, the native has defective & small eyes & is diseased; more so if Sun & Moon are located in the Navamshas belonging to their debilitation signs or inimical signs. (33)
