colic. If Moon is in the 4th house in similar conditions and is with a malefic the native has trouble in teeth and throat. (37)

चन्द्र सपाने कलिशनायुत्ते रिक्षे पुमे रन्स्गाते तयारि 1

उन्नादमाके तर सरोखा ब अजतस्व निस्यं ककहारियः : स्वाब 113211

If Moon is in the 12th house with Rahu and another malefic planet & a benefic planet in the 8th, the native suffers from lunacy & is full of anger and fond of querrels. (38)

चन्द्र तु गौककेतराशियुत्ते पापानिते तिदिपीतियुत्ते 1

उन्नदमाके ध्रिष्ठमोमस्थोगे पापानिते रोन्नदुषा रिक्षानो 113511

हत्वहुलमाके जातनरस्व निस्यं तयारि तो सद्वमणायुत्ते 1

केद्र धनो जन्मिन येन रूसे जीवे श्रभाके यादि बा दिनो 118011

विलानो स्यादिदि भागयहिन : प्रादयचोरो मुन्यो कद्विट 118211

If Moon occupies Taurus or Cancer and is located with malefics and its enemies or if Moon and Mars are with the Sun & malefic planets & are devoid of beneficial aspect, the native has constant trouble and pain in the area of his heart. If Moon & Mars are located in the 7th house, the same result follows. If Saturn located in a kendra aspects Jupiter, Moon & Sun located in lagna, the man has no luck & he is the possessor of stolen property. (39-41)

चन्द्र पुमेशे यदि पापानिते केद्रशियुत्ते जान्मनायिदिन : 1

परानुसूग रूसित्रदमाके स्यादिशमेन रूसे ककहारियुत्ते बा 118211

If the lord of the 9th house is in 12th unaspected by benefics & malefic planets are in kendras, the native is devoid of spiritual knowledge and meditation, he lives on the charity of others, & suffers physically. (42)

केद्र गुरो तज्ञनकेन काले नं कमवेबोलमायित नाडित 1

पितु : रूसो बा यदि वान कुयारियः रूस तज्ञन पुमेशेहिन 118211

If Jupiter is in kendra devoid of any association or aspect of benefic planets, neither the father of the native performed the prescribed samskaras relating to the birth of the native, nor will the native perform the last rites of his father. (43)

केद्र श्रभानायितमुस्थीत तज्ञा : रूसशियः दीगानियाकेरो रूस 118211

If Moon is located in kendra along with Mars or if Moon is within 72 degrees from the Sun & is located in the 4th house & there is a planet in the 8th house. the yoga indicates fear of accident through conveyance. (44)

---

रवो सुज्ञे पादुषा समेते बौहोगातो सोखण्यप्राधान्य : 1
रवे : श्रेष्ठकेनवमीचित्रे तू जबे सुतिस्तान्य पिउड़च वाच्या 118911
पायपिटितो चदरवी चारश्रेष्ठो जबे सुतिस्तान्य पिउड़च वाच्या 1
कुजाडियुले दिवसेश्रुले सुज्ञे भानो वा मयमिस्च वाच्याच्या 118511

If the Sun is in the 4th house, aspected by malefics, the yoga indicates excessive heat in the body which goes away after some time. If Moon is located 9th to the Sun the death of the father of the native takes place due to water. (45)

If Moon & Sun are located in Pisces and are aspected by malefics, the death of the father takes place through water. If Mars and Rahu are with Saturn in the 4th house, there is fear of death through water for the native himself. (46)

नीदे सुज्ञे धिमीचातो सपाते दिज्ज्ज़चातो यदि पायड़च �1
फिक्कलतामेती फगीनिस्थुले माने ततव सुज्ज़च शिख्ज़च : 118911

If Venus is located in its sign of debilitation in the 9th house alongwith a malefic & under the aspect of a malefic it proves injurious to teeth. If Venus is located with Rahu, the native loses his ear & if Mars is in the 10th house, it denotes the destruction of children. (47)

नीदे सुज्ञे वासरनायके वा केन्द्रितये पायड़च शिख्ज़च : 1
केन्द्र सपाते सुज्ज़च शिख्ज़च रन्से सुज्ज़च गोमुजातिहन्या 118511

If Jupiter or the Sun is located in kendra in its sign of debilitation & in company of a malefic, the yoga indicates the destruction of children. If Venus is in kendra with malefics & under malefic aspect or if Venus afflicted is in the 8th house, the native kills animals like cows. (48)

श्रेष्ठकेनवमीचित्रे दिशणितये वा पायड़च पायस्तान्य वा 1
नीचणितये सुज्ज़च शिख्ज़च जातस्त निचण सुज्ज़च शिख्ज़च : 118911

If Moon and Mercury occupy the 10th house & are associated with or under the aspect of malefic planets, are occupying the Navamsha of their debilitation sign & are devoid of benefic aspect, the native is always after killing birds. (49)

रन्से सुज्ञे नीचणितये वा गलोतस्तुले प्रववनित ताजा : 1
_CHने अस्ते वा मदने सुज्ज़च जातस्त वाच्य नयनं हिन्निस्त : 119011

If Jupiter is in 8th house with a planet in its debilitation sign, the yoga indicates death by strangling. If Moon is in the 12th house or in the 7th house in company of Venus, the yoga indicates loss of left eye. (50)

---

रन्से दिकों दिवसाचिनाये जातस्थ गैरे शिरिलीमये स्थाब 1
ततिष्क्रकनों या वडि या सकेतो पतेटवानों कुकलास्थाबत : 114811

If Moon is in a trine with Sun the native’s house is infested with poisonous insects. If in this place there is Saturn and Ketu then there is falling of many lizards. (51)

कोल्याचिनायिनमुखाति तत्राचिनायिनमुखाति राहो तु कुछे तु कोमम् 1
तत्र शिरिते सोममुखे तु देह शुक्रे तु निरायतन किरियाचिन 114211
तत्रेव मदे पतन नरगा व淋巴भति तत्र नदेधिचिन्य 114311

If Rahu is there i.e. in the trinal house, being bitten by dogs is feared, if Mars is there fear comes from tortoise. If Mercury is there the fear of being bitten by flies, if it is Venus there is fear of loss of sleep or there is trouble from women, if it is Saturn there is fear of fall from height. All this should be declared after due consideration of strength and weakness of planets. (52-53)

बण्याचिनाया : सोममन रवो स्यानमने श्रह्याके मवने समानम् 1
रज्षयताचिनामने कुछे तु बण्याचिनायाचिनामने च वाचम् 114811
बण्ये तु बण्याचिनायाचिनामने मवने हिनागानायामने वखिजजा 1
मदे गुरो रह़णमाया वा फूगो तु गम्याचिनायिनमिनी वा 114911
समुखिगी जातिष्क्रिनिका वा गम्या मवने श्रह्याचिनाये : 1
रहऋ मदे गमिखिगामम : स्यालकृष्णा च वुक्जा श्रह्याचिन वखिजट 114811

If Sun is in the 7th house one cohabits with a stirile woman. if Sun is there in the sign of Moon, the cohabitation is with a woman of equal qualification. If it is Mars the sexual act is with a woman in menses or with a stirile woman. If Mercury is there in the 7th house it indicates prostitution or with a woman of low status or one belonging to the trader class. If Jupiter is in the 7th the act is with a Brahmin woman. If it is Venus the act is with a pregnant woman. (54-55)

If it is Saturn, Ketu etc the act is with a pregnant woman or a woman of low caste. If it is Rahu in the 7th house the sexual act is with a pregnant woman. If it is Moon the act is with a dark & bent up woman. (These results follow if the planets are in their debilitation signs or in inimical sign.) (56)

सुखिचिन्यतरीषसाममर्व वाचमस्तब्धा अझमचर्विष्ठानबब 1
सुखिचिन्यतरीषसाममर्व : सुखिचिन्यवच्या तत्रो : सोममनस्तब्धा 114911

Such type of sexual acts should also be declared by planets in the 4th house. By Sun etc in the 4th house the type of the house used for the act should be determined. (57)

वने गुण शून्युहे विधार्थान तु देवालायतोपमुखि : 1
हरीसाच्यणानमतोपमुखि तु बा निर्जिततोपमुखि : 119211

If it is Sun in the 4th the act is in a jungle; if Moon, it is in the house; if Mars, it is in an uninhabited house; if it is Mercury, it is a pleasure resort; if it is Jupiter, it is in a temple; if it is Venus, it is near watery place; if it is Saturn, in a fort or in a place reclaimed as watery place. (58)

केन्द्र चुटुके यादि पापुटे जात : पशुना मिपुना सर्मेटि 1
केन्द्र दिके पापुटे यादि स्यातस्यविद्यमंत्रमेटि जात : 119211

If all the four kendras are occupied by malefic planets, the native has the sexual act with animals. If only three of the kendras are occupied by malefics, the native performs the sexual act like an animal. (59)

कुषातस्यणा मिपुटे मदस्ये तौवस्तना मदपफगीदेकेटो 1
कालितनतस्यणेकुणा रवो स्यातस्यणेकुणेकुणा 115011

If Mars occupies the 7th house the woman has very small sized breasts. If Saturn, Rahu or Ketu is in the 7th she has long breasts. If Sun is there the breasts are hard. If any one of the rest are there in the 7th house the woman, has very nice & soft limbs. (60)

## SPAN OF LIFE

Some authors praise the Yogas in astrology; others the Dasa System. They say Dasa System of ruling periods is important for without it even the learned are unable to tell any thing about the span of life. (1)

सिविधाच्चायुण्य योग : स्क्रिफायुण्यमोटमा : 1
द्रिष्ठाच्चायुण्यमलेले स्यातलुण्यमलेले मह्यमें मबेव 11211
आसवतेतस्तुण्यः तु वीचायुण्यरित समटमें 1
उत्तमायुण्य : श्रतायुण्यमिमित रोसिनित ततिदित : 11311

There are 3 kinds of yogas of longevity: less than 32 years is called short one—from 32 to 70 it is medium & above 70 it is declared as long. The longevity over 100 years is termed as "uttam" or the highest. (2 & 3)

आडाद्रशाबा जंबूनामायुण्यः तु शक्तव्यत 1
अपहमिमिकिक्सलाइबलरित तु कार्यव्य 11811

It is not possible to assess the longevity of people till they are of 12 years of age. Upto 12 the life of the young ones should be looked alter by Japa, oblations, & medical prescriptions. (4)

विश्ववेषोंयुण्य : केविहोंसनितमोतमा 1
अपरे रिस्त्योंगान्स सिविधा बालमुण्यः 11911

Some children die before 12 as a result of the fault of their parents. Some die of cruel planets governing the early age, others die of yogas causing early death. Thus there are 3 types of deaths of young children. (5)

जन्मत : प्रबलेनेव बालाना पुष्टिवेषनेम् 1
क्षण्यवेषण रोसं तु तत्स्त्योंगान्सपत्तत : 11611

The sound health of children should be seen from the strong planets in their birth charts. The rest should be declared on the basis of yogas. (6)

---

If the lord of the lagna is enemy of the Sun, one gets short life. If it is neutral, the span of life is also medium. If it is friendly, the span is long. (7)

अल्पायुलेनण माना : शासा महिम तु महिमम् 1
मिरे लगनेषरे तच्छ वीधमायुलेनण 11911

For people born in yogas giving only short life (see shlokas 2 & 3 anti) death takes place in the dasa of the planet governing the Vipat star (3rd from the tenth star). For those born with medium life it takes place in the "Pratyari" dasa. (8)

वीधमायुलेनण माना वक्षें तु महिमम् 1
अल्पायुलेनण माना वक्षें तु महिमम् 11911

People having long span of life die in the dasa of the planet governing the "Vadha" star (7th from that of birth). (9)

चरित्ररेति सूर्णेगा वीधमायुलेनण : 1
तवोरेतम जात्या चायुजीन प्रवद्धते 119011

The range of longevity should be determined by the use of the rule relating to the 3 types of signs i.e. movable, fixed and common. (10)

## TRANSLATOR'S NOTE

The shloka refers to the sutras of Jaimini. According to Jemini the signs occupied by the lords of the lagna & that of the 8th house should be seen. If both the planets are located in a movable sign (1, 4, 7, or 10) the native will have "long" life. Also when one of them is in a fixed sign and the other in a common one.

If both the planets are located in a fixed sign (2, 5, 8, or 11) the native gets "short" life; also when one of them is located in a movable sign & the other in a common one.

If both of them occupy a common sign (3, 6, 9, or 12) the native gets "medium" life span. So also if one of the planets occupies a movable sign and the other a fixed one.

अल्पायुलेनण तु पुणायुलेनण सूर्णेगा 1
महिमाधदणण तु पुणायुलेनण सूर्णेगा 119211

The short life is divided into three parts i.e. short, medium & highest. Similarly we have short, medium & highest, in the medium range. (11)

---

दीशियुपाल्मस्य तु पुण्यियुपाल्मस्य मरेवट 1
एच नवविधि : प्रोत्तस्यापाल्मस्य तु विनिष्ठय : 112211

In the long range also we have short, medium & high. Thus there are in all 9 types of ranges. (12)

फटवम्यारद्यामुळ्य द्वारात्तियुरोद्या 1
श्रान्थवम्यारद्यामुळ्य स्यावभ्याराहोड्यामुळ्य सपतमी 112311

The 5th dasa (i.e. ruling period), if it be of Mars, brings about death. The 6th dasa, if it be of Jupiter, brings about death. The 4th, if of Saturn; and the 7th, if of Rahu, similarly bring about death. (13)

विपत्तयाकब्द्धा कक्षा प्रत्यरीयाकब्द्धा तया 1
वर्षेष्ठाकब्द्धा कक्षा पापा स्यावभ्याराहोड्यामुळ्य सपतमी 112811

One suffers physically in the three dasas called Vipat, Pratyari and Vadha. Particularly, when the governing planet involved is aspected by malefics. (14)

नीचारातियुरोद्यामुळ्य विपत्तयाकब्द्धा तया 1
वर्षा द्वुमुळ्य तयय पापुणुल्य विपत्तयाकब्द्धा 112911

A planet situated in its sign of debilitation or in an inimical sign or when it is eclipsed by the Sun & having Vipat, Pratyari or Vadha gives death in its period, particularly, when it is associated with malefics. (15)

राष्ट्रसंस्कृत्य ये आत्तरसंस्कृत्य मूत्तजीवना : 1
पापुणुल्य युत्ता वापिय निर्देशयुपुल्य : सपतमी 112511

Those who are born at a time when there is in the Ascendant the end of a rising sign and the start of another, are likely to lose life early, particularly, when the conjunction points in the Ascendant are associated with or aspected by malefic plaents. (16)

गठ़ऽसंस्कृत्य मध्य : पित्रमाणुल्यलातल : 1
यदि जीवसंस्कृत्यपालो गठ़ऽसंस्कृत्यलातल : 112911

If a person born in Gandantas lives some how as a result of the merits of his parents, he is protector of his community & is possessor of elephants & horses and is rich. (17)

तुत्तियागो मानुनियाकरो या स्रुरहीगो स्रुरहिगो तुत्तियागो या 1
अयाचिनरस्यापालो वर्षेष्ठ तयय : स्यावभ्याराहोड्यामुळ्य सपतमी 112511

If Sun and Moon occupy the 3rd house of the horoscope and are located there in a malefic sign & are aspected by malefic planets give disease to a male born with this yoga. If it be a female she can survive at the most for a year (i.e. she dies). (18)

चन्द्रस्मरे वासरनायमोझे कुकोद्ये या मरणं द्षशाखात 119911

If Sun and Mars are located in the 7th house from the Moon or if Mars is in the lagna & Moon in 7th, the child hardly lives for 10 days. (19)

उध्यद्रष्टेकालजा मिने यस्य स्यादाखातो प्रह : 1
तीजाचरे विलगनस्ये सभ्यो हरवि जीवितम 112011

## OPPOSITE LAGNA

If in the "Udyat" decante in the 7th house the planet involved is a malefic one & a ksheen Moon (i.e. one within 72 degrees from the Sun) is in the lagna, the child dies soon after birth. (20)

विलगनदिपतिनीशे निश्नने बाकेस्युतो 1
कुकोद्ये जीवित विचालूतरमायो मनिवितम 112911

If the lord of the lagna is occupying its sign of debilitation, is situated in the 8th house with the Sun, the child survives with much difficulty & if lives it lives in a miserable condition physically. (21)

## TRANSLATOR'S NOTE

How the weakness of the lagna and its lord leads to short life is illustrated by the horoscope of late Shri Surya Prakash, son of Shri B.V. Raman of the Astrological Magazine, Bangalore. Here the

lagna is occupied by a Neecha (debilitated) planet & the lord of the lagna, Venus, is also in its sign of debilitation associated with Mercury the dispositor of malefic Ketu. Moon too standing as one of the lagnas is weak in "Paksha" strength, being within 72 degrees from the Sun & its dispositor, Jupiter afflicted by the 10th aspect of Saturn. The weakness of the lagnas, apart from other defects, led primarily to death at the age of 28.

---

आपोकिलमें सित्रा : सर्व प्रहा बलतीविचित्रा : 1
फ़मानस वा दिमासस वा तस्याँस : सल्ववाहतस 112211

If all planets are located in Apokrim houses (3rd, 6th, 9th & 12th) devoid of strength, the child lives for 2 or 6 months only. (22)

केतोड़यय : पूर्ण पश्चांशकालिनपस्तनसित्रा : 1
रोइ सति मोजुसे प्राग : सत्यस्तरते जवू : 112211

If at the time of birth of a person there is rise of Ketu (see Upgrahas in shloka 49 & chapter 1) in the east & it falls in the west & there are sounds of fire & winds & there is Raudra (bad) Muhoorta, the person does not live. (23)

## TRANSLATOR'S NOTE

Raudra Muhoorta is the last half portion of the 90 minutes preceding Sun rise, the earlier half being Brahm Muhoorta.

प्रहण परिवर्तनकाले जात : पापानिरते विधाननस्तर 1
हगनेशे बलहीने जीवति पद्धत्व सिमानस वा 112811

If one is born at the time of an eclipse of the Sun or the Moon or at the time of "Parivesh" (see upgrahas in shloka 49 chapter 1) associated with malefics & when there is a malefic in the lagna & the lord of the lagna too is weak the native lives for 3 fortnights or 3 months only. (24)

अष्ठाचिपित्रजन्तित्रलिनपस्तनसित्रवाहतसमुपाता खस्तर 1
जन्मावसानमरण तस्य भवेळकित्रपातन 112911

If the lord of the Navamsha in the lagna, the lord of the sign occupied by Moon and the lord of the lagna are all eclipsed by the Sun, the native gets his life terminated within some days. (25)

सतिवाहतसमुपाते जातो मुस्तर समाधिक्षालजस : 1
पापुरते वा दुस्तर थीस सौश्रेष्टसमुपाते 112911

A person, born at a time when there are 4 types of sandhis or conjunctions & the conjunction points are associated with or aspected by malefics, without the association or aspect of benefics, dies soon after birth. (26)

## TRANSLATOR'S NOTE

What is one man's food is another man's poison. The rules applicable to spirituality are antithesis of those applicable to material world. In the spiritual realm Samadhi or "Void" is the most desirable and coveted trait for the mind to be in, whereas in the material world "Voids" denote poverty and is a trait mostly to.

If Rahu is located in a kendra, in association with or under the
aspect of malefics & is not aspected by benefics, the native meets
his death soon after birth. If a malefic planet is in kendra & Saturn
is in lagna or a trinal house & the benefic planets are located in the
6th. 8th or the 12th house then also the child meets the same fate. (27)

जाते : दीजे खीतेगो लगनस्थले पायपुत्रिते नाश्यमाशु प्रयाति |
उच्चद्धेसे मेषराझिः च खिल्या राहुपुत्रितेसेप्रयाति प्रयाति : 112511

A person born when lagna is occupied by a ksheen Moon (a
Moon located within 72 degrees from the Sun) aspected by
malefics loses his life soon after birth. Similar is the fate of a person born when Moon occupies the lagna with a sign other than
Taurus, Cancer'or Aries & associated with Rahu. (28)

लागनात्यालेयो पायपुत्रिते याति सट : सप्तस्थालेयो बा खिनस्थात्यालेयो |
लागनात्यालेयलेयो पायपुत्रे : सौम्रेरूद्धे च जीवेत 112911

If the 2nd and the 12th houses from the lagna are occupied by
malefics or if there are malefic planets in the 6th and the 8th house
the child dies immediately. Or there are malefic planets in the 8th
house from the lagna and Moon is ksheen (see shloka 20) the child
lives only for 8 years). (29)

केन्द्र चन्द्रपुत्रितेसेप्रयाति : फयरो याति प्रयातेण्टे बतसरेगो |
जन्मात्यालेयो लगनेगो शुरुपुत्रितेसेप्रयाति जीववरेगो |

If there are malefics in kendras from the Moon & there are no
benefics in the kendras, the child dies within a year of birth. If the
lord of the sign occupied by Moon is located in lagna with malefics
& is aspected by Saturn, the child lives only for 8 years, provided
Jupiter does not influence the lagna. (30)

A person born during the conjunction in lagna of two signs dies in the 6th, 12th or the 8th year if he has Moon in his 6th, 8th or 12th house, in a ksheen condition (i.e. within 72 degrees from the Sun) & associated with malesies dies soon after birth. If the Moon is aspected by benefics the child lives for 8 years. If both malesies and benelic aspect the Moon the child lives for 4 years. (31)

जीवे विलागने मिथ्युने तूलायों पृक्षों तूते श्रीष्ठसुनायी 112911

पार्थेद्धे मुल्युराहिसित्रेवों जीवेद्धे चाड़में सेब भाल : 112911

If Jupiter is in the sign Libra or Gemini in the lagna conjoined with Venus and Mercury but aspected by malesies or if the malesies are in the 8th house, the native lives only for 8 years.

लाने दौजें श्रीष्ठसुनायी निध्यने रन्स्केन्सुणु

पारे : पार्थेद्धे श्रीष्ठसुनायीहिसुनायसुणु च चस्से 1

एवं लाने मविति मवनिस्करसुणुणु पारेमोजा साजे यदि न च

पृक्षों श्रीष्ठसुनायीहिसुनायसुणु च चस्से 112911

If a ksheen Moon (within 72 degrees from the Sun) is in the lagna & the 8th house & kendras are occupied by malesies & if Moon is in between malesies & located in the 8th, 4th or 7th house: in such a lagna, if malesies are in the 7th & 8th houses, the child dies along with its mother. if Moon is not aspected by strong benefics. (34)

राउस्टे श्रीष्ठसुनायी विलागने शृक्षों चाड़में मुल्युणुणु 1

мार्सासाई चन्द्रवुमाकरेवों श्रीष्ठे : पार्थेद्धे मुल्युणुणु 112911

If Moon is in lagna with Rahu & is associated also with malefic planets & if Mars is in the 8th house, the child dies soon along with its mothers. If Sun is in a similar position as the Moon is with Rahu & afflicted, the child dies soon by weapon or by fall from height. (35)

अस्तोगत दिनपतों रिक्षे विलागने मोमेसSभ च निध्यने रन्स्केन्सुणुणु 1

एवं दिनपतोSभ चिम्गावुमोजुणुणु राउस्टे च निध्यने मवतीह चाड़में 112911

If Saturn is eclipsed by the Sun in the lagna & Mars is in the 8th house the child dies in the 3rd year of its life. If Moon is eclipsed in lagna with Rahu & aspected by malesies, the child dies in the 8th year of his life. (36)

बुहस्तितिमोमेसSभ aspected by Sun, Moon & Saturn & is devoid of the aspect of Venus, the child dies within 3 years of its life. (37)

वर्षी ग्रानिमेंटलुप्त प्रयोजनिस्थाने च फट्ट च चतूल्ये बा 1
कुजन सर्याद्वजने हृदये वर्णित जीवनित प्राज़्ञम 113411

If a retrograde Saturn is located in the sign of Mars in the 8th, 6th house or in a kendra & is aspected by a strong Mars, the child lives only for 2 years. (38)

सोरे समर्शने यदि या विधाने जन्मस्थालाने ग्रानिमेंटलुप्त लवलो बा 1
सोरेयु केन्द्रौपातु सभो जातस्थ मतुल्येवनोपातित : 113911

If Saturn is in the 7th house or in lagna & Moon is in lagna or in Scorpio & benefic planets are in kendras, the child meets with immediate death according to Yavanacharya. (39)

नोवस्थये देखपूर्णे तु मोमेंटलुप्तSह बा 1
सिविस्थये जातस्थयu मासानुल्युप्तPrgआछति 118011

If Jupiter is in its sign of debilitation or is in the sign of Mars & the birth has taken place at the time of 3 Sandhis i.e conjunction of two houses, of two Lunar dates & of two signs in lagna, the child dies within a month. (40)

देखयु सन्नो तिरियादिस्थाने एकक्षता तत्वस्थयिस्थान स्यात 1
जातस्थयu मतुल्युप्तसभो सभ : शुक्रहणि जीवनित नोवस्थयिस्थान 118211

If out of the 3 types of Sandhis referred to above, there is one, two or three of them at the time of birth, the child born meets immediate death, but Nandik is of the opinion that if the day of birth is Friday, death does not take place early. (41)

फ़ट्टयु जातस्थयकलगने कुजन वा गढडाने बा मतुल्युप्तवाति 1
मोमें हतित प्राज़्ञन तत्वस्थयनि जीवनितस्थयनि मवेस्थयात : 118211

If the birth is in the 6th Lunar day. Sun or Mars is in Lagna, one of the three sandhis is there or maraka yoga is passing, the day is Tuesday, the child meets immediate death. This is modified if Jupiter aspects it. (42)

मोमेंटये तिरियस्थये कुजन वा गढडाने बा मतुल्युप्तवाति 1
जातस्थये हतित प्राज़्ञन तत्वस्थयनि जीवनितस्थयनि मवेस्थयात : 118211

If the birth is on Tuesday and Mars is located in the Lagna. Moon is ksheen. Lord of lagna is not located either in lagna or kendras Mars is the immediate maraka of this child. So is the case with Saturn. (43)

If moon is located in any of the houses 5th, 7th, 9th, 12th, 1st or the 8th along with malefic planets the yoga indicates immediate death of the child, provided Moon is not associated with or aspected by strong Venus, Mercury or Jupiter. (44)

हरेरस्ताण्तमोगवस्तु हिम्गों दीजे तु जात : धिखु : सक्षा
गच्छति सौम्यकेन्द्रहितों जीवे न वेदिहितों |
लेनोल्याण्तमोगवस्तु सहिताप्रदर्शकमोगवस्तु दिखु गच्छति
चाटके सूर्यपत्तमोगी न वेदिहितों 118911

If kendras have no benefic planet in them & Moon is devoid of aspect by Jupiter or (ii) if Moon, Sun, Mars and Saturn are located respectively in the 1st, 12th, 8th & 9th houses without the aspect of Jupiter or (iii) if a ksheen (weak) Moon occupies 1st 7th or the 8th house. the child dies soon after birth. (45)

लेने चन्द्र भासकरे वा बारित्ते पाएं : केन्द्र नेशने वा चिकोंगे |
सूर्यः सूर्यः शीतलुस्तेकस्थया नाश्य गच्छेगामवेशित जात : 118511

If lagna. Moon or the Sun is strong, but kendra are occupied by malefic planets, or if Venus. Sun & Moon are located together in the 8th house or a trine, the child meets early death. (46)

मेंब चिकोंगे स्यान्मुस्ते द्वारानिश्चाकरे : |
एक्किकोंगे स्यान्मुस्ते द्वारानिश्चाकरे : 118911

Moon located in the 20th degree of Aries, in the 21st degree of Leo & in the 25th degree of Taurus gives early death. (47)

सूर्यचके वा तथा चन्द्रस्तेये चिकोंगे : |
द्वारानिश्चाकरे वा तथा चन्द्रस्तेये चिकोंगे : 118511
चिकोंगे प्रथमस्तेये : |
शन्द्रस्तेये मागो मीने द्वारानिश्चाकरे 118911
द्वारानिश्चाकरे मागो मीने द्वारानिश्चाकरे 118911
कुमें पण्डुमागो वा मुत्रुमागो द्वारानिश्चाकरे च 119011

Similarly, Moon located in the 23rd degree of Scorpio, in the 22nd degree of Cancer, in the 4th degree of Libra, in the 20th degree of Capricorn, in the 1st degree of Virgo, in the 18th degree of Sagittarius, in the 10th degree of Pisces, in the 22nd degree of Gemini, & in the 15th degree of Aquarius at the time of birth gives early death. (48 to 50)

ये ये चिकोंगे द्वारानिश्चाकरे मुत्रुमागो द्वारानिश्चाकरे : |
ताविदिमवत्रेजीतो मुत्रुमागो न स्वष्ठय : 119211

The native dies in the number of years indicated by the death causing degree of Moon as detailed above. (51)

---

लागनजन्मपूर्वेश्व श्रुतुल्ननगत : शुम : 1
करोति मुल्यु जातस्य स्करस्य धातो : प्रमाणवत : 119211

A planet which is enemy of both the lord of the lagna & that of the sign occupied by Moon, if located in lagna, even if it be a natural benefic, causes death through its element it represents (see shloka 78 of chapter 1) (52)

रन्से धरासुतुल्ननगतेश्वा जातस्य मुल्यु स्करस्य धातो मास्करस्य यम प्रमाणवत 119211

If Mars, Sun & Saturn occupy the 8th house, the native dies within a month of its birth. If Ketu also rises the child dies within two months. (53)

श्रुतालयोगा यवने : प्रदिष्ट हाज : कुले जातने धरेशा : 1
तोतिप्रयोगस्य तदन्याता : सभो यम याति नरासत्यस्य यम 119811

Certain yogas have been given for Rajyoga by Yavanacharya. These yogas are applicable only to people born in a royal family. Being severe in character & impracticable for ordinary people, the child born in such yogas dies soon after birth. (54)

मात्रनमस्योगा यवि पापड़टे धरासुतुल्ने श्रीशनस्य गोहे 1
जातस्योगा मुल्यु स्करस्य श्रीशन श्रुतें श्रीशनस्य चेवम 119211

If the Sun located in the 10th house is aspected by malefics & is placed there in the sign of Mars or Moon, & is not under the aspect of benefits leads to early death in childhood. (55)

लागने ये इंड्रिकला निर्बलला हि विहागाप्रथमस्योगा : 1
मर्गाय सद्ब ववे : कुरुतुल्नस्य स्करस्य : 119211
रिविद्द्रमोमस्योगि : कुरुतुल्नस्य निर्बललमस्योगि : 1
रिविद्द्रमोमस्योगि स्करस्य प्रथमस्योगि : 119211

If there is any of the "Pakshi", "Sarpa", "Pashdhar" decantes in the lagna & these are in association with or aspected by malefics at the time of birth, the child dies within 7 years. (56)

If Sun, Moon, Mars & Jupiter are together in any house in the horoscope the child dies within 5 years of its birth. So also is the case if the four planets Mars, Jupiter, Saturn & Moon or Sun, Saturn, Mars & Moon are in any place together. (57)

रिविता युक्त : श्रीशन : सोमस्योगेश्वर श्रीशनस्यति नुनम 1
प्रकाशस्यमस्यवेश्वर श्रीशन जातस्य 119211

If Mercury is with Sun and is not aspected by benefics, the native dies within 11 years from his birth. (58)

In the text the word used is दृष्टे which seems to be a misprint. It should be. दृष्टे

तालने रिविशिनिमोरे : दृष्टेगुणे या र्थीं कीज़ : 1
दृष्टें न देववुरूप्ता सठतिमिक्रिनाश्रयति 114911

Sun. Saturn & Mars, all located in the lagna or Moon located in the sign of Venus in a ksheen condition (i.e. within 72 degrees from the Sun) & without the aspect of Jupiter destroys the child born, within 7 years. (59)

केसे रिविशिनिमोरे : धितिबो मन्दावलोकितोप्य दृष्टे : 1
चवववुरूप्तांश्रयति किमरत गाइडेन 114011

Mars in kendra eclipsed by Sun & associated with or aspected by Saturn surely kills the newly born within 4 years of its birth. (60)

तालनाखिप्तेहबनरेऋप मर्गापदस्तोपि कुणाता याति 1
कुणे : सकतेदुप्तें न दृष्टेमेवबनिमोरेऋप मर्गापदस्तोपि 114211

If Moon is located in the 8th house from the lord of the lagna & is weak in paksha strength is located within 72 degrees from the Sun. & is aspected by all malefics & by none of the benefics, kills the native within 3 years of its birth. (61)

यापो विलानाखिप्तेऋप : ध्रुखाकवबनिमोरे : कुणरनिराखिप्तेऋप 1
चवववुरूप्तांश्रयति याति या तरीखीं अजत : धिखु प्रतुपुरीं नवाजसे : 114211

If the lord of the lagna is a natural malefic planet, & is situated 12th from the Moon & is aspected by a malefic or if the dispositor of the malefic lord of lagna is located in the Navamsha sign of Moon (Cancer), the child dies by age of 9 years. (62)

दृष्टें भागे सद्यता : सोम्यতा : यापो : सद्य यच्छ जन्मन्यपुरे 1
राहो तालने यापुरेच्छ दृष्टें मुस्तु याति पचाकसद्यते 114211

If all the natural benefic planets occupy the houses from 4th to the 10th & the malefics occupy the rest of the houses. Rahu in lagna is with or aspected by malefics, the child dies within 5 years of its birth. (63)

राहो : सद्यमस्तोपне धिखुखवनिराखितें न दृष्टें दृष्टाखिप्तेऋप सठतिमिक्रिनाश्रयति ननमस्तोपि 114811

Rahu located in the 7th house & aspected by Sun & Moon & without the aspect of any benefic planet kills the child born within 12 years of its birth. (64)

---

चतारिति सिद्धें कगीनायपुल्णे ततिमिशिलगाने सतित पापुल्णे 1
जातो यम सप्तदर्शे प्रयाति वक्षन्दृपुल्णे यूतो न उस्त : 114911

If Rahu is in the sign Aquarius, Scorpio or Leo in the lagna & is aspected by malefics & is neither with nor aspected by Jupiter it sends the native born to death in the 17th year of its life. (65)

खीलोसुल : पापुल्णेसुले राहुलेसुले विषोपत : 1
जातो यमपुल्णे याति दिने : कक्तिपये : किल 114911

Aksheen Moon (i.e. one located within 72 degrees from the Sun) aspected by malefics particularly by Rahu sends the born child to death within days of its birth. (66)

अन्नश्रलबनायपुल्णे विषोपति विलगनायपुल्णेसुले दिनेशुलेसुले 1
जातो यम दादश्रलबनायपुल्णे धवे : प्रयाति सौझेसुले यूतो न उस्त : 114911

If the lord of the sign occupied by Moon, and the lord of the lagna are located with the Sun in 6th, 8th or 12th house from the lagna without the association or aspect of any benefic planet the native child dies within 12 years of its birth. (67)

होराइपितुलेसुले पापुल्णेसुले विषोपति 1
राहुलेसुले कुल्णा वबे मासे न सद्धस : 114911

If the lord of the lagna is in the 7th house defeated in war by a malefic, the native dies in thrice the number of months or years denoted by the sign in the 7th house. (68)

तरफीनुलुजा : पुरस्याने यूत्ता न सौझेसुले : 1
जातो यमपुल्णे याति नवस्थेसुले न सद्धस : 114911

If Sun, Moon and Mars are situated in the 5th house & are not influenced by any benefic planet, the native dies in its 9th year of life. (69)

तलगनुलुजा : विलगनुलेसुले पापे : सद्धसुलेसुले : 1
वबे मासित नवस्थेसुले याति धालोसे न सद्धसुले : 114911

If the lord of the lagna occupies the lagna but all the malefic planets occupy the houses from 11th to 3rd, the native dies in the 4th month of its birth. (70)

चन्द्रदलबनायपुल्णे : यूत्ते : चन्द्रदलबनायपुल्णे विषोपति : 1
लगनावदलबनायपुल्णे दादशलबंदलबंद मुतिप्रदर्श : 114911

If Sun is the lord of the sign occupied by Moon, and is located with its Son i.e. with Saturn, in the 8th house from the lagna, the yoga gives death to the native in its 12th year of life. (71)

---

धर्माचस्ते गापुतो सोमें दूषिवलिजिते 1
अयोक्तिलें विलगनें फौड़ें निर्णयन रखेब 119211

If natural malefics occupy the 6th and the 8th house of the birth chart, devoid of the aspect of the natural benefic planets and if the lord of the lagna is located in any of the apoklim houses (3rd, 6th, 9th or 12th), the child born dies in his 16th year of life. (72)

परस्यरहेशस्तारितो वा लागनेरशारितो न सोमें 1
रिम्टारिमें वागियिपें युते तव्यदव्याचे निर्णयन प्रयाति 119211

If the lord of the lagna is in 8th house & the lord of the 8th is in lagna & there are no beneficial planets in the 6th or the 12th house, nor is there Jupiter in these (6th or 12th) houses, the native dies in its 18th year of life. (73)

केन्द्रुप पापुतो निशाकरेगा सोम्यरहेशस्तारितो 1
धर्माचस्ते वा युते चा श्रथाकें जीविक्रुपिरहेशस्तारितो निर्णयन 119811

If natural malefics are located in kendras & the Moon is devoid of beneficial aspect and is located in 6th or 8th house, the native lives only for 20 years. (74)

जीवन सठित : सुयों लागनेस्त : कीतरारिता : 1
आद्मारितो केन्द्र दा श्रथाकें जीविक्रुपिरहेशस्तारितो निर्णयन 119411

If Sun & Jupiter are located in Cancer in lagna & the lord of the 8th house is in kendra, the native child born dies in his 22nd year of life. (75).

रायुगा सठित चन्द्र जामिरें चार्तरारिता वा 1
देवेजें लगनेगोइसिमन दार्वेजें मरवेजें 119411

If Moon is with Rahu in the 7th or 8th house & Jupiter is in lagna the native dies in its 22nd year of life. (76)

पापद्रुपातरसे तु होरानेसे न साम्यों 1
पित्रजन्मिन जातस्तुप पच्चिरहेशस्तारितो यम रखेब 119411

If the lord of the lagna is located in between malefics & is not influenced by any beneficial, the native born with the same lagna as that of his father, dies in his 25th year of life. (77)

मन्दोदेशें श्रञ्जरहेशस्तारितो सोम्यरहेशस्तारितो निर्णयन 119411

If Saturn is situated in an inimical sign in the lagna & the beneficial planets are all in apoklim (3rd, 6th, 9th & 12th) houses, the native dies in 26th or 27th year of its life. (78)

---

चन्द्रो मन्बरहायतस्तु सूयेशायतस्तु : 1
एकोनिस्थाके वणे जातो फमुलुर स्रभेव 119911

If Moon is in intimate relation with Saturn (by their exchange of places, mutual aspect etc) and the Sun is in the 8th house, the native born dies in 29th year of life. (79)

पाया जन्माध्यातस्तु : सौम्या : केन्द्रहायतस्तु : 1
अतिस्थात वोगो समुलुरने लवकारिष्ठे मुतिमवेब 114011

If natural malefic planets occupy the 1st, 8th or the 7th house & the natural benefics are not located in any of the kendras, the native dies in the 28th year of his or her life. (80)

जन्मरहायतस्तु निष्ठानेचे कये गुरो 1
सत्रिष्ठानेचे बा सिश्राणेचे या मुतिमवेब 114211

If Moon is located in between the lords of the 1st and the 8th houses, and Jupiter is in the 12th house, the child born dies in its 27th or 30th year of life. (81)

रख्यें आवरहायते पाये पायनीरिष्ठे 1
रन्स़्स्थें जन्मपे वापि अस्तारिष्ठे मुतिमवेब 114211

If the lord of the 8th house is aspected by Jupiter, the lord of the 8th is a natural malefic aspected by a malefic & the lord of the lagna is located in the 8th house, the native dies in its 28th year of life. (82)

अस्तारिष्ठें केन्द्र लाने तु बलवतरे 1
सिश्राणें आवरहायते आवरहायते जातक : 114211

If the lord of the 8th house is in a kendra, or is strong in lagna, the native lives for 30 years only. (83)

लानदरहायते मानुलुरसमवेब 1
पाये बलवतरें लाने केन्द्रारिष्ठे गुरो तथा 114811

If Saturn is located in the sign in the 8th house or is in the Navamsha of the sign in the 8th house and strong malefics occupy the lagna, there are no benefits in the kendras, the man or woman born lives for 30 or 32 years. (84)

अन्योन्नसगते गुरो लानदरहायते पायवीरिष्ठे 1
दरवें श्रिष्ठसगते बपरमालुरसमवेब डिं 114911

If two malefics have exchanged places & one of them is in lagna, & is aspected by malefics & Moon is in 12th house, the native lives for 30 or 32 years. (85)

---

जन्मात्मेशो यदि केन्स्पूर्टो रन्से तु यथा कष्चन विवरण : 1
तारिष्ठके तन्नरगा फूमेसूर केन्स्पूर हीनेश्वितेशों : 114511

If the lord of the lagna and the 8th house are together in a kendra & there is some planet in the 8th house, the native dies in the 22nd year of life, provided further that the kendras do not contain any benefic planet & contain only malefic ones. (86)

धीजे ध्रुखके दिवसेशोरो रन्साचिपे केन्स्पूर्टSध्रुखपे 1
पापिनिते तन्नरगा दिवसेशोरो निपने प्रयात 114911

If a ksheen Moon is with the Sun, itself the lord of 8th is in kendra, the 8th house contains a malefic & there is a weak planet in lagna, the native dies in 32nd year of life. (87)

गुरुत्वूरों ब केन्द्रियों लानेंशे पापस्तुरों 1
आपोकिकलमध्ये संचायायमध्ये : फटसिखादेल हि 119311

If Jupiter and Venus are situated in kendra, the lord of the lagna is with a malefic planet in 3rd, 6th, 9th or 12th house, & the birth is at Sun set time, the man lives only for 36 years. (93)

लानेनिष्ठे वासरनायके तु पापस्तुरे श्रृणुत्वे विहीने 1
फटसिखादेल परमायुरस्य श्रृणुत्वे सतीत सत्यमेतव 118811

If a weak Sun is located in lagna, in between malefics, in an inimical sign, and is not aspected by benefits, the native lives only for 36 years. (94)

श्रृणुत्वस्यस्यों ततुगों श्रृणुत्वूरों केन्द्रियों न मर्वेस्तुरे 1
आतो यवा मान्युरस्ये श्रृणुत्वूरों : स्थालस्तुरिखादेल निष्ठे प्रयाति 119911

If Mars and Moon are in lagna, and the natural benefic planets are not situated in kendras or in the 8th house, and if Mandi is in lagna, the native lives only for 36 years. (95)

हरेशास्तायायमध्येलस्युस्यों विहीने 1
पर लयकला लयस्ये तु जुत्वे लयकलामध्ये 118811

As a result of the experience in the science of astrology. I have gathered the essence of the Shastra for the pleasure of the learned. (96)

## CHAPTER-11
Cancellation of yogas for short life.

लागनिस्तरों देवयुत्रिश्षेपाल्टेडानिह्नयाचिकलात्मयेव 1
एकोपि बालेनुयरणपाल्टे : समस्तपाल्टे प्रमयेव 11211

Jupiter in the lagna is particularly qualified to destroy the evil result of weak planets, just as even one bowing before Lord Shiva destroys all sin. (1)

अस्ततसलेव यादि लागनाये सोम्यानिस्तरों ताड़युत्रिश्षेपाल्टे 1
केदिस्तरों पापुयुणा विहितने सम मायायाने जीवति वीयमायुण : 11211

If the lord of the lagna is very strong & is associated with and aspected by benefic planets by its location in kendra & is without any malefic aspect, the native is fortunate & lives a 'long life.
(2)

श्रखोकों रन्सनायस्तरों सोम्यानिस्तरों वीयमायुण : 1
धात दिएगूं प्रमयेवन रन्सयुत्रिश्षेपाल्टे 11211

If Moon is lord of the 8th house and is located in the decante of a benefic planet, it protects the long life of the native day & night. (3)

चन्दर : सेपुगासस्तरों सोम्यानिस्तरों वीयमायुण : 1
सवारितनिहतना स्यारितयुणकौविहित : 11811

If Moon is farthest away from the Sun, located in the sign or Navamsha of a benefic planet removes all dangers for short life particularly when it is also aspected by Venus. (4)

जीवमायाफिस्तरोंयानायेक : केदिस्तरों वली 1
पापुयुणाफिस्तरोंयानायेक मंगकौविहित 11911

If out of Jupiter, Venus and Mercury even one is strong and located in a kendra, without the association or aspect of any malefic planet, at once destroys all dangers to short life. (5)

चन्दरीपि श्रखोरिश्षेपों जीवयुत्रिश्षेपाल्टे तथा 1
देवकाज श्रखयुत्रिश्षेपाल्टे पाप हरियाय 11411

Moon even if located in an inimical sign but occupying the decante of Jupiter, Venus or Mercury, removes dangers to short life just as Lord Vishnu destroys sin. (6)

---

If birth has taken place in the night time in the bright fortnight of the Moon, and Moon is aspected by benefics then even if she is located in 6th or 8th house removes all dangers to short life. Similar is the case if birth is in dark fortnight but during day time & the Moon is aspected by malefics. (7)

सव्यपर्णेंश : पारिपुल्णन्नो दूख्यो हरत्नायु सम्मत्तचोपायन 1
नये : सवकीये : प्रहरेब डिटाइजो यथा तथा जन्मनि वेषजालम 112511

If the Moon is farthest away from the Sun and is aspected by all planets, it destroys all dangers to short life like a king pardoning all sins through his compassion. (13)

सौम्पर्णेंशरतितोपायलेशः पार्वेलेंश च सौम्पर्णेंशन सुम्पर्णितोपायलेश 1
सवापदा विहरतो मवति प्रशुति : पुजापरे चलु यथा पत्नेपर्णापायलेश 112811

If natural benefic planets are very strong, & the malefic are weak, the lagna contains the sign of a beneficial planet & is aspected by benefits, all dangers to short life are removed, like the mantra pooja of planets removing all sins. (14)

- उद्भेष्टगण्यमुने : सम्धवफिगा मरीशिपुल्णिगाम 1
सवापित नयवति तम हव सुययोदेश प्रशलम 112911

If Agastya (one of the Seven famous stars) rises with Sapta Rishis having Marichi as the first of them. all dangers to life are destroyed like Sun destroying all darkness. (15)

अज़पुल्णकिकी लागने रखाती राह : सम्धवतीपुल्णिगाम : 1
पुजयोदेश प्रशन : कुतापरायम यथा पुजयोदेश 112511

If Rahu is located in lagna in Aries, Taurus or Cancer, it destroys all dangers to short life like a happy king forgiving a criminal. (16)

चर : सुययोदेश : धीपोयि सुययोदेश हरति रिस्म 1
जलमिम हरतितिसार जातीप्रकालवक्लवप्रकालविस्म 112911

Moon located in a beneficial Varga (decante, Navamsha etc), even if she be ksheen but aspected by benefits removes all dangers to short life like the concoction of bark of Jateephal for removing loose motions. (17)

सव्यात्ममप्रशय : धीपिन : सोम्मा हरति कठफलम 1
सुययोदेश कठफलम लागती यथा यथा नुनम 112511

Natural benefic planets located 6th. 7th & 8th from Moon remove all trouble (of short life) like the amorous movements of the young woman removing all sorrow from the mind of a young man. (18)

पार्वेलिगाते चर तर्वीशन निरीखिते 1
सौम्पर्णहागा वर्षिसे कुपापोन यथा 112911

If moon is located in the sign of a malefic planet, but is aspected by the lord of the sign occupied by it & is situated in the Navamsha etc of benefic planets, life is protected like the wealth of a miser. (19)

चर्दायिततलेशीह लागनसे शुमरीहितण 1
भृष्टुपा वीडिते चर्दे स्वोंनसे रिखे हरेवण 112011

If the lord of the sign occupied by Moon is located in the lagna & is aspected by benefits, including Venus, & Moon is in her exaltation sign all danger to short life is removed. (20)

स्वोंचस्वहे स्वोंचस्वहे वाछiस शुमरीहे वाछiस स्वकृतियथ धा शुमरीहे:
शुमरीहित : श्रष्ठरो वंगुप सौफेयुप धा 1
शुमरीहमबोकोनसे रिखे : पापरूपैसितणो रिखे हरेवण
दिनमध्य : प्रालेखनाशे वयफa 112011

If Moon is in her sign of exaltation, or is in her own sign, in the varga (Navamsha etc) of benefits, or in its own varga is farthest away from the Sun, is under aspect of benefits, is without the aspect of her enemies, nor associated with or aspected by malefics, she removes all danger to short life like the Sun acting on ice. (21)

अध्यायवोरिकमध्यस्थ : प्रोत्तारिकमध्यस्थ मया 1
भृष्टुपैसितणो गुहीलला तु स्वकृतियथस्थमध्यस्थ 112011

1. Venteshwar Sharma have thus given the Chapter on the yogas for the removal of dangers to short life by gathering its rules like the honey bee. (22)

## CHAPTER-12
MEDIUM LONGEVITY

दारिस्थुल्यमर्शत : सद्धत्वा मह्यमाळुल्यगान 1
तावणकालीनियमितान योगिभौपानंत वद्दे 11811

I will now deal with yogas relating to medium longevity i.e. from 33 to 70 years of age. (1)

चर्ने कुजबे ततुलो प्रदृष्टे कुरस्थे : शोमन्तभौपानंत 1
कैन्दरड़ितितिनियम प्रयाति चर्ने स्थुल्यस्थानकेस्थु 11211

Moon in lagna in the sign of Mars & seen i.e. aspected by malefic and by benefic planets located outside of kendras gives a longevity of 33 years. (2)

If Jupiter and Venus are located in kendra, the lord of the lagna is with a malefic planet in apoklim i.e. in houses 3rd, 6th, 9th or 12th & the birth is at the time of Sunset or Sunrise the man gets a longevity of 36 years. (7)

स्वास्थ्ये विलागने रिकिनदने च जीवस्तों कर्मिज सुपूर्णे 1
जाते धनादशों बृहुशास्तोंता वेचाचिववेनिष्ठन प्रयाति 11211

If Saturn is in lagna in its sign of exaltation. Jupiter is in the 7th & Saturn is in the 10th, the native would be rich, knows Shastras & lives for 44 years. (8)

लानेश्रवरे रिखागते सपाते केरड़विष्ठते याति सौम्येश्रवरे 1
चत्वारिश्रवरे मुल्येश्रवित जात : पुरों नान्यया भालस्मेतब 11211

If the lord of the lagna is located in the 8th house with a malefic planet & there is no benefic planet in the kendras, the native gets a longevity of 44 years. (9)

जन्नायिने रिखागते सपाते पापायिने रिखाते रिपुर्णे 1
बलायिने चा फुम्मुलिववेते पवायिनेश्रवित प्रयाति 112011

If the lord of the lagna is located in the 8th house along with a malefic, the lord of the 8th house is strong in the 6th with a malefic planet & without any benefic aspect on it the man gets a longevity of 45 years. (10)

मेषे रिपुर्णे ततुलों सुपूर्णे सेम्येश्रवित फुम्मुलिष्ठते जात : 1
पापप्रदाशा चा रुझा विहीने नागाचिववेते प्रयाति 112211

If Moon is farthest away from the Sun & is located in Aries in the lagna, and is aspected by benefits, the native is a king. If the Moon is devoid of the aspect of malefics, the native dies at the age of 48. (11)

रिपुर्णे लानेश्रवरे सहायस्तव्यने चन्द्रों अध्यात्मने वा 1
वेबटिविशाननुश्रिताव्यतों जातव्य फुझों नयनेश्रवरे 112211

If Saturn is in lagna with any other planet & Moon is located in the 12th or 8th house, the native is well versed in Vedanta, is of good character & dies at the age of 52. (12)

Chāpe फुझों लानेश्रवरे मोमें सराहों फुझिवाचाव्यते 1

If Jupiter is in Sagittarius in the lagna and Mars and Rahu are in the 8th, the man dies at the age of 52 years.

रिपुर्णे कामागते रिपुर्णे पापायिने रिपुर्णे रिपुर्णे रिपुर्णे 112211

---

If the lord of the 8th house is located in the 7th house & the Moon is located with a malefic in 6th or 8th the native dies at the age of 58. (13)

सर्वश्रेष्ठ देवगुरों विलागने कुमे सपाते यदि केन्द्रार्थों |
धारणार्थवेचा घबू पुण्यवेचवेच जातस्तु खच्छा निश्चन प्रयाती 119811

If Jupiter and the lord of the 8th house are in lagna or if Jupiter is in Aquarius in kendra with a malefic planet, the native knows the meaning of Shastras, is lucky, & dies at the age of 60. (14)

केन्द्र सपाते तनुये धयस्तों लागनेश्रेषों रन्स्गाते हि खच्छों |
लौकनतर प्राप्तवीत सम जाते कुण्यलवुतर कुण्यपासने तम 119411

If the lord of the lagna is in kendra with a malefic planet & the lord of the lagna is in the 12th house or in the 8th, the native dies by fire. The man is of bad character & a blot on the fair name of his family. (15)

सीरे विलागने डिकुके श्रेषों कुमे कलतर गाने दिनेश्रेषों |
कवीज्ञसोमेविहतेपुतर नरेश्रेषों जीवति धयस्तों 119511

If Saturn is in lagna, Moon in the 4th house, Mars in the 7th & Sun is in the 10th with any of the three planets, Mercury, Jupiter & Venus, the native becomes a king and lives for 60 years. (16)

तलनामिःने विलागने डिकुयारिपुतर खच्छेश्रेषों : परिरुष्यमाने |
जात नरे मुपिपति धनादच्य करोति� खच्छेश्रेषों सुतरमेन्द्रुसे 119911

If Venus is in lagna aspected by Mercury. Jupiter and Moon & Jupiter is in 5th hosue the native becomes a rich king & dies at the age of 60. (17)

सित्रेविलागने डुफमासकरमजों खच्छेश्रेषों : परमोच्चश्रेषों |
सुतरमेन्द्रुसेतमजों महीनिति : स्यानिनिति ब खच्छेश्रेषों 119511

If Venus is in lagna & Mercury and Saturn are in kendra highly exalted planets are in 3rd and 11th houses the native becomes a king and dies at the age of 60. (18)

होराजनमायिनायों निश्चनपुतरातों मुल्यनायों च केन्द्र योग जातो |
नरोहिमनुयात नरेश्रेषों कुतरिविलागनिति च |
खच्छेश्रेषों धयस्तों निश्चनमायिनायों नवकोते दिनिनमायिन |
वर्ष सित्रेषों वा स्यानिस्तों सुतरेषों पासिवेसर : 119911

If the lord of the hour of birth and the lord of the lagna be located in the 8th house, & the lord of the 8th is in kendra, the native becomes a king, rich and famous and dies in 66 years. Nandak says it is in 60th year. (19)

---

## TRANSLATOR'S NOTE

The lord of the hora of the birth referred to in shloka 18 should be determined on the basis of the day of birth. The first hora or hour from Sunset would belong to the lord of the day of birth, the lord of the 2nd hour from Sunrise would be the 6th to the lord of the 1st, the lord of the 3rd hour would be the lord of the 6th from that of the 2nd & so on. For example, if we want to know the lord of the 11th hour after Sunrise of a person born on Wednesday, then the lords of the various houses would be as under:

| Hour No | Lord |
| --- | --- |
| 1st | Mercury |
| 2nd | Moon |
| 3rd | Saturn |
| 4th | Jupiter |
| 5th | Mars |
| 6th | Sun |
| 7th | Venus |
| 8th | Mercury |
| 9th | Moon |
| 10th | Saturn |
| 11th | Jupiter |

नदारनायसहित : सर्विता नमश्चय : सौरीरिबिलानसहितो हिंडुके सूरेंज्य : 1
अतिमन योगे जावते यो मनुष्य : धोगीपितिनेशनमण्ड़वच्छा 112011

If Sun & Moon are in the 10th house. Saturn is in lagna, Jupiter in the 4th, the native becomes a king and lives for 68 years. (20)

अर्थे विलागने बूधसुप्यते मीने शाने दादशाने हिमाचोह 1

आतो योगे चार्विबन्धोप्तरमाक कर जीवेब पफ्सा खट सहायेन जात : 112811

If Jupiter along with Mercury and Sun are in the Ascendant, Saturn is in Pisces. Moon in the 12th house. the native becomes rich and comfortable & lives for 66 years. (21)

चर्दे विलागने सकलुहे प्रयात नीचे शनो सपरमंगो च सभे 1

अर्डिमन जातो मानुयों जानिमुख्यों जीवेशित : पदमिः : सर्पुतक : 112211

If Moon is in Canceginiagna. Saturn is in its sign of debilitation in the 7th house with Sun also in the 7th the man is highly wise & lives for 65 years. (22)

नोबं मर्दे केन्द्रों वा विकासों सौमें केन्द्र धारकरे वा ससीमें।

योग जात : परिडिटो धर्मशीलो जाने पाए : सदस्यतेवल्लहागाम 112311

---

If Saturn occupying Aries is in kendra or a trine, benefics in kendra or Sun & Mercury are in kendra, the native is a learned man, religious, wise, & lives for 70 years. (23)

प्रबंतो केन्द्रो सौम्य निष्कर्ष सौम्यविधि 1
लगनाचिपन दृश्यশेषता जीवित सप्तातिम 112811

If a strong benefic planet is located in a kendra, & the 8th is without any benefic planet in it & is aspected by the lord of the lagna, the man though sinful lives for 70 years. (24)

पणमस्य धरास्थो नीचे मदेस्तटो रवो 1
अरिमन जातो मनुष्यस्तू सप्तातिम रवो 112911

If Mars is in the 5th house. Saturn is in Aries, Sun is in the 7th house, the native lives for 70 years. (25)

आंजराहिगता : सबे पुण्यवर्षमलिनिता : 1
आंजरवांने परे भारत वीधिमाळुल्यपोशी सम : 113011

If all the planets are in odd signs along with the strong Moon, the native gets long life. Odd sign in lagna too is conducive to great fortune. (30)

समराहिगता : सबे पुण्यवर्षमलिनिता : 1
स्टीयाड़ू जनने पुण्यलागने भारतवर्षपोशी सम : 113011

If all the planets are in even signs along with a strong Moon (i.e. when Moon is farthest away from the Sun) & the birth is of a female in an even sign in lagna the woman gets much fortune. (31)

भारतवर्षपोशी वीधिमाळुल्यपोशी ववनाद्य : 1
तत्वयके पुण्यवर्षवर्षमलिनिता : 113011

Yavanacharya & other are of the view that yogas that ensure affluence and power confer long life. Varahmihir & others have however, treated luck & longevity yogas separately. (32)

मेराफल्यवलने संगुरी मुझो वा निशाकरे गौर्थुम्यमांचे |
सिहासनांचे यदि वा धराणे जातस्वरसभाच्यमुझोती मर्बे : 114011

If lagna is the last Navainsha of Aries & contains Jupiter or
Venus, the Moon is in the 5th Navamsha of Taurus or Sagittarius,
& if Mars is in "Simasana" amsha, the native gets innumerable
number of years as longevity by Mantras. (80)

सिहरे रवो सोम्यवतने युक्ते चरे उपस्थये मिष्टने च शुक्ते |

If Saturn occupies Libra, if Sun is in a fixed sign with Mercury.
Moon, is in Taurus, Venus in Gemini, Jupiter in Cancer lagna, the
native is equal to a Muni (81) & lives very long.

देवलोकशाखे चरे भोमे पारवताशाखे |

सिहासने रवो लाने जातो मुनिसमे मर्बे 114211

If lagna be Aries, Sun in 10th house, Jupiter in Cancer, the

gets very long life of a Muni. (83)

सिहासने मया प्रोत्त संघयुम्यमिष्टने |
युक्ते पुवेके : सवे तत्ववेव मयायुना 114811

Whatever my predecessores have stated I have also stated in this

# CHAPTER—13

द्वारातुरोयेन फलो वंदिति मूनीष्ठरा जात्तुरोयेन तत् 1
सारे समुद्रय तत्ववेच वंदिति मंदे यथा विस्तरतो द्वारातुरोयेन 11211

The good and bad results of the dasa of planets have been narrated by great Munis. I have taken the essence of what they have said & will state in detail the dasas. (1)

दीपण : स्वस्तस्तु मूनीष्ठरा : शातो हीनोडितु : खित् 1
विकल्पश्च घत् : कौपी नवयया बंधरो मंदे घत् 11211

A planet is of 9 types viz. "Deepta", "Swastha", "Muditah", "Shantah", "Heen", "Dukhutah", "Vikal", "Khal" & "Kopi". (2)

उच्चस्तस्त : रेचरो दीपण : स्वस्तस्त : स्वस्तस्तरामिष्ठरे 1
मूनीष्ठरे मिर्में शातो वंदितस्तस्तरे हिन उच्चस्तस्तो 11211

A planet located in its sign of exaltation is called "Deeptah", in its own sign it is called "Swastha", in a friendly sign "Muditah", in a benefic sign "Shantah" in its sign of debilitation "Heena". (3)

द्वारुमें रु :भ स्वस्तस्तु विकल्प : पापस्तस्तु : 1
घत् :परायितो रुय : कौपी स्यावकस्तस्तु : 11811

It is called "Dukhitah" within the sign of an enemy, it is called "Vikal" when located with malefic planet, one defeated in war is called "Khal" & one with Sun is called "Kopi". (4)

पृष्ठवृष्ठक फलो तेया द्वारातुरोयेन खित्तो खित् 1
तत्व नामातुरोयेन परिपाणे वंदिति खित्तो खित् 11411

These 9 types of planets give different results in their ruling periods according to the meaning of their names. (5)

During the ruling period of a "Swasthah" planet, the native gets good health, wealth and comforts from the ruler, knowledge, fame, love, greatness, wife, wealth, lands, sons, & morality. (7)

मुवानितत्यापि द्रष्टिपाके बस्सािद्वृष्टिपूत्तापीण्य 1
पुरुगाम-श्रक्षणाचिद्वृष्टिपूत्तापीण्य 11211

During the ruling period of a "Mudit" planet one gets clothes, etc, lands, scents, son, wealth, patience, hearing of the Sacred Texts, & songs, & also gets charity, conveyance, clothes & ornaments. (8)

द्रष्टिपाके स्थृष्टिपाके श्रात्तस्थ मुलুरकलस्थापीण्य 1
विधा-विनोवानितत्य धम्मश्रात्तस्थ बहवयं द्रष्टिपाके पूत्तापीण्य भ 11911

During the ruling period of a "Shartali" planet the native gets comforts, patience, lands, sons, wife, conveyance, knowledge, recreation. Sacred Texts, much wealth, & favour from the ruler of the country. (9)

स्यानचुटित बस्सुरिरोपिता भ हीनस्य चेतस्य द्रष्टिपाके 1
जीवत्यस्यो कुलिसन्दिनसुटिता लयत्यो जने रोगिनिपीडित : स्यात 119011

During the ruling period of a "Heena" planet, the native lives by despicable & low means, forsaken by people, & suffers from disease. (10)

सु.चाईनितत्यापि द्रष्टिपाके नानापिण्य सु.चुटिपाके नियस्य 1
विदेशागो बस्सुनेशिनिरोपितोराविद्वृष्टिपूत्तापीण्य लयत्यो 119211

During the ruling period of a "Dukhit" planet he suffers frequently from various types of sorrows, he has to travel abroad, has clash with his friends and relatives, & gets fear from thieves, king's, wife etc. (11)

वेकल्य चेतस्य द्रष्टिपाके वेकल्यमायाति मनोविकारस्य 1
पिसाविकानो मर्फ विश्वायत्योपिनिरोपितोराविद्वृष्टिपूत्तापीण्य 119211

During the ruling period of a "Vikal" planet, the man gets some of his limbs impaired, is worried mentally, & meets with death of his elders like father etc, & gets trouble from wife, son, conveyance, clothes, thieves. (12)

म्रष्यिपाके कलह विषोगो चेतस्य चेतस्य विषोगोगय 1
श्रात्य जनानो चनन्मुल्यिनिरोपिति नियस्य स्यातनोस्य नियस्य 119211

During the ruling period of "Kala" planet, one gets loss of father, gets enmity from people, loss of wealth, & lands & gets bad name from his relatives. (13)

कोपीनित्रत्याविध द्वाराित्याके पाण समायाति बुल्फकरे : 1
vikhayath : सर्विन्मुखिनाश्च राजा च विकि हरतेSsr योगी 112811

During the ruling period of a "Kopi" planet, one engages in sin in many ways, there is loss of education, honour, wife, wealth, lands. He gets the wealth of a king through unfair means even if he be a Yogi. (14)

## MAIN RULING PERIOD—SUN

मानोदेशाविध परस्थोचास्य मूल्ययंदरास्मज कोटित्याविधम् 1
समायाने मूल्ययंदरे : सकाशाउपीत सन्धार विनोदेशाउपीत 11211

During the main ruling period of Sun occupying its highest degree of exaltation one gets lands, wealth, wife, son, lame, courage, honour from the king, movements, recreation meetings.

उन्नयानित्रत्याविध रवेद्धाव्या गौवैदियान्याविधम् च 1

from thieves, & fire, opposition & clash, wrath of the ruler and travel to other countries. (5)

नीविश्रतस्यापि रवेचितपाके मानायनाथ दितिपालकोपाबः 1
स्वर्णुनाथ सूत्रिमिरबरे : पिर्षाचिकानामिपकोपाबः 11511

During the ruling period of the Sun occupying its sign of debilitation, there is destruction of honour & wealth due to wrath of the ruler, the destruction of ones relative's and friends, & one gets bad name through sons, friends, wife, father etc. (6)

अल्लेट नीविश्रत सूत्रिमिरबरे पिर्षाचिकानामिपकोपाबः 1
पिर्षाचिकानामिपकोपाबः 11911

During the Sun occupying its highest degree (10th) of debilitation, one gets into danger, separation from home and hearth, travel abroad, death of elders, & the destruction of wife, son, cows, lands, agriculture. (7)

मुल्लिकोपाग सवरेचितपाके देशायनाथमिपकोपाबः 1
राजास्थ्य गौपननिमिरबरे सवरेचितपाके यानायनाथमिपकोपाबः 11411

During the ruling period of Sun occupying its Mool Trikon i.e. positive sign (see shloka 51, chapter 1) the native gets lands, wealth, wife, son, friends, comforts, support of government, cattle wealth, gain from friends, appropriate status & ruling powers. (8)

सवरेचितपाके रवेचितपाके सवरेचितपाके कौवितपाके कौवितपाके 1
पिर्षाचिकानामिपकोपाबः 11911

During the ruling period of Sun located in its own sign, the native gets comforts from his friends and relatives, from agriculture. He gets wealth, fame, education, honour, favour asked for from the government & gain of land. (9)

द्वारावितपाके सवरेचितपाके सवरेचितपाके रवेचितपाके सवरेचितपाके 1
गौपननिमिरबरे कठं शवरेचितपाके कठं शवरेचितपाके रवेचितपाके 119011

During the ruling period of the Sun placed in its sign of bitter enemy (i.c. natural & local), the native loses wealth, wife, son, cattle, friends, father etc. physical trouble & all round enmity with people. (10)

सवरेचितपाके सवरेचितपाके सूत्रिमिरबरे रवेचितपाके सूत्रिमिरबरे 1
नुपाननिमिरबरे रवेचितपाके रवेचितपाके रवेचितपाके 119211

Sun located in an inimical sign makes the native sorrowful, troubled from son, wife, also financially, he gets into danger from the ruler, fire, thieves, querrels, opposition from father during its ruling period. (11)

स्वास्थ्यराशिक्षत सुद्धाराने स्वास्थ्यराशिक्षत पुण्याम् 1
·चक्रे हवाळं स्वास्थ्यन्त्य संगा यानाडिमुख्याबरतामलाम् 112211

Sun located in a friendly sign, gives in its ruling period servants, favour from the government, the father and the son, abode in ones house, association of one's own people, honour, ornaments, clothes, copper etc. (12)

अल्टेट मिर्शभात्त्य मानोदेशाविपाणे हयतिस्थीमेशिति 1
स्वीुस्थ्यान्त्य मनोदेशितासर्या दियानोदेशुख्यानि 112311

During the ruling period of the Sun when it is located in the sign of its bosom friend the native gets much comfort, wife, son, wealth, grains, happiness of mind, conveyance, clothes, & ornaments. (13)

सम्महाग्रहायि रवेद्रशाया सम्मजने : स्वास्थ्यराशिक्षत मानोदेशाविपाणे 1
गोवाचिज्ञानांरे रवेद्रशाया स्वीुस्थ्य वैष्ठ रवेद्रशाया रवेद्रशाया 112811

During the ruling period of the Sun, occupying the sign of a neutral planet, one deals with people of equal status, he gets gain from agriculture, lands, grains, cattle, conveyance, clothes, comforts of the body. But defect in wife & sons & trouble in battle also. (14)

नीच्यानित्यायि रवेद्रशाया नीच्यानुख्याया कुन्याया कुन्याया : 1
·स्वीुस्थ्यानित्यायि पवुस्थ्यानित्यायिनोख्यायरे सम्महोयिति रवेद्रशाया 112911

During the ruling period of the Sun located with a planet, in its sign of debilitation the man earns by unbecoming means. He has bad nails & is of bad character. He gets trouble from wife, son, grains, wealth, cattle, & 'he engages himself in actions that should be avoided. (15)

उच्चानित्यायि रवेद्रशाया मनोदेशितायात लमते स्वीुस्थ्याया 1
तीयानित्यायक हरिकीटनं बः प्रकाररुपायिनोख्यायात शास्त्रम् 112511

During the ruling period of the Sun located in its sign of exaltation, the native achieves the object of his desire through his profession, he has sacred baths in holy places, sings praise of the Lord & engages himself in the service of the public through the renovation of the temples etc. (16)

पायानित्यायि सुद्धाराने नित्य मन : विलाह्यात्त्य रवेद्रशाया 1
कुन्यायाने कुन्यायत्त्यायाने कुन्यायालुख्याया स्वीुस्थ्याया 112911

During the ruling period of the Sun located with a malefic planet, the mind of the native is always worried for having to part with his money. He takes had food & wears bad clothes, he gets his wealth reduced much as a result of his immoral behaviour.
(17)

दिनाचिन्तस्य शुमारितस्य पाके सूज शुमिरिनाचिन्तस्य 1
इस्तेविलास स्ववंजने : सर्माएः कक्षयावाण्यालः विन्देवागीश्य 112511

During the ruling period of Sun located with a natural benefic planet the native gets happiness, land, wealth, clothes, happy associations with friends & his own people. (18)

करोति भावु : शुमारितस्य रस्तियाप्रथम : स्रीसुबतवागीश्य 1
काटिप्रताप रस्तिकेलिसोखे पिरो : सूज शुमिरिनागीने भ 112911

During the ruling period of Sun when it is aspected by a beneficial planet, the native gets education, fame, wife, son, good speech, a lustrous body, influence over others, enjoyment of amorous & playful acts, help from father & honour from the government.
(19)

पापेडितस्यापि सहस्मानानेद्रापितस्यापке परम तु सूज 1
पिरो विन्देवागीने सूजवाण्यालः कोरीआन्नुपालउत्तर कुशलस्य 112011

During the ruling period of the Sun when it is aspected by malefic planets, the native gets much sorrows, destruction of father, trouble to son & wife & suffering & loss of position at the hands of thieves, ruler & fire. (20)

केन्द्रितस्यापि दिवाकरस्य वस्त्रियापके सूजदेवमुस्य 1
श्यानंचुटित बछुवियापोमोठि भग : कुशलस्यिपरिमेम भ 112811

During the ruling period of the Sun, when, it is located in kendra, one gets severe punishment at the hands of the king (i.e. the government), loss of position, separation from friends, loss in agriculture, & roaming. (21)

सिकोगसुबतवेद्रापितस्यापे सूजस्यम राजिवामनेन भ 1
सूजयाविद्रापितने नियन पिरुषस्य कम्मादिवेद्रापित काले 11292

During the ruling period of the Sun located in a trinal house, the native gets confusion of mind, defame from government, loss of comforts, & father, frustration in actions. (22)

उच्चार्थक्षय भ द्व्या दिवाकरस्य वस्त्रियापके सूजदेवमुस्य 1
नानारिनोदलितर रतिकेलिसोखे स्वी वस्त्रलाममनिन्य पिरुषणान्श्य 112311

The ruling period of Sun when it is located in the Navamsha of its sign of exaltation (Aries), gives to the native means of livelihood, constant personal influence, much wealth, many pleasure giving recreations, wife, robes, income by day and night; & the destruction of the paternal side. (23)

नीच्चारुतक्ष्य रवेद्धाया मानोपृथ्यानिवेद्धायन् 1
लयतों जनेशुतों कुलितरणू मनोपृथ्यानेशुतों जबरसेहोरोगम् 112811

During the ruling period of Sun located in its sign of debilitation, the native gets loss of wife, wealth, lands. He has to travel abroad. He is forsaken by his friends and relatives. He has bad conduct, mental misbehaviour, fever, & urinal trouble. (24)

आदे रुप्रदेशाया रुप्रदेश पिवूरोगक्ष्यदेशायि : 1
मध्ये पिवूरोगहानिश्चानेशुतों पिव्या मध्येशोरोगम् 112911

During the 1st one third part of the ruling period of Sun, the native gets sorrow. He has consumption in his body due to contact with his father. In the middle portion of the ruling period the native has loss of wealth & cattle, but at the end he gets education & high status. (25)

द्रष्टिपाके चन्द्रानिमेठि फख्तिप्रमानोरोगi रुप्रदेशायाम् 1
गुलमस्योरोगम् पविस रोग मुर्याइदक्ष्य लयभ या प्रमेड़म् 112511

During the ruling period of Sun located in the 6th house, the native gets colic pains, trouble in passing urine or even diabeties. (26)

रन्स्स्यमानोरोगi या द्रष्टायाम् देखस्य कक्ष लयभ वानिन्मीतरणु 1
चातुरिके नेविकारकास जवरातिसार लयपदस्यतरणु च 112911

During the ruling period of Sun in the 8th house, there is trouble to the body or trouble from fire, intermitant fever, trouble to eyes, cough or asthma, loose motions, & fall from position or office. (27)

During the ruling period of the Sun occupying the 2nd house, there is both the acquisition of & trouble to son, sorrow, separation from friends & relatives, sorrow & clashes, spoilt speech, anger, loss of wife, & wealth, fear from the government, loss of lands, sons, conveyances, robes, & other articles. In case Sun has benefic influence on it these adverse results do not take place. (29)

नृपमान नमप्राशित शाळूरेरिवितस्य 113011

During the ruling period of Sun located in the 4th house, there is loss of land, enjoyments, wealth, servants, wife, fall from the position held, fall from a vehicle, & danger from thieves, poison, & fire. (31)

The results of a ruling period should be declared by taking into account all objects etc that are relevant to the planet in the chapter of definitions & in that dealing with profession, as also by the thing relating to the house involved, the aspect falling on it, or the yoga made with it. (35)

तत्याके ध्याननबलाखिके लमते सवोपकारे महाकीणित मृघपित्रमस्तित तीद्धिमित्रके महव 112911

When the Sun is strong by possessing the strength arising out of the place (see shloka 99 to 100 of chapter 1) it gives in its ruling period agricultural wealth, cows, land, conveyance, clothes, comforts, honour from the government, wealth from others, lustre of the body. In the ruling period of the Sun one gets articles for sleep (good bed etc) and clothes. One also engages himself in the great service of others, & dips in the sacred waters accompanied by fame, ornaments, & the acquisition of good friends & relatives. (36)

krūraदियपूर्णपूर्णइदियान सर्वपूर्णपूर्णति बा नुपस्थचोमाटिनम. 1

## MAIN RULING PERIOD OF MOON

He gets mental derangement, clash with his own people, indebtedness due to immoral acts. (14)

## TRANSLATOR'S NOTE

When a planet is dispositor of malefic planets it acts as a malefic planet in its ruling or subperiod. The point would be clear from the following horoscope of the translator. Even though both Venus

and Moon are watery planets, the face of the translator caught fire from an inflammable material on 12-1-1925 when he was having the main ruling period of Venus and the sub ruling period of Moon.

283

---

The reason must be looked for in the fact that Moon is the dispositor of 3 firy planets viz Sun, Mars & Mercury & by aspecting Taurus (face) it threw the fire on the face & on Venus the main period lord who is always influenced by the sub period lord.

चर्चश्यातयायवो नरपतिस्तनान कीटेसोख्य च 1

In the earlier part of the ruling period of Moon the native gets honour from the ruler, fame & comforts, and in the middle portion loss of wife & son. He gets comforts of home, wealth & clothes in the last portion. (27)

During the ruling period of Moon occupying the 6th house, the native gets trouble, querrels, separation from desired objects, fear from thieves, fire & the ruler & trouble from water & has urinal trouble & loss of wealth. (28)

विवोगमन सककोलिरेगापिड सूपयम नमवस्तनसूपयम 112911

During the ruling period of Moon situated in the 8th house, the native gets emaciated, body trouble & fear from water (drowning etc) foreign travel, & trouble to mother etc. (29)

रिफकानवर्द्धनाया संपादों मुतिनाशन कुछते 1
रज्ञौनत्तनमाये च्याननिनाशन महत्वरे रूख 113011

During the ruling period of Moon occupying the 12th house, the native loses his job, being proved untrue by government, loss of wealth, luck, position & gets much sorrow. (30)

कर्मस्थ वितलिततपाककाने वितामज स्टीपुष्ठमोगमायम 1

During the ruling period of moon located in the 2nd house, one gets wealth, sons, wife, comforts, enjoyment of good dishes, good luck, gain of income & dip in the holy waters. (31)

During the ruling period of Moon occupying the 3rd house, the native gets much comfort & much wealth, firmness of mind & comfort from brothers etc, agriculture, good drinks and dishes, clothes & ornaments. (32)

During the ruling period of Moon occupying the 11th house, the native gets income of different kinds, good food & drinks, clothes, recreation & play, wife, son, & happiness of mind. (33)

दिनेश्यशातवर्द्धनायपितशोध प्रानोते रूख स्टीपुष्ठमायम 1
भावजनादिवाहसोध भीतिनुपानिन चोरेमुष्ठमितशोध स्टीपुष्ठमायम 113811

During the ruling period of Moon eclipsed by the Sun, the native gets trouble, opposition from his own people, loss of wife, fear from the ruler, fire & thieves, separation from mother & loss of agriculture & grains. (34)

चर्द च्याननपनायपितशोध कुण्यनपनानेरकृपुष्ठमायम नुपयनपनानेरकृपुष्ठमायम 1
च्याननपनायपितशोध कुण्यनपनानेरकृपुष्ठमायम गोविक्रय सेवन मिथ्यनपनानेरकृपुष्ठमायम फलुट
च्याननपनायपितशोध सेवन मिथ्यनपनानेरकृपुष्ठमायम फलुट
During the ruling period of Moon when it has much "Sathan" strength the native gets wealth, comforts, fame, education, service of Devatas & Brahmins, wealth from the ruler, & lands & wealth. He also gets wife, jewels, clothes, ornaments, agricultural wealth, sale of cows, service, sweets & tonics, fruits & also curd, ghee, scents and clothes. (35)

निष्कारे कयानवरोन हीने कयानवरोन स्वप्रद्रुति च 1
स्वबंधनुलाग तथ्य बा विवृद्धि कुणेशिनाग समुप्ति काले 113511

During the ruling period of Moon devoid of "Sthan" strength,

friends and relatives, or their separation, & loss of agriculture.

निष्कारे विवृद्धि स्वप्रद्रुति सिम्निष्कारतरावागतव्यस्वप्रद्रुति च 113911

During the ruling period of Moon endowed with "Directional

सिम्निष्कारे नखकेशदतरममहिंसच च 113511

During the ruling period of Moon endowed with "Kaal"

अयनतरे बाडनेष्ठलाईम नुयालपुण्य बुळवाहने च 113911

चन्द्रे यदा विवृद्धि स्वप्रद्रुति सॉखमहिंसच : कुणाकतार्जग नरेशदर्सच 1
समस्तमागय स्वप्रद्रुति सॉखमहिंसच परोपकारे च मनोमिलागय 118011

During the ruling period of Moon endowed with "Directional"

During the ruling period of Moon located in "Mridu" amsha, the native gets many sons, also gains servants, wealth, victory, happiness, fame, & education. (42)

पार्वताच्यासमिति चर्दर्य दौरे मध्टी च कीति च
विश्लेषनों दौरे सूख्य देवाच्यासमिति को 118311

During the ruling period of Moon located in "Paravat" amsha, the native gets much fame, educational recreation, comforts, worship of diety, & bath in the holy waters. (43)

कृष्णेदेकागसमिति शर्दर्य दिशाति रोमिताम् 1
कारे पार्वतसमिति गोर्डाच्यासमिति को 118811

During the ruling period of Moon occupying a malefic decantc, the native gets disease, sinful deeds, oppression by the native of cow and Brahmins. (44)

जाने मायफले प्रोत्त स्थाननवन्न तब : परस् 1
अर्थानवनवन्न प्रभावदेहस्तानवन्न तब्य 118411

Moon in its ruling period gives results relating to the house, which it occupies, the results relating to the sign occupied by it & last of all the results arising out of the particular Navamsha occupied by it & also the results arising out of the influence of other planets on Moon. (45)

CHAPTER-14
MARS

अर्थुल्यमुन्दनवाधकाजे देशायलाम समरे बये च 1
आतिष्कयमन्त्रीत नरेशमाने सहदर्शरसीपूर्णायलाम 11211

During the ruling period of Mars located in its highest degree of exaltation, the native gets lands, wealth, victory in battle. much honour from the government, also comforts of brothers, wife, son. & enjoyment of speech. (1)

उत्तलगतम् च देशायलामें कुछस्थ प्राणोति राजयलामें डिरिपाचवितम् 1
मुस्यवारसुतस्थमागम् च यानाविरोहाविशेषवितम् 11211

During the ruling period of Mars located in its sign of exaltation, the native gets ruling powers or wealth from government, inflow of lands, wife, son, relatives and friends, honour, special conveyance, & foreign travel. (2)

आतोखिति मुस्यवारसुतस्थमागम् देशा तनोति नरेशवारसुतस्थमागम् 1
प्रयानता येयमनोतिलागम् माययमतर गौगजवारसुतस्थमागम् 11311

During the ruling period of Mars located in the sign previous to that of its exaltation, the native gets comforts, favour from government, getting into prominence, he gets patience, cherished object, rise in prospects & gets cattle such as cows, elephants & horses. (3)

धरायलगतम्ायवरोह काले स्थानायलामें कलिकोपुरुण्ठः 1
विरेषवारसुतस्थमागम् स्थजनोवरोह चोराइनुण्ठः कल्षण 11811

During the ruling period of Mars occupying a sign previous to its sign of debilitation, there is loss of property, wealth, rift, anger and sorrow, abode in a foreign land, opposition to one's own people, & fear & trouble from thieves, fire & the ruler. (4)

नीविष्कयमतयापि धरायलगतम् बाये कुछस्थया स्थजनायद्या 1
कुछस्थयने गौगजवारसुतस्थमागम् स्थजनोवरोह : 11911

During the ruling period of Mars located in its sign of debilitation (Cancer) the native protects his people by bad means, takes bad food, there is loss to him of cattle, such as cows, & horses, loss of relatives & losses through the ruler, thieves and fire. (5)

---

मुल्लिरिकोपाइसित मोमरवाये मिड्रान्पनानकरमुल्लाइसित 1
पूर्णाधिमस्सनः मनोजं भाषाहिसोच्छ कुविलामस्सत 11611

During the ruling period of Mars occupying its Mooltrikon (positive) sign, the native gets sweets, good drinks & dishes, clothes, ornaments, hearing of Sacred Texts from Puranas etc, comfort to & from brothers etc & agricultural gains. (6)

श्रद्धेष्ठास्थायी धराउत्तर्य द्यारिवायके लामतेपुर्मिमित 1
श्रद्धेष्ठास्थायी सुखवाहनं ब नामद्रय भाषाउत्तर्य सुखवाहनं 11911

During the ruling period of Mars located in its own sign, the native gets property, wealth, position, comforts & conveyance. He also gets fame or titles, comfort to & from brothers & general happiness. (7)

धराउत्तर्याप्रतिśरुराही गतस्थ वाये कलहारिवुरुरुह 1
नरेशकोपे सवजनेवरोह सुखवाहनेवरोह 11511

During the ruling period of Mars occupying the sign of its bitterest enemy, the native gets clashes, sorrow, wrath of government; opposition from his own people, losses of property, wealth, wife, son, friends & gets disease too. (8)

मुन्दनस्थायीरितिśरुराही द्यारिवायके समरें ब पीडास्थ 1
श्रद्धेष्ठास्थायीसंस्थायीसंस्थायी : प्रमाणे पीडास्थायीसंस्थायीसंस्थायी 11911

During the ruling period of Mars occupying an inimical sign, the native gets trouble in the battle field, sorrow, trouble from fire, ruler & poison. He suffers through urinary troubles & disease of the rectum. (9)

मिर्षणजस्थायी कुविलामस्सत वाये मिर्षणजस्थायीत सपतनस्थइं : 1
चौरानिमध्याविद्विपद्मिमित कुविलामस्सत कलिकोपे वाये 112011

During the ruling period of Mars occupying the sign of its friend, the native gets friendship even with his enemies. But has trouble from thieves, fire, disease of the eyes, loss of lands & agriculture, also meets rift, wrath & sorrow. (10)

वस्तविद्याविद्विपद्मिमित देशातरलजमास्सत 112211

During the ruling period of Mars occupying the sign of its bosom friend, the native gets lands from the government, gets clothes & initiation into acts of religious charity & marriage. He also gets his prospects boosted from abroad. (11)

---

During the ruling period of Mars placed in a neutral sign, the native is unable to carry out repairs to his house through want of wealth. He gets enmity from wife, son, servants, & brothers.
(12)

नीचर्थेगारिस मनिवत्तय धराउत्तयाटिनोविकारण 1
पर्यत्वत्तयिति परकीयमनं हरी०७७नां नुपहानिनोरे : 112511

During the ruling period of Mars situated with a planet in debilitation, the native gets his mind spoilt, he has to take to service, & take food offered by others. He meets loss through wife, son, ruler, fire & thieves. (13)

किचर्थैलुख मोजनवस्त्रपानं कृष्णगा वूटि नुपहाननं बच 1
उस्त्रपानटेनापानं समनिवत्तय मोजनवस्त्रपानं बचे सुत्रवारपीड़ 112811

During the ruling period of Mars located with an exalted planet, the native gets a little comfort of drinking and eating, clothes. He makes his both ends meet with difficulty, & also gets help from the ruler with difficulty & there is loss of son, & wife & sorrow.

पापाईवत्तयापानं कृष्णगा वूटि नुपहाननं कमाझी करोति निल्यम 1
देविद्वानं बच सहभदरगां कृष्णगां हयापकारणं बच 112911

During the ruling period of Mars associated with a malefic planet, the native always engages himself in sinful deeds. He harms the interests of Gods, Brahmins, brothers, through his immoral earnings. (15)

शुमानिवत्तयापानं कृष्णगा वूटि किचर्थैलुख देहकुशारोगाम 1
पुरोदिवारं समरें जयं बच विषा विवारं परदेशायसम 112511

During the ruling period of Mars located with a benefic planet one gets small physical comfort, the body becomes emaciated through disease. There is clash with rulers & success in battle. There is unnecessary discussions of intellectual topics & travel to a foreign land. (16)

शुमानिवत्तयापानं पुरोदिवारं समरें जयं बच विषा विवारं परदेशायसम 112911

During the ruling period of Mars under aspect of malefics the native has loss of lands and wealth; but if Mars is in gochar position (technically a condition of strength in many directions) the period is very nice. (17)

## TRANSLATOR'S NOTES

It seems the word, शुल्क has been used in this shloka instead of "अगुल्क" for the results for शुल्क effect have already been stated in the previous shloka. We have therefore given the results arising out of malefic aspect on Mars.

(2) The word गोचर (Gochar) used in the shloka has not been used in any sense of transit. A Gochar planet is one which is strong & well aspected & without any bad influence. "Agochar" is one which is weak, badly influenced, without any good influence etc.

भारतीय पाण्षरवीदित्सय प्राटों द्वारा बड़ुल्क खक्कस्थ।
जन : परिवत्तकल्लामर्शा वेशातर्षय : धिपतिपालकोपापब 119511

During the ruling period of Mars aspected by malefic planet, the native gets much sorrow & trouble. He is forsaken by people, his wife & friends, & he has to live in another territory as a result of wrath of the ruler. (18)

केद्रतमोमबाये चौरिष्ठान्यमुपोपि दूःचाति।

During the ruling period of Mars occupying a kendra, the native suffers from thieves, poison; he gets into clashes with others and gets loss of peace of mind & has to travel to another country. (19)

दूःचाति राष्ट्रिष्ठपत्त बोमबाये स्थान चौरिष्ठ बड़ुल्किर्ष्ठपत्त च।
चौरिष्ठिन्याओं नुपरे : सक्षारद्विपत्त परे दूःचाति प्राटों 112011

अगुल्कर्षयस्थ व ताड़ुझों तदन्तया चेत्रलमन्ययस्थ 112211

कमीशितः स्थानिः दूरिष्ठ पाण्षर बोमबाये कमीशितःकलहर्षयपोपि दूरिष्ठ।
उच्चोगणन तदन्तिपदेशिति विचारमुप्रत्यानमानधानिशिति 112211

राज्याच्चुति विपष्टायोगतर यातिर 112311

स्वकृतलाद्यले बामते नुपुणतिरतम् मुखादिरोगं च 112811

शाळस्थानागतरस सौखपफवे भुनदनोसRातिरह चेये विरोहायोगतरसहजे :
सर्वो नुपुणतुण्ठाम् 1
बुद्धस्थानागतरस बुद्धस्थान जाड़णतो श्रुदेशस्थानागतरस भुनदनोसूण्ठाम् 112911

During the ruling period of Mars located in the 3rd house, the native gets happiness. The native gets rid of enemies. The native has patience, wealth, sons, wife, brothers, respect from the ruler. If Mars occupies the 5th house, it indicates death of the son, confusion of intellect, foolishness & if it is in inimical sign the native gets trouble from property & brothers and severe disease.

पनमस्थानसरुणवेवस : 'कीतिरिवेकलाम् 1
नेसरोगं तस्यनाशं ध्यातिरहमेम् वा 112511

During the ruling period of Mars located in the 5th house, it gives fame, & the power of discrimination, also trouble in the eyes, loss of wealth & rifts. (26)
मर्गपदस्थान चेये : करोटि बुद्धं भुनदनम् पाके 1
श्रुदेशस्थानसरुणवेवस ध्यातिरहमेम् वा 112911

During the ruling period of Mars located in the 8th house, there is much sorrow & fear, the native suffers from boils, small pox etc, there is distaste for food, loss of property & foreign travel. (27)

## TRANSLATOR'S NOTE

Although foreign travel has been associated by the authors with many other houses including the 8th, we are of the opinion that the

---

8th house, related as it is to water (seas) & troublesome affairs, is more intimately connected with foreign travel, which takes place during the main & sub period of malefics influencing it.

नवम्बस्थायरायुनोदेशापाक : पदचुतिति 1
गुणखंडा च तया कक्ष तपोविचन महुदम्यम् 112511

आयस्थायरायुनोदेशापाक : करोति राज्यायरायुनोदेशापाक 1
