लयवतायरायुनोदेशापाक प्रावो धनहुतिति नुपादमीतिति 1
ल्यानसुतवारनाश्री धागुपकार मनोजबं कीतिति 113011

During the ruling period of Mars located in the 11th house, the native meets with financial losses, fear from the ruler, loss of property, son, wife & brothers & abode in another land. (30)

उच्चवायरायुनोदेशापाक मनोजबं विचय सुछ च 1
प्रचलदवारसीगमन नुपस्थि प्रचलनती याति सुछमकोतिति 113211

During the ruling period of Mars occupying the Navamsha of its sign of exaltation, the native gets the fulfilment of his desires, victory over others, happiness, cohabitation with a maid servant, high position under government & gains fame & good actions. (31)

नीचवायरायुनोदेशापाक नीचवुतिति कमबेकफ़म् 1
धनहानिसुतवारस्त : शिखनसुतवारस्तोःS्थील : 113211

During the ruling period of Mars located in the Navamsha of its sign of debilitation, there is detrioration in the qualities of one's karmas, loss of wealth; punishment from the government. The man becomes characterless & engaged in selfish earnings. (32)

मोबवायरायुनामांवो लामते विचयायरायुनामांवो च 1
मध्यवायरायुनामांवो तर विचयायरायुनामांवो 113211

During the earlier part of the ruling period of Mars, one gets loss of wealth in various ways & loss of honour. In the middle period there is fear from the ruler, fire & thieves. (33)

---

In the last portion of the ruling period of Mars there is separation from brothers and trouble from son, wife, fire, colic pains, urinal troubles. This will be particularly so if Mars is not in Gochar (excellence) (see shloka 17). (34)

मोमर्श संस्कारन्ततािन्तरय द्वारािपाणेकल्लस्थान्तरय

स्यानादिलाम सुक्षकीदिर्घोपोगिस्ति तबन्यापूर्वति 112911

During the ruling period of Mars endowed with "Sthan" strength, the native is happy with wealth, wife. He gets property, happiness, fame & bravery, success in undertakings through his moral actions. (35)

स्यानादिलाम सुक्षकीदिर्घोपोगिस्ति तबन्यापूर्वति

कुज : कुस्तिदिर्घोपोगिस्ति च करोटि शुव्यापूर्वति 112511

Mars devoid of "Sthan" strength gives fall from position, in its ruling period & gives livelihood through transactions of interest on money. (36)

दिवाविपूर्णतय कुजस्ति धाये नुपातुल्लस्थान्तरय।

गौमुलितयावर्णनालम दिवाविपूर्णतय : प्रतापम 112911

Mars endowed with "Directional" strength, gives in his ruling period much wealth from the ruler, prowess in battle, gain of cows, lands, gold, clothes, conveyance, wide spread fame & influence. (37)

कालविपूर्णतय गौमुलितयावर्णनालम काम्यलिखितयावर्णनालम शुव्यापूर्वति।

पढ़वस्तमितयावर्णनालम निर्वस्तस्तकुलिगोपोगलम 112511

During the ruling period of Mars endowed with "Kaal" strength, the native gets the object of his desire, is very happy, gains silky clothes, jewels, pearls, beautiful clothes, & gain of agriculture, cattle horses etc. (38)

निस्तविपूर्णतय मोमर्श कुजाकたार्थ गौमुलितयावर्णनालम।

समस्ततभागावर्णनालम गौमुलितयावर्णनालम 112911

During the ruling period of Mars endowed with "Natural" strength, the native gets his prospects boosted by the favour of the government. He gets sons, friends, relatives, cows, property, favour from the ruler, clothes, & good health. (39)

निस्तविपूर्णतय मोमर्श पिताचिके कुलिस्तभागावर्णन च।

कुजस्तय वाये कुनन्ती पिताचन्त : सहभारणामिति देहपूर्णा 118011

---

During the ruling period of Mars possessing natural strength, the native gets loss of wealth, & eyes. He suffers from excess of heat, bad food. He has bad nails, loses his father. There is also trouble to brothers. (40)

वर्षानिततस्य मोमस्य द्रभाकाले महड़मयम् 1
चौरागिनस्पीपि च वन्यास पवंछव्यतिम 118211

During the ruling period of Mars in retrogression, there is much fear & trouble from thieves, fire, & serpents. One may go to live in jungle and there is also fall from the position held by the native. (41)

दिववियुणतस्य कुजस्य बाये कुपाकक्टारेगा महड़मयम् 1
समस्त मायपासमजिमिस्तय गोमस्यमयमनरेदशोधम् 118211

During the ruling period of Mars endowed with "directional" strength, there is much favour from government. The native gets sons, friends, relatives, cows, land, clothes, ornaments & good health. (42)

स्रूपण्यप्रशास्यप्रणुतस्य मोमस्यप्रतिपीहनम् 1
कारेगुणस्तयथेगा च समस्त विमवयम् 118211

During the ruling period of Mars when it is situated in a malefic Shasti amsha, the native gets much trouble, imprisonment & loss of all wealth & influence. (43)

सोमस्यप्रशास्यप्रतिपीहनम् 1
मुम्ययप्रशास्यप्रतिपीहनम् 118211

During the ruling period of Mars located in a benefic Shashti amsha, the native gets much happiness. He gets lands, wealth, wife, conveyance & good dishes to eat. (44)

परावतातिस्यप्रशास्यप्रतिपीहनम् शुम् मवेब 1
विवाहदीशायस्तय च सवेवपुणकारकम् 118211

During the ruling period of Mars located in "Paravat" amsha, there is happiness, marriage, initiation, yagya, & service of all. (45)

स्रूपरेकागस्यप्रशास्यप्रतिपीहनम् मनोश्यय 1
निगात विमवीति च पाश्रभयनमेव च 118211

During the ruling period of Mars located in a malefic decante, the native has mental anxiety, fear from being strangled, poisoned or imprisoned. (46)

---

During the ruling period of Mars when it is in its sign of exaltation but in the Navamsha of its sign of debilitation, the native gets death of his brothers & trouble from the ruler. fire & poison.
(47)

मुझिमुझोसी नौचस्य : श्रेष्ठमाणस्यसित् : 1
तत्याके मुझिवारायपूर्णमिरिवारन् 118511

When Mars is in its sign of debilitation but occupies the Navamsha of its sign of exaltation, Mars in its ruling period gives expansion in all directions, sons, lands, wife, wealth, & friends
(49)

During the ruling period of Mercury when it is in the sign prior to that of debilitation, the native suffers much. One is devoid of discretion, has affairs with other women, and undergoes trouble through the ruler, fire and thieves. (4)

नीवस्त्र चन्द्रमलेखण्यकाळे जानेन हिंन स्वभागनेविषुतम् 1

पब्धुति बंधुविषुतम् च विदेशायन वन्नवासुत:च �11911

During the ruling period of Mercury located in its sign of debilitation, the native is without power of discrimination, is separated from one’s relatives, falls from the position held, gets opposition from relatives, goes abroad, & gets trouble by going to jungle and living there. (5)

мульτιरिकोणानितरोप्यवये राज्य महत्वोप्यकरं च कीतिम्;
विधायिलास निगमाटिशिले पृथ्वायम्यवयादिवुत: 11611

During the ruling period of Mercury located in its Mool trikon (positive) sign, the native gets ruling powers, much comfort, fame, enjoyment of literature, study of spiritual Shastras & getting pure by hearing religious discourses from Puranas. (6)

स्वभासेस्थयापि श्रह्यकृष्टो : प्राप्तो चन्द्रायन चन्द्रायनस्थयपि
यागिज्ञोपोम्यविषुतम् वर्णनवासुतम्यपि: 11911

During the ruling period of Mercury located in its own sign, the native gets wealth, grains etc, prosperity in trade, cows, lands, son, wife, nice food & drinks & ornaments. (7)

श्रह्यकृष्टोपोम्यविषुतम् पृथ्वायम्यविषुतम्
विधायिलास कुलहिनस्थयपि कुम्यजन वर्णनवासुतम् 11411

During the ruling period of Mercury located in its inimical sign, the native is in fear of the enemy & that of the ruler, he is devoid of education, does service acts unbecoming his family, eats bad food, & there is loss of son, wealth and wife, (8)

श्रह्यकृष्टोपोम्यविषुतम् गतस्थय पाके विपदें च रुणह: 1
उच्चमंगा चन्द्रनेविषुतम् यजादिविषुतम् श्रह्यकृष्टोपोम्यविषुतम् 11911

During the ruling period of Mercury located in the sign of its bitter enemy, there is danger & trouble allround frustration in undertakings, opposition from relatives, obstacle in acts of charity, & destruction of good actions. (9)

---

मिस्रेनरशाया ध्याकृकस्नोचनायत : सोखम् 1
नामद्वषस्मायित स्वनामायित गणपथायि 119011

During the ruling period of Mercury located in a friendly sign,
the native gets income & comforts, honour or titles, fame through
writings. (10)

अतिमिराशिगणय ध्याँ पणनोमहवत्ता याति 1
मुपति मेरे सोखम् चननुतबराशचवंचस्मायि 119211

During the ruling period of Mercury located in the sign of its
bosom friend, the native rises in estimation of others, gets
friendship of the ruler, comforts of wealth, sons, wife, & respect
from relatives. (11)

सम्मध्यायायि ध्याकृकस्नोचनायत सुखम् धानयुतबराशि 1
करोटि राज्यचुतबराशि विशन विज्ञानहीं पिडकाविरोगम् 119211

During the ruling period of Mercury located in a neutral sign,
the native gets comforts, grains, clothes. Also there is loss of political power, obstacles, one is devoid of wisdom & gets small pox
etc. (12)

नौच्छेनरशुतसोखम् सोखमवायोटिकतलाम् 1
पणम् बंधुनाया कमनाया मनोद्वशम् 119211

During the ruling period of Mercury located with a planet who
is in its sign of debilitation, the native undergoes much trouble. He
loses position, has loss of relatives, & that of karma. He gets disease of the mind. (13)

उन्नभेनरशुतसोखम् सोखमवायोटिकतलाम् 1
मांगोतर सुखमिया च वातिज्ञ गौकुविकिया : 119811

During the ruling period of Mercury located with an exalted
planet, the native gets much comfort, rise in prospects, & in education, & trade, & affairs relating to cattle and agriculture. (14)

विद : पापानिस्तस्यायि धाय पापमुतबराशि च 1
बेस्थानिस्तस्यायि कुखियोमुतबराशि 119211

During the ruling period of Mercury located with a malefic
planet, the native is involved in sin & there is loss of land, wealth,
wife, son, agriculture, cattle etc. (15)

विद : सोखमुतबराशि परियाके मनोद्वशम् 1
राज्ययोन सुखम कोटि धारुनुतबराशम् 119211

During the ruling period of Mercury located with a benefic
planet the native enjoys much pleasure, he gets power and affluencce, comforts, fame, wife, son & favour from the ruler. (16)

---

During the ruling period of Mercury aspected by a benefic planet, the native gets great fame. He gets honour from the government as a result of his educational qualifications & influence accompanied with good name. (17)

पार्शितलेस्यावि श्रेष्ठक सूनोचन्द्रयं बछुजनोचन्द्रयं |
विदेशानं स्वरद्धतुली च प्रश्नानुल्या कलहोर कृष्णम् 112411

During the ruling period of Mercury who is aspected by malefic planets, the native gets his grains destroyed, has separation from his relatives, travels abroad, falls from the position held by him. He has to serve for a living, is engaged in querrels & has disease. (18)

केडेटलेस्यावि हि द्व्रा श्रेष्ठनद्रयं मुपालमिश्रणनथान्यकलहोर कृष्णम् 112411

व्यादिकमनुल्यानयः : प्रश्निकमनुल्यानयः नद्रयः मुपालमिश्रणनथान्यकलहोर मागयम् 112011

During the ruling period of Mercury located in kendra, the native develops friendship with the ruler, gets wealth and grains, wife, sons and does acts of public service, gets honour from the government, fame, good wholesome food and drinks, comforts of sleep, clothes, & ornaments. (19)

लानन गतरस्य च द्व्रा श्रेष्ठनद्रयं मुपालमिश्रणनथान्यकलहोर मागयम् 112011

भर्तियादिकमनुल्यानयः तीश्रयादिकमनुल्यानयः या अगाति प्रश्निदिम् 112011

During the ruling period of Mercury located in the Ascendant, the native gets honour from the ruler, income from agriculture, luck, conveyance fitted with musical instruments like Bheri. (20)

चित्रगसोमस्यावि चित्रापारित महद्रकारित च 1
मुपालमिश्रणनयः राजस्याने प्रश्ननत्र याति 112211

During the ruling period of Mercury located in the 2nd house, there is the acquisition of education & much fame, honour from government & prominence under government. (21)

तृतीयादिकमनुल्यानयः चद्रयादिकमनुल्यानयः अधत्र समेखित 1
उद्राणमा जीवन गुलमरेगमनातियोगे नुपमानने च 112211

During the ruling period of Mercury located in the 3rd house, one gets a confused mind. He engages himself in music, gets trouble in intestines, trouble from food & gets honour from the ruler. (22)

one becomes equal in status to a king, he gets comforts, writes under his name verse and prose & gains wife, son and wealth.

प्रयुक्तन देवमतीयुक्तागा सामाजिकलाम अन्ननायकलम 1
काविस्तरमागा समुप्ति काले यजादिविष्टा स्वच्छन्निश्रेष्ठाबल 113011

During the ruling period of Mercury located in the 10th house, the native worships the Diety & the Brahmins, gets ruling powers, name in the public, adopts a course of writing poetry, he is particularly engaged in religious acts such as the yagyas, initiation & doing good to his relatives. (30)
उपाध्यारिशिष्टतसोमदये तवनेक्षा वितरमुप्ति काले 1
धानेन वा मुप्तिमाननादा कृष्णश्रेष्ठ वागिज़्यिविष्टाबले या 113211

During the ruling period of Mercury located in the 11th house, the native gets wealth from many sources, gets money of charity or as a result of honour by the king or through agriculture, trade or by intellectual pursuits. (31)
उद्भाषासंतुतशाखाकृष्णनेष्टाशिष्टे सूतरमुप्ताविष्ट 1
मनोविष्टाबले मदनामिराममुप्तसाहिष्टे च अलामिराममुप्त 113211

During the ruling period of Mercury located in the Navamsha of his sign of exaltation, the native gets son & ornaments, happiness of mind, amorous pleasures, zeal, patience & bathing in sacred waters. (32)
नीच्छाख्यकृष्ट : सौम्यो नीच्छयलायनुष्ठिनम् 1
प्रयुक्तस परिहार च द्वारायो च करोडित तव 113211

During the ruling period of Mercury located in the Navamsha of its sign of debilitation, the native engages in carning by unfair means, gets in service, suffers from compulsion forced by others. (33)
सौम्यद्यायामारो तमरते यन्नायनुष्ठिनम् 1
अर्टेस स्वच्छन्यविष्टाबले मध्ये वागे नरेशसनायनम् 113811

One gets wealth, grains, etc in the earlier part of the ruling period of Mercury. In the last portion, he gets opposition from his relatives. & honour from the ruler in the middle portion of it. (34)
अर्टेससंतुतशाखायामारो तमरते वितरमुप्तसाहिष्टे मनोविष्टाबले मध्ये 113211

During the ruling period of Mercury located with the Sun, one faces troubles of various types, mental worry, opposition from his own people. People speak ill of him & he gets disease in eyes, &
ears. (35)

स्थाननिवीतुले सोम्ये तत्याक : कीतिराजदर :
मनोशेम मनोशेम यज्जित्याच्युम्यरद : 112611

During the ruling period of Mercury when it is endowed with "Sthan" strength, the native gets fame & ruling powers, mental firmness, zeal, & religious acts like yagya initiation etc. (36)

तत्रिहानुले स्थाननिवीतुले सोम्ये तत्याक : कीतिराजदर :
विदेशावास रूप.ख ननापीरिवीतिया : 112911

When Mercury is devoid of "Sthan" strength, there is great danger to property, son, wife. One has to travel abroad, worry & many actions leading to failure or defeat. (37)

विदेशावास तत्रिहानुले सोम्ये तत्याक : रूपीया : 1
सामतराज़िमिर्णे गाणतोष्यरिवीतदर : रूपीया 112511

During the ruling period of Mercury endowed with "directional" strength", the native gets wealth from all directions. He has much wisdom, gets friendship of the ruler & enjoyment of scent & flowers. (38)

CHAPTER—15
## RULING PERIOD OF JUPITER

गुरोदेशाया पण्षेत्रलंगस्थल्य राज्य महत्वसोधपूर्वीत कौटित्र 1
मनोविचारारे गाण्याविचारस्थल्यपूर्वीतके सवकुलायिप्रयोग 11811

During the ruling period of Jupiter located in its highest degree of exaltation, the native gets ruling powers, much happiness & fame, comforts, elephants & horses. honour from the ruler & ruling over ones own people. (1)

कुलीगणस्थल्यपूर्वीत गुरोदेशाया मनोविचारस्थल्यपूर्वीत 1
बिदेशायन महबाळिप्रयोग रूपः : परिक्रिपलनतरुपमुख्य : 11211

During the ruling period of Jupiter located in Cancer, the native gets up in prospects, & is honoured by the government. He goes abroad, & gets ruling powers but is afflicted with sorrow. (2)

## TRANSLATOR'S NOTE

Sorrow would result if Jupiter is afflicted. Jupiter is considered in Astrology as the best of benefics, which no doubt it is. But in actual experience it has sometime, though not always failed to act as the benefic planet. We would like to give an example. Here is the birth chart of a boy from the family of the translator of this work. The native died in his 7th or 8th year of life, inspite of its full 5th aspect on lagna. Jupiter is not only in exaltation but is also in retrogression & therefore, should be considered as strong. Then Moon is full. There must be some reason for short life. We do not subscribe to the view that a planet in exaltation but in retrogression acts as a debilitation planet. Here Jupiter is no doubt weak but not for being in retrogression while in exaltation. The reason lies
in the fact that Jupiter is fully aspected by an extra malefic Saturn.
Saturn aspecting Jupiter was not sufficient to turn Jupiter from a
benefic to a malefic but when you consider the fact that Saturn is
the dispositor of as many as 3 malefics viz Sun, Mars & Mercury
you can at once see the malefic influence of 4 planets on Jupiter.
Jupiter is also fully aspected by the 5th aspect of Rahu who in
doing so throws on Jupiter the extremely malefic influence of
Saturn. You can thus see Jupiter is under not less then 8 malefic
influences. In the circumstances Jupiter is out & out a malefic
planet harming the life prospects by aspecting the lagnal Strange
but true for the reasons stated above Moon the dispositor of the
malefic Jupiter is acting as a malefic planet & harming Mercury,
the lord of the house of longevity. (8th)

आरोहिती वेव्रुरोमहर्षे द्वारा प्रपन्ना कुतरेयपुलिमस 1

गानिकिया स्रीशूतरारपुल्य स्वर्वीयत : प्राप्तयय : प्रतापय 11211

to its sign of exaltation, the native rises in the eyes of the public &
the native gets wealth, lands. He is engaged in musical performances,
gets wife and honour from the ruler. He also gets prowess and
fame through his own power. (3)

During the rulig period of Venus located in the sign of its friend, the native does good to others, gives evidence of his knowing arts, engages in having orchard of "Supari" a hard ingredient of betal & used in its whole form for worship purposes & spends money on worship of diety & on the welfare of humanity. (10)

अर्टिमिन्स भूगोद्धायों धर्में भूगोद्धायी सन्मान सोझ़न ब 1
गोष्ठन ब्रह्मायों सम्मेंत गजपीति सम्मेंत मिर्च़न बोडतायश्रम 112911

During the ruling period of Venus located in the sign of its bosom friend, the native gets honour from the king, comforts, cattle, horses, elephants and lives a clean life. (11)

---

सत्मिगाश्यापि मुगोवियाके प्रमेह गुल्याशिन गुल्यरोग : 1
कितभित्रस्थ मुगोवियाके बचिन चौरे : मय स्वनामीकत गाधपयम 119211

During the ruling period of Venus located in the sign of a neutral planet, the native suffers from diseases like loss of semen, colic pains, disease in eyes, & rectum. But gets some fear from the ruler, fire and thieves. (12)

नीच्छेषणर सृष्टत्र मुगो वैय महदमयम 1
अपवाद कुतं वैय लामते पापकमीम : 119211

During the ruling period of Venus located with a planet in its sign of debilitation, the native gets much trouble, & he gets defame as a result of his sinful deeds. (13)

स्वोच्छेषणित्रन सृष्टत्र मुगोवियाके राज्य महदमयमराइपित्रमेम 1
हमबराराइमीपि मुगपयानलाम मरी मुद्रापयानवरवायचारोग : 119811

During the ruling period of Venus located with a planet in exaltation, the native gets ruling powers, prominence, distinction in battle, & gain of gold, clothes, jewels, ornaments, conveyances, with musical instruments like Bheri. Panwar etc. (14)

पापापित्रयापि मुगोवियाके स्वान्तस्थटि बृहुजनित्रमेम 1
आयारहीन कलहरियत्रटि कुण्यपयमत्रयानवरवायचारोग : 119211

During the ruling period of Venus located with a malefic planet, the native gets fall from the position held, opposition to relatives, characterlessness, likes engaging himself in clash with others, & suffers losses in wealth, agriculture, lands, sons, & wife. (15)

पुण्यापित्रयापि मुगोवियाके सोमायपित्रमेमनवरवायचारोग : 1
नरेशपुण्या गजवाडिस्थठ प्रवालमुगोवियाके सोमायपित्रमेमनवरवायचारोग : 119511

During the ruling period of Venus located with a benefic planet, the native gets good luck, friends, sons, grains, honour from the ruler, many horses and elephants, coral, pearls, rubies, & conveyances. (16)

पापापित्रयापि मुगोवियाके मनायपित्रमेमनवरवायचारोग : 1
सिस्या खिरोय स्वपयमटि बच विरेषयासस्थठ निर्कमपित्रमेमनवरवायचारोग : 119911

During the sub period of Venus aspected by a malefic planet, the native suffers loss of honour, wealth, goes through troubles, opposition from woman, fall from the position held, living abroad & bereft of the duties of his office or position etc. (17)

पुण्यापित्रयापि मुगोवियाके धनारसर मुगोवियाके सुप्रतिपुण्यन बच 1
जनायपित्रया स्वपयमटि कलबरिरिकारीत कलबरिरिकारीत सुप्रतिपुण्यन बच 1

---

During the ruling period of Venus aspected by natural benefies,
the native gets, wealth, clothes, honour from the king, prominence
over people, lustre in the body, & comforts from wife, friends, &
sons. (18)

केन्द्र गतस्य हि वशा मुल्लनस्य यानंचराइमिटी प्रृक्ति, देखकारिटि 1
राज्याय়मुल्लनस्यवाणवस्यशस्ति रूपाइयणनवाणवस्यशस्ति 112911

During the ruling period of Venus, located in a kendra i.e. a cardinal house, the native gets conveyance, clothes, jewels, ornaments & lustre of body. He also gets ruling powers, wealth, lands, agriculture, conveyance, clothes, weapons, visit to forts, jungles & bath in sacred waters. (19)

भागनायुक्षबाधाया सेरायो राजमानन लम्बते 1
मडिगोशनकुल्लाम परापवाद महोल्सायम 112011

During the ruling period of Venus located in the Ascendant, the native gets honour from the government, jewels, cattle wealth, agriculture, great zeal & ill talk about him by others. (20)

बउट्य राजिशित्तत रूकबाधाये राजय महत्तसोझमुल्लन यानम् 1
कुलिक कियाइतपूर्णजना वूपि प्रतापवाद कोईजालम 112211

During the ruling period of Venus located in the 4th house, the native gets ruling powers, much happiness, & honour, agricultural activity, increase of wealth, cattle, & also fame with prowess. (21)

कलसरायित्तत रूकबाधाये ककलसनायय लम्बय या विदेशम् 1
प्रमेहुलमायित्तपूर्णजना प्रमेहुलमायितपूर्णजना 112211

During the ruling period of Venus located in the 7th house, the native loses wife or goes abroad, gets diseases like loss of semen, colic pains, loss of wealth, sons, relatives & ruling powers. (22)

कमस्य रूकबाधाये बख्याइतपूर्णजना विदेशम् 1
माणयोतरे पावित्तपूर्णजना विदेशम् : प्रतापवाद 112211

During the ruling period of Venus located in the 10th house, the native gets education, wealth, honour from the ruler, betterment of prospects, increase in personal charm, & prowess & fame from all directions. (23)
दिसिकोजगात : रूकस्य करोटित नुपयुण्यताम् 1
यजाकमायितलाम च रूकपिसो : रूकस्य यथा : 12811

During the ruling period of Venus located in the 9th house, the native gets honour from the ruler, he engages himself in religious yagyas & actions. There is also happiness & fame to Gurn &
parents. (24)

कीति भ राजपुणा भ सर्वेषपुणकरकम 112911

During the ruling period of Venus located in the 5th house, the native gets son, also fame, honour from the ruler & engages himself in the welfare of all. (25)

वितगढ़कद्धाया यनहानिमाड़नायति चारित 1
अनन्तपुणा वाटिफलासं परोपकार नरेशस्थलमनम 112911

During the ruling period of Venus located in the 2nd house, the native suffers loss of wealth as also gain of wealth. He gets grain, pleasure of speech, does good to others & gets honour from the government. (26)

उत्तरिय राखिय सित्त पुरकवादे घेरे महोत्तरसाधमवीनस्तवम 1
चिस्ताबलेकटवानायति सहवर्गगा बहुमायवालमम 112911

During the ruling period of Venus located in the 3rd house, the native shows much patience, zeal & invincible power. He gets fine clothes, ornaments & conveyance & much furtherence of the prospects of his brothers. (27)

During the ruling period of Venus located in inimical sign, the native gets loss of grains, wealth, sons, & brothers, gets disease, destruction of important underjakings, fear from the enemy, ruler & thieves. (28)

रोग सित्तस्थलपुणांबाइ मुगोविपाके श्रस्तानिनवरोगतिमिनिनवरोग 1

---

During the ruling period of Venus located in the 12th house, the native gains grains, wealth, honour from government, but fall from the position held, lives abroad, is separated from mother & feels happy. (31)

जीवन्तरागतस्य भुगों : चर्चुपुर्मुमिनाश्य कुक्ते 1
कममू निर्णोदिनों दननी कलेशाशितों मनौय़ूः 113211

During the ruling period of Venus located in the sign of Jupiter, the native gets loss of wife, son, lands, constant obstacles in his actions, & experiences, mental worry & trouble to mother. (32)

उच्चारोगातस्य : कममू विक्रमेवरोगातस्य : 113811

During the ruling period of Venus located in the sign Leo, the native gets various troubles, mental worry, frustration in efforts, disease, & he gets constant frustration in his undertakings. (34)

भुगों स्यानबलाशितों नरपते : सन्मानन भुगों विविधापरिषद गोडितरिषद कनममू 1
ततिसिन विक्रमबलाशितों बलुयशा : पुर्षयदारोगरे भुगों कालबलाशितों सुक्षभन कीटि : स्वनामाकिता 113211

During the ruling period of Venus endowed with "Sathan" strength, the native gets honour from the ruler, ornaments, engages himself in discussion of educational subjects, gets titles & name. If Venus is endowed with "Directional" strength, the native gets much fame, sons, wealth, wife & clothes. If it is endowed with "Kaal" strength, the native gets happiness, wealth, fame & name. (35)

निस्तानीयुपुर्मुमिनाश्य भुगोंदरोगे महत्वूः 1
कुक्तेमुमिनाश्यचिताओं धारणिनाश्य महत्वूः 113211

During the ruling period of Venus having "Natural" strength.

---

the native gets much happiness, comforts from agriculture, cattle, lands, wealth, brothers, & mother. (36)

बर्णनात्तस्यापि भुगो : सूत्रस्य द्वाराियापके लवतिराजपुष्यम् 1
मुंदेशरी वृष्टक्षणन विचिरस्यापके राख्यम् 112911

During the ruling period of Venus in retrogression, the native gets much honour from the ruler, & conveyance fitted with musical instruments like Bheri, Mridang; also fine clothes, ornaments & ruling powers. (37)

बृष्टेवियुतस्य भुगोवियुतस्य यजारिकमानी करोईपके काले 1
विचारिविलासश्रहनामरं च नुपाइपके कलेपके विचारश्रहन् 112411

During the ruling period of Venus having "Aspectual" strength i.e. one arising from benefic aspects on Venus, the native performs religious acts like yagyas, take pleasure in educational pursuits, pleasures of bed, clothes, honour from the ruler & also mental worry & opposition. (38)

कृुपाइप्रयुतस्य भुगोवियुतस्य विपदम्यम् 1
चौरारिनराजमानीतिष्ठ कुपि गोमुमिनाथ्यम् 112911

During the ruling period of Venus located in malefic Shashti amsha, the native gets into trouble & experiences fear from thieves, and fire. He is in fear of the ruler also & has loss of agriculture, lands & cattle. (39)

सोमफ़ण्यप्रयुतस्य भुगोवियुतस्य महत्तवम् 1
कुपारामतडगानो निम्नग्रहण देवपुष्यम् 118011

During the ruling period of Venus located in a benefic "Shashti amsha" the native gets much happiness, he undertakes in a religious spirit the work relating to the construction of wells, orchards, tanks, & worships the diety. (40)

वेशोषिकमानीप्रयुतस्य भुगोवियुतस्य महत्तवम् 1
बाधन मुपसन्मान शारणस्याप्रयुतस्य निम्नग्रहण : 118211

During the ruling period of Venus located in "Vaisheshik" amsha, the native gets much happiness, conveyances, honour from the ruler, brothers, wife & wealth. (41)

कुर देवकागस्यप्रयुतस्य भुगोवियुतस्य सिरितवम् : 1
कारगार महत्तवम् महत्तवम् 118211

During the ruling period of Venus located in a malefic decante, the native has fear from enemies, imprisonment, much trouble, & suffering from fire and thieves. (42)

---

During the ruling period of Venus located in the sign of its exaltation, but in the Navamsha of its sign of debilitation, the native gets much suffering, there is loss of ruling powers & loss of the position held in life. (43)

During the ruling period of Venus located in its sign of debilitation, but in the Navamsha sign of exaltation, the native prospers in agriculture, cattle, lands, trade, grains & wealth. (44)

## MAIN RULING PERIOD OF SATURN

मन्नेबोत्तुलवर्षाया ग्रामस्मामणं उल्लाहिप्रदेश स्थाब 1
लाम्टे विनोद्धीले पिरुनायं बंधुकलाई च 11811

During the ruling period of Saturn located in its highest degree of exaltation the native becomes the leader of his village, assembly, or territory, gets happy temperament, but loss of father and rift with relatives. (1)

स्वोच्छवर्षाया कुतते देखाम्ये मनोजः रूचम् 11
वागिज़स्तवहाने कुविहाने नुपविरोयं च 11211

During the ruling period of Saturn located in its sign of exaltation, the native loses lands, has mental worry, troubles, loss of trade and strength, loss of agriculture & he meets with the opposition from the ruler. (2)

आरोहिगी वासरनायस्तुलवर्षायाके नुपविरोयं 1
वागिज़स्तवहाने कुविहाने गौरविजयाने सुतवारवहाने 11311

During the ruling period of Saturn occupying the sign Virgo, the native gets income from the ruler, income from trade, from agriculture, lands, cattle, horses & conveyances & also gain of son & wife. (3)

दिनेश्चुलवर्षायाके राजयचुलवर्षायाके 1
भागयचुलवर्ष मुपविरोयण्यते प्रश्नविरोयण्यते रूचम् 11811

During the ruling period of Saturn occupying the sign Pisces, the native gets loss of ruling powers, loss of wife, son & wealth; loss of prospects, gets wrath of the ruler, has to serve others & gets disease in the eyes & rectum. (4)

---

During the ruling period of Saturn occupying its sign of debilitation, the native gets loss of wife, sons & brothers, gets trouble in the agricultural activities, has to take up a low job involving low means. (5)

मुत्तारिकोणनिलपस्य धरनेद्राया वेशनत्रायदिनवास्मुपोटि काले 1

नामद्रय वादि समाननाराहिपस्य विरेषपंथ सुतक्षणस्यनाराहिपस्य 11411

During the ruling period of Saturn located in its Mool trikon sign, the native has to go to other countries & to live in jungles. He also gets name or titles, leadership in city, society, & meets hatred from son, wife etc & gets financial trouble. (6)

स्वर्षेसनपस्य ब धर्म विरेषपंथ करोटि बचानेद्रायदिनवास्मुपोटि काले 1

राजस्य कनकमुपगमुपिलाम धर्म सवनामस्यभुलुगा ब सौखम् 11911

During the ruling period of Saturn located in its own sign, the native develops an attitude of hatred, gets strength, activity, fame, support from the ruler, gains gold, lands, ornaments, patience, comforts & name according to his station in life. (7)

धरनेद्रायदिनवास्मुपगमुपिलाम धर्म सवनामस्यभुलुगा ब सौखम् 1

धरनेद्रायदिनवास्मुपगमुपिलाम धर्म सवनामस्यभुलुगा ब सौखम् 11411

During the ruling period of Saturn located in the sign of its bitter enemy, the native falls from the position held by him, gets opposition from his own people, fear from thieves, rulers. He is obstructed in his livelihood & gets the wrath of wife & sons. (8)

विरेषपंथस्यदिनवास्मुपगमुपिलाम धर्म सवनामस्यभुलुगा ब सौखम् 1

कुमेविनायथ धर्म सवनामस्यभुलुगा ब सौखम् 11911

During the ruling period of Saturn located in an inimical sign, the native gets money from the trading community, gets loss of land & agriculture, fall from his position, meets enemies, & emaciation of body. (9)

जानवळं ब प्रतापं दवातितू सुखम् महस्यं 119011

During the ruling period of Saturn located in the sign of its friend, the native undertakes handwork, recognises virtue, wisdom & gets prowess & prominence but troubles also. (10)

---

During the ruling period of Saturn aspected by a benefic planet, the native acquires wife, sons, servants, wealth. Afterwards, however, he gets loss of cows, lands, business & agriculture.
(18)

कृष्णाशित्रनेवरी कलाधायपासिद्नम् 1
पुरुषित्राशित्रवरी मर्फ श्रुणम् 112311

During the ruling period of Saturn located in kendra, the native gets querrel with other, hard labour & troubles & has death of his son, friends, wife and of relatives etc and loss of wealth. (19)

लगनिशत्रनेवरी बेहुक्क्षमुप्ति च 1
स्थानिशत्रनेवरी प्रवाससे च राजकोण खिएरोड़म् 112011

During the ruling period of Saturn located in lagna, the native gets his body emaciated, has fall from his position, lives away from home, gets wrath from the ruler and disease in the head. (20)

च्रुणस्त्र श्रुने वाये मार्त तर वगं नाशनम् 1
गुहराहे पद प्रभा चौराटि नुप्तपासिद्नम् 112211

During the ruling period of Saturn located in the 4th house, the native has loss of mother & members of maternal side, burning away of the house, fall from position, & trouble from thieves, fire & the ruler. (21)

बारराशित्रनेवरी श्रुनेवरीस्रिपीद्नम् 1
मुस्कच्छण महादेशपे स्वीठतोमरेगा च वा 112211

During the ruling period of Saturn located in the 7th house, the native suffers from enemies, & urinal troubles, he develops hatred, or death on account of or due to wife. (22)

व्यामस्त्रनेवरी कमनाश्रमुप्ति च 1
देशातर पदम्श्रण निगात राजपासिद्नम् 112211

During the ruling period of Saturn located in the 10th house, the native gets frustration in his undertakings, he has to travel abroad, & loses his position and gets imprisonment & punishment from the ruler. (23)

डिटीपित्रश्रमनेवरी विचनाश्रमाश्रमिकण 1
राजकोण मनस्त्रपासिद्नम् मनोतमण 112811

During the ruling period of Saturn located in the 2nd house, the native gets loss of wealth or disease in the eyes. He faces wrath of government, has mental remorse, hatred for food & trouble to mind. (24)

---

During the ruling period of Saturn located in the 3rd house, the native gets income from agriculture, cows, & wealth but confusion of mind. He gets destruction of zeal; & of brothers & brotherly relations. (25)

परम्मत्स्यानेवों पुरनाश मनोदक्षण 1
राजकों पुरनाश बच्छूरीवितिमण 112411

During the ruling period of Saturn in the 5th house, the native gets loss of son, disease of mind, wrath of the ruler, destruction of servants & loss etc of relatives, wife & wealth. (26)

प्रत्यस्यारिवितुनोदण व्याकालोसSरियदनम 1
अधिकारीवितुनोदण गुफडेस्यानोदण 112911

During the ruling period of Saturn located in the 6th house, the native gets trouble from enemies, also disease & trouble from thieves, poison, & also destruction of land & house. (27)

मर्थपदणोदण मध्य : करोति निस्त्र पुरताहदरागम 1
नाश पुरतणनाना गोमहिकमुमिदरागम भ 112411

During the ruling period of Saturn located in the 8th house, the native gets destruction of sons, wife, wealth, & also loss of servants, cows, buffalows, lands, wife. (28)

नवमात्मदणदण पिरोनोदण पुरोस्यानोदण 1
तमरे पिरोस्यानन सभकुलजातीवितुनोदण भ 112811

During the ruling period of Saturn located in the 9th house, the native gets loss of his father or of his guru, has to travel abroad, & gets destruction of the members of his family. (29)

लामगतमदणदण लामरे पिरोस्यान सौख़सनमनम 1
सभकुलमदणदण मनोदिलासे कुवेस्यान भनलाम : 113011

During the ruling period of Saturn in the 11th house, the native gets wealth of many kinds, comforts & honour, happiness from sons, wife, servants, happiness of mind too & gain from agriculture. (30)

अधिकारीवितुनोदण भीस्ति चौरारिनुमसदेष्ट 1
बिविधापदे ब नुढ़ बिवेषापदे सभकुलमदण 13211

During the ruling period of Saturn located in the 12th house, the native gets trouble from thieves, fire & the ruler. He gets into danger & sorrow of various types, has to travel abroad, & gets loss of relatives. (31)

---

During the ruling period of Saturn located with the Sun, the native has enmity with his own people, has contact with woman other than his wife. He meets opposition from his servants and progeny & suffers from excess labours. (32)

नीच्छाशमद्वारे नोचाशवरे जुखने लामते 1
सर्वेया प्रणयते धननुतरारेहब विषयं उच्चम 112811

During the ruling period of Saturn occupying the Navamsha of the sign of its debilitation, the native earns by unbecoming means, he has to serve all, he falls out with his son & wife, has trouble in earning & gets sorrow. (33)

उच्चशमद्वारे विषयःनुतरारेहब मालनाशमद्वारे 1
कुटने विषयःनुतरारेहब प्रामस्मामग्रहलाशमद्वारे भा 112811

During the ruling period of Saturn occupying the Navamsha of its sign of exaltation, the native gets comforts of all types, pleasures and enjoyments, with his prospects boosted up. He travels abroad & gets leadership of his village, society, territory etc. (34)

आरा मद्वाशमद्वारेमतिरूह मालनाशमद्वारे कुटने 1
मस्थि विषयःनुतरारेहब परणुवारे परणनुतरारेहब भाने 112811

During the early part of the ruling period of Saturn, the native gets much sorrow, death of mother, in the middle portion the man goes abroad & in the last part he has to live in another person’s house & has also to depend for his food on others. (35)

स्थाननुतरारेमतिरूह वारणुवारे कीतिरूह 1
चौरष्ठुवारेमतिरूह वा धाननुतरारेहब नोचाशमद्वारे 112811

During the ruling period of Saturn endowed with "Sthan" strength, the native gets wife, sons, wealth & fame. He may also get trouble from thieves, enemies, ruler or fire & gets grains, lands, agriculture & conveyance. (36)

मद्वाशमद्वारेमतिरूह वारे विगतरवारेमतिरूह 1
मुलुवारालस्म सादरगा विषयःनुतरारेहब भनुवारे भनुवारे 112811

During the ruling period of Saturn endowed with "Directional" strength, the native gets sons, & fame in all directions. He also gets loss of land, wife kept in secrecy, son, brothers & gets opposition from his relatives. (37)

---

During the ruling period of Saturn endowed with "Kaaf" strength, the native has the danger from deadly poison, also fear from wife, son, ruler, thieves & gain of grains, lands, agriculture & convevance. (38)

स्कर्णारुनो मन्ब : करोति विप्रदेश कियानम् 1
उच्चोगंगं तृष्ट च सोदरागं च नाखनम् 113911

During the ruling period of Saturn in retrogression, the native gets failure in actions, frustration in undertakings, sorrow & destruction of brothers. (39)

स्कर्णारुनो तृष्ट भानिबाय मन्तरमयम् 1
नुपकौण परमध्य कारागुनिबायम् 118011

During the ruling period of Saturn located in the malefic "Shashti" amsha, the native faces much fear, wrath from the ruler, fall from position & is imprisoned. (40)

(44)

उत्तराशिगणो मनेव नीच्छाखक्षणिस्तर : 1
द्याळे सुर्कमापाथ द्याळे कक्षरो मनेव 118911

During the ruling period of Saturn located in its sign of exaltation but in the Navamsha sign of its debilitation, the native first gets happiness & in the latter period gets troubles. (45)

## CHAPTER—16

राहोस्बू वुपमं केतोयुषिकके रुगासिततम 1
мুलाइसिकोण. कुम्मं न दिरे मिस्ममुल्यः 11211

Rahu has Taurus & Ketu has Scorpio as its sign of exaltation.
Aquarius is Mooltrikon (positive) sign of Rahu, its friendly
sign. (1)

एखा सप्तमराहिस्बू केतोयुषिकके रुगासिततम 1
फड़ाचिरिकोणो राहू : सववाये कक्षवे मवेव 11211

Ketu has Leo as its Mooltrikon or positive sign. Rahu located in
the 6th, 8th or 12th house from lagna gives trouble in its ruling
period. (2)

उन्दरश्य : सोटिकेयस्बू तल्याके रुगवे भवेव 1
राज्य करोटि मिस्माइच धन्यान्यविवर्णनम 11211

During the ruling period of Rahu located in Taurus, the native
gets happiness, ruling powers, gets friends & increase of wealth &
grains. (3)

राहुनीचिसिततम बाये चोराहिनुपम्याचिसितम : 1
उन्दरश्यने विवादमीठि कुछते सिहिकास्थल : 11811

During the ruling period of Rahu located in its sign of debilitation, the native gets fear from thieves, fire & the ruler. He faces
being hanged or poisoned. (4)

राहोस्बू समाप्तो नुपढोराहिनुपम्याचिसितम 1
विवादमीठि रनवासादम्य रुगवे 11211

During the ruling period of Rahu there is trouble from the ruler,
thieves & fire. going out of the country, sufferings & living in
jungle. (5)

लगनगातराहुबाये रुगिविहिकास्थल विवादमीठि रुगवे भवेव 11211

During the ruling period of Rahu located in the lagna, the native
is devoid of intellect. He loses relatives by poison, fire, weapons
etc. The native suffers sorrow & defeat in battle. (6)

राहोदेशाया नन्नराहिगास्थ राज्य ब विसं हरते विषेषायब 1
कुमोजन कुलितराहस्थेवा मनोविकार लवनैत प्रकौपम् 11911

During the ruling period of Rahu located in the 2nd house, the native particularly loses ruling powers & wealth. He takes bad food & undertakes bad service under the government. His mind is defiled & he gets fits of anger & tells lies. (7)

During the ruling period of Rahu located in the 7th house, the native soon gets destruction of his wife, goes abroad, suffers losses in agriculture etc, faces danger of serpent bite, death. & loss of son & wealth. (13)

राहदेशायो निष्कर्ष चित्रतस्य वमाळबन्ध याति सुलागे नाथम् 1

चौराजिनमूपो : चव्वकुलोदमेवस्य भय मुगोखी वन्नाससुलोदम् 112811

During the ruling period of Rahu located in the 8th house, the native dies. He has loss of sons & wealth. He faces danger from thieves, fire & the ruler, also from his own people, also from wild animals & sorrow of living in a jungle. (14)

राहदेशायो नवम़ितस्य पिर्सोविनायो हामते मनुष्य : 1

विदेशायों गुणबुलुनायो सनान समुलोदमेवस्य सुलागेनायो हामते मनुष्य : 112411

During the ruling period of Rahu located in the 9th house, the native gets loss of his father, goes to another country, & has loss of Guru & brothers, takes bath in the sea & loses son & wealth. (15)

मननितस्यतस्यायों न्यायिपाके राहो : प्रवृत्ति हामते मनुष्य : 1

पुराणपम्ष्यातिमितस्य गानेयतोरेरित पुरदेश : 112411

During the ruling period of Rahu located in the 10th house, the native acts in the direction of good karmas, hears Sacred Texts from Puranas etc & gets his body purified by bath in the sacred waters of the Ganges. (16)

सौनितस्यतस्यातिमितस्य पापस्यातिमितस्य तथ्यामेवस्याति 1

प्रोट्र कफो यत्स्कर्तलो नदेव सौनितस्यातिमितस्य स्याति 112911

The results stated above about Rahu apply only when Rahu is located in a benefic sign & not when it occupies a malefic sign. The results in a benefic sign are opposite to those for being in a malefic sign. (17)

पापस्यातितस्याति राहो : कमस्याति पापस्यातितस्याति 1

पुरिष्ठस्यतस्याति काले पुरबाराईनपदम् 112411

During the ruling period of Rahu located in the 10th house with a malefic planet the native is condemned by people & he suffers in respect of sons, wife & fire. (18)

आयराशिगातों राहुस्तस्याके सुलागनम् 1

खनाडित बारलाम च पुरबाराईनपदम् 112811

During the ruling period of Rahu located in the 11th house, the native gets honour from the ruler, gets wealth, wife, lands, houses & other property. (19)

---

During the ruling period of Rahu located in the 12th house, the native has to leave his country, has mental trouble, is separated from wife & sons & loses agriculture, cattle, wealth, grains. (20)

कुलीरीगोमेपुत्त्र राहोदेशाविपाण क्षनलाममेटि
विधायिनोंदे नृपमाननसकलब्रमुळलमेटि सूच्छ प्रयाति (112811)

During the ruling period of Rahu located in Cancer or Aries, the native gets wealth, enjoyment of literature, honour from the ruler & happiness from wife, & servants. (21)

पाथोन मीऩखणुत्त्र राहोदेशाविपाण क्षनलाममेटि
देशाविपाण नर बाहन च देशाविपाण सकलब्रमुळलमेटि विधायिनोंदे

During the ruling period of Rahu located in Virgo or Pisces, the native gets son, wife, rules over a territory, conveyance driven by men, but loss of every thing at the end of the period. (22)

पाथोन सूच्छत प्रयातिनसकलब्रमुळलमेटि देशाविपाण सकलब्रमुळलमेटि विधायिनोंदे

During the ruling period of Rahu located in a malefic sign, the native gets emaciation of body, loss of members of his family, fear from the ruler, gets cheated also, & he suffers from loss of semen, asthma, consumption & urinal troubles. (23)

प्रयातिनसकलब्रमुळलमेटि राहो : करोटिसप्लैक्सायमेटि
राहोदेशाविपाण बंधुना मर्फि सूच्छमेटि (112811)

During the ruling period of Rahu under the aspect of a benefic planet, the native succeeds in his undertakings, gets honour from the ruler, wealth & death of relatives. (24)

पाथोनसकलब्रमुळलमेटि राहो : करोटिसप्लैक्सायमेटि बंधुना मर्फि सूच्छमेटि विधायिनोंदे

During the ruling period of Rahu under the aspect of malefic planets, the native loses the fruits of actions. There is frustration in undertakings, trouble to the body & from thieves, ruler and fire. (25)

उत्तरप्रभुत्त्र राहोदेशाविपाण करोटिसप्लैक्सायमेटि बंधुना मर्फि सूच्छमेटि विधायिनोंदे

During the ruling period of Rahu located with an exalted planet, the native has gains of wife, sons, wealth, clothes, ornaments, property & scents. (26)

---

During the ruling period of Rahu located with a planet in its sign of debilitation, the native earns from a low type of means, eats bad food. has bad wife & bad sons. (27)

ध्याले रुण.चमानेंति ध्यालस्थय सूत्र यह : 1

ध्याले स्थाननाश्च च गुरुवृत्षादिनाश्च नौज़ी

Rahu in the early part of its ruling period gives trouble, happiness and fame in the middle part, loss of position & loss of Guru’s sons etc in the last portion of the period. (28)

During the ruling period of Ketu located in the 2nd house, the native has loss of wealth, curt speech, mental sorrow, intake of bad food, & mental trouble. (5)

बतौराशिगास्यापि केतौराशि महत्त्वप्रदान 1
मनोराशिगास्यापि शाळभिद्धप्रदान परम 11811

During the ruling period of Ketu located in the 3rd house, the native gets much happiness, but gets trouble in mind, has hatred towards his brothers. (6)

चतौराशिगास्यापि केतौराशि सुखप्रदान :
प्रमन्ननवरुस्यापि यान्नप्रदान : 11911

During the ruling period of Ketu located in the 4th house, there is loss of comforts. One loses wife, son etc but has happiness from grains in the house. (7)

पणमस्यापि केतौराशि द्षाकाले सुखप्रदान 1
बतौराशिगापि विषोगं राजकोपि यनस्यापि 11411

During the ruling period of Ketu located in the 5th house, one loses son. There is particularly confusion of intellect, wrath from the ruler & loss of wealth. (8)

केतौराशिगास्यापि द्षाकाले महत्त्वप्रदान 1
चोराशिगापि विषोगं राजकोपि यनस्यापि ब 11911

During the ruling period of Ketu located in the 6th house, there is great danger from thieves, poison, & fire & one has to live in tattered clothes. (9)

कथास्याशिगास्यापि महत्त्वप्रदान 1
बतौराशिगापि च मूर्णकोपि मनोराशिगापि 119011

During the ruling period of Ketu in the 7th house, there is much fear, loss of wife, son & wealth, urinal trouble & mental sorrow. (10)

केतौराशिगास्यापि द्षाकाले महत्त्वप्रदान 1
पिउमत्त्वस्यापि सकास्यापि विषोगं राजकोपि यनस्यापि ब 119211

During the ruling period of Ketu located in the 8th house, there is great sorrow, death of father, cough, asthma, dysentry, consumption etc. (11)

नवमस्यापि केतौराशि द्षाकाले पिउमत्त्वस्यापि विषोगं राजकोपि यनस्यापि 119211

During the ruling period of Ketu located in the 9th house there is danger to father or to Guru & destruction of meritorious acts. (12)

---

करमस्थलकेतो : संपादतो वशाया सुखमलित ब 1
मानहाजि मनोजाड़मलित मनोजाड़मलित 112511

During the ruling period of Ketu located in the 10th house, the native gets happiness but also loss of honour, confusion of mind. & mental disease. (13)

तौमस्थलकेतो : संपादतो धाये सौखम करोटित ब 1
भारतूषणाचितसौखम ब यजाबनाचितसौखम 112811

During the ruling period of Ketu located in the 11th house, the native gets comforts, also happiness from brother & the brotherly relations & there is increase in acts of charity & yagyas. (14)

रिफक्सलकेतो : संपादतो धाये करोटर मधेव 1
स्यानसूषणाचितसौखम ब राजपीड़णाचितसौखम 112911

During the ruling period of Ketu located in the 12th house, the native suffers much, he loses his position in life, gets a living abroad, trouble from the government and loss of eye. (15)

बशायो सुखमाचितसौखम महदममलित 1
बशायो राजमीतितसौखम देहजाबनाचितसौखम वा 112511

During the earlier part of the ruling period of Ketu the native gets happiness, much fear in the middle portion & fear of government, disease in the last portion. (16)

पुष्मवीड़णाचितसौखम : केव : सौखम करोटित ब 1
राजयाय गुहशायितसौखम ब राजपीड़णाचितसौखम 112911

During the ruling period of Ketu located under the aspect of benelic planets, the native gets comforts, ruling powers, wealth, peace in the home, & gets firm honour from the government. (17)

पावेदितसौखम वापि केवदुषणाचितसौखम करोटित ब 1
जवरातितसौखम वापि केवदुषणाचितसौखम ब राजपीड़णाचितसौखम 112511

During the ruling period of Ketu located with or aspected by malefic planets, the native gets troubles, fever, loose motions, loss of semen, trouble in the skin & trouble from the government. (18)

## SUB PERIOD
तैजिसिनमतितसौखम सुखमिरविमण नुपाचण लोकश्रमणम् 1
स्वन्नवो श्रक्षणलुषणम् : पुरत्यं कुषदुषणनानितसौखम ह्यात्मणम् 112511
पुरमब्रहण फलवुषणम् : करोटित विकयातितक सभनम् 1
सुमगाययासमणम् सुखपदेह सुखमणम् ब 112511

---

If a planet is strong by virtue of being in its own Navamsha sign, it makes the native influential, very rich, possessor of lasting wealth, gainer of wealth from the government, and famous. (1) If a planet is aspected by benefic planets, it makes the native famous, wealthy, exerting to earn good wealth, or pure mind, of good complexion, and gentle. (2)

द्रुशीन्यपातमरवकाले नृपादिष्ठः भूतस्थलनेविरोधः 1
रिस्या विरोधः भूतस्थलनेविरोधः चौटारिनंब्रहणातिमनोविरोधः 11511
पाकेश्वराइल्यातिमनोविरोधः भूततो स्थाननेविरोधः बृजुनेविरोधः 1
विनेश्याने स्वजनेविरोधः पावदिश्रुगामुर्वित काले 11811

When the main dasa lord and the sub dasa lord are located in the 6th, 8th position mutually, the native gets trouble from the government, opposition from subordinates and wife, loss of son or wife, trouble from thieves, fire, relatives, affliction of mind. (3)
When there is the sub period of a planet located in the 12th house from the planet having its main period, the native loses his position in life, gets opposition from his relatives, has to go abroad, gets opposition from friends and gets trouble in the feet, eyes, or heart. (4)

---

During the sub period of the planet located in the 4th house from
the planet having its main ruling period, the native gets wife, son,
wealth, house, morality, conveyance, sweets, good food and
drinks, good clothes & ornaments. If the planet having its sub
period is a malefic the results are in the opposite direction. Even a
malefic planet situated 4th from the planet having its main ruling
period will give good results if it occupies a position of strength
such as being in its own sign or in its sign of exaltation. On the
other hand even a benefic planet located 4th from the planet having its main ruling period, will give bad results if it is not located in
a position of strength, such as its own sign or its sign of exaltation.
During the sub period of a planet located in the 5th house from
that of the planet having its main period the native acquires son
etc if the planet in the sub period is natural benefic. If otherwise in
the sub period of a natural malefic there is loss of son. (8-10)

(13) During the sub period of a benefic placed 7th from the main dasa lord and occupying a sign other than an inimical sign or the sign of its debilitation, the native gets comforts, good jewels, clothes, & ornaments. मुत्रवानो शोमनं प्रौजमेते कक्ष विनिद्धशोषत 112911
पाकेश्याबद्धमस्तः पापस्यापहतो मयम् 1
निधनं कुटिस्तानं च वोरागिनस्यापहतो 112511
बायेश्यानवमस्तः पापस्यापहतो यवा 1
अशुमं लमते कमस्यानमशोषो मनोड़जम 112911
प्रभानत : शुम्यस्यापहतो सोम्यस्यापहतो यवा 1
विवाद यजवीधो च वानाधिन लमते नह : 112511

During the sub period of a benefic located 8th from the main dasha lord, the native enjoys comforts. In the first half portion of the sub period the native gets good results but in the second half he gets trouble. (15) During the sub period of a malefic located in 8th from the main dasa lord, the native gets into trouble, has to eat unbecoming food & has to suffer at the hands of thieves, fire or the government. (16) During the sub period of a malefic planet located 9th from the planet having its main ruling period the native gets bad luck, and set back in his profession and gets mental trouble. (17) During the sub period of a benefic located by the main dasa lord, a man generally gets marriage, initiation into some religious order, celebrating of some yagya, and performs acts of charity. (18)

During the sub period of a malefic located 10th from the main
dasa lord, the native falls from good deeds, & gets defame and misfortune. (19)

In the sub period of a benefic located 10th from the main period
lord, the native gets comforts, and earns merit through such good
karmas as the building of the public tanks, temples, etc. (20) During the sub period of a malefic planet located in 11th from the
main dasa lord, the native gets comforts, better prospects in life,
favour from the government & increase of sons, wife etc. (22) During the sub period of a malefic planet located in the 12th from the
main dasa lord, the native meets with sorrow, loss of wealth,
punishment from government, loss of position and loss of
memory. (20-23)

During the sub period of a benefic located in the 12th from the
main dasa lord, the native gets conveyance, enjoyments, luck,
clothes, and ornaments. (24)

During the sub and main periods of benefic planets the native gets position, conveyance, and ornaments. During the main ruling period of a malefic and the sub ruling period of a benefic the native first gets good results and then bad results. (28) During the main ruling period of a benefic and the sub ruling period of a malefic the native gets trouble first and then comforts. (29)

In cases where there are many contradictory factors the results for the majority should be declared. Where factors are equal the results earlier & later should be predicted as detailed above.

## SUB PERIODS IN MAIN PERIODS OF SUN

अन्नस्यायो मिस्गास्य गौनरस्य मयेद्रुह : 11311
अन्नस्यायो नीच्छो वाछiप सवरिसिमनिकोपाद्रुह : 1
फळ्णस्यमयस्य गौनरस्य बा वच : चेतो यमयोचर : 11811

During the main ruling period of the Sun located in the Ascendant and the sub periods of Mars, Saturn, Ketu and Rahu the native gets sorrow & loss of ruling powers, wealth and property. (1) This would be the result when the planets Mars etc are in "Agochar" position i.e. are ill placed from the Sun & weak. If however, they are in "Gochar" they give good results. (2) A planet in its own sign, in its sign of exaltation, in its friends sign, not eclipsed by the Sun, not situated in the 6th, 8th or 12th house is technically called in gochar. (3) If it is eclipsed in debilitation sign, and in sign other than its Mool Trikon sign or other than a friends sign & when located in 6th, 8th or 12th house is bad and is technically called "Yam gochar". (4)

During the main ruling period of the Sun located in the Ascendant and in the sub periods of Jupiter, Venus, Moon or Mercury, the native gets benefitted from agriculture, cows, sons, wife and lands. (5)

During the ruling period of the Sun located in the 2nd house and in the sub period of malefics there will be loss of wealth, use of curt speech, mental sorrow, eye disease, & great trouble. (6) During the main ruling period of the Sun located in the 2nd house and in the sub period of beneficial planets there will be much comfort, acquisition of education, favour from government, and gain of clothes, conveyance. (7) During the main ruling period of the Sun located in the 3rd house and in the sub period of malefics who are "Gochar Sthan" i.e. well placed and strong the native gets much comfort; If the planets having sub period are not "Gochar Sthan" the results are bad i.e. sorrow etc. (8)

## TRANSLATOR'S NOTE

There are a few points to be specially noted about the above opinion of the author. In the first place (vide shloka 7) it must be remembered that academic education & its extent and quality have to be determined from the 2nd house of the horoscope i.e. through the nature of influence falling on the second house & its lord and its significator (Mercury). Such education is not to be seen from any other house such as the 4th and the 5th as some people do. Secondly, it would be seen that a uniform principle runs through the method of prediction taught by the author. The principle is that the planet, whether a natural malefic or a natural benefic, must be taken as influencing the planet having its main ruling period irrespective of the house occupied by them.

In that event, the sub period of Mars located any where will harm the right eye, if sun in the 2nd house is having its main ruling period. In case, where Mars is strong and aspecting also the Sun in the 2nd house, injury to the right eye is a certainty. The reason is that Mars in such a case will have double malefic influence on the factors representing the right eye viz the 2nd house and the planet Sun.

As regards the "Gochar sthan" position of the planets having their sub period, we are of the opinion that the benefit or harm to the house occupied by the main dasa lord would be much when the planets having their sub periods are strong, for then their influence, good or bad, will be more effective.

During the main dasa of Sun located in the 10th house, and the sub period of malefic planets. the native gets frustration in his actions and suffers at the hands of thieves. fire and government. (22)

With Sun as before and the sub periods of benefic planets, one gets much ruling powers, and everlasting fame. (23) During the main dasa of Sun in the 11th house, and the sub periods of malefic planets there is first trouble & then comforts. (24) With Sun located as above and with sub periods of benefics in it. the native gets wealth, honour from government and comforts from wife, sons. and the government. (25)

During the main ruling period of the Sun located in the 12th house and in the sub ruling period of malefic planets. there is much trouble to the native. He falls from his position in life, has to live away from his home, and gets dishonour at the hands of the govt. (26)

## TRANSLATOR'S NOTE

With reference to shloka 27 above, it is pointed out that the 12th house being the 3rd house from that of the government (10th) stands for the arms of the govt i.e. its deliberate self through which it functions. Hence where the 12th house and the significator of government i.e. the Sun suffer, trouble comes through the adverse orders of the government. (27)

During the main ruling period of the Sun located in the 12th house and in the sub periods of benefic planets, there is much comfort. One gets cows, lands, clothes, grains, jewels, corals and ornaments.

## SUB PERIODS IN MAIN DASA OF MOON

মুটিস্যাবন্দী বু খুরকের্শারজি বিভা হতো ।

देहरोग्य नुपारेशीति वाधनाधिकरणमुख्याम् 11911

तথ্যाविषयی চাজজন্য পরিপাকে শুধুমেতে ।

हूतित : करोडित रुद्ध सं कुरीगामुखिनाशनस 11211

---

During the main ruling period of Moon located in the Ascendant and in the sub periods of Venus, Jupiter, Moon & Mercury, the native keeps good health, gets favour from government, conveyance, clothes and ornaments. (1)

The same type of Moon’s dasa and the sub period of malefic planets, brings about trouble & loss of agriculture, cows, & lands. (2)

During the main ruling period of Moon located in the 2nd house, and in the sub periods of malefic planets, there is trouble from or to wife, son, relatives, & fear from government. (3)

During the sub periods of benefic planets in the main period of Moon located in the 2nd house, there is much happiness to the native. He gets good food, clothes, drinks and enthusiasm. (4)

## TRANSLATOR’S NOTE

Moon by herself is the significator of eating when she is in the 2nd house—the house of eating and drinking, it is clear that good influence on a good Moon in the second house will give high class dishes to eat.

During the main dasa of Moon in the 4th house, and in the sub periods of benelic planets, the native gets much comfort, favour from government and also comforts relating to his residence. (7)

During the same type of the main ruling period of Moon and the sub period of malefic planets, the native suffers much loss of house, wife, & wealth & gets trouble from thieves, fire and the government. (8)

| शुममुल्टो नृपात्रीटि शाधवक्षणमब सुखम 1 |
| तथ्यारिष्ठत्तरासूनोदेशाया दैस्वाधम 11211 |
| प्रनिष्ठत्तरासूनो. शुममुल्टियवा तबा 1 |
| शाधवरुसोच्यं मनोतसाह विभावाहनसुखमय 11211 |
| डिटीयस्थपरासूनो : परीपाके शुमाहटि : 1 |
| पुवरिदनविनाशो श राजकोप जसराइनमय : 11211 |

---

During the main ruling period of Mars located in the 1st house and in the sub period of malefic planets there is much trouble, wounds and injuries and there is much trouble through indigestion etc. (1) During the sub periods of benefics in the main period of Mars in the 1st house, the native gets favour from govt & happiness through brothers etc & acquisition of lands and conveyance. (2)

During the sub periods of benefics in the main period of Mars located in the 2nd house, the native gets help from brothers, enthusiasm of mind, education, conveyance and ornaments. (3)

During the sub periods of malefic planets in the main period of Mars located in the 2nd house, there is loss of accumulated wealth, adverse attitude by government, fever and fire trouble. (4)

वृत्तियस्यारहनो : पापमुखियवा तला |
मनोवेक्षणमायाति धारवरवरिनाशनम् 11911|
वृत्तियस्यारहनो : पाके सौमुखियवा |
दोजनावरवरिनाशनम् 11511|
हिंडक्षणस्यारहनो : स्रुमुखियवा महद्वमयम् |
गहद्वमयम् च नृपवरवरिनाशनम् 11911|
हिंडक्षणस्यारहनो : पाके सौमुखियवा |
दोसंबंधस्यारहनो पशुवानमुखम् 11411|

During the sub periods of malefic planets in the main ruling period of Mars placed in the 3rd house, there is distress of mind and loss of brothers etc. (5)

During the sub period of the benefic planets in the main period of Mars located in the 3rd house, the native gets comfort from food, clothes, agriculture, ornaments, & conveyance. (6)

During the sub periods of the malefic planets in the main ruling period of Mars located in the 4th house, there is much trouble, there is loss of land and property & trouble from the government, fire and thieves. (7) During the sub periods of benefic planets in the main ruling period of Mars located in the 4th house, one gains land, clothes, confiscits, animals conveyance and ornaments. (8)

पश्चमर्यस्यारहनो : पाके पापमुखियवा |
कुवियस्यारहनम् स्रुमुखियवा |
तथ्यवियस्यारहनम् स्रुमुखियवा |
राजपुष्य स्रुमायिति च नर्सायिति स्रुमायिति च |

---

During the sub periods of malefic planets in the main period of Mars placed in 5th house there is loss of agriculture, cattles, grains, son, wife etc. (9)

With Mars located in the 5th house and having its main period and during the sub period of benefies, the native gets honour from the government, acquisition of son & Mantra. (10)

During the sub periods of malefics in the main period of Mars located in the 6th house, the native gets trouble. He gets trouble from thieves, fire and government, boils, consumption & urinal troubles. (11) During the sub periods of benefics in the main ruling period of Mars located in the 6th house, the native gets favour from the govt, loss of relatives, mental worry but he is happy at the end. (12)

कल्लरस्थयकुजातपानपुल्ला स्रीमुतराच्छि : |
पुल्लमुतराच्छि महत्वसोच्छि नृष्ठाधनमुपपानपम् 119211
अस्तमस्थयकुजातपानपम् पापिनां मर्गं कुशम् |
सोमस्थयकुजातपानपम् महत्वसोच्छि कुशिनांनुपपणम् 119811
नवमस्थयकारणसोच्छि पापपुल्लित्वबा |
पिरोनिश्न गुरोनिश्न धमेहानिन मनोदशम् 119411
तथ्याविष्कुजातपानपम् गोखनसपद : |
विवाह भड़ादिजा च देवमुतराच्छि 119511

During the sub period of malefic planets in the main period of Mars located in the 7th house, the native suffers on account of wife, son & the government. In the sub periods of benefies however, there is much happiness relating to the government, conveyance, and ornaments. (13)

During the sub periods of malefic planets and the main ruling period of Mars located in the 8th house, there is death, & much weakness of body. During the sub periods of benefic planets, however, there is much comfort, one gets benefit from agriculture, & cattle and honour from government. (14)

During the sub period of malefic planets in the main period of Mars placed in the 9th house there is destruction of father and the Guru, loss of morality, and mental trouble. (15) During the sub periods of benefic planets, however, the native has cattle, wealth,
marriage, spiritual initiation, and the service of the Gods, and
Brahmins. (16)

कमीसित्यतराहुनोडू.चे स्वालयापिनो हतो 1
विदेशानं रूकीटि लम्बरे हि पराजयम 119911
लाम्सभमुमित्यस्वय पाके पापुतित्यवा 1
करोटि विपुत्य राज्य गण्मालयाइमुपयम 119411
पुर्षंजाख्यविवर्ध मुत्तो लामराहिगत्यवा तु 1
परियाके महत्वोझ्य धान्यमुमित्यस्वयम 119911
दाब्दह्यस्तराहुनोडू.चे पाके पापुतित्यवा 1
करोटि रू.चवाडूल्य कारगुठिनेशनम 119011
पुर्षमापहरे सौख्य च यानोरविमुपयम 1
मुत्तोटि राज्योझ्य च परद्रष्टम मनोद्रष्टम 119211

During the sub periods of malefic planets in the main ruling
period of Mars located in the 10th house, the native goes to foreign
land, gets bad name, and defeat. (17)

During the sub period of malefic planets and the main ruling
period of Mars located in the 11th house, one gets good ruling
powers, scents, flowers, ornaments etc. (18)

During the sub periods of benefic planets Venus, Moon & Mercury and the main ruling period of Mars located in the 11th house.
there is much happiness and one earns merit through charity &
moral conduct. (19)

During the sub periods of malefic planets in the main ruling
period of Mars located in the 12th house, there is much sorrow and
fear of imprisonment. (20)

During the sub periods of benefic planets, however, there is
comfort from conveyance, clothes, ornaments. At the end of the
sub period however, there is anger from the government, fall from
position and mental worry. (21)

## TRANSLATOR'S NOTE

In the text the shloka for the results of the sub periods of the
benefic planets in the main period of Mars located in the 10th
house is missing. Following the trend of the method of deliniation
by the author it may be stated that the results of such sub periods
should give honour to the native, good actions on his part, and success in action but bad name and adverse results at the end of the
sub period.

SUB PERIODS IN THE MAIN PERIOD OF RAHU

लानन्स्यरेहिकेयस्य धारे पापहीतिवब 1
करोति दुःचखाहुल्य नृपस्यरेहिकेयस्य 11211
तर्षश्यरेहिकेयस्य : पाके रुमस्यतो रुमं बरेव 1
गुणस्यरेहिकेयस्य भोजनोरस्यस्य 11211
पड़चलयातस्यस्य : परिपाके रुमतस्य 1
हूटि : कलहरोगािनृपस्यरेहिकेयस्य 11311
फकास्यरेहिकेयस्य महादिवुल्यनिर्दिष्टिमामस्यवेब 1
कुमो जने कुवस्यं च श्याननाथो रुमातस्यस्य 11811

During the main ruling period of Rahu located in the first house and in the sub periods of malefic planets, there is much sorrow, and trouble from the government, fire and thieves. (1) During the sub periods of benefic planets, however, the results are good. There is addition of house, land etc & acquisition of good food, clothes and ornaments. (2) During the main ruling period of Rahu located in 6th, 8th or 12th house and in the sub periods of malefic planets, there is quarrel, disease, fire, accident, and fear from the government, thieves and poison. (3)

In the same period the native sufferers from such diseases as asthma, consumption, urinal complaints, pain, too much of sleep (laziness etc). (4)

दुःचखाहुल्य धारेहिकेयस्य परिपाके रुमा हूटि : 1
आदे रुमं महत्वस्यतो रुमस्यन धनगमस्य 11411
असे रुम राजमोटि : स्यात्यान नाथो मनोदजम 1
कुवस्य गौपुमिवस्यस्यस्यस्यनशनस्य 11511

During the sub period of benefic planets in the main period of Rahu placed in the 6th, 8th or 12th house, there are good results in the beginning, much happiness, honour from govt. & gain of wealth. (5) But at the end there is trouble from govt., fall from position & mental sorrow, loss of agriculture, cattle, lands, clothes, relatives, son, & wealth. (6)

During the main ruling period of Rahu placed in the 3 cardinal houses other than the Ascendant, and in the sub period of the malefic planets events like house being burnt, trouble to eyes, disease, trouble to wife & sons take place. (7)

Loss of position, mental worry, loss of character, sudden quarrels & trouble from government, thieves and fire, take place. (8)

During the main period of Rahu located in a kendra (cardinal house) & in the sub period of a benefic planet the native has some times comforts, some times fame, some times moral acts and some times the opposite of these. (9) The above results will be experienced in the first half of the sub period. At the end of the sub period, there will be loss of wealth caused by anger of government, defeat in battle & quarrel regarding learning. (10)

During the main dasa of Rahu located in the trines (5th or 9th house) and in the sub period of malefics there is much trouble, accompanied with sinful acts. (11)

Bad name, bad food, loss of agriculture, cattle, land, trouble from the government, engagement in acts of valour, and fall in prices of articles. (12) In the sub periods of benefic planets during the main period of such a Rahu, there is acquisition of son, wife, wealth, good actions. These results are obtained at the end of the sub period. (13) In the first half of the sub period there is travel to foreign lands, a little gain, worship through the mantras, enthusiasm & blemish to wife and son. (14)

During the sub periods of malefic planets in the main period of Rahu located in the 3rd or 11th house, one gets favour from the government. (15)

At the end of the sub period there is trouble, from thieves, fire or government, there is hatred towards relatives, mental sorrow, destruction of brothers etc. (16)

During the sub periods of malefics in the main dasa of Rahu located in the 2nd house there is loss of wealth, mental sorrow & loss of wife & son. (17)

In these periods there is trouble in the sale and purchase of articles, there is trouble in speech, but during the sub periods there one gets (good) food. (18) Acquisition of clothes, conveyance and ornaments, but trouble in business, loss of perseverence, trouble to the body, and hidden sin. (19)

During the sub periods of malefic planets in the main period of Jupiter there is bodily trouble, sorrow, anger of the government, loss of wealth. (1) loss of agriculture, cattle, lands, opposition to relatives, loss of enthusiasm, impairment of limb but there is some good at the end. (2) During the sub periods of benefic planets in the main period of Jupiter-Jupiter located in any of the cardinal houses, the native gets ruling powers, enthusiastic mind, clothes, conveyance, & ornaments. (3) Also the native engages in charity, religious act of offering oblations. Japa. He has patience, favour of government, recognition, doing good to others, acts of spiritual merit, nice clothes, & gold. (4)

अथवारभिन कुतते सवुलुलोदिमाचराखित च।

During the sub-period of benefic planets in the main period of Jupiter located in the 8th house, there is much comfort. The native becomes the ruler of the country or the city & gets much fame. (12) Also he gets good health, & gets elephants, horses, & clothes, nice food, high spirits, milk, curd, ghee & sugar. (13)

During the sub-period of the benefic planets in the main dasa of Jupiter placed in the 3rd or the 11th house, the native gets clothes, conveyance, & ornaments. (14) The native also gets ruby, coral, gold, pearls, clothes etc, rule over the country, ministership. (15) But during the sub-periods of malefics the native becomes characterless & acts contrary to the good traditions of his family. (16) He also has to live in a foreign land. These results are for the first half of the sub-period. In the latter half, he gets good comfort, conveyance & food. (17)

## SUB PERIODS IN DASA OF SATURN

केन्द्रशिष्ट धानवर्णे यब पाप हुतितिस्तरा 1
च्यानन्त्रशिष्ट प्रवासे च नुपंजोरामिनीपिन्दरम् 11211
त्यानिष्ठशिष्ट धानवर्णे पुम्मुत्तो महत्तवुत्तम् 1
नुपंजोरामिनीपिन्दरम् 11211
फलामिनिष्ठशिष्ट महत्तवुत्तम् 1
परववादे बंधुनो मर्गो धननान्त्रम् 11211

During the sub period of malefic planets in the main dasa of Saturn located in kendra the native falls from his position in life. He has to live in a different place and suffer through government, thieves and fire. (1)

During the sub periods of benefics, however, he gets much happiness, honour from government, wealth, and rule over the country or a village. (2) Such is the result during the first half of the beneficial sub periods. At the end of the sub periods the native gets disease, bad name, death of relatives, and loss of wealth. (3)

सभकृष्टकलहे पिपुम्मुत्तो महत्तवुत्तम् 1
मुल्य मिस्रायस्पदित तममत्ते धननान्त्रम् 11911

During the sub periods of the malefic planets in the main period of Saturn located in the 5th or 9th house, the native gets much sorrow, loss of father, son & loss of the results of his efforts. (4)

Also he has diseases arising out of nervous and eye troubles. He has conflict with his relatives also. (5)

---

During the sub periods of benefics, however, the native gets honour from the government, much enjoyment, gain from agriculture, increase of wealth and grains. (6) Also good health of his relatives, wife, sons, and gains, ornaments etc. (7)

आरोग्य कालित्वदि च वेश्यामाचिप्रयताम् 118011

During the sub periods of the malefic planets in the main period of Saturn located in the 6th, 8th or 12th house, one gets much sorrow and trouble & loss of position. (8)

One also gets disease near the private parts of the body, suffers from intake of poison, fever, fire, trouble from government, death of a dear friend, & loss of perseverence. (9)

During the sub periods of the benefic planets in the main period of Saturn located in the 6th, 8th or 12th house, there is much comfort, good health, much glow on the body, and rule over the country or a village. (10)

During the sub periods of malefic planets in the main period of Saturn located in the 2nd house, the native undergoes punishment from the government. There are great obstacles, & confinement in prison. (14) There is also loss of spirits, bodily suffering, fever, & indigestion, loss of ruling powers, death of cows, horses etc & danger from conveyance. (15)

During the sub periods of benefic planets, however, the native has a firm mind. He helps others, amuses himself with gambling. (16) Also he engages himself in secrets of singing, he gets food, clothes & ornaments, his efforts bear fruit. He gets ruling powers ruby, coral & gold. (17)

## SUB PERIODS IN MAIN PERIOD OF MERCURY

During the main period of Mercury located in kendra & the sub period of malefic planets, there are obstacles in undertakings, great worry & the flickleness of mind. (1)

At that time the native gets his zeal broken, & loss of cows, lands, gold and clothes. He falls from the position held. Great hatred, & loss of education. (2)

During the sub-period of a benefic Mercury having malefics in kendra to it, the native performs acts such as marriage, yagyas, charity, religious acts, Japa etc. (3)

In this period there is profundity of thought, friendship with the ruler, prosperity of agriculture, lands, cows, coral, ruby, pearls,
conveyances, clothes & ornaments. (4)

During the main ruling period of Mercury located in trine and
the sub period of malefics, the native gets loss of wife, sons, wealth,
karmas & gets mental disease. (5) He also gets losses in agriculture,
trade, & loss of relatives, breaking of feet, great enmity, & enmity
with the relatives. During the main ruling period of Mercury in
trine and the sub period of benefics the native gets good health,
comforts & pleasure of high class drinks. He writes prose in his
name or he gets title or honour. He also gets good food, clothes,
ornaments & ruling powers. (8)

During the main ruling period of Mercury located in the 6th or
8th house, and in the sub period of malefic planets the native gets
trouble from thieves, & fire & fever & loose motions. (9) Also death
of relatives, mental worry, loss of servants, wife, & son, quarrel &
arguments with every relative. if Mercury is in the 6th or 8th house
but in the sub period of benefics, the native gets great fame, good
health, lovely looks, worship of Gods & Brahmins. (11)

This is the result in the early part of the sub period, there is loss
of happiness in the end, trouble relating to cows and buffalloes.
use of curt speech & fear from the government. (12)

---

During the main ruling period of Mercury located in the 3rd or the 11th house, & the sub period of a benefic planet the native gets good results. He has patience and zeal of mind, & collection of articles from abroad. (13)

He has success in education, friendship with the ruler & takes invigorating food, engages in works like yagyas, marriage & hearing etc of Sacred Texts from the Puranas etc. (14)

During the main period of such a Mercury i.e. when located in the 3rd or 11th house, and the sub period of malefic planets there is great danger, loss of brother and sisters, impairment of some limb & trouble from the ruler. (15) Also fear from thieves, enemies & fire, cohabitation with a despicable woman, worship of bad dead souls, he leaves work, has loss in agriculture, & trouble from elephants and horses. (16)

During the main ruling period of Mercury located in the 2nd house & the sub period of malefic planets the native gets punishment from the government, arrest and imprisonment. (17)

There is trouble from poison, hatred with relatives, loss of agriculture, cows, lands enmity with all, always acting in a characterless manner. (18) During the period when Mercury is in the 2nd house, the native gets wealth, and in the sub periods of benefic planets great income & the worship of Gods & Brahmins. (19)

The native also performs great acts like yagyas, charity, japa etc.
The period is one for being respected by relatives. There is great enthusiasm, & gain of education. (20)

During the main ruling period of Ketu located in a kendra & the sub period of malesics, the native gets dishonour, he has great enmity & trouble from the ruler, thieves & fire. (1) Also loss of mother or death of himself & the loss of wife, son, loss of position, frustration in undertakings, & sudden quarrels. (2)

During the main ruling period of such a Ketu located in a kendra & the sub periods of benefic planets, the native gets love from the ruler, comforts & good health & cordial meetings with relatives. (3)

In the 1st part of the sub period the native enjoys good food, clothes & ornaments. In the last part, there is mental sorrow, frustration in undertakings, trouble from sex & the death of relatives. (4)

## TRANSLATOR'S NOTE

To illustrate the aspect of Rahu here is a birth chart. The person
left his wife in the main period of Ketu & the sub period of Rahu.

Rahu is influenced by Sun, both are "Separative" in nature. Hence
Rahu in its sub period will throw the separative influence of Sun &
of itself on Venus—the lord & significator of the 7th house. Rahu
also aspects the 7th house—the house of wife. Hence all the three
factors representing wife i.e. the 7th house, its lord & significator
Venus being under separative influence, there was separation.

During the ruling period of Venus located in the 3rd or 11th house & the sub period of malefic planets, the native gets discomfort, loss of grains etc, frustration in efforts, mental worry, trouble from the ruler, thieves and fire, litigation regarding land, loss of relatives, & loss of position, (13-14) During the main ruling period of such a Venus i.e. Venus in 3rd or 11th house & the sub period of benefic planets, there is much happiness, honour from the ruler, firmness of mind, ruling over a village or territory, acquisition of conveyance, ornaments, sons, wife and servants, provision of drinking water for others, construction of orchards & tanks & doing acts of religion. (15-16)

चन्द्रस्याति शुक्करस्य शुक्करस्य महत्विष्णस्य।
बारूसायलाम च स्वभंडुसनरधपम। 118911
विश्वासय मनोजलाम च लमेनामधपम तया 118211
चन्द्रस्यतस्य शुक्करस्य पावस्तोपम वदेव।
राजवद्द मनोजलम च हर्दोगाखिपपम 118911
विश्वासायण कुवनीह कमहानिन पदममय।
विश्वासिन्नोरारिपमिति च लमेते नास स्थाप : 118011

During the main ruling period of Venus located in the 2nd house and the sub period of benefic planets, there is much happiness, gain of wife, son, wealth and the protection of relatives, success in education, happy mood, worship of Gods & Brahmins, performance of acts like yagyas, getting name or titles. In the sub period of malefic planets there is trouble, punishment from the government, sorrow in mind, suffering from heart attack etc, loss of work, fall from position & fear from thieves, enemies & fire. (17-20)
