तथापि तथोगाफेलमाला ताडूखिः स्यालुन्यो बधिल 1
स्यालीवमालाइ महिपयोगेयेव फलो तु.खित्ततिनितायो : 11911
तथापिते जन्मनित यस्य कक्ष भालेय च दिरोमर्था च कक्षम 1
मिधाओशनायुष्मेयेव पुरितस्तवा मयस्येव तदेखायो : 11511

Acharya Shankar by name is of the opinion that the bad results viz short life etc ascribed to the location of all malefics in kendras accrue, if the malefics include the malefic lord of the lagna as well. (6)

Similarly in cases where there is yoga for becoming a king, the location of planets in the Navamsha of their signs of debilitation gives short life & discomforts & the native gets trouble to his father or his death, lives on charity & has loss of a limb. (7-8)

स्वनोशमायाइदमायियो जातोपि यस्यापि नरस्य कक्ष.1
केन्द्रिकोणोपुणो यस्य स्यालस्यालयोग सपतमें यस्यति 11911
स्यालोखिते लागनेते कक्षमोपि जातोपि मुमरर्थियमेंट 1
स्यालीवमायाइदमायियो जातोपि मुमरर्थियमेंट 119011
एस चिन्तामर्थो प्रोटे बेकटहोन ध्रिमता 1
नीयमायाइदमायघ राज्योगायिते फलम 119211

Even though the location of planets in the Navamsha of their signs of debilitation in the case of people with Rajayoga, normally cancels such a yoga, yet if the kendras and trines are occupied by benelic planets the yoga continues. (9) Similarly, a person with Rajayoga having planets located in Navamsha of debilitation, but having the planet creating Rajayoga in lagna, located in its own Navamsha is aspected by Jupiter & the lord of the 2nd house, still gives rulership. (10) Thus the results or Rajayoga for planets in debilitation Navamsha. (11)

## DECANTES

मेवादतीयो मियुन : पुर्ण : सिहस्य प्रयम : भागस्येक्षा : कक्षस्य दित्तियमेंट 1
पुर्णिकोणोपुणमेंट मीननवतीयो ध्याले : मकरायो निगाड : 119211

The second decante of Aries, all the three of Gemini, & the first of Leo are known as "Bird" decantes. The 2nd and 3rd decantes of

---

Cancer, the first & 3rd of Scorpio & the 3rd of Pisces are called "ध्याला" or serpent decantes. The first decante of Capricorn is called "Nigad" (related to hanging).

रतिमंतोमकेजा : शुफका : सचवलो चन्द्रमानिनी 1
चुफणचण्टनी जैयो सचवलो सगलरिखानी 112311
कुम्मकेकतो मीनमकरालुलात्रा : 1
सन्जडा राष्ट्रय : प्रोड्रा दिनबूडा : शुफराखण्ट : 112811

Sun, Mars and Saturn are "dry" planets. Moon and Venus are watery, Mercury and Jupiter become watery if associated with watery signs, otherwise they are dry. Aquarius, Cancer, Pisces, Capricorn, Scorpio, Libra are watery signs, other signs are without water. (12-14)

## BADHAK

जनमन्यको हिमकरस्थुल : सोहिदेय : शुफरण : कुम्मचण्टना दिनकर
तुलो भागियो भुमिम्युल : 1
ताप कालिन ध्रितिशितलाय कुम्मचण्टनी प्रमाणे भुम्यु ताराबलम्युलिन
सचवरित कक्षेग 11211

The 9 planets belonging the 9 asterisms at birth are as under & give results as indicated against each: 1st Sun, heat; 2nd Mercury, lovely face; 3rd Rahu, losses; 4th Jupiter, possession; 5th Ketu, destruction; 6th Moon, fame; 7th Saturn, losses; 8th Venus, dexultation; 9th Mars, death. In this order Sun, Mercury etc come every day.

शुफणगा 'च्यानवशोन परस्परबायकरस्थुल 1
कक्षेगव रागिदिशीरमाजानुपलयममनरस्थुल 1
च्रष्ठमाजिदिशितरमाजिनाय अत्तिवयाकरस्थुल : शुफ 11211
चुफणगारमरमगी भुम्युल : सोमरस्थुलो भुम्युलिनतनयारो भागियो भानुपलयममयुल : 1
दिनकरदिवशोन जैयमानुलमयमयुल : शुफ्युलिनस्थुल : कारकाचणितमयमयुल 11211

The "Badhaka" (frustrative) planets are in the case of people with movable signs. The planets in the 11th house & the lord of the 11th house, for those having fixed signs as their Ascendants, the 9th house lord & the planets in the 9th house & for people having common signs as their Ascendant, the 7th house lord & the planets in the 7th house are Badhakas. The planets, lord of the sign occupied by the "Kharesh" (22nd decante) & Mandi are highly Badhakas (obstructive) karkas (significator) for the 12 houses are 1st house Sun, 2nd Jupiter, 3rd Mars, 4th Moon & Mercury 5th Jupiter, 6th Saturn & Mars 7th Venus 8th Saturn, 9th Sun & Jupiter

---

10th Jupiter, Sun & Mercury 11th Jupiter & 12th Saturn.

## TRANSLATOR'S NOTE

Karak for the 1st house is Sun both for health and honour. Karka i.e. significator for the 2nd house is Jupiter which means in financial matter. Significator for the 3rd house is Mars which has to be studied when considering younger brothers. Significator for the 4th house is Moon in respect of mother, & Mercury in respect of relatives other than our own family. We can include here Saturn as the significator of lands & Mars as the significator of built up property & Venus as the significator for conveyances. Jupiter is the significator for the 5th nouse as son. Saturn is significator for the 6th house as disease, white Mars is significator of enemies, litigation & injuries. Venus is the significator of 7th house as wife. Saturn is the significator of the 8th house as longevity. Sun is significator of the 9th house as tather & Jupiter as Guru & governmental favour, Sun is significator for the 10th house as "Ruling" powers. Jupiter & Mercury both can be considered as significators for acts of charity. Jupiter can be considered as significator for the 11th house both as the elder brother & as finances. Saturn can be considered as the significator for the 12th house as a "Separator".

Sun is significator for father, prowess, health, purity of mind,
liking, spiritual knowledge, Moon is the significator for white
coloured chonirie (an item of royal use) fame, pleasure, lustre of
body, beauty of face, mother, mind, & peace. (1-2) Mars is the
significator for bravery, victory, fame, battle, courage, generalship,
executive power, sword, parshu (axe) adha kunta (spear) kuthar,
guns, bhindpal, efficiency in use of bows & arrows, patience, glow
of face, seriousness, sex, anger, growth of enemies, argumentation,
bad name, freedom of self, the foster mother & earth. (3) Mercury
is the significator for progeny, peace of mind, humility, devotion,
intellect, uncles, relatives, community, prosperity of gotra (family
tree) mathematics, spiritual intellect, knowledge of Vedanta. (4)

Jupiter is the significator for:

Power of eloquence, Mantras (including advisory capacity)
management of governmental affairs, spiritually established.
elephants, horses, conveyances knowledge of Vedas, karma (good
& bad), son, wealth, means of livelihood, yoga, throne. (5) Venus is
significator for:

Music, literature, enjoyment of service of others, fine sexual
enjoyments of women and other amorous etc pleasures. Fine
beauty, ruling powers, charming influence, winning over the king.
Knowledge of magic, flowers, excelling others, yagic powers, all
types of wealth & power, enjoyments & wife. (6)

Saturn is significator of greed, attachment, cruel, tormentor of
others, adamant, ill-disposed, poverty, bad condition, disease,
wind, curt speech, buffalow, barley, black grains, longevity, means
of livelihood. (7) Rahu is significator of fame, honour, canopy
etc. (8)
